Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: kickserv_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Kickserv Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). login.hint: The **account slug** is the name right after `app.kickserv.com/` in your browser's address bar (on the old `<name>.kickservapp.com` address, it is that `<name>`). servers.name: LearnWorlds
servers.description: Check LearnWorlds courses, learners, progress, grades and payments, and enroll or tag users.

tools.name: learnworlds_list_courses
tools.title: List courses
tools.description: List the school's courses, newest first, 50 per page — title, price fields, access (paid/free/draft...), categories and author. A cheap way to confirm the credentials work. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/courses.

tools.name: learnworlds_get_course
tools.title: Get a course
tools.description: Fetch one course by id (its slug). LearnWorlds: GET /v2/courses/{id}.

tools.name: learnworlds_get_course_contents
tools.title: Get course contents
tools.description: The course outline: its sections (with drip-feed settings) and the learning activities (videos, PDFs, SCORM, assessments, certificates...) in each, with their ids. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/courses/{id}/contents.

tools.name: learnworlds_get_course_analytics
tools.title: Get course analytics
tools.description: Course-level analytics: students, learning units, average score and success rate, total study time, average time to finish, social interactions and certificates issued. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/courses/{id}/analytics.

tools.name: learnworlds_list_course_users
tools.title: List users enrolled in a course
tools.description: The users enrolled in one course, newest first (20 per page by default). LearnWorlds: GET /v2/courses/{id}/users.

tools.name: learnworlds_get_course_grades
tools.title: Get course grades
tools.description: Assessment grades of the users enrolled in a course — per user and learning unit, with submission time. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/courses/{id}/grades.

tools.name: learnworlds_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the school's users, newest first (20 per page by default), filterable by status, role, tags, registration date and custom fields. All filters are ANDed. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/users.

tools.name: learnworlds_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Fetch one user by id or email — profile, role, tags, sign-up fields, UTMs and last login. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/users/{id}.

tools.name: learnworlds_list_user_courses
tools.title: List a user's course enrollments
tools.description: The courses a user is enrolled in, with enrollment and expiry dates (50 per page). LearnWorlds: GET /v2/users/{id}/courses.

tools.name: learnworlds_get_user_course_progress
tools.title: Get a user's progress in a course
tools.description: A user's progress in one course — status, progress rate, average score, time on course, completed units, and a per-section / per-activity breakdown. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/users/{id}/courses/{cid}/progress.

tools.name: learnworlds_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List payments, newest first (50 per page by default) — product, price, discount, tax, coupon, affiliate, gateway and billing info. All filters are ANDed. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/payments.

tools.name: learnworlds_get_payment
tools.title: Get a payment
tools.description: Fetch one payment by payment id or transaction id. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/payments/{id}.

tools.name: learnworlds_list_certificates
tools.title: List certificates
tools.description: Certificates awarded, newest first (20 per page), for a course and/or a user — at least one of course_id or user_id is required. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/certificates.

tools.name: learnworlds_list_user_groups
tools.title: List user groups
tools.description: List the school's user groups (cohorts / B2B seats), newest first — title, products, group managers, capacity and tags. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/user_groups.

tools.name: learnworlds_list_event_logs
tools.title: List event logs
tools.description: The school's activity log (50 per page) — registrations, logins, purchases, enrollments, course completions, certificates, subscription changes and more, filterable by user, activity and time. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/event-logs.

tools.name: learnworlds_create_user

tools.description: WRITE: create a learner account. Deliberately no password or admin flag — set send_registration_email so the learner sets their own password. LearnWorlds: POST /v2/users.

tools.name: learnworlds_update_user

tools.name: learnworlds_enroll_user

servers.name: Little Green Light
servers.description: Search Little Green Light donors, gifts, notes and memberships, and add gifts and contact reports.

tools.name: lgl_search_constituents
tools.title: Search constituents
tools.description: Search active constituents (donors, members, volunteers, organizations). Give `name` and/or `email` for the common case, or raw `terms`. Available term fields: name, eaddr (email contains), phone_number, street, city, state (2-letter), postal_code, country, keyword (keyword id), updated_from / updated_to (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ), membership_status (0 lapsed, 1 active), membership_level (comma-separated ids), membership_end_date_from / _to (YYYY-MM-DD), external_id, constituent_type (0 individual, 1 organization), groups (comma-separated group ids), lists (comma-separated list ids), custom_attr (key|op|value). At least one term is required. LGL: GET /api/v1/constituents/search.

tools.name: lgl_get_constituent
tools.title: Get a constituent
tools.description: Full details for one constituent by LGL id: names, salutations, addresses, phone numbers, email addresses, groups, memberships and custom attributes. LGL: GET /api/v1/constituents/{id}.

tools.name: lgl_list_constituent_gifts
tools.title: List a constituent's gifts
tools.description: A constituent's giving history: every gift with amount, date, gift type, fund, campaign, appeal, event and payment type. LGL: GET /api/v1/constituents/{constituent_id}/gifts.

tools.name: lgl_search_gifts
tools.title: Search gifts
tools.description: Search active gifts across the account — e.g. everything received in a date range, or gifts to one fund or campaign. Give date/updated bounds and/or raw `terms`. Available term fields: date_from / date_to (YYYY-MM-DD), gift_types (in|ni + comma ids, e.g. in|1,7), gift_amount (gte|lte|btw|gt|lt|eq|ne + number[s], e.g. btw|100|1000), payment_types, campaigns, funds, appeals, events, categories (in|ni|bl + comma ids), appeal_types, event_types, constituent_type (0/1), gift_ids, external_gift_ids, created_from / created_to and updated_from / updated_to (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). At least one term is required. LGL: GET /api/v1/gifts/search.

tools.name: lgl_get_gift
tools.title: Get a gift
tools.description: Full details for one gift by id: amount, deductible amount, dates, fund/campaign/appeal/event, payment type, acknowledgment template, tribute and custom fields. LGL: GET /api/v1/gifts/{id}.

tools.name: lgl_list_constituent_notes
tools.title: List a constituent's notes
tools.description: Notes recorded on a constituent (type, text, original date). LGL: GET /api/v1/constituents/{constituent_id}/notes.

tools.name: lgl_list_constituent_contact_reports
tools.title: List a constituent's contact reports
tools.description: Contact reports (calls, emails, meetings) logged for a constituent, with type, date, text and team member. LGL: GET /api/v1/constituents/{constituent_id}/contact_reports.

tools.name: lgl_list_constituent_memberships
tools.title: List a constituent's memberships
tools.description: A constituent's memberships: level, start date and finish date — use it to see whether someone is current or lapsed. LGL: GET /api/v1/constituents/{constituent_id}/memberships.

tools.name: lgl_list_appeals
tools.title: List appeals
tools.description: Fundraising appeals (mailings, emails, asks) with campaign, date, financial goal, cost and active flag. Use the ids and names when recording gifts or filtering searches. LGL: GET /api/v1/appeals.

tools.name: lgl_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: Campaigns with start/end dates, financial goal, code and active flag. Use the ids and names when recording gifts or filtering searches. LGL: GET /api/v1/campaigns.

tools.name: lgl_list_funds
tools.title: List funds
tools.description: Funds (where gifts are designated) with campaign, code, financial goal and active flag. Use the ids and names when recording gifts or filtering searches. LGL: GET /api/v1/funds.

tools.name: lgl_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: Events (galas, lunches, board weekends) with dates, campaign, event type, goal and active flag. Use the ids and names when recording gifts or filtering searches. LGL: GET /api/v1/events.

tools.name: lgl_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: Constituent groups (e.g. Board Member, Staff, Volunteer) with their ids and keys. Use the ids and names when recording gifts or filtering searches. LGL: GET /api/v1/groups.

tools.name: lgl_list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: LGL user accounts on the team (name, email, admin flag) — the values a gift or contact report's team_member refers to. Use the ids and names when recording gifts or filtering searches. LGL: GET /api/v1/team_members.

tools.name: lgl_list_type_values
tools.title: List lookup values
tools.description: The account's configured lookup values for one type — the ids and names other tools accept. gift_types, payment_types and gift_categories come from their own endpoints (GET /api/v1/gift_types, /payment_types, /gift_categories — the last optionally filtered by gift_type_id); every other type from GET /api/v1/types/{type} (contact_report_types, note_types, appeal_types, event_types, email/phone/street/web address types, mailing_types, volunteering_categories, list_types).

tools.name: lgl_create_constituent
tools.title: Create a constituent
tools.description: WRITE: add a new constituent (person or organization) to the account, optionally with email addresses, phone numbers, street addresses and group memberships. LGL's schema marks first_name, last_name and email_addresses as required. Search first (lgl_search_constituents) to avoid creating a duplicate. LGL: POST /api/v1/constituents.

tools.name: lgl_update_constituent
tools.title: Update a constituent
tools.description: WRITE: change scalar fields on an existing constituent (name, salutation, job title, org name, deceased flag, etc.). Only the fields you pass are sent. LGL's update schema marks first_name and last_name as required, so pass the current values (from lgl_get_constituent) if you are not changing them. Addresses, emails and phones are not edited here. LGL: PATCH /api/v1/constituents/{id}.

tools.name: lgl_create_gift
tools.title: Record a gift
tools.description: WRITE: record a gift (donation, pledge payment, in-kind, etc.) on a constituent's record. This writes a CRM record of a gift that already happened — it does NOT charge a card or move money. Give gift_type_id or gift_type_name (required; see lgl_list_type_values type=gift_types). Fund, campaign, appeal, event, gift category and payment type may each be given by id or by exact name. Set ack_template_name to 'do_not_ack' to skip acknowledgment. LGL: POST /api/v1/constituents/{constituent_id}/gifts.

tools.name: lgl_create_note
tools.title: Add a note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a constituent's record. text and original_date are required; the note type may be given by id or name (e.g. 'General'; see lgl_list_type_values type=note_types). LGL: POST /api/v1/constituents/{constituent_id}/notes.

tools.name: lgl_create_contact_report
tools.title: Log a contact report
tools.description: WRITE: log a contact report (a call, email or meeting with a constituent). text is required; the type may be given by id or name (e.g. 'Call'; see lgl_list_type_values type=contact_report_types). LGL: POST /api/v1/constituents/{constituent_id}/contact_reports.
