tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Little Green Light Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run lgl_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: In Little Green Light go to **Settings → Integration settings → LGL API**. An account **administrator** generates the key there. If you don't see the LGL API link, API access isn't enabled for your account yet — ask LGL support (support@littlegreenlight.com) to turn it on. Your key is used only to call the LGL API on your behalf and to derive a private account id; it is never shown to anyone.

examples: Which gifts did we receive last month and from whom?
Show me Jane Smith's complete giving history.
Does Acme Ltd have an active membership, and when does it end?
Log a contact report that I met Jane Smith for coffee today.

servers.name: Loyverse
servers.description: Query Loyverse POS receipts, shifts, items, inventory and customers, and update stock and customers.

tools.name: loyverse_get_merchant
tools.title: Get the merchant
tools.description: Fetch the merchant account this token belongs to — business name, email, country and currency. A cheap way to confirm the token works. Loyverse: GET /merchant/.

tools.name: loyverse_list_stores
tools.title: List stores
tools.description: List the merchant's stores (locations) with their addresses. Store ids are what the receipt, shift and inventory filters take. Loyverse: GET /stores.

tools.name: loyverse_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List employees, with the stores each can access and whether they are the owner. Loyverse: GET /employees.

tools.name: loyverse_list_receipts
tools.title: List receipts
tools.description: List sales and refund receipts, newest first, with line items, payments, discounts and taxes. Filter by store, time range or receipt numbers — the core of any sales question. Loyverse: GET /receipts.

tools.name: loyverse_get_receipt
tools.title: Get one receipt
tools.description: Fetch a single receipt by its receipt number (e.g. 2-1008), with line items, modifiers, discounts, taxes and payments. Loyverse: GET /receipts/{receipt_number}.

tools.name: loyverse_list_shifts
tools.title: List shifts
tools.description: List cash-register shifts with their cash, gross/net sales, refunds, discounts, taxes, per-payment-type totals and pay-in/pay-out movements — the end-of-day view. Loyverse: GET /shifts.

tools.name: loyverse_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: List catalog items with their variants (SKU, barcode, price, cost, per-store pricing), category, taxes and modifiers. Loyverse: GET /items.

tools.name: loyverse_get_item
tools.title: Get one item
tools.description: Fetch a single catalog item by id, with its variants. Loyverse: GET /items/{item_id}.

tools.name: loyverse_list_variants
tools.title: List item variants
tools.description: List item variants — the sellable SKUs — optionally for given items or one SKU. Variant ids are what inventory levels are keyed on. Loyverse: GET /variants.

tools.name: loyverse_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List item categories. Loyverse: GET /categories.

tools.name: loyverse_list_inventory
tools.title: List inventory levels
tools.description: List current stock (`in_stock`) per variant per store. Filter by stores and/or variants — the answer to 'what is running low?'. Loyverse: GET /inventory.

tools.name: loyverse_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List loyalty customers, newest first, with visits, total spent and points balance. Filter by email or ids. Loyverse: GET /customers.

tools.name: loyverse_get_customer
tools.title: Get one customer
tools.description: Fetch a single customer by id, with visits, total spent and points balance. Loyverse: GET /customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: loyverse_list_payment_types
tools.title: List payment types
tools.description: List the payment types (cash, card, integrated terminals…) and the stores where each is available. Receipt payments reference these ids. Loyverse: GET /payment_types.

tools.name: loyverse_list_discounts
tools.title: List discounts
tools.description: List configured discounts (fixed/variable percent or amount, discount-by-points) and where they apply. Loyverse: GET /discounts.

tools.name: loyverse_list_taxes
tools.title: List taxes
tools.description: List taxes with their rate, whether they are INCLUDED in or ADDED to the price, and the stores they apply in. Loyverse: GET /taxes.

tools.name: loyverse_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers with their contact details. Loyverse: GET /suppliers/.

tools.name: loyverse_upsert_customer
tools.title: Create or update a customer
tools.description: Create a loyalty customer, or update one by passing its `id`. Loyverse does not document whether omitted fields survive an update, so on update fetch the customer first and send the full record. Loyverse: POST /customers.

tools.name: loyverse_upsert_category
tools.title: Create or update a category
tools.description: Create an item category, or rename/recolor one by passing its `id`. Loyverse: POST /categories.

tools.name: loyverse_upsert_supplier
tools.title: Create or update a supplier
tools.description: Create a supplier, or update one by passing its `id`. Loyverse does not document whether omitted fields survive an update, so on update send the full record. Loyverse: POST /suppliers/.

tools.name: loyverse_set_inventory_levels
tools.title: Set inventory levels
tools.description: Set the ABSOLUTE stock (`stock_after`) of one or more variants at given stores — e.g. after a stock count. This overwrites the current level rather than adding to it; read the current levels with loyverse_list_inventory first so they can be restored. Loyverse: POST /inventory.

tools.name: loyverse_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: loyverse_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Loyverse tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: loyverse_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Loyverse (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: loyverse_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Loyverse Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run loyverse_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: Create one in the Loyverse Back Office → **Integrations → Access tokens** → Add access token. Works on every Loyverse plan, including free. Your token is used only to call the API on your behalf and to derive a private account id; it is never shown to anyone.

examples: What were my total sales yesterday across all stores?
Show the first 25 stock records at my main store with current quantities.
Show my 25 newest loyalty customers with visits, spending and points.
Which cash register shifts opened last week, and what sales did each record?

servers.name: Momence
servers.description: Look up Momence members, class schedules, bookings and memberships, and handle front-desk actions.

tools.name: momence_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the logged-in user
tools.description: Return the staff user the API is acting as (userId, email, name). A cheap way to confirm the credentials work. Momence: GET /api/v2/auth/profile.

tools.name: momence_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List or search the studio's customers (members), with visit counts, custom fields and tags. Search by name, email or phone with `query`; use filterPreset=with-active-membership for current members. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/members.

tools.name: momence_get_member
tools.title: Get one member
tools.description: Fetch one customer by id: contact details, first/last seen, visit counts, custom fields and tags. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/members/{memberId}.

tools.name: momence_list_member_session_bookings
tools.title: List a member's class bookings
tools.description: List the class/session bookings of one member, with the session details and check-in state. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/members/{memberId}/sessions.

tools.name: momence_list_member_appointments
tools.title: List a member's appointments
tools.description: List the appointment reservations (1:1 services) of one member. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/members/{memberId}/appointments.

tools.name: momence_list_member_notes
tools.title: List a member's notes
tools.description: List the staff notes (regular and SOAP) recorded on one member. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/members/{memberId}/notes.

tools.name: momence_list_member_memberships
tools.title: List a member's active memberships
tools.description: List one member's active subscriptions and class packs (bought memberships): type, dates, credits left, usage limits and freeze state. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/members/{memberId}/bought-memberships/active.

tools.name: momence_list_sessions
tools.title: List sessions (classes)
tools.description: List the studio's scheduled sessions — classes, events, courses — with time, teacher, location, capacity and booking count. Filter by date window, type, teacher or location. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/sessions.

tools.name: momence_get_session
tools.title: Get one session
tools.description: Fetch one session's detail: times, capacity and booking count, waitlist capacity and count, teachers, location, online stream details and tags. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/sessions/{sessionId}.

tools.name: momence_list_session_bookings
tools.title: List a session's bookings (roster)
tools.description: List who is booked into one session — the class roster — with each booking's id, member, check-in state and recurring-booking id. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/sessions/{sessionId}/bookings.

tools.name: momence_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointment reservations
tools.description: List all appointment reservations across the studio (service, teacher, time, price, paid state, attendees). Momence: GET /api/v2/host/appointments/reservations.

tools.name: momence_list_memberships
tools.title: List membership plans
tools.description: List the membership plans the studio sells (subscriptions, class packs, money packs): pricing, duration, credits, usage limits, trial and intro-offer flags. Optionally only plans usable for a given session or appointment. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/memberships.

tools.name: momence_list_tags
tools.title: List customer tags
tools.description: List the customer tags defined for the studio (ids for momence_set_member_tag). Momence: GET /api/v2/host/tags.

tools.name: momence_list_customer_leads
tools.title: List customer leads
tools.description: List the studio's sales leads, open and converted (a non-null memberId means converted). Filter by search text, lead source or pipeline stage; resolve the ids with momence_list_lead_sources / momence_list_lead_stages. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/customer-leads.

tools.name: momence_list_lead_sources
tools.title: List lead sources
tools.description: List lead sources (resolves the sourceId on customer leads). Momence: GET /api/v2/host/customer-lead-sources.

tools.name: momence_list_lead_stages
tools.title: List lead stages
tools.description: List lead pipeline stages (resolves the stageId on customer leads). Momence: GET /api/v2/host/customer-lead-stages.

tools.name: momence_create_member
tools.title: Add a member
tools.description: Add a new customer to the studio. Returns the new memberId. Momence: POST /api/v2/host/members.

tools.name: momence_update_member
tools.title: Update a member's name, email or phone
tools.description: Correct a customer's contact details. Give firstName+lastName together to rename, and/or email, and/or phoneNumber; each is a separate Momence call (PUT /api/v2/host/members/{memberId}/name, /email, /phone-number) and they run in that order, stopping at the first failure.

tools.name: momence_set_member_tag
tools.title: Tag or untag a member
tools.description: Assign a customer tag to a member (assigned=true) or remove it (assigned=false). Fully reversible. Tag ids come from momence_list_tags. Momence: POST / DELETE /api/v2/host/members/{memberId}/tags/{tagId}.

tools.name: momence_book_member_free
tools.title: Book a member into a session for free
tools.description: Add a member to a session at no charge (a comp booking), optionally as a recurring booking for every occurrence of a recurring class. Returns the sessionBookingId. Undo with momence_cancel_session_booking. Momence: POST /api/v2/host/sessions/{sessionId}/bookings/free.

tools.name: momence_add_member_to_waitlist
tools.title: Add a member to a session waitlist
tools.description: Put a member on a session's waitlist. If a spot opens and they are booked from the waitlist, Momence uses the best matching bought membership unless you name specific ones in useBoughtMembershipIds. Returns the waitlistBookingId. Momence: POST /api/v2/host/sessions/{sessionId}/waitlist/bookings.

tools.name: momence_set_booking_check_in
tools.title: Check a booking in or out
tools.description: Mark a session booking as checked in (checkedIn=true) or undo the check-in (checkedIn=false). Booking ids come from momence_list_session_bookings. Momence: POST / DELETE /api/v2/host/session-bookings/{bookingId}/check-in.

tools.name: momence_cancel_session_booking
tools.title: Cancel one session booking
tools.description: Cancel a SINGLE session booking (not a recurring series). By default: NO refund, NOT treated as a late cancellation (no penalty), and the member IS notified. Set refund=true only to return the member's payment or credit; isLateCancellation=true applies the studio's late-cancel policy. Not undoable except by re-booking. Momence: DELETE /api/v2/host/session-bookings/{bookingId}.

tools.name: momence_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: momence_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Momence tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: momence_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Momence (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: momence_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Momence Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run momence_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: Your client id, client secret, email and password are stored **encrypted** in this connection's authorization grant and used **only** to sign in to Momence and call the Momence API on your behalf. They are never shown to anyone; the client id and email are also hashed into a private account id for usage metering.

examples: Who is booked into this evening's class?
What classes are on the schedule this week and how full are they?
Which memberships does Jane Smith have, and when do they end?
Check Jane Smith in for this morning's class.

servers.name: Moosend
servers.description: Inspect Moosend lists, subscribers, segments and campaign stats, and add or unsubscribe subscribers.

tools.name: moosend_list_mailing_lists
tools.title: List mailing lists
tools.description: List the active email (mailing) lists in the account with member counts (active, bounced, removed, unsubscribed), custom field definitions and preferences, plus paging info. A cheap way to confirm the API key works and to find list IDs. Moosend: GET /lists/{Page}/{PageSize}.json.

tools.name: moosend_get_mailing_list
tools.title: Get mailing list details
tools.description: Get one mailing list: name, member counts, status, custom field definitions (id, name, type, required), preferences and the latest import operation. Moosend: GET /lists/{MailingListID}/details.json.

tools.name: moosend_list_subscribers
tools.title: List subscribers in a list
tools.description: List the subscribers of one mailing list filtered by status (Subscribed, Unsubscribed, Bounced or Removed), with name, email, custom fields, tags, preferences and dates. Paged. Moosend: GET /lists/{MailingListID}/subscribers/{Status}.json.

tools.name: moosend_get_subscriber_by_email
tools.title: Find subscriber by email
tools.description: Look up a subscriber in one mailing list by email address: ID, name, status (SubscribeType 1 subscribed, 2 unsubscribed, 3 bounced, 4 removed), custom fields, tags and preferences. Moosend: GET /subscribers/{MailingListID}/view.json?Email=.

tools.name: moosend_get_subscriber
tools.title: Get subscriber by ID
tools.description: Get one subscriber in a mailing list by subscriber ID. Moosend: GET /subscribers/{MailingListID}/find/{SubscriberID}.json.

tools.name: moosend_list_segments
tools.title: List segments of a list
tools.description: List the segments of one mailing list, including their criteria, match type (0 all / 1 any) and a readable description. Moosend: GET /lists/{MailingListID}/segments.json.

tools.name: moosend_get_segment
tools.title: Get segment details
tools.description: Get one segment's details and criteria (not its members). Moosend: GET /lists/{MailingListID}/segments/{SegmentID}/details.json.

tools.name: moosend_list_segment_subscribers
tools.title: List segment subscribers
tools.description: List the subscribers that currently match one segment's criteria. Moosend: GET /lists/{MailingListID}/segments/{SegmentID}/members.json.

tools.name: moosend_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns with status (0 draft, 1 queued, 3 sent, 5 awaiting delivery, 6 sending, ...), delivery/schedule dates, target lists and headline stats (sent, opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes, complaints). Paged, up to 1000 per page. Moosend: GET /campaigns/{Page}/{PageSize}.json.

tools.name: moosend_get_campaign
tools.title: Get campaign details
tools.description: Get one campaign's details: subject, sender and reply-to, HTML and plain content, target lists/segments, schedule, status and A/B data. No statistics (use moosend_get_campaign_summary). Moosend: GET /campaigns/{CampaignID}/view.json.

tools.name: moosend_get_campaign_summary
tools.title: Get campaign summary
tools.description: Get a sent campaign's results to date: sent, total/unique opens, total/unique link clicks, bounces, complaints, forwards and unsubscribes. Moosend: GET /campaigns/{CampaignID}/view_summary.json.

tools.name: moosend_get_campaign_activity
tools.title: Get campaign recipient activity
tools.description: Per-recipient activity for a campaign by type: Sent, Opened, LinkClicked, Unsubscribed, Bounced, Complained, or Activity (all). Paged (default 50, max 1000) and filterable by date. NOTE: Moosend rate-limits this endpoint to 2 calls per 60 seconds per API key. Moosend: GET /campaigns/{CampaignID}/stats/{Type}.json.

tools.name: moosend_get_campaign_link_activity
tools.title: Get campaign link clicks
tools.description: List every link in a campaign with its total and unique click counts. Moosend: GET /campaigns/{CampaignID}/stats/links.json.

tools.name: moosend_get_campaign_activity_by_location
tools.title: Get campaign opens by country
tools.description: A campaign's total and unique opens broken down by country code. Moosend: GET /campaigns/{CampaignID}/stats/countries.json.

tools.name: moosend_list_senders
tools.title: List campaign senders
tools.description: List the account's campaign senders (name, email, enabled, SPF/DKIM verification). A draft campaign's sender and reply-to must be one of these. Moosend: GET /senders/find_all.json.

tools.name: moosend_create_mailing_list
tools.title: Create a mailing list
tools.description: WRITE: create a new, empty mailing list. Returns the new list's ID. Moosend: POST /lists/create.json.

tools.name: moosend_add_subscriber
tools.title: Add or update a subscriber
tools.description: WRITE: add one subscriber to a mailing list. If the email already exists in the list, that subscriber is UPDATED instead (and custom fields you omit are cleared). A previously unsubscribed address is re-subscribed. Rate limit 10 calls / 10 s. Moosend: POST /subscribers/{MailingListID}/subscribe.json.

tools.name: moosend_update_subscriber
tools.title: Update a subscriber
tools.description: WRITE: update one subscriber (by ID) in a mailing list — email, name, custom fields, tags, preferences. Include every custom field you want to keep. Moosend: POST /subscribers/{MailingListID}/update/{SubscriberID}.json.

tools.name: moosend_unsubscribe_subscriber
tools.title: Unsubscribe from a list
tools.description: WRITE: unsubscribe one email address from one mailing list (not account-wide). Undo by adding the subscriber again with moosend_add_subscriber. Moosend: POST /subscribers/{MailingListID}/unsubscribe.json.

tools.name: moosend_create_draft_campaign
tools.title: Create a draft campaign
tools.description: WRITE: create a regular (non-A/B) DRAFT campaign. It is NOT sent — sending stays a human action in Moosend. Give the content as html_content or a web_location URL. sender_email and reply_to_email must be senders in the account (see moosend_list_senders). Returns the new campaign's ID. Moosend: POST /campaigns/create.json.

tools.name: moosend_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: moosend_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Moosend tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: moosend_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Moosend (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: moosend_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Moosend Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run moosend_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: Find it in Moosend → **More → Settings → API key**. API access requires a paid plan (or the free trial), and the key can reach what its user's role allows. Your key is used only to call the Moosend API on your behalf and to derive a private account id; it is never shown to anyone.

examples: How did my last email campaign do on opens and clicks?
How many active subscribers are on each of my mailing lists?
Which links got the most clicks in my latest campaign?
Add jane@example.com as a subscriber to my newsletter list.

servers.name: OfficeRnD
servers.description: Browse OfficeRnD members, bookings, memberships, invoices and tickets, with optional write access.

tools.name: officernd_get_organization
tools.title: Get the organization
tools.description: Fetch the OfficeRnD organization these credentials belong to — name, slug and region. A cheap way to confirm the setup works. OfficeRnD: GET /api/v2/organizations/{orgSlug}.

tools.name: officernd_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the organization's locations (coworking spaces/buildings) with address, timezone and open/public flags. Location _ids are needed by most other filters and by officernd_create_member. OfficeRnD: GET /locations.

tools.name: officernd_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List members (people) of the workspace, filterable by exact email or name, location, company, status and creation/modification date. OfficeRnD: GET /members.

tools.name: officernd_get_member
tools.title: Get one member
tools.description: Fetch one member by _id — contact details, company, location, status, billing details and custom properties. OfficeRnD: GET /members/{memberId}.

tools.name: officernd_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List companies (teams/tenants renting space), filterable by exact name or _id, location and status. OfficeRnD: GET /companies.

tools.name: officernd_list_resources
tools.title: List resources
tools.description: List bookable/assignable resources — meeting rooms, desks, hot desks, private offices — with capacity, price, rate, floor and amenities. Resource _ids are needed by officernd_create_booking. OfficeRnD: GET /resources.

tools.name: officernd_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings: one entry per one-off booking and one per recurring series (first instance only). Filter by member, company, location, resource, series start window and status. For every individual occurrence in a date window use officernd_list_booking_occurrences. OfficeRnD: GET /bookings.

tools.name: officernd_list_booking_occurrences
tools.title: List booking occurrences
tools.description: List every individual booking occurrence between two times — one-off bookings plus each expanded instance of recurring series. The right tool for calendars, room availability and utilisation. Without pagination the window may be at most 1 year. OfficeRnD: GET /bookings/occurrences.

tools.name: officernd_get_booking
tools.title: Get one booking
tools.description: Fetch one booking by _id — resource, member/company, times, recurrence rule, fees, extras, visitors and status. OfficeRnD: GET /bookings/{bookingId}.

tools.name: officernd_list_memberships
tools.title: List memberships
tools.description: List memberships (recurring plans sold to members/companies) with plan, price, discount, start/end dates and calculated status. OfficeRnD: GET /memberships.

tools.name: officernd_list_contracts
tools.title: List contracts
tools.description: List contracts (agreements for plans and resources) with totals, dates, notice period, status and lifecycle stage — e.g. find contracts up for renewal or serving notice. OfficeRnD: GET /contracts.

tools.name: officernd_list_checkins
tools.title: List check-ins
tools.description: List member check-ins (who was on site, when, and via which booking or pass) — useful for occupancy and attendance. OfficeRnD: GET /checkins.

tools.name: officernd_list_payments
tools.title: List invoices and payments
tools.description: List billing documents — invoices, credit notes, overpayments — with totals, paid/pending amounts, due dates and status. Filter by member, company, location, document type, status, number and issue/due date (e.g. overdue invoices). OfficeRnD: GET /payments.

tools.name: officernd_list_tickets
tools.title: List helpdesk tickets
tools.description: List helpdesk tickets (member requests/issues) with subject, message, status (open/new/pending/resolved), priority, severity and assignee. OfficeRnD: GET /tickets.

tools.name: officernd_list_ticket_options
tools.title: List ticket options
tools.description: List the helpdesk ticket options — the configured types, priorities and severities (each with an _id, category and label). Their _ids are required by officernd_create_ticket. OfficeRnD: GET /ticket-options.

tools.name: officernd_create_member
tools.title: Create a member
tools.description: WRITE. Add a new member (person) to a location, optionally attached to a company. Needs scope flex.community.members.create. OfficeRnD: POST /members.

tools.name: officernd_update_member
tools.title: Update a member
tools.description: WRITE. Update a member's name, email, phone, start date, billing/contact flags, tags or custom properties. Only the fields you pass are changed; `tags` replaces the whole tag list. Needs scope flex.community.members.update. OfficeRnD: PUT /members/{memberId}.

tools.name: officernd_create_booking
tools.title: Create a booking
tools.description: WRITE. Book a resource (e.g. a meeting room) for a member and/or company. Unless is_free or is_tentative is set, the booking is charged per the resource's rate, and the member is notified unless is_silent. Needs scope flex.space.bookings.create. OfficeRnD: POST /bookings.

tools.name: officernd_create_ticket
tools.title: Open a helpdesk ticket
tools.description: WRITE. Open a helpdesk ticket on behalf of a member. type, priority and severity are ticket-option _ids from officernd_list_ticket_options. Needs scope flex.collaboration.tickets.create. OfficeRnD: POST /tickets.

tools.name: officernd_add_ticket_comment
tools.title: Comment on a ticket
tools.description: WRITE. Post a comment on a helpdesk ticket. Public comments are visible to the member; comments attributed to members must be public. Needs scope flex.collaboration.ticketComments.create. OfficeRnD: POST /ticket-comments/{ticketId}.

tools.name: officernd_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: officernd_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the OfficeRnD tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: officernd_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on OfficeRnD (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: officernd_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's OfficeRnD Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run officernd_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: Create an application in OfficeRnD → **Settings → Data & Extensibility → Developer Tools → Add application**, grant it the permissions you need, then click **View** to copy the client ID and client secret. The **organization slug** is under **Settings → My Account** (it's in the Admin Site / Members Portal URLs). Read + write needs the application to also have the create/update permissions for members, bookings, helpdesk tickets and ticket comments. Your credentials are used only to call the OfficeRnD API on your behalf and to derive a private account id; they are never shown to anyone.

examples: Which meeting rooms are booked tomorrow and by whom?
Which members have an active membership, and on which plans?
Show invoices that are still unpaid or pending.
Who checked in at our coworking space this week, and when?

servers.name: OptimoRoute
servers.description: Check OptimoRoute routes, orders and driver events, and create orders or start route planning.

tools.name: optimoroute_get_routes
tools.title: Get routes for a date
tools.description: Get the planned routes for one date: per driver/vehicle the duration, distance, loads and the ordered list of stops with scheduled times. Optionally filter to one driver or vehicle and include the encoded polyline, start/end locations and dispatch status. OptimoRoute: GET /get_routes.

tools.name: optimoroute_get_orders
tools.title: Get orders
tools.description: Fetch full order data (location, time windows, assignment, loads, skills, contact) for up to 500 orders by orderNo or id. Each result has its own success flag; missing orders come back with ERR_ORD_NOT_FOUND rather than failing the call. Read-only despite using POST. OptimoRoute: POST /get_orders.

tools.name: optimoroute_search_orders
tools.title: Search orders
tools.description: Find orders in a date range (at most 35 days) or by a list of orderNo/id, optionally filtered by status (e.g. failed, rejected, unscheduled), with order data and/or scheduling info. Up to 500 per page; pass the returned after_tag with the SAME other parameters to get the next page. Read-only despite using POST. OptimoRoute: POST /search_orders.

tools.name: optimoroute_get_scheduling_info
tools.title: Get an order's scheduling info
tools.description: Is this order scheduled, and if so on which driver/vehicle, at which stop number and time, plus the live ETA from the routes sent to drivers. Give orderNo or id. OptimoRoute: GET /get_scheduling_info.

tools.name: optimoroute_get_completion_details
tools.title: Get order completion details
tools.description: Get the completion status of up to 500 orders (unscheduled, scheduled, on_route, servicing, success, failed, rejected, cancelled) with service start/end times and positions, proof-of-delivery form data (notes, signature and photo URLs, barcodes), the tracking URL and optionally customer feedback. Read-only despite using POST. OptimoRoute: POST /get_completion_details.

tools.name: optimoroute_get_events
tools.title: Get mobile events
tools.description: Read driver-app events for the live routes — on_duty, off_duty, start_route, end_route, start_service, success, failed, rejected, start_time_changed — up to 500 per call. Pass the returned tag as after_tag next time to get only newer events; remainingEvents says whether more are waiting. Events can arrive out of order when devices were offline. OptimoRoute: GET /get_events.

tools.name: optimoroute_get_planning_status
tools.title: Get planning status
tools.description: Check a planning (route optimization) run started with optimoroute_start_planning: status N new, R running, C cancelled, F finished, E error, plus percentageComplete. OptimoRoute: GET /get_planning_status.

tools.name: optimoroute_get_dispatch_status
tools.title: Get dispatch status
tools.description: Have the routes (and customer notifications) for a date been sent to drivers, when, and are they the live routes? Optionally counts routes added, modified or removed since sending. Omit date for the currently live date. OptimoRoute: GET /get_dispatch_status.

tools.name: optimoroute_create_order
tools.title: Create or update an order
tools.description: Create one order, or update an existing one, with address geocoding. operation: CREATE (new; errors if orderNo exists), UPDATE (existing only), MERGE (create or update only the fields you send — safest for edits), SYNC (create or REPLACE all fields with what you send). CREATE/SYNC/MERGE of a new order need date, type, location and orderNo or id. A location is either an existing locationNo alone, an address to geocode, or latitude+longitude+locationName. OptimoRoute: POST /create_order.

tools.name: optimoroute_create_or_update_orders
tools.title: Create or update orders in bulk
tools.description: Create, update or replace up to 500 orders in one call. No geocoding here: each location must be an existing locationNo or carry latitude+longitude (+ locationNo, address or locationName). Per order, operation MERGE/SYNC/CREATE/UPDATE works as in optimoroute_create_order; by default an order matched by id or orderNo is updated with only the fields sent, otherwise created. Returns a per-order success list. OptimoRoute: POST /create_or_update_orders.

tools.name: optimoroute_start_planning
tools.title: Start route planning
tools.description: Start OptimoRoute's route optimization for a date (or a dateRange for weekly planning, if the plan allows). With the default startWith EMPTY, existing routes for that date are REPLACED; use startWith CURRENT (+ lockType) to keep them. Returns a planningId — poll it with optimoroute_get_planning_status, then read the result with optimoroute_get_routes. Can be cancelled with optimoroute_stop_planning. OptimoRoute: POST /start_planning.

tools.name: optimoroute_stop_planning
tools.title: Stop route planning
tools.description: Stop a running planning (optimization) process by its planningId. OptimoRoute: POST /stop_planning.

tools.name: optimoroute_update_driver_parameters
tools.title: Update a driver's parameters for a date
tools.description: Change one driver's setup for one date: enable/disable, work hours, assigned vehicle, vehicle capacities, start/end location. WARNING: any existing route for that driver on that date is UNSCHEDULED; re-run planning afterwards. Start/end locations also apply to future optimizations. OptimoRoute: POST /update_driver_parameters.

tools.name: optimoroute_update_completion_details
tools.title: Update order completion status
tools.description: Set the completion status of up to 500 orders (e.g. mark success, failed or cancelled from an external system), optionally with service start/end times. Each time takes unixTimestamp, utcTime or localTime. Reversible by setting the status again. Returns a per-order success list. OptimoRoute: POST /update_completion_details.

tools.name: optimoroute_send_routes
tools.title: Send routes to drivers
tools.description: Dispatch the routes for a date to the drivers' mobile app (the web app's Send Routes). This makes that date the live routes and CANNOT be unsent. sendNotifications defaults to FALSE here (OptimoRoute's own default is true); set it true only when you mean to email/SMS customers per the account's Order Tracking settings. Returns ERR_NOTHING_TO_SEND if nothing changed since the last send. Confirm with optimoroute_get_dispatch_status. OptimoRoute: POST /send_routes.

tools.name: optimoroute_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: optimoroute_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the OptimoRoute tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: optimoroute_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on OptimoRoute (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: optimoroute_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's OptimoRoute Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run optimoroute_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: Find it in the OptimoRoute web app → **Administration → Settings → WS API** (enable the WS API there; the key is generated for you — it needs an active trial or paid plan). Your key is used only to call the API on your behalf and to derive a private account id; it is never shown to anyone.

examples: Show the planned routes for tomorrow with distance and duration per driver.
Which orders are still unscheduled for this week?
Have tomorrow's routes been sent to the drivers yet?
Which of yesterday's deliveries were completed, and which failed?

servers.name: Paymo
servers.description: Browse Paymo projects, tasks, timesheets and invoices, and create tasks, log time or run timers.

tools.name: paymo_get_me
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Fetch the Paymo user the API key belongs to (id, name, type, timezone). Use the id as user_id for 'my' time entries and timers. A cheap way to confirm the key works. Paymo: GET /api/me.

tools.name: paymo_get_company
tools.title: Get company info
tools.description: Fetch the company (account) info and settings: name, default currency, timezone, working days, invoice numbering. Paymo: GET /api/company.

tools.name: paymo_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users in the company (id, name, email, type, hourly rate, assigned/managed projects). Paymo: GET /api/users.

tools.name: paymo_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List clients (id, name, contact details, active flag). Paymo: GET /api/clients.

tools.name: paymo_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects (id, name, code, client_id, active, billable, budget_hours, users, managers), optionally filtered. Paymo: GET /api/projects.

tools.name: paymo_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Fetch one project, optionally with related objects inline, e.g. include=tasklists.tasks for the whole task tree or include=client. Paymo: GET /api/projects/{id}.

tools.name: paymo_list_tasklists
tools.title: List task lists
tools.description: List task lists (id, name, project_id, milestone_id), e.g. to pick a tasklist_id when creating a task. Paymo: GET /api/tasklists.

tools.name: paymo_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks (id, name, code, project_id, tasklist_id, complete, due_date, users, priority), filtered by project, task list, assignee or completion. my_tasks=true returns the caller's 'My Tasks'. Paymo: GET /api/tasks.

tools.name: paymo_get_task
tools.title: Get a task
tools.description: Fetch one task, optionally with related objects: include=thread.comments for its comments, subtasks, entries (time logged), files, project. Paymo: GET /api/tasks/{id}.

tools.name: paymo_list_time_entries
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List time entries (id, task_id, user_id, project_id, start_time/end_time or date, duration in seconds, description, billed). At least one filter is required. from/to filter by the entry's time interval; running_only=true returns running timers. Paymo: GET /api/entries.

tools.name: paymo_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices (id, number, client_id, status, currency, date, due_date, subtotal, total). Paymo: GET /api/invoices.

tools.name: paymo_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Fetch one invoice with totals, and (by default) its line items and payments. Paymo: GET /api/invoices/{id}?include=invoiceitems,invoicepayments.

tools.name: paymo_list_expenses
tools.title: List expenses
tools.description: List expenses (id, client_id, project_id, user_id, amount, currency, date, notes, invoiced, tags). Paymo: GET /api/expenses.

tools.name: paymo_create_project
tools.title: Create a project
tools.description: Create a project. Note: if client_id is omitted Paymo auto-creates a 'Sample Client'. Free plans have an active-projects limit (403). Paymo: POST /api/projects.

tools.name: paymo_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create a task in a task list (tasklist_id) or a project (project_id — goes to its 'Default Task List'). Paymo: POST /api/tasks.

tools.name: paymo_update_task
tools.title: Update a task
tools.description: Update a task — rename, re-describe, reassign (users replaces the whole list), set due date or priority, mark complete/incomplete, move to another task list or workflow status. Only the fields given are changed. Paymo: PUT /api/tasks/{id}.

tools.name: paymo_create_time_entry
tools.title: Log time
tools.description: Log a completed time entry on a task, EITHER as date + duration_seconds OR as start_time + end_time (min 1 minute). To start a live timer use paymo_start_timer. Paymo: POST /api/entries.

tools.name: paymo_update_time_entry
tools.title: Update a time entry
tools.description: Edit a time entry: description, task, or its length. duration_seconds only applies to date+duration entries; for start/end entries change end_time instead. Paymo: PUT /api/entries/{id}.

tools.name: paymo_start_timer
tools.title: Start a timer
tools.description: Start a running timer on a task (a time entry with a start_time and no end_time). A user can have only one running timer; if one is running Paymo returns 409. Paymo: POST /api/entries.

tools.name: paymo_stop_timer
tools.title: Stop a timer
tools.description: Stop a running timer by setting its end_time (default: now). The final duration must be at least 1 minute. Find running timers with paymo_list_time_entries running_only=true. Paymo: PUT /api/entries/{id}.

tools.name: paymo_add_task_comment
tools.title: Comment on a task
tools.description: Add a comment to a task's discussion thread (content may contain basic HTML). Read existing comments with paymo_get_task include=thread.comments. Paymo: POST /api/comments.

tools.name: paymo_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: paymo_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Paymo tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: paymo_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Paymo (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: paymo_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Paymo Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run paymo_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: In Paymo, open **My account → API keys** and click **Generate new API key**. The key acts as you (your projects and permissions). It is used only to call the Paymo API on your behalf and to derive a private account id; it is never shown to anyone.

examples: How many hours did my team log last week across all projects?
Which tasks are overdue, and who are they assigned to?
Which invoices are still unpaid and for which clients?
Log 2 hours on the website redesign task for today.

servers.name: Printful
servers.description: Browse the Printful catalog, orders, shipping quotes and stats, and create draft orders and mockups.

tools.name: printful_list_stores
tools.title: List stores
tools.description: List the stores this token can reach (id, name, platform type). A cheap way to confirm the token works, and where to find the store_id an ACCOUNT-level token needs. Printful: GET /stores.

tools.name: printful_list_catalog_categories
tools.title: List catalog categories
tools.description: List Printful's catalog categories (T-shirts, Mugs, Posters…) with their ids and parent ids — the filter for printful_list_catalog_products. Printful: GET /categories.

tools.name: printful_list_catalog_products
tools.title: List catalog products
tools.description: List the blank products Printful can print on (id, title, brand, model, variant count, print-file placements), optionally filtered by category. Printful: GET /products.

tools.name: printful_get_catalog_product
tools.title: Get a catalog product
tools.description: Fetch one catalog product with ALL its variants (size, color, variant_id, price, stock). Use the variant_id values when quoting shipping or building an order. Printful: GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: printful_get_catalog_variant
tools.title: Get a catalog variant
tools.description: Fetch one catalog variant and its parent product. Printful: GET /products/variant/{id}.

tools.name: printful_list_store_products
tools.title: List store products (Manual/API store)
tools.description: List the Sync Products in a Manual-order / API store. For a Shopify, Etsy, WooCommerce or other integrated store use printful_list_sync_products instead. Printful: GET /store/products.

tools.name: printful_get_store_product
tools.title: Get a store product (Manual/API store)
tools.description: Fetch one product of a Manual-order / API store with all its Sync Variants — catalog variant, print files, retail price. For a Shopify, Etsy, WooCommerce or other integrated store use printful_get_sync_product instead. Printful: GET /store/products/{id}.

tools.name: printful_list_sync_products
tools.title: List synced products (integrated store)
tools.description: List the products Printful has imported from an integrated store (Shopify, Etsy, WooCommerce…), with how many variants are synced. Filter by status=unsynced to find products that still need a design or catalog variant. Printful: GET /sync/products.

tools.name: printful_get_sync_product
tools.title: Get a synced product (integrated store)
tools.description: Fetch one product imported from an integrated store (Shopify, Etsy, WooCommerce…) with all its Sync Variants — catalog variant, print files, retail price, sync status. Ids come from printful_list_sync_products. Printful: GET /sync/products/{id}.

tools.name: printful_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List the store's orders, newest first, optionally by status (draft, pending, failed, canceled, inprocess, onhold, partial, fulfilled, archived). Printful: GET /orders.

tools.name: printful_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Fetch one order: status, recipient, items, costs, and shipments with carrier and tracking links — the answer to 'where is my order?'. Printful: GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: printful_calculate_shipping_rates
tools.title: Calculate shipping rates
tools.description: Quote the shipping options (method id, name, rate, delivery-day estimate) for a set of items to an address. Only country_code is required (plus state_code for US/CA/AU). Changes nothing. Printful: POST /shipping/rates.

tools.name: printful_estimate_order_costs
tools.title: Estimate order costs
tools.description: Price an order WITHOUT creating it: item, print, shipping and tax costs, plus retail totals. Same item shape as printful_create_draft_order. Changes nothing. Printful: POST /orders/estimate-costs.

tools.name: printful_get_file
tools.title: Get a file
tools.description: Fetch one File Library entry — processing status (ok / waiting / failed), dimensions, DPI and preview URLs. Poll this after printful_add_file. Printful: GET /files/{id}.

tools.name: printful_get_printfiles
tools.title: Get printfile specs for a product
tools.description: List the print areas (placements) and required print-file pixel sizes/DPI for each variant of a catalog product — what a design must match before mockups or orders. DTG is assumed unless technique is given. Printful: GET /mockup-generator/printfiles/{id}.

tools.name: printful_get_mockup_task
tools.title: Get a mockup task result
tools.description: Check a mockup-generation task: status (pending / completed / failed) and, when done, the mockup image URLs per placement and variant. Printful: GET /mockup-generator/task.

tools.name: printful_get_statistics
tools.title: Get store statistics
tools.description: Sales, costs, profit and order-count reports for a period of at most 6 months. Printful: GET /reports/statistics.

tools.name: printful_create_draft_order
tools.title: Create a draft order
tools.description: Create an order as a DRAFT — nothing is charged or produced. It must be confirmed later in the Printful dashboard, where the charge is shown. Each item needs one of variant_id (+ files), sync_variant_id, external_variant_id, warehouse_product_variant_id or product_template_id (+ variant_id). Printful: POST /orders (never with confirm).

tools.name: printful_update_draft_order
tools.title: Update a draft order
tools.description: Change a DRAFT order (unsubmitted orders only) — send only the fields to change. CAUTION: if you send `items`, it replaces the list: existing items not included (by id or external_id) are removed. The order stays a draft; nothing is charged. Printful: PUT /orders/{id} (never with confirm).

tools.name: printful_add_file
tools.title: Add a file to the File Library
tools.description: Add a print file to the File Library from a public URL (PNG/JPG recommended). If a file with the same URL already exists it is returned instead. Processing is async — poll printful_get_file until status is ok. Printful: POST /files.

tools.name: printful_create_mockup_task
tools.title: Create a mockup generation task
tools.description: Start generating product mockups for a design on a catalog product — returns a task_key; poll printful_get_mockup_task for the images. Heavily rate-limited (about 10/min for established stores, 2/min for new ones). Printful: POST /mockup-generator/create-task/{id}.

tools.name: printful_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: printful_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Printful tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: printful_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Printful (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: printful_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Printful Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run printful_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

fields.label: Store ID (needed only for an account-level token)

login.hint: Create the token at [developers.printful.com](https://developers.printful.com) → **Your tokens → Create**, with the scopes you need (`stores_list`, `orders`, `sync_products`, `file_library`…). Private Tokens **expire** and can't be refreshed — when yours lapses, create a new one and reconnect.

examples: Which of my orders are still pending, and what is each one's status?
What were my sales, costs and profit over the last 3 months?
Quote shipping for one mug using catalog variant ID 1234 to Texas.
Which of my store's orders have shipped, with tracking numbers?

servers.name: Recruitee
servers.description: Search Recruitee candidates, jobs, pipelines and interviews, and add notes, tags and tasks.

tools.name: recruitee_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Fetch the Recruitee user the API token belongs to — name, email, role, role abilities and company id. A cheap way to confirm the token and company id are right. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/admin.

tools.name: recruitee_list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List the company's team members (memberships): admin_id, role, whether they are a recruiter or hiring manager, and the jobs they can access. Use admin_id values for task assignees and filters. User names/emails are in the `references` array. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/memberships.

tools.name: recruitee_search_candidates
tools.title: Search candidates
tools.description: Search the company's candidates with Recruitee's candidate search (the same engine as the app's filters). `query` is a free-text search across name, emails, phones, tags, sources, job assignments, current stage, cover letter and CV content. `filters` accepts Recruitee filter objects verbatim, e.g. {"field":"created_at","gte":1548975600} (Unix seconds), {"field":"has_cv","eq":true}, {"filter":"tags","id":{"in":[12]}}, {"filter":"stages","name":{"in":["Phone interview"]}}. Returns `hits` (with each candidate's placements: job + current stage) and `total`. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/search/new/candidates.

tools.name: recruitee_list_candidates
tools.title: List candidates
tools.description: List candidates, newest first, optionally narrowed to one job, a name/job search, qualified or disqualified only, specific ids, or those created after a date. Paginate with limit + offset (next offset = offset + limit). Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/candidates.

tools.name: recruitee_get_candidate
tools.title: Get one candidate
tools.description: Fetch one candidate's full profile: contact details, sources, tags, cover letter, CV URL, custom fields, ratings, and `placements` — one per job they are on, each with its placement id and current stage. The placement id is what recruitee_move_candidate_stage needs. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/candidates/{id}.

tools.name: recruitee_list_candidate_notes
tools.title: List a candidate's notes
tools.description: List the notes on a candidate's profile, with replies, author admin_id and visibility. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/candidates/{candidate_id}/notes.

tools.name: recruitee_list_offers
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List the company's jobs (Recruitee calls them offers) with id, title, status, slug, department_id, recruiter_id, hiring_manager_id and pipeline_template_id. Filter by status, department, location, recruiter, hiring manager, tag and more; add heavy fields with `include` (e.g. counters for candidate counts, description, salary, location_ids). Paginated with limit + page (default 1000 per page); `meta.total_count` gives the total. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/offers.

tools.name: recruitee_get_offer
tools.title: Get one job
tools.description: Fetch one job or talent pool by id with its full details: description, requirements, location, salary, employment type, candidate counters and pipeline_template_id. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/offers/{id}.

tools.name: recruitee_get_pipeline_template
tools.title: Get a hiring pipeline
tools.description: Fetch a pipeline template with its ordered stages (id, name, group, category). A job's `pipeline_template_id` (from recruitee_list_offers / recruitee_get_offer) names its pipeline; the stage ids here are what recruitee_move_candidate_stage takes. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/pipeline_templates/{id}.

tools.name: recruitee_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List the company's departments with their ids and job counts. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/departments.

tools.name: recruitee_list_tags
tools.title: List candidate tags
tools.description: List the company's candidate tags with ids and usage counts. Tag ids are used in recruitee_search_candidates filters. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/tags.

tools.name: recruitee_list_disqualify_reasons
tools.title: List disqualify reasons
tools.description: List the company's configured disqualification reasons (id, name, position). Useful for reading why candidates were disqualified. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/disqualify_reasons.

tools.name: recruitee_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List recruiting tasks (title, description, due date, completed, candidate_id). With candidate_id, lists that candidate's tasks (Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/candidates/{candidate_id}/tasks — only `status` applies). Otherwise lists company tasks with scope, assignee, sorting and paging (Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/tasks).

tools.name: recruitee_list_interview_events
tools.title: List interviews
tools.description: List scheduled interview events (candidate_id, offer_id, stage_id, start time, duration, location, attendees). Defaults to upcoming events for the whole company; narrow by candidate, date range or interviewer. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/interview/events.

tools.name: recruitee_list_evaluations
tools.title: List evaluations
tools.description: List interview results — evaluations (rating + note) and questionnaire scorecards — optionally for one candidate or by selected reviewers. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/interview/results.

tools.name: recruitee_create_candidate
tools.title: Create a candidate
tools.description: WRITE: add a candidate manually (as if a recruiter added them in the app — no auto-confirmation email is sent), optionally assigning them straight to one or more jobs in the job's default stage. Recruitee: POST /c/{company_id}/candidates.

tools.name: recruitee_update_candidate
tools.title: Update a candidate
tools.description: WRITE: update a candidate's name or contact details. Only the fields you pass change; list fields (emails, phones, links) REPLACE the existing list, so pass the full list you want. Recruitee: PATCH /c/{company_id}/candidates/{id}.

tools.name: recruitee_add_candidate_note
tools.title: Add a note to a candidate
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a candidate's profile, visible to the team. Recruitee: POST /c/{company_id}/candidates/{candidate_id}/notes.

tools.name: recruitee_add_candidate_tags
tools.title: Tag a candidate
tools.description: WRITE: add one or more tags to a candidate (existing tags are reused by name; new names create new tags). Recruitee: POST /c/{company_id}/candidates/{candidate_id}/tags.

tools.name: recruitee_assign_candidate_to_offer
tools.title: Add a candidate to a job
tools.description: WRITE: put an existing candidate on a job (or talent pool) — creates a placement in the pipeline's first stage. Pass exactly one of offer_id or talent_pool_id. Recruitee: POST /c/{company_id}/placements.

tools.name: recruitee_move_candidate_stage
tools.title: Move a candidate to another stage
tools.description: WRITE: move a candidate to another stage of a job's pipeline. Takes the PLACEMENT id (from recruitee_get_candidate → placements[].id, one per job) and the destination stage id (from recruitee_get_pipeline_template). Moving to a 'hired' stage also requires work_location_id. Stage automations configured in Recruitee may run. Undo by moving back. Recruitee: PATCH /c/{company_id}/placements/{id}/change_stage.

tools.name: recruitee_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: WRITE: create a recruiting task, optionally about a candidate, assigned to team members (admin ids from recruitee_list_team_members), with an optional due date. Recruitee: POST /c/{company_id}/tasks.

tools.name: recruitee_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: recruitee_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Recruitee tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: recruitee_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Recruitee (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: recruitee_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Recruitee Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run recruitee_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: Both are in Recruitee → **Settings → Apps and plugins → Personal API tokens**: create a token there, and the company ID is shown on the same page. The token acts with your own user's role permissions. Your credentials are used only to call the Recruitee API on your behalf and to derive a private account id; they are never shown to anyone.

examples: Which candidates applied to my open sales role this week?
Which interviews are scheduled for the next few days?
Show me the notes on candidate Jane Smith.
Add a note to Jane Smith's profile saying she is available from June 1.

servers.name: Rewardful
servers.description: Browse affiliates, referrals, commissions and payouts, and set up campaigns and affiliates.

tools.name: rewardful_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List the affiliate program's campaigns with their reward rules (percent or fixed commission, payout minimum, referral expiry) and totals (visitors, leads, conversions, affiliates). Rewardful: GET /v1/campaigns.

tools.name: rewardful_get_campaign
tools.title: Get one campaign
tools.description: Fetch a single campaign by id. Rewardful: GET /v1/campaigns/:id.

tools.name: rewardful_list_affiliates
tools.title: List affiliates
tools.description: List affiliates, newest first, with visitors/leads/conversions. Filter by campaign, or look one up by email or Stripe customer id (returns zero or one). Expand campaign, links or commission_stats for more detail. Rewardful: GET /v1/affiliates.

tools.name: rewardful_get_affiliate
tools.title: Get one affiliate
tools.description: Fetch a single affiliate by id, including their campaign, links, coupon and visitor/lead/conversion counts. Rewardful: GET /v1/affiliates/:id.

tools.name: rewardful_list_affiliate_links
tools.title: List affiliate links
tools.description: List affiliate links (URL, token, visitors, leads, conversions, affiliate_id), newest first. Rewardful: GET /v1/affiliate_links.

tools.name: rewardful_get_affiliate_link
tools.title: Get one affiliate link
tools.description: Fetch a single affiliate link by id. Rewardful: GET /v1/affiliate_links/:id.

tools.name: rewardful_list_affiliate_coupons
tools.title: List affiliate coupons
tools.description: List affiliate coupon / promotion codes (token, Stripe id, leads, conversions, archived), optionally for one affiliate. Rewardful: GET /v1/affiliate_coupons.

tools.name: rewardful_get_affiliate_coupon
tools.title: Get one affiliate coupon
tools.description: Fetch a single affiliate coupon by id. Rewardful: GET /v1/affiliate_coupons/:id.

tools.name: rewardful_list_referrals
tools.title: List referrals
tools.description: List referrals — visitors who arrived via an affiliate link — newest first, with their conversion state (visitor, lead, conversion), customer and link. Filter by affiliate, state, email, Stripe customer or an updated-at window. Rewardful: GET /v1/referrals.

tools.name: rewardful_list_commissions
tools.title: List commissions
tools.description: List commissions (rewards owed for referred customers' payments) newest first, with amount in cents, currency and state (pending, due, paid, voided). Filter by affiliate or state; expand the sale (with referral, customer and affiliate) or campaign. Rewardful: GET /v1/commissions.

tools.name: rewardful_get_commission
tools.title: Get one commission
tools.description: Fetch a single commission by id, with its campaign and the sale (charge, refund and tax amounts, referral, customer, affiliate) that earned it. Rewardful: GET /v1/commissions/:id.

tools.name: rewardful_list_payouts
tools.title: List payouts
tools.description: List payouts — bundles of an affiliate's payable commissions — newest first, with amount, currency and state (pending, due, processing, paid). Filter by affiliate or state; expand affiliate or commissions. Rewardful: GET /v1/payouts.

tools.name: rewardful_get_payout
tools.title: Get one payout
tools.description: Fetch a single payout by id, with the affiliate and the commissions it bundles. Rewardful: GET /v1/payouts/:id.

tools.name: rewardful_create_campaign
tools.title: Create a campaign
tools.description: Create a new affiliate campaign with its reward rule. For reward_type percent pass commission_percent; for amount pass commission_amount_cents and commission_amount_currency. Rewardful: POST /v1/campaigns.

tools.name: rewardful_update_campaign
tools.title: Update a campaign
tools.description: Change a campaign's name, URL, visibility, reward rule, payout minimum or coupon. Only the fields you pass change. Rewardful: PUT /v1/campaigns/:id.

tools.name: rewardful_create_affiliate
tools.title: Create an affiliate
tools.description: Add an affiliate (or a customer referrer, by passing stripe_customer_id). Rewardful sends NO welcome email for API-created affiliates. Rewardful: POST /v1/affiliates.

tools.name: rewardful_update_affiliate
tools.title: Update an affiliate
tools.description: Change an affiliate's name, email, payout emails, notifications, campaign (moves them) or state. Setting state to disabled stops tracking and earning; set it back to active to undo. Rewardful: PUT /v1/affiliates/:id.

tools.name: rewardful_create_affiliate_link
tools.title: Create an affiliate link
tools.description: Give an affiliate an additional tracking link. A token is generated if omitted. Growth/Enterprise plans only. Rewardful: POST /v1/affiliate_links.

tools.name: rewardful_update_affiliate_link
tools.title: Change an affiliate link's token
tools.description: Change the token of an existing affiliate link. WARNING: the old token stops tracking immediately — links already shared with it break. Prefer rewardful_create_affiliate_link to add a second token. Rewardful: PUT /v1/affiliate_links/:id.

tools.name: rewardful_create_affiliate_coupon
tools.title: Create an affiliate coupon
tools.description: Assign a coupon / promotion code to an affiliate so sales using it are credited to them. The code must match one defined in Stripe, and the affiliate's campaign must have a campaign coupon set in the dashboard. Rewardful: POST /v1/affiliate_coupons.

tools.name: rewardful_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: rewardful_request_feature
