servers.name: Airbrake
servers.description: Read Airbrake projects, error groups, notices, deploys and stats; mute or unmute error groups.

tools.name: airbrake_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the Airbrake projects your user can see, with id, name, last deploy, notice total, rejected count, deploy count and resolved/unresolved error-group counts. Start here to get a project_id. Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects.

tools.name: airbrake_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Get one Airbrake project: name, last deploy id/time, notice total, rejection count, deploy count and resolved/unresolved error-group counts. Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects/{project_id}.

tools.name: airbrake_list_groups
tools.title: List error groups
tools.description: List a project's error groups ("errors" in the Airbrake app): each with id, resolved flag, error type/message/backtrace, context (environment, severity, component/action), last notice time, notice counts and last deploy. Sorted by last notice by default; order by notice_count, weight or created instead. Filter by deploy, archived or muted groups, or creation time. Backtraces are cut to the first 5 frames (set full_backtraces for all; airbrake_get_group shows one group in full). Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/groups.

tools.name: airbrake_get_group
tools.title: Get an error group
tools.description: Get one error group in full: resolved flag, every error with its complete backtrace (file, function, line, column), context, last deploy, last notice id/time, notice counts and creation time. Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/groups/{group_id}.

tools.name: airbrake_get_group_stats
tools.title: Get error group statistics
tools.description: Occurrence counts over time for one error group: parallel arrays `time`, `accepted` (notices counted) and `limited` (dropped by rate limits), aggregated per period, from `since` until `until` (default now). Use it to see whether an error is spiking or fading. Airbrake API: GET /api/v5/projects/{project_id}/groups/{group_id}/stats.

tools.name: airbrake_list_notices
tools.title: List notices of an error group
tools.description: List the individual occurrences (notices) of one error group, newest first: each with id, deploy, errors and backtrace, context (environment, hostname, app version, user, URL, severity, notifier), environment, session and request params, and created time. Optionally only notices of one app version. Backtraces are cut to the first 10 frames unless full_backtraces is set. Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/groups/{group_id}/notices.

tools.name: airbrake_get_notice_status
tools.title: Get a notice's processing status
tools.description: Check what happened to a reported error, by the notice id that Airbrake's create-notice API returned: code = processed (groupId = its error group), rejected (message = why, e.g. an app-version filter), archived (past retention) or not_found (unknown or still processing). Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/notice-status/{notice_id}.

tools.name: airbrake_list_deploys
tools.title: List deploys
tools.description: List a project's tracked deploys: environment, username/email of the deployer, repository, revision (commit) and version. Use it to correlate new errors with a release. Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/deploys.

tools.name: airbrake_get_deploy
tools.title: Get a deploy
tools.description: Get one deploy: environment, deployer, repository, revision and version. Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/deploys/{deploy_id}.

tools.name: airbrake_list_activities
tools.title: List project activity
tools.description: List a project's activity feed: who did what and when (for example group.resolved), with user name, activity, the affected object (trackableType/trackableId) and timestamps. Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/activities.

tools.name: airbrake_get_project_stats
tools.title: Get project statistics
tools.description: Error volume over time for a whole project: parallel arrays `time`, `accepted` (notices counted), `limited` (dropped by rate limits) and `overQuota` (dropped over the plan quota), aggregated per period (1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 2h, 3h, 6h, 12h, 24h). Airbrake API: GET /api/v5/projects/{project_id}/stats.

tools.name: airbrake_mute_group
tools.title: Mute an error group
tools.description: WRITE: mute one error group. Airbrake removes it from the default error list and stops ALL notifications for it (email, Slack and other integrations) until it is unmuted. Notices are still recorded. Reversible with airbrake_unmute_group. Airbrake API: PUT /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/groups/{group_id}/muted.

tools.name: airbrake_unmute_group
tools.title: Unmute an error group
tools.description: WRITE: unmute one error group, so it is back in the default error list and its notifications resume. Airbrake API: PUT /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/groups/{group_id}/unmuted.

tools.name: airbrake_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

Does not count against the meter.

tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Airbrake (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: airbrake_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Airbrake Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). login.hint: Find it in Airbrake → your avatar (top right) → **Profile** → **User API key**. Use the permanent User API key: a project key can only report errors, and a temporary user token expires. Your key is used only to call the Airbrake API on your behalf and to derive a private account id; it is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: churchsuite_list_contacts

tools.name: churchsuite_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact

tools.name: churchsuite_list_children

tools.name: churchsuite_get_child

tools.name: churchsuite_list_children_groups

tools.name: churchsuite_list_small_groups

tools.name: churchsuite_get_small_group

tools.name: churchsuite_list_small_group_members

tools.name: churchsuite_get_event

tools.name: churchsuite_list_event_categories

tools.name: churchsuite_list_ministries

tools.name: churchsuite_list_ministry_teams
tools.title: List ministry teams

tools.name: churchsuite_list_ministry_members

tools.name: churchsuite_list_unavailability

tools.name: churchsuite_list_attendance_records

login.hint: A ChurchSuite administrator enables **API access** on a user profile (Account Settings → **Users**; a dedicated user for this integration is best). That API user then generates a **client secret** and copies its client ID. The user's ChurchSuite permissions decide which modules this server can see, so grant only what you need. API access may depend on your ChurchSuite plan. Your credentials are used only to call the ChurchSuite API on your behalf; your account is identified by your church's ChurchSuite account id.

examples: Which small groups meet on Wednesdays, and where and when?
Who serves in our welcome team ministry?
How many people attended our services over the last month?
Add a note to Jane Smith's record: visited her at home today.

servers.name: Cin7 Core
servers.description: Read Cin7 Core products, stock by location, sales, purchases, customers, suppliers and transfers.

tools.name: cin7core_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: The Cin7 Core company these credentials belong to: company name, base currency, time zone, default weight/dimension units, lock date and tax calculation method. Good first call. GET /me.

tools.name: cin7core_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List stock locations (warehouses) with their id, name, default flag, address, bins and pick zones. Location names are what the stock-availability and sale/purchase tools use. GET /ref/location.

tools.name: cin7core_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products (active by default): id, SKU, name, category, brand, type (Stock/Service), costing method, unit of measure, barcode, price tiers, average cost, reorder settings, status and description. Filter by name or SKU (contains) or by modification date. GET /product.

tools.name: cin7core_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One product by id (including deprecated ones) with its full detail; optionally its bill of materials, suppliers, stock movements, attachments, reorder levels and customer-specific prices. GET /product?ID=…

tools.name: cin7core_get_stock_availability
tools.title: Get stock availability
tools.description: Stock levels per product, location, bin and batch: on hand, allocated, available, on order, in transit, stock on hand value and next delivery date. Filter by product id, name (starts with), exact SKU, location name, batch/serial number or category. GET /ref/productavailability.

tools.name: cin7core_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (active by default): id, name, display name, currency, payment term, tax rule, price tier, sales rep, location, credit limit and hold, status, addresses and contacts. Filter by name (starts with), contact name/email, or modification date. GET /customer.

tools.name: cin7core_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer by id (including deprecated ones), optionally with its customer-specific product prices. GET /customer?ID=…

tools.name: cin7core_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers (active by default): id, name, currency, payment term, tax rule, discount, status, addresses and contacts. Filter by name (starts with) or modification date. GET /supplier.

tools.name: cin7core_get_supplier
tools.title: Get supplier
tools.description: One supplier by id (including deprecated ones). GET /supplier?ID=…

tools.name: cin7core_list_sales
tools.title: List sales
tools.description: List sales (sale orders) with order number, status, customer, order/invoice dates, invoice and paid amounts, currencies, and the quote/order/pick/pack/ship/invoice/payment statuses. Search by order number, customer, invoice number or customer reference; filter by dates and statuses. GET /saleList.

tools.name: cin7core_get_sale
tools.title: Get sale
tools.description: One sale by id with everything on it: customer, contact, addresses, terms, location, notes, quote, order lines, fulfilments (pick/pack/ship and tracking), invoices, credit notes, payments, attachments and inventory movements. GET /sale?ID=…

tools.name: cin7core_list_purchases
tools.title: List purchases
tools.description: List purchases (purchase orders) with order number, status, supplier, order/invoice/required-by dates, invoice and paid amounts, currencies, type (simple/advanced/service) and the order/receiving/invoice/payment statuses. GET /purchaseList.

tools.name: cin7core_get_purchase
tools.title: Get purchase
tools.description: One purchase by id (simple, advanced or service purchase): supplier, contact, addresses, terms, location, required-by date, note, order lines, stock received, put away, invoices, credit notes, payments and attachments. GET /advanced-purchase?ID=… (the vendor endpoint that serves every purchase type).

tools.name: cin7core_list_stock_adjustments
tools.title: List stock adjustments
tools.description: List stock adjustments: task id, number, effective date, status, expense account, reference and comment. GET /stockadjustmentList.

tools.name: cin7core_get_stock_adjustment
tools.title: Get stock adjustment
tools.description: One stock adjustment by task id with its lines (product, location, batch, quantity, unit cost) and transactions. GET /stockadjustment?TaskID=…

tools.name: cin7core_list_stock_transfers
tools.title: List stock transfers
tools.description: List stock transfers between locations: task id, number, from/to location, status, departure and completion dates, reference. GET /stockTransferList.

tools.name: cin7core_get_stock_transfer
tools.title: Get stock transfer
tools.description: One stock transfer by task id with its lines (product, quantity, from/to bin, batch) and status. GET /stockTransfer?TaskID=…

tools.name: cin7core_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: cin7core_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Cin7 Core tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: cin7core_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Cin7 Core (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: cin7core_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Cin7 Core Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run cin7core_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: In Cin7 Core (formerly DEAR Inventory) go to **Integrations → API** (inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalAPI), add an API Application if you have none, and copy the Account ID and the Key. Each company has its own Account ID. The API allows 60 calls per minute per application. Your credentials are used only to call the Cin7 Core API on your behalf; they are never shown to anyone.

examples: How much stock do we have of each product at each location?
Which sales orders are still open for Acme Ltd?
Which purchase orders are still waiting to be received from suppliers?
Which stock transfers between our warehouses are still in transit?

servers.name: Connecteam
servers.description: Read Connecteam users, shifts, time clock, jobs, time off, tasks and forms; create shifts and tasks.

tools.name: connecteam_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The Connecteam company this API key belongs to: company name and company id. GET /me.

tools.name: connecteam_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List employees (users): name, email, phone, user type (user/manager/owner), archived state, smart groups, custom fields and last login. Use it to map the user ids in shifts, time activities, timesheets, time off and tasks to names. Kiosk codes and device ids are never returned. GET /users/v1/users.

tools.name: connecteam_list_schedulers
tools.title: List schedulers
tools.description: List the job schedulers (schedules) in the account with their id, name, time zone and archived state. The scheduler id is needed to list or create shifts. GET /scheduler/v1/schedulers.

tools.name: connecteam_list_shifts
tools.title: List shifts
tools.description: List shifts of one scheduler in a time window (one row per assigned user, as Connecteam's V1 endpoint returns them): title, start/end (Unix seconds), time zone, assigned user ids, open-shift spots, job, location, published state, statuses, breaks, notes and shift tasks. Filter by assigned users, job, open or published. GET /scheduler/v1/schedulers/{schedulerId}/shifts.

tools.name: connecteam_get_shift
tools.title: Get shift
tools.description: One shift of a scheduler by its id, with assignments, statuses, breaks, notes and tasks. GET /scheduler/v1/schedulers/{schedulerId}/shifts/{shiftId}.

tools.name: connecteam_create_shift
tools.title: Create shift
tools.description: WRITE: create ONE shift in a scheduler (one assignee or one open spot: the V1 endpoint does not create group or multi-spot shifts). By default it is created as an unpublished draft (employees see nothing). With is_published=true it is published, and Connecteam notifies the assigned users unless notify_users=false. Give a title or a job_id (Connecteam requires one). For an open shift set is_open_shift=true and leave assigned_user_ids empty. POST /scheduler/v1/schedulers/{schedulerId}/shifts.

tools.name: connecteam_list_time_clocks
tools.title: List time clocks
tools.description: List the time clocks in the account (id, name, archived). The time clock id is needed for time activities and timesheets. GET /time-clock/v1/time-clocks.

tools.name: connecteam_list_time_activities
tools.title: List time activities
tools.description: Clock-in/clock-out records of a time clock for a date range (at most 31 days per call), grouped by user: worked shifts (start/end, job, sub-job, notes, auto clock-out), manual breaks and time off. Filter by users, jobs or activity type. GET /time-clock/v1/time-clocks/{timeClockId}/time-activities.

tools.name: connecteam_get_timesheet_totals
tools.title: Get timesheet totals
tools.description: Payroll-ready timesheet totals of a time clock for a date range (at most 45 days, Connecteam's limit): per user and day, total/work/paid-break/unpaid-break hours (decimal), approved/submitted/locked flags and pay items by pay rule (with pay rates when defined). Filter by users, groups, jobs or approval state. GET /time-clock/v1/time-clocks/{timeClockId}/timesheet.

tools.name: connecteam_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List jobs (the work items shifts and time are tracked against): id, title, code, color, description, GPS/geofence, assigned users/groups, parent job and sub-jobs, and the schedulers/time clocks (instance ids) they belong to. GET /jobs/v1/jobs.

tools.name: connecteam_get_job
tools.title: Get job
tools.description: One job by id, with its sub-jobs, assignments and location. GET /jobs/v1/jobs/{jobId}.

tools.name: connecteam_list_time_off_policy_types
tools.title: List time-off policy types
tools.description: List time-off policy types (e.g. Vacation, Sick) and their policies with unit (hours/days) and accrual type. Needs the HR & Skills hub. GET /time-off/v1/policy-types.

tools.name: connecteam_list_time_off_requests
tools.title: List time-off requests
tools.description: List time-off requests overlapping a date range (at most 365 days): user, policy type, dates/times, all-day flag, status (approved/pending/denied), notes, approving manager and, for approved requests, the amount deducted. Connecteam returns only approved requests unless statuses is given. Needs the HR & Skills hub. GET /time-off/v1/requests.

tools.name: connecteam_list_task_boards
tools.title: List task boards
tools.description: List the quick-task boards in the account (id, name, archived). The board id is needed to list or create tasks. GET /tasks/v1/taskboards.

tools.name: connecteam_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks on a task board: title, assigned user ids, status (draft/published/completed), start and due time (Unix seconds), labels, sub-tasks and description. Filter by status, users, labels or task ids. GET /tasks/v1/taskboards/{taskBoardId}/tasks.

tools.name: connecteam_list_task_labels
tools.title: List task labels
tools.description: List the labels of a task board (id, name, color), for filtering tasks or labelling a new one. GET /tasks/v1/taskboards/{taskBoardId}/labels.

tools.name: connecteam_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: WRITE: create one quick task on a task board for the given users. status 'draft' keeps it hidden; 'published' sends it to the assignees' apps. Several user ids make one group task. POST /tasks/v1/taskboards/{taskBoardId}/tasks.

tools.name: connecteam_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List forms (checklists, inspections, reports) with their questions. Filter by name or creation date. GET /forms/v1/forms.

tools.name: connecteam_list_form_submissions
tools.title: List form submissions
tools.description: List the submissions of one form: who submitted and when, the answers and the manager fields (status, owner, notes). Filter by submitting users and time window. GET /forms/v1/forms/{formId}/form-submissions.

tools.name: connecteam_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: connecteam_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Connecteam tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: connecteam_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Connecteam (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: connecteam_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Connecteam Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run connecteam_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: Create one in Connecteam → **Settings → API Keys** (an owner or admin can; the API needs the Expert plan or higher). Pick **Australia** only if you sign in at app-au.connecteam.com. Your key is used only to call the Connecteam API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

examples: Who is scheduled to work tomorrow, and on which shifts?
What are the total hours worked by each employee on the time clock this week?
Who has requested time off in the next month?
Create a shift for Jane Smith next Monday from 9am to 5pm.

servers.name: Gingr
servers.description: Read Gingr reservations, owners, pets, check-ins, invoices and timeclock for your pet-care business.

tools.name: gingr_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the locations (facilities) of this Gingr app, as id (value) + name (label). Good first call: most other tools take a location_id. Gingr: GET /api/v1/get_locations.

tools.name: gingr_list_reservation_types
tools.title: List reservation types
tools.description: List the reservation types (services such as boarding, daycare, grooming, training) with their ids. Use the ids to filter reservations or to read a type's add-on services. Gingr: GET /api/v1/reservation_types.

tools.name: gingr_list_services_by_type
tools.title: List add-on services of a reservation type
tools.description: List the additional services (add-ons) allowed for a reservation type, e.g. baths or nail trims on a boarding stay. Gingr: GET /api/v1/get_services_by_type.

tools.name: gingr_list_reference
tools.title: List reference data
tools.description: List one kind of reference data of this Gingr app: species, breeds, temperaments, vets (veterinarians with details), retail_items (retail items for sale) or immunization_types (of one species; needs species_id). Paged. Gingr: GET /api/v1/get_species | get_breeds | get_temperaments | get_vets | get_all_retail_items | get_immunization_types.

tools.name: gingr_list_reservations
tools.title: List reservations in a date range
tools.description: List all reservations (boarding, daycare, grooming, training…) between two dates, at most 30 days apart (Gingr's limit). Paged: total, next_offset, items. Gingr: POST /api/v1/reservations (checked_in=false).

tools.name: gingr_list_checked_in
tools.title: List pets checked in now
tools.description: List the reservations that are checked in right now (the pets currently on site). Paged. Gingr: POST /api/v1/reservations (checked_in=true).

tools.name: gingr_get_daily_summary
tools.title: Get the day's check-in / check-out summary
tools.description: Get the summary of reservations for one date: number of check-ins, check-outs and overnights (the widget at the top of the Gingr dashboard). Gingr: GET /api/v1/reservation_widget_data.

tools.name: gingr_get_whiteboard
tools.title: Get today's arrivals and departures (whiteboard)
tools.description: Get the pets checking in and checking out today at a location, by reservation type, with owner/pet names, times, run and status (Gingr's Digital Whiteboard). Gingr: GET /api/v1/back_of_house.

tools.name: gingr_list_owner_reservations
tools.title: List an owner's reservations
tools.description: List the reservations of one owner (customer), optionally only pending requests, current, future, past or wait-listed ones, by dates, types or pets. Only the location the API user is logged into is included (Gingr). Gingr: POST /api/v1/reservations_by_owner.

tools.name: gingr_list_animal_reservations
tools.title: List a pet's reservations
tools.description: List the reservations of one animal (pet), optionally only pending requests, current, future, past or wait-listed ones, by dates or types. Only the location the API user is logged into is included (Gingr). Gingr: POST /api/v1/reservations_by_animal.

tools.name: gingr_list_cancelled_reservations
tools.title: List recently cancelled reservations
tools.description: List the reservations that were cancelled between two dates (at most 31 days apart). Paged. Gingr: POST /api/v1/recently_cancelled_reservations.

tools.name: gingr_get_reservation_estimate
tools.title: Get a reservation's cost estimate
tools.description: Get the estimated cost of an existing (future) reservation. Gingr: GET /api/v1/existing_reservation_estimate.

tools.name: gingr_list_owners
tools.title: List owners (customers)
tools.description: List owners (pet parents / customers) with contact details, balance and reservation counts, optionally filtered by exact first/last name, email, cell phone, ZIP or home location. Paged. Gingr: GET /api/v1/owners (filters as params[<field>]). Passwords and payment-card references are removed.

tools.name: gingr_get_owner
tools.title: Get an owner
tools.description: Get one owner (customer) record by exactly one of: owner id, one of their pets' id, one of their reservations' id, cell phone or email. Gingr: GET /api/v1/owner. Passwords and payment-card references are removed.

tools.name: gingr_list_new_modified_owners
tools.title: List new or changed owners
tools.description: List the owners (customers) created or modified between two dates (at most 366 days apart). Paged. Gingr: POST /api/v1/new_modified_owners.

tools.name: gingr_list_animals
tools.title: List animals (pets)
tools.description: List animals (pets) with species, breed, birthday, weight, owner and notes, optionally filtered by owner, exact name, species or breed. Paged. Gingr: GET /api/v1/animals (filters as params[<field>]).

tools.name: gingr_get_animal_immunizations
tools.title: Get a pet's immunization records
tools.description: Get the immunization (vaccination) records of one animal, with expiration dates. Gingr: GET /api/v1/get_animal_immunizations.

tools.name: gingr_get_animal_feeding
tools.title: Get a pet's feeding instructions
tools.description: Get the feeding information of one animal (food, amounts, schedule). Gingr: GET /api/v1/get_feeding_info.

tools.name: gingr_get_animal_medications
tools.title: Get a pet's medications
tools.description: Get the medication information of one animal (medications, doses, schedule). Gingr: GET /api/v1/get_medication_info.

tools.name: gingr_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices or estimates
tools.description: List invoices (complete=true) or estimates (complete=false, Gingr's default) created on or after 2019-08-01, optionally closed only and by date range. Paged by Gingr: per_page + start (the 1-based number of the first result; the next page starts at start + per_page). Gingr: GET /api/v1/list_invoices.

tools.name: gingr_get_transaction
tools.title: Get a POS transaction
tools.description: Get one point-of-sale transaction with its items and payment details (card numbers, processor references and auth codes are removed). Gingr: POST /api/v1/transaction.

tools.name: gingr_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions (packages)
tools.description: List recurring subscriptions (membership packages), optionally of one owner, location or package, by billing day, including cancelled ones if asked. Paged by Gingr (limit + offset). Gingr: GET /api/v1/get_subscriptions.

tools.name: gingr_get_subscription
tools.title: Get a subscription
tools.description: Get one subscription (membership package) by id. Gingr: GET /api/v1/get_subscription.

tools.name: gingr_get_timeclock_report
tools.title: Get the staff timeclock report
tools.description: Get staff timeclock records (clock-ins/outs, hours) at a location between two dates (at most 31 days apart). Gingr: GET /api/v1/timeclock_report.

tools.name: gingr_list_report_card_files
tools.title: List recent report card files
tools.description: List recently uploaded report card files (photos and videos shared with pet parents), newest first. Gingr: GET /api/v1/report_card_files.

tools.name: gingr_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Does not count against the meter.

tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Gingr (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: gingr_cancel_subscription

tools.description: Cancel the caller's Gingr Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run gingr_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: The subdomain is the first part of the address you sign in to Gingr at (`acme` for `https://acme.gingrapp.com`). Find the key in Gingr → **Reports & More → Users → Edit User → API Keys**; the user's group needs the **Can Access API** permission. The API only sees the location that user is logged into. examples: Which pets are checked in at our facility right now, and who owns them?
How many check-ins and check-outs do we have today?
Show all boarding reservations for next week.
Which reservations were cancelled in the last two weeks?

servers.name: Kisi
servers.description: Read Kisi places, doors, users, groups, access rights and access logs (no unlocking).

tools.name: kisi_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: The Kisi user the API key belongs to (id, name, email, organization). Good first call. GET /user.

tools.name: kisi_get_organization
tools.title: Get the organization
tools.description: The current Kisi organization (name, domain, settings summary). GET /organization.

tools.name: kisi_list_places
tools.title: List places
tools.description: List places (sites/buildings) in the organization with address, time zone and lock/member counts. GET /places.

tools.name: kisi_get_place
tools.title: Get a place
tools.description: One place by id, including lockdown state. GET /places/{id}.

tools.name: kisi_list_locks
tools.title: List locks (doors)
tools.description: List locks/doors with their state: online, unlocked, locked_down, configured, place and floor. Filter to find offline or locked-down doors. GET /locks.

tools.name: kisi_get_lock
tools.title: Get a lock (door)
tools.description: One lock/door by id: online/unlocked/locked-down state, place, floor, settings. GET /locks/{id}.

tools.name: kisi_list_groups
tools.title: List access groups
tools.description: List access groups (who-can-open-what bundles of doors). Filter by place or by a lock to see which groups open that door. GET /groups.

tools.name: kisi_get_group
tools.title: Get an access group
tools.description: One access group by id (name, description, place, member/lock counts, restrictions). GET /groups/{id}.

tools.name: kisi_list_group_locks
tools.title: List a group's locks
tools.description: The locks/doors an access group opens. GET /group_locks?group_id=.

tools.name: kisi_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users (members) of the organization. Filter by group or place (users with access there), email, or free text over name/email/notes. Sort by last unlock. GET /users.

tools.name: kisi_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: One user by id. GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: kisi_list_role_assignments
tools.title: List role assignments (access rights)
tools.description: Who holds which role where: a user/team/guest's role on the organization, a place or a group (group members = door access). Filter by user, group, place or role. GET /role_assignments.

tools.name: kisi_list_cards
tools.title: List access cards
tools.description: List access cards with status (activated/deactivated/unassigned), assignee and last use. GET /cards.

tools.name: kisi_list_presences
tools.title: List presences at a place
tools.description: Who was present at a place on a given day (derived from unlocks): actor, first/last unlock, last door. GET /presences.

tools.name: kisi_list_schedules
tools.title: List schedules
tools.description: Time rules: when a group's access is allowed, when doors auto-unlock (unlock timer), first-to-arrive, elevator permit timers. Filter by consequence or by the group/lock it applies to. GET /schedules.

tools.name: kisi_list_controllers
tools.title: List controllers
tools.description: Kisi controllers (door hardware hubs) with online/offline status. Filter by place, lock or status. GET /controllers.

tools.name: kisi_list_readers
tools.title: List readers
tools.description: Kisi readers (card/phone readers at doors) with model and online/offline status. GET /readers.

tools.name: kisi_search_events
tools.title: Search access events
tools.description: Search the access log (unlocks, denied attempts, lockdowns, admin changes) and return the first page. This CREATES a temporary saved search in Kisi (an event set, cursor-paginated, kept ~24 h); it changes no door, user or access right. Defaults to the past 90 days, the maximum width. If status is still in_progress or cursor is set, call kisi_get_event_set with the returned id. POST /event_sets.

tools.name: kisi_get_event_set
tools.title: Get an event set page
tools.description: Read an event set from kisi_search_events: its status and events. Pass the previous page's cursor for the next page. GET /event_sets/{id}.

tools.name: kisi_list_event_types
tools.title: List event types
tools.description: All event type names usable as the type filter of kisi_search_events (e.g. lock.unlock). GET /events/types.

tools.name: kisi_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: kisi_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Kisi tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: kisi_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Kisi (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: kisi_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Kisi Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run kisi_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: In the Kisi Dashboard click your name (top right) → **My Account → API → Add API Key** (organization admin or owner rights needed; the key is shown once). Your key is used only to call the Kisi API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

examples: Which doors are online, and which are currently locked down?
Who has access to the main office group?
Who came into the downtown office yesterday?
Which access cards are deactivated or unassigned?

servers.name: Lexware Office
servers.description: Read Lexware Office contacts, articles, invoices and vouchers; create contacts and draft invoices.

tools.name: lexware_get_profile
tools.title: Get the company profile
tools.description: The connected Lexware Office organization: organizationId, company name, the user who created the API key, tax type (net/gross/vatfree), small-business flag (Kleinunternehmer), distance-sales principle and the plan's business features (INVOICING, INVOICING_PRO, BOOKKEEPING). Good first call. GET /v1/profile.

tools.name: lexware_list_contacts
tools.title: List or search contacts
tools.description: List customers and vendors, optionally filtered (filters combine with AND). name and email match as case-insensitive substrings (at least 3 characters; _ and % are wildcards). Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /v1/contacts.

tools.name: lexware_list_articles
tools.title: List articles
tools.description: List articles (products and services usable as invoice line items), with price, tax rate and unit. Optional exact filters by article number, GTIN or type. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /v1/articles.

tools.name: lexware_list_vouchers
tools.title: List vouchers (invoices, quotations, receipts...)
tools.description: Search the voucher list: metadata (id, type, status, number, dates, contact, total and open amount) of sales documents (invoice, quotation, creditnote, orderconfirmation, deliverynote, downpaymentinvoice) and bookkeeping vouchers (salesinvoice, salescreditnote, purchaseinvoice, purchasecreditnote). Omit voucher_types / voucher_statuses for all. Then fetch details with the matching get tool (invoice → lexware_get_invoice, quotation → lexware_get_quotation, creditnote → lexware_get_credit_note, orderconfirmation → lexware_get_order_confirmation, deliverynote → lexware_get_delivery_note, downpaymentinvoice → lexware_get_down_payment_invoice, the four bookkeeping types → lexware_get_bookkeeping_voucher). Dates are yyyy-mm-dd, whole days in German time. Up to 10,000 results can be paged through; narrow the dates for more. GET /v1/voucherlist.

tools.name: lexware_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id: status (draft/open/paid/voided), line items, totals, tax amounts, payment and shipping conditions, related vouchers. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/invoices/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_quotation
tools.title: Get a quotation
tools.description: Get one quotation by id: status (draft/open/accepted/rejected), expiration date, line items, totals. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/quotations/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_credit_note
tools.title: Get a credit note
tools.description: Get one credit note by id: status, line items, totals, related invoice. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/credit-notes/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_order_confirmation
tools.title: Get an order confirmation
tools.description: Get one order confirmation by id: status, line items, totals, delivery terms. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/order-confirmations/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_delivery_note
tools.title: Get a delivery note
tools.description: Get one delivery note by id: status, line items, shipping conditions. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/delivery-notes/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_down_payment_invoice
tools.title: Get a down payment invoice
tools.description: Get one down payment invoice (Abschlagsrechnung) by id: status, amounts, related closing invoice. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/down-payment-invoices/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_dunning
tools.title: Get a dunning
tools.description: Get one dunning (payment reminder) by id: status, the dunned invoice in relatedVouchers, line items, totals. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/dunnings/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_bookkeeping_voucher
tools.title: Get a bookkeeping voucher
tools.description: Get one bookkeeping voucher (salesinvoice, salescreditnote, purchaseinvoice or purchasecreditnote from the voucher list) by id: status, voucher items with posting category ids, tax amounts, contact, file ids. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/vouchers/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_article
tools.title: Get an article
tools.description: Get one article (product or service) by id: title, type, article number, GTIN, unit, net/gross price and tax rate. GET /v1/articles/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact (customer and/or vendor) by id: customer/vendor numbers, company or person, contact persons, addresses, emails, phones, note. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_payments
tools.title: Get a voucher's payments
tools.description: Payment status of an invoice, credit note, down payment invoice or bookkeeping voucher: open amount, payment status (balanced/openRevenue/openExpense), paid date and the payment items (bank transactions, cash, credit notes, Skonto). Not available for quotations or drafts. GET /v1/payments/{voucherId}.

tools.name: lexware_list_countries
tools.title: List countries
tools.description: Countries known to Lexware Office with their code, English and German name and tax classification (de, intraCommunity, thirdPartyCountry). GET /v1/countries.

tools.name: lexware_list_payment_conditions
tools.title: List payment conditions
tools.description: The payment conditions configured in Lexware Office (days until due, early-payment discount, label template, which is the organization default). GET /v1/payment-conditions.

tools.name: lexware_list_posting_categories
tools.title: List posting categories
tools.description: Bookkeeping posting categories (id, name, group, income or outgo, whether a contact is required and split tax rates are allowed), used by bookkeeping vouchers' categoryId. Optionally only income or outgo. GET /v1/posting-categories.

tools.name: lexware_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new customer and/or vendor in Lexware Office (Lexware assigns the customer/vendor number). Give company_name for a company OR person_last_name for a private person. One billing and one shipping address, one email and one phone at most. Check lexware_list_contacts first to avoid duplicates. POST /v1/contacts.

tools.name: lexware_create_draft_invoice
tools.title: Create a draft invoice
tools.description: WRITE: creates an invoice in Lexware Office as a DRAFT (never finalized, numbered or sent; Lexware assigns the number when the user finalizes it in the app). Address it to an existing customer (contact_id) or a one-time address (name + country_code). Prices are EUR. Returns the new id and lexwareAppUrl to review and finalize it in Lexware Office. POST /v1/invoices (without finalize).

tools.name: lexware_create_draft_quotation
tools.title: Create a draft quotation
tools.description: WRITE: creates a quotation (Angebot) in Lexware Office as a DRAFT (never finalized or sent). Address it to an existing customer (contact_id) or a one-time address (name + country_code). Prices are EUR. Returns the new id and lexwareAppUrl to review and finalize it in Lexware Office. POST /v1/quotations (without finalize).

tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Lexware Office tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: lexware_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Lexware Office (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: lexware_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Lexware Office Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run lexware_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: Create a key in Lexware Office → **Erweiterungen → Public API** ([app.lexware.de/addons/public-api](https://app.lexware.de/addons/public-api)); the Public API needs the **XL** plan. examples: Show me all my customers whose name starts with Acme.
Which invoices are open and not yet paid?
List my articles and services with their prices.
Create a new customer contact for Acme GmbH in Berlin.

servers.name: Nookal
servers.description: Read Nookal locations, practitioners, availability, appointments, clients, cases and invoices.

tools.name: nookal_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the clinic's locations (id, name, address, time zone, active). Location ids are needed by most other tools. Only the locations your API client was granted are returned. Nookal GraphQL: locations.

tools.name: nookal_list_staff
tools.title: List practitioners and staff
tools.description: List staff members and practitioners (id, name, title, speciality, email, location ids, whether they are a provider / bookable online / active). Use the staff ids as provider_ids in list_appointments and staff_ids in get_availability. Nookal GraphQL: staff.

tools.name: nookal_list_services
tools.title: List services (appointment types)
tools.description: List the appointment types / services offered (id, name, category, duration in minutes, price, location, online-booking settings). Use a service id in get_availability. Nookal GraphQL: services.

tools.name: nookal_list_classes
tools.title: List class types
tools.description: List the class types offered (id, name, category, duration, price, location, online-booking settings) — the class definitions, not individual sessions. Nookal GraphQL: classes.

tools.name: nookal_get_availability
tools.title: Get appointment availability
tools.description: Get the free appointment slots per date between two dates (max 60 days, Nookal's limit), optionally for given locations, practitioners and a service. Each slot has its date, start time (24h, clinic local time), provider id and location id. Read-only: it does not book anything. Nookal GraphQL: availabilities.

tools.name: nookal_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List appointments (date, start/end time, status, type, client, practitioner, case, location, arrived / did-not-arrive flags, notes), filtered by date range, location, client, practitioner, type and status. Dates are clinic local. Nookal GraphQL: appointments.

tools.name: nookal_search_clients
tools.title: Search clients (patients)
tools.description: Find clients (patients) by name, date of birth, mobile, email or id. Returns id, name, date of birth, location, active/deceased flags and contact details. With partial_match, names match on their first letters (e.g. 'Sm' finds Smith). Nookal GraphQL: clients.

tools.name: nookal_get_client
tools.title: Get a client (patient)
tools.description: Get one client (patient) by id: name, date of birth, contact details, addresses, alerts, allergies, notes, occupation, referring doctor and their treatment cases; optionally a summary of their invoices (totals and balances). Health-fund, pension and online-booking codes are not returned. Nookal GraphQL: clients.

tools.name: nookal_list_cases
tools.title: List treatment cases
tools.description: List treatment cases (id, client, title, start and referral dates, referrer, primary practitioner, notes), filtered by client, case or practitioner. Nookal GraphQL: cases.

tools.name: nookal_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices with their line items and payments (number, client, case, location, practitioner, date, subtotal, tax, total, paid, balance), filtered by location, invoice id or creation date. For one client's invoices use get_client with include_invoices. Nookal GraphQL: invoices.

tools.name: nookal_list_payments
tools.title: List invoice payments
tools.description: List payments received against invoices (method, amount, date, reference, invoice, client, location), filtered by invoice or payment date. Nookal GraphQL: payments.

tools.name: nookal_usage_status

tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Nookal (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: nookal_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Nookal Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). login.hint: In Nookal go to **Setup → Connections → API v3.0 (GraphQL) → Create New Client**, select the locations, enable the queries you want (Locations, Staff, Services, Classes, Appointments, Availabilities, Clients, Cases, Invoices, Payments; no mutations needed), set it Active and copy the Basic Key (shown only once). No API v3.0 menu? Ask Nookal support to enable it. Your key is used only to call the Nookal API on your behalf and to derive a private account id; it is never shown to anyone.

examples: How many appointments do we have booked tomorrow, and with which practitioners?
What free appointment slots are left next week?
Find the client record for Jane Smith and show her contact details.
Which invoices were issued this month and what payments came in?

servers.name: Ordoro
servers.description: Read Ordoro orders, products, shipments, suppliers and purchase orders; tag and comment on orders.

tools.name: ordoro_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders across all sales channels, newest first by default. Filter by status (awaiting_fulfillment, shipped, cancelled, dropshipment_requested, all), free-text search, SKU, tag, warehouse, and created/updated/shipped date ranges. Returns { count, limit, offset, order: [...] } with lines, addresses, shipping_info (tracking), tags and financials. Ordoro API: GET /v3/order.

tools.name: ordoro_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order by order number: status, lines (SKU, quantity, price), shipping/billing address, warehouse, shipping_info (carrier, tracking number, ship date, cost), comments, tags, financials and dropship info. Ordoro API: GET /v3/order/{order_number}.

tools.name: ordoro_get_order_counts
tools.title: Get order counts by status
tools.description: Count orders per status: all, awaiting_fulfillment, shipped, unprinted_shipped, cancelled, dropshipment_requested. A quick fulfillment-backlog overview. Ordoro API: GET /v3/order/counts.

tools.name: ordoro_get_order_tracking
tools.title: Get an order's shipment tracking
tools.description: Get the shipment and tracking details of one order: carrier, shipping method, tracking number and tracking URL, ship date, estimated delivery, label cost, plus any return shipment and dropship info. Ordoro API: GET /v3/order/{order_number} (shipping_info).

tools.name: ordoro_list_order_comments
tools.title: List an order's comments
tools.description: List the comments (internal notes and the order's activity log) of one order, with user and date. Paginated: returns { count, limit, offset, comment: [...] }; use offset for the next page. Ordoro API: GET /v3/order/{order_number}/comment.

tools.name: ordoro_list_order_tags
tools.title: List order tags
tools.description: List the account's order tags (id, name, color). Use the id with ordoro_add_order_tag / ordoro_remove_order_tag. Ordoro API: GET /v3/order/tag.

tools.name: ordoro_list_products
tools.title: List products and inventory
tools.description: List products with inventory totals (total_on_hand, available_on_hand, total_committed, total_allocated, to_be_shipped, po_total_committed). Filter by search, active, low inventory, oversold, needs_sync, warehouse, supplier, tag, kit status and updated date. Returns { count, limit, offset, products: [...] }. Ordoro API: GET /product/.

tools.name: ordoro_get_product
tools.title: Get a product with stock per warehouse
tools.description: Get one product by SKU: price, cost, weight and dimensions, inventory totals, stock per warehouse (on hand, available, committed, location), suppliers, kit components and sales-channel links. Ordoro API: GET /product/{sku}/.

tools.name: ordoro_list_warehouses
tools.title: List warehouses
tools.description: List warehouses (ship-from locations) with id, name, address and whether each is the default. Ordoro API: GET /warehouse/.

tools.name: ordoro_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers and dropshippers with id, company name, address, contact email and dropship settings. Ordoro API: GET /supplier/.

tools.name: ordoro_get_supplier
tools.title: Get a supplier
tools.description: Get one supplier by id, with address, contact details and dropship/PO settings. Ordoro API: GET /supplier/{supplier_id}/.

tools.name: ordoro_list_shippers
tools.title: List shipping carrier accounts
tools.description: List the carrier accounts (shippers) connected to Ordoro: UPS, FedEx, USPS (Endicia/Pitney), DHL, Canada Post, Australia Post, Amazon, Sendle. Returns id, name, vendor, archive/created/updated dates and hidden shipping methods only (carrier credentials are never returned). Ordoro API: GET /shipper/.

tools.name: ordoro_list_purchase_orders
tools.title: List purchase orders
tools.description: List purchase orders to suppliers with status (unsent, sent, partial, received, cancelled), supplier, lines and expected delivery. Filter by status, SKU, tag, search and updated date. Ordoro API: GET /purchase_order/.

tools.name: ordoro_get_purchase_order
tools.title: Get a purchase order
tools.description: Get one purchase order by its PO id: supplier, warehouse, status, lines (SKU, quantity ordered/received, unit price), shipping/payment method and dates. Ordoro API: GET /purchase_order/{po_id}/.

tools.name: ordoro_list_return_orders
tools.title: List return orders (RMAs)
tools.description: List return orders (RMAs) with reference id, status, original order, lines and return label info. Ordoro API: GET /v3/return_order.

tools.name: ordoro_add_order_comment
tools.title: Add a comment to an order
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal comment to an order (visible to the team in Ordoro, not sent to the customer). Each call adds a new comment. Ordoro API: POST /v3/order/{order_number}/comment.

tools.name: ordoro_add_order_tag
tools.title: Tag an order
tools.description: WRITE: apply an existing order tag (by id, from ordoro_list_order_tags) to an order, for example to put it on hold or route it. Returns the order's tags. Ordoro API: POST /v3/order/{order_number}/tag/{tag_id}.

tools.name: ordoro_remove_order_tag
tools.title: Remove a tag from an order
tools.description: WRITE: remove a tag (by id) from an order. The tag itself stays defined. Ordoro API: DELETE /v3/order/{order_number}/tag/{tag_id}.
