servers.name: Photon Health
servers.description: Read Photon Health patients, prescriptions, orders, pharmacies and medications; screen interactions.

tools.name: photonhealth_list_patients
tools.title: List patients
tools.description: List the organization's patients (id, external id, name, date of birth, sex, contact, address), optionally filtered by name. Photon GraphQL: patients.

tools.name: photonhealth_get_patient
tools.title: Get a patient
tools.description: Get one patient by Photon id, with allergies, medication history, preferred pharmacies, and their prescriptions and orders (ids + states). Photon GraphQL: patient.

tools.name: photonhealth_list_prescriptions
tools.title: List prescriptions
tools.description: List the organization's prescriptions, filterable by patient, prescriber and state (ACTIVE, EXPIRED, DEPLETED, CANCELED). Each has the medication, quantity, refills/fills remaining, directions, diagnoses and fills. Photon GraphQL: prescriptions.

tools.name: photonhealth_get_prescription
tools.title: Get a prescription
tools.description: Get one prescription by id: state, prescriber, patient, medication (with RxCUI/NDC codes), quantity, refills and fills remaining, days supply, directions, notes, diagnoses, dates and fills. Photon GraphQL: prescription.

tools.name: photonhealth_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List pharmacy orders, filterable by patient and state (ROUTING, PENDING, PLACED, COMPLETED, CANCELED, ERROR). Each has the pharmacy, delivery address, fulfillment (type, state, carrier, tracking number) and fills. Photon GraphQL: orders.

tools.name: photonhealth_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order by id: state, patient, pharmacy, address, fulfillment status/tracking and its fills. Photon GraphQL: order.

tools.name: photonhealth_get_fill
tools.title: Get a fill
tools.description: Get one fill (a single dispensing of a prescription within an order) by id: state (SCHEDULED, NEW, SENT, CANCELED), requested/filled times, medication, prescription and order. Photon GraphQL: fill.

tools.name: photonhealth_search_pharmacies
tools.title: Search pharmacies
tools.description: Search pharmacies by name and/or near a location (latitude/longitude + radius in miles), by fulfillment type (PICK_UP = retail, MAIL_ORDER). Returns NPI, NCPDP, address, phone, fax. Photon GraphQL: pharmacies.

tools.name: photonhealth_get_pharmacy
tools.title: Get a pharmacy
tools.description: Get one pharmacy by Photon id: name, NPI, NCPDP, address, phone, fax and fulfillment types. Photon GraphQL: pharmacy.

tools.name: photonhealth_search_medications
tools.title: Search medications
tools.description: Search Photon's medication database by drug name (partial) or code (RxCUI, NDC or SKU). Returns DRUG-level concepts with RxCUI/NDC codes, schedule, controlled flag, strength and form; drill down with list_medication_products / list_medication_packages. Photon GraphQL: medications.

tools.name: photonhealth_list_medication_products
tools.title: List medication products
tools.description: List the prescribable products (strength + form) of a DRUG-level medication from search_medications. Photon GraphQL: medicationProducts.

tools.name: photonhealth_list_medication_packages
tools.title: List medication packages
tools.description: List the packages (package NDCs) of a PRODUCT-level medication from list_medication_products. Photon GraphQL: medicationPackages.

tools.name: photonhealth_get_medication_by_ndc
tools.title: Look up a medication by NDC
tools.description: Find the medication matching a package NDC (11-digit National Drug Code). Photon GraphQL (clinical API): medicationFromNdc.

tools.name: photonhealth_search_medical_equipment
tools.title: Search medical equipment
tools.description: Search prescribable medical equipment/supplies (e.g. glucose test strips) by name. Photon GraphQL: medicalEquipment.

tools.name: photonhealth_list_catalogs
tools.title: List catalogs
tools.description: List the organization's treatment catalogs (the medications it prescribes) with their treatments and prescription templates. Photon GraphQL: catalogs.

tools.name: photonhealth_get_catalog
tools.title: Get a catalog
tools.description: Get one treatment catalog by id with its treatments and prescription templates (quantity, refills, days supply, directions). Photon GraphQL: catalog.

tools.name: photonhealth_search_allergens
tools.title: Search allergens
tools.description: Search Photon's allergen list by name (fuzzy), e.g. to map a patient's reported allergy to an allergen id/RxCUI. Photon GraphQL: allergens.

tools.name: photonhealth_list_dispense_units
tools.title: List dispense units
tools.description: List the dispense units Photon accepts on a prescription (e.g. Each, Milliliter, Tablet). Photon GraphQL: dispenseUnits.

tools.name: photonhealth_get_organization
tools.title: Get the organization
tools.description: Get the Photon organization these API keys belong to: id, name, type, NPI, address and contact details. Photon GraphQL (clinical API): organization.

tools.name: photonhealth_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the organization's users (prescribers and staff): id, name, email, NPI, credentials and roles — use an id as prescriber_id in list_prescriptions. Photon GraphQL (clinical API): users.

tools.name: photonhealth_screen_interactions
tools.title: Screen for drug interactions
tools.description: Screen proposed medications for a patient against drug-drug and drug-allergy (and diagnosis) interactions, using the patient's allergies, medication history and existing prescriptions. READ-ONLY: nothing is written or prescribed. Returns alerts with type (DRUG, ALLERGEN, CONDITION), severity (MINOR, MODERATE, MAJOR), a description and the involved medications/allergens. Photon GraphQL (clinical API): prescriptionScreen.

tools.name: photonhealth_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: photonhealth_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Photon Health tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: photonhealth_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Photon Health (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: photonhealth_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Photon Health Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run photonhealth_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: Find the key pair in the Photon app → **Settings** (app.photon.health for production, app.neutron.health for the Neutron sandbox). Sandbox keys only work with Sandbox, production keys only with Production. Your credentials are used only to call the Photon API on your behalf and to derive a private account id; they are never shown to anyone.

examples: Show the most recent prescriptions for patient Jane Smith.
Which pharmacy orders are still pending or being routed?
Which mail-order pharmacies are available for prescriptions?
Screen amoxicillin for interactions with patient Jane Smith's current medications.

servers.name: RotaCloud
servers.description: Read RotaCloud shifts, attendance, leave, availability and payroll; create shifts and handle leave.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts
tools.description: The RotaCloud account(s) this API key belongs to: name, plan, time zone, employee count. GET /accounts.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List employees (users) with their level, roles, locations, contact details and pay settings. Use it to map user ids in shifts, leave and attendance to names. GET /users.

tools.name: rotacloud_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: One employee by id. GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List locations (sites/branches) with address, time zone and managers. GET /locations.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: List job roles (positions) with colour, default break and pay rate. GET /roles.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_shifts
tools.title: List shifts
tools.description: List rota shifts in a time range: start/end times (Unix seconds), break, assigned user (null = open shift), location, role, notes, published and acknowledged state. Filter by users, locations, roles, open or published. GET /shifts.

tools.name: rotacloud_get_shift
tools.title: Get shift
tools.description: One shift by id. GET /shifts/{id}.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_swap_requests
tools.title: List shift swap requests
tools.description: List shift swap requests with their status, the shifts and the users involved. GET /swap_requests.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_day_notes
tools.title: List day notes
tools.description: List day notes (notices pinned to rota dates, e.g. events or deliveries), optionally for one location. GET /day_notes.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_attendance
tools.title: List attendance records
tools.description: List time & attendance records (clock-in/out times, breaks, minutes late, hours, approval state) in a time range. GET /attendance.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_clocked_in
tools.title: List clocked-in users
tools.description: Who is clocked in right now: user, location, role, clock-in time, minutes late and break state. GET /users_clocked_in.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_leave
tools.title: List leave
tools.description: List booked leave (holiday, sickness, etc.) with type, user, dates, hours and status. Filter by date range or leave year, users and leave types; pending/denied/expired requests are excluded unless asked for. GET /leave.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_leave_requests
tools.title: List leave requests
tools.description: List leave requests awaiting a decision (and past ones): user, leave type, dates, half days, the employee's message. GET /leave_requests.

tools.name: rotacloud_get_leave_request
tools.title: Get leave request
tools.description: One leave request by id, with the per-day breakdown. GET /leave_requests/{id}.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_leave_types
tools.title: List leave types
tools.description: List leave types (Holiday, Sickness, Unpaid, ...) with id, short name and whether employees can request them. GET /leave_types.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_holiday_allowances
tools.title: List holiday allowances
tools.description: Every employee's holiday allowance for a leave year (default and custom allowance, unit, carried over). GET /holiday_allowances/{year}.

tools.name: rotacloud_get_availability
tools.title: Get availability
tools.description: Employees' availability per date in a range (available / unavailable times). GET /availability.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_days_off
tools.title: List days off
tools.description: Employees' scheduled days off per date in a range. GET /days_off.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_pay_periods
tools.title: List pay periods
tools.description: List pay periods overlapping a date range (id, name, start/end date, locked). GET /pay_periods.

tools.name: rotacloud_get_payroll
tools.title: Get payroll for a pay period
tools.description: Payroll for one pay period, per employee: pay settings, attendance worked, paid/unpaid leave, overtime and pay totals. Contains pay data. GET /pay_periods/{id}/payroll.

tools.name: rotacloud_create_shift
tools.title: Create shift
tools.description: WRITE: create a shift on the rota. Leave user_id out for an open shift. Unpublished by default (employees see it once published). POST /shifts.

tools.name: rotacloud_update_shift
tools.title: Update shift
tools.description: WRITE: change a shift's times, assignee, location, role, break, notes or published state. Only the fields you pass change. POST /shifts/{id}.

tools.name: rotacloud_publish_shifts
tools.title: Publish shifts
tools.description: WRITE: publish shifts so the assigned employees see them (and get notified). POST /shifts_published.

tools.name: rotacloud_find_shifts
tools.title: Find shifts
tools.description: Find shifts in a time range by open/assigned state, published state, location, role and ELAPSED duration (end − start; the break is not subtracted). It reads page after page, so it is the way to select shifts for a bulk change such as rotacloud_delete_shifts: e.g. open shifts shorter than 3 hours = open: true, shorter_than_minutes: 180 (a shift of exactly 180 minutes does not match). Deleted shifts never match. Returns up to max_results matches (shift_ids plus a summary each: UTC times, elapsed_minutes, user, location, role, published). complete: true = the whole range was read. Otherwise pass next_offset as offset to continue — but after deleting or changing shifts, search again from offset 0, because the list positions move. GET /shifts.

tools.name: rotacloud_delete_shifts
tools.title: Delete shifts
tools.description: WRITE — deletes shifts from the rota (assigned employees lose the shift). Delete 1-100 shifts by id; select them first with rotacloud_find_shifts. Without confirm it only previews: it reads each shift and deletes nothing. Show the preview to the user, then call again with confirm: true. Guards re-check each shift right before its delete and skip it if it no longer qualifies: require_open (skip assigned shifts), require_shorter_than_minutes (skip shifts whose elapsed duration is not strictly less). After each delete the shift is read again to verify it is gone. DELETE /shifts/{id}.

tools.name: rotacloud_create_leave_request
tools.title: Request leave
tools.description: WRITE: submit a leave request on behalf of an employee (sent as that user, for a manager to approve). POST /leave_requests with the User header.

tools.name: rotacloud_approve_leave_request
tools.title: Approve leave request
tools.description: WRITE: approve a pending leave request (it becomes booked leave and the employee is notified). POST /leave_requests/{id}/approve.

tools.name: rotacloud_deny_leave_request
tools.title: Deny leave request
tools.description: WRITE: deny a pending leave request (the employee is notified). POST /leave_requests/{id}/deny.

tools.name: rotacloud_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: rotacloud_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the RotaCloud tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: rotacloud_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on RotaCloud (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: rotacloud_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's RotaCloud Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run rotacloud_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: Create one in RotaCloud → **Settings → Integrations → API** (an account admin can do this; available on all plans). Calls run with admin permissions. Your key is used only to call the RotaCloud API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

examples: Who is working tomorrow and at which location?
Who is clocked in right now and is anyone late?
Which leave requests are waiting for my decision?
Create a draft shift for Jane Smith at our Main site next Tuesday, 9am to 5pm.

servers.name: Shiftbase
servers.description: Read Shiftbase rosters, timesheets, absences and availability; schedule shifts and review absences.

tools.name: shiftbase_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The Shiftbase account this API key belongs to: company, country, time zone, working-day start/end, plan facts. GET /accounts.

tools.name: shiftbase_list_users
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List employees (users) with their teams and departments, contact details, employee number, start/end dates and plus-min hours balance. Use it to map user ids in schedules, timesheets and absences to names. Identity, bank and birth data are never returned. GET /users.

tools.name: shiftbase_get_user
tools.title: Get employee
tools.description: One employee by user id or email address, with teams and departments. GET /users/{identifier}.

tools.name: shiftbase_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List departments (sites/branches that own teams, shifts and schedules) with address and timesheet/clocking settings. GET /departments.

tools.name: shiftbase_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List teams (the rows of the schedule within a department), optionally for one department. GET /teams.

tools.name: shiftbase_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List active locations (addresses that group departments). GET /locations.

tools.name: shiftbase_list_shift_types
tools.title: List shift types
tools.description: List shift types (the templates a scheduled shift uses: name, short name, default start/end time and break), optionally for one department. Their ids are the shift_id for shiftbase_create_roster. GET /shifts.

tools.name: shiftbase_list_rosters
tools.title: List scheduled shifts
tools.description: List the schedule (rosters = shifts assigned to employees) for a date range of at most 62 days: date, start/end time, break, employee, team, shift type, department, published state, hours and cost. Each item's occurrence_id identifies it for shiftbase_get_roster and shiftbase_update_roster. GET /rosters.

tools.name: shiftbase_get_roster
tools.title: Get scheduled shift
tools.description: One scheduled shift by its occurrence_id, with the employee, shift type, team and who created/changed it. GET /rosters/{occurrenceId}.

tools.name: shiftbase_list_open_shifts
tools.title: List open shifts
tools.description: List open (unassigned) shifts that employees can pick up, for a date range of at most 62 days (default: today). Needs the Basic plan or higher. GET /open_shifts.

tools.name: shiftbase_get_availability
tools.title: Get employee availability
tools.description: Employee availability (available / unavailable, all day or from a time) for a date range of at most 62 days, from Shiftbase's availability report. Needs the Basic plan and the "View reports" permission. POST /reports/availability (export json; reads only).

tools.name: shiftbase_list_timesheets
tools.title: List timesheets
tools.description: List timesheets (worked hours: clock in/out, breaks, total, status Approved/Declined/Pending, wage and surcharges) for a date range of at most 62 days. GET /timesheets.

tools.name: shiftbase_get_timesheet
tools.title: Get timesheet
tools.description: One timesheet by id, with its clocked breaks. GET /timesheets/{timesheetId}.

tools.name: shiftbase_list_clocked_in
tools.title: List clocked-in employees
tools.description: Who is clocked in right now: employee, since when, their scheduled shift, team, department and location. GET /timesheets/clock.

tools.name: shiftbase_list_absences
tools.title: List absences
tools.description: List absences (leave, sick leave, other time off) overlapping a date range of at most 366 days: employee, absence type, start/end date, hours or days, status Approved/Declined/Pending and who reviewed it. Needs the Basic plan. GET /absentees.

tools.name: shiftbase_get_absence
tools.title: Get absence
tools.description: One absence by id, with the per-day hours and who reviewed it. GET /absentees/{absenteeId}.

tools.name: shiftbase_list_absence_types
tools.title: List absence types
tools.description: List absence types (e.g. Holiday, Sick, Unpaid leave): name, unit (hours or days), whether it costs leave hours, colour. Their ids are the absence_type_id for absences. GET /absentee_options.

tools.name: shiftbase_get_expected_absence_hours
tools.title: Get expected absence hours
tools.description: How many hours an absence would cost for an employee, per day and in total (from the schedule or the contract, per the absence policy), for a period of at most 366 days. Changes nothing. POST /absentees/expected.

tools.name: shiftbase_create_roster
tools.title: Schedule a shift
tools.description: WRITE: put one employee on the schedule for one date (a single, non-recurring shift) in a team, with a shift type, start/end time and break. The employee is notified only when notify is true. POST /rosters.

tools.name: shiftbase_update_roster
tools.title: Change a scheduled shift
tools.description: WRITE: change a scheduled shift: move it to another date, time, employee, team or shift type, or change its break or note. Reads the shift first and sends it back with your changes. For a recurring shift, scope says what changes: "occurrence" (this date only), "sequence" (this date and all later ones) or "original" (the whole series; also the right scope for a non-recurring shift). PUT /rosters/{occurrenceId}/{scope}.

tools.name: shiftbase_request_absence
tools.title: Request an absence
tools.description: WRITE: add an absence (leave/time-off request) for an employee. By default it is a Pending request for a manager to review; status Approved books it directly (needs the approve-absence permission). The hours per day come from Shiftbase's own expected-hours calculation (the same as shiftbase_get_expected_absence_hours). Needs the Basic plan. POST /absentees.

tools.name: shiftbase_review_absence
tools.title: Approve or decline an absence
tools.description: WRITE: approve or decline an absence request. Reads the absence first and sends it back unchanged except for the status (needs the approve-absence permission). PUT /absentees/{absenteeId}.

tools.name: shiftbase_usage_status

Does not count against the meter.

tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Shiftbase (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Shipday
servers.description: Read Shipday orders, carriers and delivery status; create orders and assign drivers.

tools.name: shipday_list_active_orders
tools.title: List active orders
tools.description: List the account's active (not yet completed) delivery orders with customer, pickup location (restaurant), assigned carrier/driver, timeline (activityLog), costs, payment method and orderStatus.orderState. Good first call. Shipday: GET /orders.

tools.name: shipday_get_order
tools.title: Get order by order number
tools.description: Get the details of a delivery order by its order number (the merchant's reference, `orderNumber`). Returns an array, since several orders can share one order number. Includes the numeric orderId needed by the write tools, the carrier, tracking link and status. Shipday: GET /orders/{orderNumber}.

tools.name: shipday_query_orders
tools.title: Search orders (history)
tools.description: Search delivery orders, including completed ones, by placement-time window and status, with row-based paging: start_cursor/end_cursor select rows (e.g. 1–100, then 101–200; at most 100 per call) sorted newest first. Each row has timestamps (placement, assigned, picked up, delivered, failed), totals, driver payment, distance and carrier. Shipday: POST /orders/query.

tools.name: shipday_get_pickup_order
tools.title: Get a pickup order
tools.description: Get a pickup (customer collects it) order by its numeric id, with restaurant, customer, items, costs, expected pickup date/time and status. Shipday: GET /pickup-orders/{orderId}.

tools.name: shipday_get_delivery_progress
tools.title: Get delivery progress and ETA
tools.description: Real-time delivery progress of an order by its tracking id: status (STARTED, PICKED_UP, ...), timestamps, the driver's current location and the ETA in minutes. The tracking id is the last part of the order's trackingLink. Shipday's Business Advanced plan only; at most 3 requests per minute per tracking id. Shipday: GET /order/progress/{trackingId}.

tools.name: shipday_list_carriers
tools.title: List carriers (drivers)
tools.description: List the account's carriers (drivers) with id, name, phone, email, isOnShift, isActive and last known location. Use an id here with shipday_assign_order_to_carrier. Shipday: GET /carriers.

tools.name: shipday_list_on_demand_services
tools.title: List on-demand delivery services
tools.description: List the third-party on-demand delivery services (DoorDash, Uber, ...) available to the account and whether each is enabled. Shipday: GET /on-demand/services.

tools.name: shipday_get_on_demand_estimate
tools.title: Get on-demand delivery estimates
tools.description: Get fee and time estimates from the third-party on-demand delivery services for an existing order (fee, pickup/delivery time, durations, per-service errors). Read only: nothing is booked. Shipday: GET /on-demand/estimate/{orderId}.

tools.name: shipday_get_on_demand_details
tools.title: Get on-demand delivery details
tools.description: Details of the third-party on-demand delivery booked for an order: provider, reference id, third-party fee, Shipday charge, total billable amount and tracking URL. Shipday: GET /on-demand/details/{orderId}.

tools.name: shipday_check_on_demand_availability
tools.title: Check on-demand delivery availability
tools.description: Quote third-party on-demand delivery for a pickup and delivery address before creating an order: which services can deliver, their fee and pickup/delivery times. Read only: nothing is booked. Shipday: POST /on-demand/availability.

tools.name: shipday_create_order
tools.title: Create a delivery order
tools.description: WRITE: insert a new delivery order into Shipday (it appears on the dispatch board; it is not assigned to a driver). Returns the new orderId. Times are UTC. Shipday: POST /orders.

tools.name: shipday_assign_order_to_carrier
tools.title: Assign an order to a driver
tools.description: WRITE: assign a delivery order to one of the account's own carriers (drivers); the driver is notified in the Shipday driver app. Re-assigning to the same driver changes nothing. Shipday: PUT /orders/assign/{orderId}/{carrierId}.

tools.name: shipday_unassign_order
tools.title: Unassign an order from its driver
tools.description: WRITE: remove the driver from a delivery order (it goes back to unassigned). Shipday: PUT /orders/unassign/{orderId}.

tools.name: shipday_set_order_ready_to_pickup
tools.title: Mark an order ready for pickup
tools.description: WRITE: set or clear an order's ready-to-pickup flag (tells the driver the order is ready at the pickup location). Shipday: PUT /orders/{orderId}/meta.

tools.name: shipday_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: shipday_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Shipday tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: shipday_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Shipday (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: shipday_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Shipday Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run shipday_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: Find it in the Shipday Dispatch Dashboard → **My Account** → API key. Your key is used only to call the Shipday API on your behalf and to derive a private account id; it is never shown to anyone.

examples: Which delivery orders are active right now?
Which drivers are on shift at the moment?
How many delivery orders did we place yesterday and what are their statuses?
Assign delivery order 1055 to our driver Tom Brown.

servers.name: SlickText
servers.description: Read SlickText contacts, lists, campaigns, analytics and inbox; create and update contacts.

tools.name: slicktext_get_brand
tools.title: Get the brand
tools.description: Get the SlickText brand this API key belongs to: brand_id, name, website, sending-number registration details, opt-in / double-opt-in messages, inbox settings and the message credit limit. Every other tool works within this brand. GET /brands.

tools.name: slicktext_get_credit_usage
tools.title: Get message credit usage
tools.description: Message credits for the current billing period: total_credits (subscription + rollover + purchased), credits_used, credits_available and the credit limit. GET /brands/{brand_id}/usage.

tools.name: slicktext_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List the brand's contacts (subscribers) with name, mobile_number, email, opt_in_status, source, custom_fields and dates. Filters are exact, case-sensitive matches (SlickText has no partial search). Paged: returns count, has_more and next_offset. GET /brands/{brand_id}/contacts.

tools.name: slicktext_find_contact
tools.title: Find a contact by phone or email
tools.description: Find contacts by mobile number or email address (exact match). A 10-digit US number is matched as +1XXXXXXXXXX, the way SlickText stores numbers. Use it before creating a contact to avoid duplicates. GET /brands/{brand_id}/contacts?mobile_number=… or ?email=….

tools.name: slicktext_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id: name, mobile_number, email, birthdate, address, opt_in_status, source, custom_fields, time zone and dates. GET /brands/{brand_id}/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: slicktext_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: List the brand's contact custom fields: name, internal_name (the key used in contact filters and writes), data_type and description. GET /brands/{brand_id}/custom-fields.

tools.name: slicktext_list_lists
tools.title: List contact lists
tools.description: List the brand's contact lists (contact_list_id, name, description, created). Optional exact name filter. GET /brands/{brand_id}/lists.

tools.name: slicktext_get_list
tools.title: Get a contact list
tools.description: Get one contact list by id plus its contact count (all statuses: subscribed, not subscribed, unsubscribed, blocked). GET /brands/{brand_id}/lists/{id} and /lists/{id}/contacts/count.

tools.name: slicktext_list_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts in a list
tools.description: List the contacts in one contact list (paged). GET /brands/{brand_id}/lists/{id}/contacts.

tools.name: slicktext_list_segments
tools.title: List segments
tools.description: List the brand's segments (rule-based contact groups: segment_id, name, description). GET /brands/{brand_id}/segments.

tools.name: slicktext_list_segment_contacts
tools.title: List contacts in a segment
tools.description: List the contacts that currently match one segment (paged). GET /brands/{brand_id}/segments/{id}/contacts.

tools.name: slicktext_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List the brand's SMS/MMS campaigns: name, body, status (e.g. draft, scheduled, queued, sent), scheduled/started/finished times, completion_percentage and audience (lists/segments and size). GET /brands/{brand_id}/campaigns.

tools.name: slicktext_get_campaign
tools.title: Get a campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign by id: body, media_url, status, audience_size, schedule and completion. GET /brands/{brand_id}/campaigns/{id}.

tools.name: slicktext_get_campaign_stats
tools.title: Get campaign performance
tools.description: Performance of one campaign: contacts reached, clicks, click_rate, unique clicks, unsubscribes, unsubscribe_rate, orders, revenue, average order value, revenue per message, plus the campaign, its audiences and links. GET /brands/{brand_id}/analytics/campaigns/{id}.

tools.name: slicktext_get_analytics
tools.title: Get brand analytics
tools.description: Brand-level analytics. metric: contacts (current totals), contact_growth, contact_add_delete_events, opt_in_status_events, campaigns, messages (messages sent), message_credits, inbox_users (assignments, closures, response times per user), inbox_tags. Optional group (allowed per metric — contacts: source|opt_in_status; contact_growth/campaigns: contact_source; contact_add_delete_events: contact_source|type; opt_in_status_events: contact_source|contact_unsubscribe_source|opt_in_status; messages: source|status|direction|weekday; message_credits: source|status), a start/end range, frequency (hour/day/month/year) and compare (YoY, QoQ, MoM, WoW, DoD, PoP). GET /brands/{brand_id}/analytics/….

tools.name: slicktext_list_keywords
tools.title: List keywords
tools.description: List the brand's text-to-join keywords (word, description, active, auto-response and opt-in messages, double opt-in). GET /brands/{brand_id}/keywords.

tools.name: slicktext_get_keyword
tools.title: Get a keyword
tools.description: Get one keyword by id, including the contact_list_ids that people who text it are added to. GET /brands/{brand_id}/keywords/{id}.

tools.name: slicktext_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List individual SMS/MMS messages sent and received by the brand: to, from, body, direction, source (Campaign, Keyword, InboxThread, API …), status (delivered, undelivered …), credits and the contact. Filters are exact matches; use to/from with a phone number to read one contact's history, or source=InboxThread with source_id = a conversation id. GET /brands/{brand_id}/messages.

tools.name: slicktext_list_conversations
tools.title: List inbox conversations
tools.description: List two-way inbox conversations: status (open, pending, closed), the contact, the last message and its direction/time, assigned user, tags and unread state. GET /brands/{brand_id}/inbox-threads.

tools.name: slicktext_get_conversation
tools.title: Get an inbox conversation
tools.description: Get the content of one inbox conversation by its id (the _id from slicktext_list_conversations). For the message-by-message history also call slicktext_list_messages with source=InboxThread and source_id=<conversation id>. GET /brands/{brand_id}/inbox-threads/{id}/content.

tools.name: slicktext_list_inbox_tags
tools.title: List inbox tags
tools.description: List the inbox tags used to label conversations (inbox_tag_id, name, color, description). GET /brands/{brand_id}/inbox-tags.

tools.name: slicktext_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: WRITE: add a contact to the brand. By default the contact is created as 'not subscribed' and gets no text. Set opt_in_status='subscribed' ONLY for people who gave explicit permission to receive texts (SlickText has a zero-tolerance policy for unsolicited texts). force_double_opt_in=true makes SlickText SEND A REAL SMS to the number asking the person to confirm. Check slicktext_find_contact first to avoid duplicates. WARNING: SlickText workflows can trigger on this event (Contact Created / Contact Field Changed / Contact Added to List) and may immediately SEND REAL TEXTS or take other actions configured in the brand's workflows. POST /brands/{brand_id}/contacts.

tools.name: slicktext_update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing contact (only the fields you pass are sent). opt_in_status can mark a contact unsubscribed or blocked; set it to 'subscribed' ONLY when the person explicitly agreed to receive texts. WARNING: SlickText workflows can trigger on this event (Contact Created / Contact Field Changed / Contact Added to List) and may immediately SEND REAL TEXTS or take other actions configured in the brand's workflows. PUT /brands/{brand_id}/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: slicktext_add_contact_to_lists
tools.title: Add a contact to lists
tools.description: WRITE: add one contact to one or more contact lists (it does not change the contact's opt-in status; lists are also campaign audiences). Returns SlickText's count of memberships added. WARNING: SlickText workflows can trigger on this event (Contact Created / Contact Field Changed / Contact Added to List) and may immediately SEND REAL TEXTS or take other actions configured in the brand's workflows. POST /brands/{brand_id}/lists/contacts.

tools.name: slicktext_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: slicktext_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the SlickText tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: slicktext_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on SlickText (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: slicktext_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's SlickText Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run slicktext_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: In SlickText click the **…** beside your name → **Settings → API & Webhooks → API Keys → Create API Key** (the key is shown once). This is the SlickText API for accounts created on or after January 22, 2025; older (legacy) accounts are not supported. Your key is used only to call the SlickText API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

examples: How many credits do I have left this billing period?
Show clicks and unsubscribes for text campaign ID 1042.
How many contacts are on my VIP list, counting all statuses?
Find the contact with phone number (615) 555-0100.

servers.name: Spruce Health
servers.description: Read Spruce Health contacts, conversations, messages, phone lines and team members (read-only).

tools.name: sprucehealth_get_organization
tools.title: Get the organization
tools.description: Your Spruce organization (id and name). The id is the owner/member id used by other objects. Good first call. GET /organization.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_members
tools.title: List organization members
tools.description: All members of the organization: teammates (name, email, admin, suspended), teams and the organization itself. Paged with hasMore/paginationToken; totalCount included. GET /organization/members.

tools.name: sprucehealth_get_member
tools.title: Get an organization member
tools.description: One organization member (teammate, team or the organization) by id. GET /organization/members/{memberId}.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_team_members
tools.title: List a team's members
tools.description: The members of one team (team ids come from sprucehealth_list_members, type 'team'). Paged. GET /teams/{teamId}/members.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: Contacts of the organization (patients, professionals, clinics): name, date of birth, phones, emails, tags, custom fields, integration links. Paged with hasMore/paginationToken; totalCount included. Use sprucehealth_search_contacts to find someone. GET /contacts.

tools.name: sprucehealth_search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: Find contacts by free text and/or filters (category, tags, name, phone, email, invite state, created time). Filters combine with AND; values inside one filter match ANY (tags can use all/none). Paged; totalCount with totalCountRelation (eq = exact, gte = lower bound). A read: POST /contacts/search changes nothing.

tools.name: sprucehealth_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: One contact by Spruce contact id (entity_…): demographics, phones, emails, tags, custom and organization fields, integration links. GET /contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_contact_conversations
tools.title: List a contact's conversations
tools.description: The conversations (secure, SMS/phone, email, fax…) associated with one contact. GET /contacts/{contactId}/conversations.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_contact_integration_links
tools.title: List a contact's integration links
tools.description: Links between a contact and external systems (Elation, Hint, athena, custom): type, external id, url. GET /contacts/{contactId}/integrationlinks.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_contact_tags
tools.title: List contact tags
tools.description: All contact tags of the organization. Paged with hasMore/paginationToken; totalCount included. GET /contacts/tags.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_contact_fields
tools.title: List organization contact fields
tools.description: The organization-wide contact fields shown on every contact. Paged; totalCount included. GET /contacts/fields.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_conversations
tools.title: List conversations
tools.description: Conversations of the organization (title, type, tags, archived, assignee, participants, last message time), ordered by creation or last message. With start_from, only conversations whose ordering time is at or after it (useful for 'what changed since…'). Eventually consistent. Paged; give start_from OR pagination_token, not both. GET /conversations.

tools.name: sprucehealth_get_conversation
tools.title: Get a conversation
tools.description: One conversation by id (t_…). GET /conversations/{conversationId}.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_conversation_items
tools.title: List conversation messages
tools.description: The items (messages, internal notes, calls, voicemails, faxes, attachments with short-lived signed URLs) in one conversation. Order newest_first (default) or oldest_first; start_from = only items created after that time. Paged with hasMore/paginationToken; totalCount is a best-effort count. GET /conversations/{conversationId}/items.

tools.name: sprucehealth_get_conversation_item
tools.title: Get a conversation message
tools.description: One conversation item (message, note, call, voicemail…) by id (ti_…). GET /conversationItems/{conversationItemId}.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_read_receipts
tools.title: List a message's read receipts
tools.description: Who has read one conversation item and when they first read it (oldest first). GET /conversationItems/{conversationItemId}/readReceipts.

tools.name: sprucehealth_get_transcription
tools.title: Get a call or voicemail transcription
tools.description: The full transcription text and its summary (if any) for a transcription id (the transcriptionId on a call/voicemail attachment). Status pending/completed/failed/noSpeech. GET /transcriptions/{transcriptionId}.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_conversation_tags
tools.title: List conversation tags
tools.description: All conversation tags of the organization. Paged; totalCount included. GET /conversations/tags.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_conversation_scheduled_messages
tools.title: List a conversation's scheduled messages
tools.description: Messages scheduled to be sent later in one conversation (read only; nothing is sent or cancelled). GET /conversations/{conversationId}/scheduledmessages.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_scheduled_messages
tools.title: List scheduled messages
tools.description: All messages scheduled to be sent from the organization (read only). Paged with hasMore/paginationToken; totalCount included. GET /scheduledmessages.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_saved_messages
tools.title: List saved messages
tools.description: Saved message templates (private and organization-wide): title, text, internal/shared flags. Paged with hasMore/paginationToken. GET /savedmessages.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_internal_endpoints
tools.title: List internal endpoints
tools.description: The organization's own channels: Spruce phone and fax numbers, email addresses and Spruce Links, with their owner and members. GET /internalendpoints.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_phone_lines
tools.title: List phone lines
tools.description: All phone lines of the organization (id, name); totalCount included. GET /phonelines.

tools.name: sprucehealth_get_phone_line
tools.title: Get a phone line
tools.description: One phone line by id (pd_…). GET /phonelines/{phonelineId}.

tools.name: sprucehealth_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: sprucehealth_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Spruce Health tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Spruce Health (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: sprucehealth_cancel_subscription

tools.description: Cancel the caller's Spruce Health Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run sprucehealth_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

Find the contact record for patient Jane Smith.
Show the latest messages in Jane Smith's conversation.
Which phone lines and teammates are set up in our organization?

servers.name: TalentLMS
servers.description: Read TalentLMS users, courses, groups, branches and progress; create learners and enroll users.

tools.name: talentlms_get_portal_statistics
tools.title: Get portal statistics
tools.description: Portal-wide totals (users, courses, categories, groups, branches, monthly active users) and settings (signup method, date format, branch limit). A good first call. GET /api/v2/statistics.

tools.name: talentlms_get_timeline
tools.title: Get timeline
tools.description: Recent portal events (logins, user/course/group/branch changes, course completions, certificates...) with the user and related course/group/branch/unit. Filter by event type (e.g. course_completion, user_login_user, user_create_user) and a date range. GET /api/v2/timeline.

tools.name: talentlms_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the portal's users (id, login, name, email, user type, status, registration, last login), paginated. Filter by keyword (name/login/email), exact email or login, status, branch, group, last-updated range or a custom field value. GET /api/v2/users.

tools.name: talentlms_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Full profile of one user: login, name, email, user type, status, timezone, locale, credits, custom fields, deactivation date. GET /api/v2/users/{id}.

tools.name: talentlms_list_user_courses
tools.title: List a user's courses
tools.description: The courses a user is enrolled in, with their role (learner/instructor), enrollment and completion dates, completion status and percentage, score and total time. GET /api/v2/users/{id}/courses.

tools.name: talentlms_list_user_groups
tools.title: List a user's groups
tools.description: The groups a user belongs to (id, name). GET /api/v2/users/{id}/groups.

tools.name: talentlms_list_user_branches
tools.title: List a user's branches
tools.description: The branches a user belongs to (id, name). GET /api/v2/users/{id}/branches.

tools.name: talentlms_list_user_certificates
tools.title: List a user's certificates
tools.description: Certificates a user has earned (course, issue and expiration dates, download/public URLs). GET /api/v2/users/{id}/certificates.

tools.name: talentlms_get_course_progress
tools.title: Get a user's progress in a course
tools.description: One user's status in one course: enrolled or not, role, completion status, completion percentage and date, score, total time, last viewed unit and certificate. GET /api/v2/course-progress?user_id=&course_id=.

tools.name: talentlms_list_courses
tools.title: List courses
tools.description: List the portal's courses (id, name, code, category, status, price, dates, catalog visibility), paginated. Optionally only courses with a given custom course field value. GET /api/v2/courses.

tools.name: talentlms_get_course
tools.title: Get a course
tools.description: Full details of one course: description, category, status, price, capacity, time limit, start/expiration, settings. GET /api/v2/courses/{id}.

tools.name: talentlms_list_course_users
tools.title: List a course's users
tools.description: Users enrolled in a course with their enrollment date, completion status, completion percentage, completion date and total time: the course's progress report. GET /api/v2/courses/{id}/users.

tools.name: talentlms_list_categories
tools.title: List course categories
tools.description: The course category tree (id, parent, name, price, children), paginated. GET /api/v2/categories.

tools.name: talentlms_list_learning_paths
tools.title: List learning paths
tools.description: Learning paths (sequences of courses) with status, category, price, dates and rules, paginated. GET /api/v2/learning-paths.

tools.name: talentlms_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List the portal's groups (id, name, description, branch, price, key redemptions), paginated. GET /api/v2/groups.

tools.name: talentlms_get_group
tools.title: Get a group
tools.description: Details of one group: name, description, branch, group key, max key redemptions, price. GET /api/v2/groups/{id}.

tools.name: talentlms_list_group_users
tools.title: List a group's users
tools.description: Members of a group (id, login, name, email, user type, status, last login), paginated. GET /api/v2/groups/{id}/users.

tools.name: talentlms_list_branches
tools.title: List branches
tools.description: List the portal's branches (sub-portals: id, name, URL, description, active), paginated. GET /api/v2/branches.

tools.name: talentlms_get_branch
tools.title: Get a branch
tools.description: Details of one branch: URL, title, theme, default locale/timezone/user type/group, signup and verification settings, e-commerce settings. GET /api/v2/branches/{id}.

tools.name: talentlms_list_branch_users
tools.title: List a branch's users
tools.description: Users in a branch (id, login, name, email, user type, status, last login), paginated. GET /api/v2/branches/{id}/users.

tools.name: talentlms_create_user
tools.title: Create a learner
tools.description: WRITE: create a new LEARNER account in the portal (TalentLMS may email the user, depending on the portal's settings). The user type is always the portal's built-in Learner-Type; this tool cannot create administrators, instructors or any other type (the portal's default type is never used, since it may be an admin type). If the portal has no type named Learner-Type, the tool refuses. Returns the new user's id and type. POST /api/v2/users.

servers.name: Textline
servers.description: Read Textline conversations, contacts and reports; send a text, add notes, resolve or transfer.

tools.name: textline_list_conversations
tools.title: List conversations
tools.description: List conversations (one per contact) in a department of the Textline shared inbox, with the contact and resolved status. Optional keyword search. GET /api/conversations.json.

tools.name: textline_get_conversation
tools.title: Get conversation messages
tools.description: Retrieve one conversation and its posts (messages in and out, internal whispers, resolve/transfer events), newest page first. Page with page/page_size or with before_uuid/after_uuid (a post uuid). GET /api/conversation/{uuid}.json.

tools.name: textline_get_conversation_by_phone
tools.title: Get conversation by phone number
tools.description: Retrieve the conversation with a phone number (in a department) and its posts (messages). GET /api/conversations.json?phone_number=….

tools.name: textline_list_customers
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: List or search contacts (customers) in the Textline address book: name, phone, email, tags, notes, custom fields, consent and reachability. GET /api/customers.json.

tools.name: textline_get_customer
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Retrieve one contact (customer) from the address book by UUID. GET /api/customer/{uuid}.json.

tools.name: textline_get_customer_by_phone
tools.title: Get contact by phone number
tools.description: Retrieve one contact (customer) from the address book by phone number. GET /api/customers.json?phone_number=….

tools.name: textline_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List contact custom fields
tools.description: List the address book's custom fields (name, data type, UUID). Use the UUIDs with textline_update_customer. GET /api/address_book/custom_fields.json.

tools.name: textline_list_saved_searches
tools.title: List saved searches
tools.description: List the address book's saved searches (contact segments) with name, description and UUID. GET /api/address_book/saved_searches.json.

tools.name: textline_get_organization
tools.title: Get organization
tools.description: Retrieve the organization (account) name, optionally with its departments and agents. GET /api/organization.json.

tools.name: textline_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List the departments (groups / inbox phone lines) the token's agent can see: name, UUID, phone number, type (sms, facebook, smart_sms) and member agent UUIDs. GET /api/groups.json.

tools.name: textline_list_agents

tools.name: textline_list_dispositions

GET /api/reporting/conversations.json.

tools.name: textline_report_posts
tools.title: Report posts of a conversation
tools.description: Reporting API: list all posts (messages, whispers) of one conversation with creator, thread, first-response flags, filtered by created time, with total_records. To get the next page pass the returned next.search_uuid, next.page and next.page_size exactly. GET /api/reporting/conversation/{uuid}/posts.json.

tools.name: textline_send_message

tools.description: SENDS A REAL SMS/MMS to ONE contact from your Textline number — the customer receives it immediately and it cannot be unsent; it consumes message credits. tools.name: trackpod_list_orders
tools.title: List orders for a day
tools.description: List the orders of one day — by order date (GET /Order/Date/{date}) or by planned route date (GET /Order/Route/Date/{date}) — with optional filters on delivery status, driver and route number. tools.name: trackpod_list_orders_changed_since
tools.title: List orders with a recent status change
tools.description: List orders whose delivery status changed after a moment in the last 24 hours (GET /Order/Status/Date/{date-time}; Track-POD accepts no earlier time than UTC now − 1 day). Good for 'what was delivered / failed since this morning'. Paged here (offset/limit).

tools.name: trackpod_list_route_orders
