tools.name: trackpod_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order with every field: client, address, time slot, goods lines, route, driver, delivery status, ETA, signature/photo links and tracking link. Pass exactly one of number, order_id or track_id (GET /Order/Number|Id|TrackId/{…}). A removed order answers with who removed it (HTTP 410).

tools.name: trackpod_find_orders_by_number
tools.title: Find orders by number
tools.description: List the last 25 orders that share one order number (re-deliveries, repeated jobs) — GET /Order/Number/{number}/List. Use it when an order number was reused and trackpod_get_order returns only one of them.

tools.name: trackpod_get_proof_of_delivery
tools.title: Get proof of delivery
tools.description: Get the electronic proof of delivery (ePOD) of one order: status and status time/GPS, who signed, signature and photo links (valid 24 h), driver comment, reject reasons, delivered vs ordered goods quantities, cash collected, customer feedback and the PDF delivery-note link (ReportUrl, valid 1 h). Pass exactly one of number, order_id or track_id.

tools.name: trackpod_list_reject_reasons
tools.title: List reject reasons
tools.description: List the account's reasons for not delivering / not collecting: site, order, goods and scanning issues (GET /RejectReason).

tools.name: trackpod_list_routes
tools.title: List routes for a day
tools.description: List the routes of one day (GET /Route/Date/{date}): code, status (Draft, Ready, Loaded, InProgress, Closed), driver, vehicle, planned vs actual start/finish, distance, cost, current GPS position, and per-route order counts by status. Paged here (offset/limit).

tools.name: trackpod_get_route
tools.title: Get a route
tools.description: Get one route with its status, driver, vehicle, timings, distance, cost, current GPS position and its orders. Pass exactly one of route_code or route_id (GET /Route/Code|Id/{…}).

tools.name: trackpod_get_route_track
tools.title: Get a route's GPS track
tools.description: Get the driver's recorded GPS track of a route (latitude, longitude, speed in m/s, time) — GET /Route/Track/Code|Id/{…}. Pass exactly one of route_code or route_id. Points are paged here (offset/limit, max 1000 per call).

tools.name: trackpod_list_drivers
tools.title: List drivers
tools.description: List the account's drivers: name, username, phone, vehicle, depot, zone, teams and active flag (GET /Driver). Paged here.

tools.name: trackpod_get_driver
tools.title: Get a driver
tools.description: Get one driver by Track-POD id (UUID) or by username (GET /Driver/Id/{id} or /Driver/Username/{username}). Pass exactly one.

tools.name: trackpod_list_vehicles
tools.title: List vehicles
tools.description: List the account's vehicles: plate number, assigned driver, depot, capacity (weight/volume/pallets/size), limits, costs, type and carrier (GET /Vehicle, optional plate-number filter). Paged here.

tools.name: trackpod_get_vehicle
tools.title: Get a vehicle
tools.description: Get one vehicle by its Track-POD id (an integer, from trackpod_list_vehicles) — GET /Vehicle/{id}.

tools.name: trackpod_list_vehicle_checks
tools.title: List vehicle checks
tools.description: Driver vehicle inspections (before/after route): checklist items with pass/fail, notes, photo links (valid 24 h), odometer and signature. date only: every check of that day (GET /VehicleCheck/Date/{date}); date + vehicle_number: that vehicle's checks of the day; vehicle_number only: that vehicle's last check (GET /VehicleCheck/{number}).

tools.name: trackpod_create_order
tools.title: Create an order
tools.description: Create ONE REAL unscheduled order in Track-POD (POST /Order): a delivery or a collection for a client at an address, ready to be planned into a route by a dispatcher. It does not create or optimise routes. Depending on the account's notification settings the customer may later receive SMS/e-mail updates about it. Confirm the details with the user first. Address and client are required; Track-POD geocodes the address unless you pass address_lat/address_lon.

tools.name: trackpod_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: trackpod_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Track-POD tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: trackpod_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Track-POD (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: trackpod_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Track-POD Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run trackpod_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: In Track-POD go to **Settings → API key** and copy the key. API access depends on your Track-POD plan. Your key is used only to call the Track-POD API on your behalf and to derive a private account id; it is never shown to anyone.

examples: Which deliveries are planned for today and what is their status?
Show today's routes with their drivers and vehicles.
Show the proof of delivery for order 2031.
Which orders changed delivery status in the last few hours?

servers.name: Veeqo
servers.description: Read Veeqo orders, products, stock, warehouses, customers and POs; add notes, tag, set stock.

tools.name: veeqo_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: The Veeqo company this API key belongs to: id, name, product (e.g. veeqo-shipping), paying/trial state, address and company settings (currency, weight/dimension units, timezone). The employee list and billing internals are not returned. GET /current_company.

tools.name: veeqo_list_stores
tools.title: List stores (sales channels)
tools.description: List the sales channels (stores) connected to Veeqo — Amazon, eBay, Shopify, POS, etc. — with id, name, type and state. Use the ids to filter orders by store. Marketplace credentials and integration settings are never returned. GET /channels.

tools.name: veeqo_list_warehouses
tools.title: List warehouses
tools.description: List warehouses with address, phone and dispatch cut-off times. Use the ids for stock levels and warehouse filters. GET /warehouses.

tools.name: veeqo_get_warehouse
tools.title: Get warehouse
tools.description: One warehouse by id. GET /warehouses/{id}.

tools.name: veeqo_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List or search orders, newest first, with line items, customer, delivery address, store, allocations and shipments (tracking numbers). Filter by status, store, tag, free text, created/due date or update time. GET /orders.

tools.name: veeqo_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by id: status, totals, line items (sellable ids, SKUs, quantities), customer and delivery address, store, notes, tags, allocations and shipments with tracking numbers. GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: veeqo_get_order_returns
tools.title: Get order returns
tools.description: Returns (RMAs) recorded on an order for one of its sellables: return number, status, reason, returned line items and received quantities. Veeqo's reference requires the sellable id (an order line item's sellable.id). GET /orders/{id}/returns?sellable_id=.

tools.name: veeqo_get_shipment_tracking
tools.title: Get shipment tracking
tools.description: Tracking events (timestamp, status, description, location) for a shipment. Available when the label was bought in Veeqo. The shipment id is in an order's allocations[].shipment. GET /shipping/tracking_events/{shipment_id}.

tools.name: veeqo_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List or search products with their sellables (variants): SKU, UPC, price, cost, and per-warehouse stock entries (physical, allocated, available). GET /products.

tools.name: veeqo_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One product by id with all sellables (variants), prices, weights, customs data and stock entries per warehouse. GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: veeqo_get_stock_entry
tools.title: Get stock level
tools.description: Stock of one sellable (variant) in one warehouse: physical, allocated, available, incoming (purchase orders) and in-transit levels, bin location and the low-stock flag. GET /sellables/{sellable_id}/warehouses/{warehouse_id}/stock_entry.

tools.name: veeqo_set_stock_level
tools.title: Set stock level
tools.description: WRITE: set the physical stock level of ONE sellable in ONE warehouse (a stock count correction), optionally its bin location. This overwrites the current on-hand quantity, and Veeqo may push the new available stock to the connected sales channels. The entry's infinite-stock setting is read first and kept as it is (this tool never changes it). Veeqo marks this endpoint 'Paid plan only'. GET then PUT /sellables/{sellable_id}/warehouses/{warehouse_id}/stock_entry.

tools.name: veeqo_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List or search customers with email, phone, billing address and shipping addresses. GET /customers.

tools.name: veeqo_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer by id with billing and shipping addresses and notes. GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: veeqo_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers with address, sales/accounting contacts, currency, credit limit and open/completed purchase-order counts (bank details are not returned). Paid Veeqo plans only. GET /suppliers.

tools.name: veeqo_get_supplier
tools.title: Get supplier
tools.description: One supplier by id (bank details are not returned). Paid Veeqo plans only. GET /suppliers/{id}.

tools.name: veeqo_list_purchase_orders
tools.title: List purchase orders
tools.description: List or search purchase orders with supplier, destination warehouse and line items (ordered/received quantities, cost). Search-index backed, so a just-changed PO may be stale here — confirm with veeqo_get_purchase_order. Paid Veeqo plans only. GET /purchase_orders.

tools.name: veeqo_get_purchase_order
tools.title: Get purchase order
tools.description: One purchase order by id with supplier, destination warehouse and every line item. Paid Veeqo plans only. GET /purchase_orders/{id}.

tools.name: veeqo_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: All tags in the account (id, name, colour, how many records use it). Use the ids with veeqo_tag_orders. GET /tags.

tools.name: veeqo_list_delivery_methods
tools.title: List delivery methods
tools.description: List the delivery methods orders can use (id, name, cost). GET /delivery_methods.

tools.name: veeqo_add_order_note
tools.title: Add order note
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal (employee) note to an order, e.g. 'Customer asked for gift wrap'. It is visible to your Veeqo team on the order; it is not emailed to the customer. Notes cannot be deleted through the API. POST /orders/{order_id}/notes.

tools.name: veeqo_tag_orders
tools.title: Tag orders
tools.description: WRITE: apply existing tags (ids from veeqo_list_tags) to up to 50 orders. Tags can drive Veeqo automation rules and filters. Tagging an order that already has the tag changes nothing. POST /bulk_tagging.

tools.name: veeqo_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: veeqo_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Veeqo tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: veeqo_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Veeqo (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: veeqo_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Veeqo Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run veeqo_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: Find it in Veeqo → **Settings → Users** → your user → **Refresh API Key**. The key acts with that user's permissions; a dedicated user makes its activity easy to track. Your key is used only to call the Veeqo API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

examples: How many orders came in today and which are still unshipped?
Which products are running low on stock in my main warehouse?
Show the tracking events for order 5012.
Add a note to order 5012: customer asked for gift wrapping.

servers.name: Clockify
servers.description: Track time in Clockify: time entries, projects, clients, tags and reports; start, stop and log time.

tools.name: clockify_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: The Clockify user this API key belongs to: id, name, email, status, active and default workspace ids, and profile settings (time zone, week start, date/time format). GET /v1/user.

tools.name: clockify_list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: List the Clockify workspaces you belong to: id, name, plan (featureSubscriptionType), subdomain, currencies and default hourly/cost rate. Use the id as workspace_id in other tools. GET /v1/workspaces.

tools.name: clockify_list_users
tools.title: List workspace users
tools.description: List the members of a workspace: id, name, email, status and settings. Filter by name, email, status or project access. GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/users.

tools.name: clockify_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List the clients of a workspace (id, name, email, address, currency, archived). GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/clients.

tools.name: clockify_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the projects of a workspace: id, name, client, billable, public, color, archived, duration tracked, estimate and rates. Filter by name, client, user, billable or archived. GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/projects.

tools.name: clockify_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: One project by id: name, client, billable, color, note, estimate, duration tracked, rates and memberships. GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/projects/{projectId}.

tools.name: clockify_list_tasks
tools.title: List project tasks
tools.description: List the tasks of a project (id, name, status, assignees, estimate, duration tracked). GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/projects/{projectId}/tasks.

tools.name: clockify_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the tags of a workspace (id, name, archived). GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/tags.

tools.name: clockify_list_time_entries
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List the time entries of one user (default: you), newest first: id, description, project, task, tags, billable and timeInterval (start, end, ISO 8601 duration). Filter by time range, project, task, tags or description. For totals across users use clockify_summary_report. GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/user/{userId}/time-entries.

tools.name: clockify_get_time_entry
tools.title: Get a time entry
tools.description: One time entry by id: description, project, task, tags, billable, rates, custom fields and timeInterval. GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/time-entries/{id}.

tools.name: clockify_get_running_timer
tools.title: Get running timer
tools.description: The timer that is running right now for a user (default: you), or running: false. GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/user/{userId}/time-entries?in-progress=true.

tools.name: clockify_summary_report
tools.title: Summary report
tools.description: Totals of tracked time (seconds) and amounts for a date range across the workspace, grouped by up to 3 levels (default project → time entry), e.g. hours per user per project last month. Respects the filters. POST reports /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/reports/summary.

tools.name: clockify_detailed_report
tools.title: Detailed report
tools.description: Every time entry in a date range across the workspace (user, project, client, task, tags, description, start/end, duration in seconds, amount), with totals; newest first, paged. POST reports /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/reports/detailed.

tools.name: clockify_create_time_entry
tools.title: Log time or start a timer
tools.description: WRITE: add a time entry for yourself. With end = a finished entry (log time); without end = a running timer that starts at start (default now). A workspace with required custom fields may refuse it. POST /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/time-entries.

tools.name: clockify_stop_timer
tools.title: Stop running timer
tools.description: WRITE: stop the running timer of a user (default: you) at end (default now). Clockify answers 404 if no timer is running. PATCH /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/user/{userId}/time-entries.

tools.name: clockify_update_time_entry
tools.title: Update a time entry
tools.description: WRITE: change a time entry's start, end, description, project, task, tags or billable. Only the fields you pass change: the entry is read first and every other field (custom fields included) is sent back as it was. The entry is rewritten (PUT) from a fresh read, so an edit made to the same entry in between (e.g. in the Clockify app) can be lost. A new project without task_id clears the task. GET then PUT /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/time-entries/{id}.

tools.name: clockify_delete_time_entry
tools.title: Delete a time entry
tools.description: WRITE (destructive): permanently delete one time entry. It cannot be undone. DELETE /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/time-entries/{id}.

tools.name: clockify_create_project
tools.title: Create a project
tools.description: WRITE: create a project in a workspace (needs an admin or project-manager role, depending on workspace settings). POST /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/projects.

tools.name: clockify_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: WRITE: add a task to a project. POST /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/projects/{projectId}/tasks.

tools.name: clockify_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: WRITE: add a client to a workspace. POST /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/clients.

tools.name: clockify_create_tag
tools.title: Create a tag
tools.description: WRITE: add a tag to a workspace. POST /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/tags.

tools.name: clockify_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: clockify_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Clockify tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: clockify_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Clockify (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: clockify_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Clockify Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run clockify_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

fields.label: Workspace subdomain (only for a regional workspace on its own subdomain)

login.hint: Create the key in Clockify → **Profile settings → Advanced → Manage API keys → Generate new**. The key acts with your permissions in each workspace. The data region is shown in Workspace settings; most workspaces are **Global**. A workspace on its own subdomain (acme.clockify.me) needs a key generated while you are in that workspace. Your key is used only to call the Clockify API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

examples: How many hours did I track last week, by project?
Which client got the most tracked time this month?
Do I have a timer running right now, and on which project?
Log 2 hours on the Website Redesign project for yesterday.

servers.name: Gelato
servers.description: Browse the Gelato catalog, prices, orders and shipping; quote, create draft orders and products.

tools.name: gelato_list_catalogs
tools.title: List product catalogs
tools.description: List Gelato's product catalogs (posters, cards, t-shirts, mugs, photo books, ...) with their catalogUid and title. Start here to find products. GET product.gelatoapis.com/v3/catalogs.

tools.name: gelato_get_catalog
tools.title: Get catalog
tools.description: One catalog with the attributes that define its products (e.g. PaperFormat, PaperType, ColorType) and each attribute's possible values. Use them as attribute_filters in gelato_search_products. GET /v3/catalogs/{catalogUid}.

tools.name: gelato_search_products
tools.title: Search catalog products
tools.description: List the products of a catalog, optionally filtered by attribute values, with each product's productUid, attributes, weight and dimensions, plus hit counts per attribute value. POST /v3/catalogs/{catalogUid}/products:search.

tools.name: gelato_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One catalog product by productUid: attributes, weight, supported and unsupported countries, whether it is printable or stockable, and valid page counts for multi-page products. GET /v3/products/{productUid}.

tools.name: gelato_get_product_prices
tools.title: Get product prices
tools.description: Gelato's production prices of a product for every quantity tier, optionally for one destination country and currency. page_count is required for multi-page products. Shipping is not included (use gelato_quote_order). GET /v3/products/{productUid}/prices.

tools.name: gelato_get_cover_dimensions
tools.title: Get cover dimensions
tools.description: Cover layout of a multi-page product (photo book, brochure) in millimetres: spine, front, back, bleed and wraparound areas, for designing the cover file. GET /v3/products/{productUid}/cover-dimensions.

tools.name: gelato_check_stock
tools.title: Check stock availability
tools.description: Stock status of stockable products per stock region (US-CA, EU, UK, OC, AS, SA, ROW): in-stock, out-of-stock-replenishable (with a replenishment date), out-of-stock, non-stockable or not-supported. POST /v3/stock/region-availability.

tools.name: gelato_list_shipment_methods
tools.title: List shipment methods
tools.description: Gelato's shipment methods (shipmentMethodUid, name, type normal/express/pallet, tracking, business/private, supported destination countries), optionally only those for one destination country. GET shipment.gelatoapis.com/v1/shipment-methods.

tools.name: gelato_search_orders
tools.title: Search orders
tools.description: Search orders and drafts, newest first: id, your reference ids, order type, fulfillment and financial status, channel, store, country, currency, totals and dates. Filter by status, type, country, channel, store, reference, date range or free text (recipient name or order reference). POST /v4/orders:search.

tools.name: gelato_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by Gelato order id: type (order/draft), fulfillment and financial status, items with their files and statuses, shipment with packages and tracking codes/URLs, shipping address, receipts and totals. GET /v4/orders/{orderId}.

tools.name: gelato_quote_order
tools.title: Quote order
tools.description: Price an order before placing it: product prices and the available shipment methods (shipmentMethodUid, price, min/max delivery days and dates) per fulfillment facility, for a recipient address. Nothing is created or charged. Pass a returned shipmentMethodUid to gelato_create_order. POST /v4/orders:quote.

tools.name: gelato_create_order
tools.title: Create order (draft by default)
tools.description: Create an order. By default it is a DRAFT: nothing is produced or charged until it is submitted with gelato_submit_draft_order (or in the dashboard). With order_type "order" Gelato starts production and charges the account right away. Shipment: a shipmentMethodUid from gelato_quote_order, or "normal"/"standard"/"express"; omitted = the cheapest. POST /v4/orders.

tools.name: gelato_submit_draft_order
tools.title: Submit draft order
tools.description: Convert a DRAFT order into a regular order: Gelato starts production and charges the account. Items stay as they are. Only drafts can be submitted. PATCH /v4/orders/{orderId} {"orderType":"order"}.

tools.name: gelato_cancel_order
tools.title: Cancel order
tools.description: Cancel an order before production. Gelato refuses (HTTP 409) once any item is printed or the order has shipped. This cannot be undone. POST /v4/orders/{orderId}:cancel.

tools.name: gelato_delete_draft_order
tools.title: Delete draft order
tools.description: Permanently delete a DRAFT order (regular orders cannot be deleted; cancel them instead). DELETE /v4/orders/{orderId}.

tools.name: gelato_list_store_products
tools.title: List store products
tools.description: Products of a connected e-commerce store (Shopify, Etsy, WooCommerce, ...) as Gelato knows them: id, title, status (created/publishing/publishing_error/active), external id, variants with their productUid, preview images and dates. The store id is in the Gelato dashboard URL of the store and on its orders (storeId). GET ecommerce.gelatoapis.com/v1/stores/{storeId}/products.

tools.name: gelato_get_store_product
tools.title: Get store product
tools.description: One product of a connected store: title, description, status, variants (with productUid and external ids), options, preview and publishing state. GET /v1/stores/{storeId}/products/{productId}.

tools.name: gelato_get_template
tools.title: Get template
tools.description: A product template made in the Gelato dashboard: title, description, preview, and its variants (id, title, productUid; pass the variant id as template_variant_id) with their image placeholders (names to fill in gelato_create_product_from_template). GET /v1/templates/{templateId}.

tools.name: gelato_create_product_from_template
tools.title: Create store product from template
tools.description: Create a product in a connected store from a template, with your own images in the template's placeholders. Gelato creates the product, then publishes variants and mockups in the background (track it with gelato_get_store_product). Hidden in the online store unless visible_in_online_store is true. POST /v1/stores/{storeId}/products:create-from-template.

tools.name: gelato_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: gelato_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Gelato tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: gelato_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Gelato (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: gelato_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Gelato Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run gelato_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: Create one in the Gelato dashboard → **Developer → API Keys**. The key can create and cancel orders on your account. Your key is used only to call the Gelato API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

examples: Which print products are available in the posters catalog?
How much would it cost to produce 50 mugs, and what are the shipping options?
Show my most recent orders and whether they have shipped.
Are the products I sell in stock in the EU region?

servers.name: Fathom Analytics
servers.description: Query Fathom Analytics sites, stats, current visitors and events, and manage sites and events.

tools.name: fathom_get_token
tools.title: Get the API token's permissions
tools.description: The connected API token's name, permissions (abilities: "*" = Admin, "all-sites-readonly", or per-site read:<id> / manage:<id>) and timestamps. The secret value is never returned. Good first call to know which tools will work. GET /token.

tools.name: fathom_get_account
tools.title: Get the account
tools.description: The Fathom account that owns the API token: id, name and email. Needs an Admin token (the * scope). GET /account.

tools.name: fathom_list_sites
tools.title: List sites
tools.description: List the sites the token can read (id, name, sharing, timezone, created_at), oldest first. The site id is what every report tool takes. Needs an Admin or all-sites read-only token; a token scoped to a single site cannot list sites, so use fathom_get_site with that site id instead. Paged: pass next.starting_after. GET /sites.

tools.name: fathom_get_site
tools.title: Get a site
tools.description: One site: id, name, sharing (none/private/public), timezone and created_at. GET /sites/{site_id}.

tools.name: fathom_list_events
tools.title: List a site's events
tools.description: List a site's events (conversions/goals): every event name the site has tracked plus events with a currency set, sorted by name. Identify events by name (use it as event_name in fathom_get_aggregation); the id is only a paging cursor. Paged: pass next.starting_after. GET /sites/{site_id}/events.

tools.name: fathom_list_milestones
tools.title: List a site's milestones
tools.description: List a site's milestones (dated annotations on reports, such as a redesign launch or a campaign start), oldest first. Paged: pass next.starting_after. GET /sites/{site_id}/milestones.

tools.name: fathom_get_milestone
tools.title: Get a milestone
tools.description: One milestone: id, name, milestone_date, created_at, updated_at. GET /sites/{site_id}/milestones/{milestone_id}.

tools.name: fathom_get_aggregation
tools.title: Run a traffic or event report
tools.description: Fathom's custom report (the dashboard's numbers): aggregate pageviews or one event over a date range, optionally grouped by date and/or fields and filtered. Pageviews: aggregates visits (unique site visits), uniques (unique page visits), pageviews, avg_duration (seconds), bounce_rate. Events (entity event + event_name): conversions, unique_conversions, value (in cents). Examples: top pages = field_grouping [pathname], sort_by pageviews:desc; traffic sources = [referrer_source] or [referrer_hostname]; AI referrals = [ai_source]; daily trend = date_grouping day. All numbers come back as strings. Dates are in the site's timezone; hour grouping only for ranges up to 7 days. Grouped reports return at most 500 rows unless limit is set (max 1000, no paging), so narrow with filters or dates. Data before March 2021 cannot be grouped/filtered. GET /aggregations.

tools.name: fathom_get_current_visitors
tools.title: Get current visitors
tools.description: Live visitors on a site right now: the total, and with detailed true the top 150 pages (hostname, pathname, total) and top 150 referrers. GET /current_visitors.

tools.name: fathom_create_site
tools.title: Create a site
tools.description: Create a new site in the Fathom account (returns its id, used in the tracking code). Needs an Admin token. Sharing private needs share_password; multi_domain true needs multi_domain_option. POST /sites.

tools.name: fathom_update_site
tools.title: Update a site
tools.description: Change a site's name, sharing, timezone or multi-domain setting (send only what changes). Changing the timezone changes how reports are bucketed. Needs a manage token for the site. POST /sites/{site_id}.

tools.name: fathom_set_event_currency
tools.title: Set an event's currency
tools.description: Set the currency of an event's value by event name (works before the event is first tracked). Needs a manage token for the site. POST /sites/{site_id}/events/currency.

tools.name: fathom_clear_event_currency
tools.title: Clear an event's currency
tools.description: Remove the currency set for an event, so it uses the site's default again. The event and its completion data stay. Needs a manage token for the site. DELETE /sites/{site_id}/events?name=.

tools.name: fathom_create_milestone
tools.title: Create a milestone
tools.description: Add a milestone (a dated annotation shown on the site's reports, e.g. a launch or campaign start). Needs a manage token for the site. POST /sites/{site_id}/milestones.

tools.name: fathom_update_milestone
tools.title: Update a milestone
tools.description: Rename or re-date a milestone (both name and milestone_date are required). Needs a manage token for the site. POST /sites/{site_id}/milestones/{milestone_id}.

tools.name: fathom_delete_milestone
tools.title: Delete a milestone
tools.description: Permanently delete a milestone (only the annotation; traffic data is not touched). Cannot be undone. Needs a manage token for the site. DELETE /sites/{site_id}/milestones/{milestone_id}.

tools.name: fathom_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: fathom_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Fathom Analytics tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: fathom_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Fathom Analytics (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: fathom_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Fathom Analytics Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run fathom_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: Create a token at [app.usefathom.com/api](https://app.usefathom.com/api) → **Create new**. A **read only (all sites)** token is enough for reports; writes need Admin or site-manage access. Every API request counts towards your monthly pageviews. Your token is used only to call the Fathom API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

examples: How many pageviews did my site get last week?
How many people are on my website right now?
How many times was the signup event triggered this month?
Add a milestone to my site for today: launched the new pricing page.

servers.name: Paperform
servers.description: Read Paperform forms, submissions, products and coupons, Papersign documents, and manage coupons.

tools.name: paperform_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List the forms in the Paperform account (id, slug, custom_slug, title, url, live, tags, submission_count, space_id, dates), newest first. Search by title, or also by slug/custom_slug with search_fields. Start here to find the slug or id the other tools need. Paperform: GET /forms.

tools.name: paperform_get_form
tools.title: Get a form
tools.description: Fetch one form by slug, custom slug or id: title, description, url, live flag, tags, submission_count, space and dates. Paperform: GET /forms/{slug_or_id}.

tools.name: paperform_list_form_fields
tools.title: List form fields
tools.description: List a form's questions (key, title, type, required, custom_key, description, options). The field keys are the keys of a submission's `data` object, so read this to interpret answers. Paperform: GET /forms/{slug_or_id}/fields.

tools.name: paperform_list_submissions
tools.title: List submissions
tools.description: List one page of a form's completed submissions, newest first: answers (`data`, keyed by field key — see paperform_list_form_fields), device and UTM info, payment `charge`, generated PDFs and created_at. Page with skip/next_skip or after_id/last_id; filter by date. Paperform: GET /forms/{slug_or_id}/submissions.

tools.name: paperform_get_submission
tools.title: Get a submission
tools.description: Fetch one submission by id, with every answer, device info, payment charge and PDFs. Paperform: GET /submissions/{id}.

tools.name: paperform_list_partial_submissions
tools.title: List partial submissions
tools.description: List one page of a form's partial submissions (someone started the form), newest first: answers so far, last_answered field, dates. Partials that were later completed stay in the list with submitted_at set; only those with submitted_at null are abandoned. Useful for drop-off analysis and follow-ups. Paperform: GET /forms/{slug_or_id}/partial-submissions.

tools.name: paperform_get_partial_submission
tools.title: Get a partial submission
tools.description: Fetch one partial submission by id, with the answers given so far. It may have been completed since (submitted_at set); submitted_at null means abandoned. Paperform: GET /partial-submissions/{id}.

tools.name: paperform_list_products
tools.title: List form products
tools.description: List the products sold on a form (SKU, name, price, quantity in stock, sold, minimum/maximum, discountable, images). Paperform: GET /forms/{slug_or_id}/products.

tools.name: paperform_get_product
tools.title: Get a form product
tools.description: Fetch one product on a form by SKU: price, quantity in stock, sold count, limits. Paperform: GET /forms/{slug_or_id}/products/{sku}.

tools.name: paperform_list_coupons
tools.title: List form coupons
tools.description: List a form's coupon codes (code, enabled, target, discountAmount or discountPercentage, expiresAt). Paperform: GET /forms/{slug_or_id}/coupons.

tools.name: paperform_get_coupon
tools.title: Get a form coupon
tools.description: Fetch one coupon on a form by code. Paperform: GET /forms/{slug_or_id}/coupons/{code}.

tools.name: paperform_list_webhooks
tools.title: List form webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks on a form (id, target_url, triggers: submission / partial_submission, dates). Needs the Business API. Paperform: GET /forms/{slug_or_id}/webhooks.

tools.name: paperform_list_spaces
tools.title: List spaces
tools.description: List the account's spaces (folders that group forms): id, name, dates. Needs the Business API. Paperform: GET /spaces.

tools.name: paperform_list_space_forms
tools.title: List the forms in a space
tools.description: List the forms in one space. Needs the Business API. Paperform: GET /spaces/{id}/forms.

tools.name: paperform_list_papersign_documents
tools.title: List Papersign documents
tools.description: List Papersign e-signature documents (id, name, status, folder, space, signers, variables, source form/submission, sent/completed dates), filtered by name, status, folder, space or the Paperform submission that created them. Needs the Papersign API. Paperform: GET /papersign/documents.

tools.name: paperform_get_papersign_document
tools.title: Get a Papersign document
tools.description: Fetch one Papersign document by id: status, signers and their progress, variables, folder, space and dates. Needs the Papersign API. Paperform: GET /papersign/documents/{id}.

tools.name: paperform_get_signed_document_url
tools.title: Get the signed PDF link
tools.description: Get a download link for a completed (fully signed) Papersign document as a PDF. A fresh link is made on each call and is valid for one week (expires_at_utc). Needs the Papersign API. Paperform: GET /papersign/documents/{id}/completed-document-url.

tools.name: paperform_list_papersign_folders
tools.title: List Papersign folders
tools.description: List Papersign folders (id, name, parent_id, space_id), optionally inside one space or folder. Needs the Papersign API. Paperform: GET /papersign/folders.

tools.name: paperform_list_papersign_spaces
tools.title: List Papersign spaces
tools.description: List Papersign spaces (id, name, root_folder_id). Needs the Papersign API. Paperform: GET /papersign/spaces.

tools.name: paperform_create_coupon
tools.title: Create a form coupon
tools.description: WRITE: create a coupon code on a form, with a fixed discountAmount or a discountPercentage (not both), an optional target (price or subscription) and expiry. Respondents can use it at checkout as soon as it is enabled. Undo: paperform_update_coupon with enabled=false. Paperform: POST /forms/{slug_or_id}/coupons.

tools.name: paperform_update_coupon
tools.title: Update a form coupon
tools.description: WRITE: change a coupon on a form — enable or disable it, change its discount (amount or percentage), target or expiry (null = never expires). Only the fields you pass are sent. Paperform: PUT /forms/{slug_or_id}/coupons/{code}.

tools.name: paperform_set_product_quantity
tools.title: Set a product's stock quantity
tools.description: WRITE: set how many units of a form product are available (its stock quantity), e.g. after restocking. Replaces the current value; read it first with paperform_get_product. Not atomic: it overwrites rather than adjusts, so a sale between your read and this write is lost. Paperform: PUT /forms/{slug_or_id}/products/{sku}/quantity.

tools.name: paperform_set_product_sold
tools.title: Set a product's sold count
tools.description: WRITE: set the number of units of a form product recorded as sold (e.g. to correct it after a refund or an offline sale). Replaces the current value; read it first with paperform_get_product. Not atomic: it overwrites rather than adjusts, so a sale between your read and this write is lost. Paperform: PUT /forms/{slug_or_id}/products/{sku}/sold.

tools.name: paperform_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: paperform_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Paperform tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: paperform_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Paperform (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: paperform_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Paperform Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run paperform_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: Create it in Paperform → **Account → Developer** (paperform.co/account/developer). API access comes with Paperform plans that include the Standard or Business API, or Papersign plans with the Papersign API. Your key is used only to call the Paperform API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

examples: How many submissions did my contact form get this week?
Show the latest 10 submissions on my booking form.
Which coupon codes are active on my order form?
How many units of each product have been sold on my shop form?

servers.name: UserVoice
servers.description: Search UserVoice ideas, feedback and users; post ideas, comments, notes and status updates.

tools.name: uservoice_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The UserVoice account (subdomain) these credentials belong to: id, name, default forum and settings. GET /api/v2/admin/subdomains/current.

tools.name: uservoice_list_forums
tools.title: List forums
tools.description: List the feedback forums (idea portals) with name, open/private state and suggestion counts. Use a forum id to filter or create suggestions. GET /api/v2/admin/forums.

tools.name: uservoice_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List suggestion categories, optionally only those of some forums. GET /api/v2/admin/categories.

tools.name: uservoice_list_statuses
tools.title: List statuses
tools.description: List the public suggestion statuses (e.g. under review, planned, started, completed, declined) with ids, colors and open/closed flag. Use the ids for filters and status updates. GET /api/v2/admin/statuses.

tools.name: uservoice_list_labels
tools.title: List labels
tools.description: List or search the labels used to organize suggestions. GET /api/v2/admin/labels.

tools.name: uservoice_list_suggestions
tools.title: List suggestions
tools.description: List or search suggestions (ideas) with title, body, state, vote/supporter counts, revenue of supporters and links to forum, category, status and labels. Filter by text, forum, category, status, state, label or created/updated time. GET /api/v2/admin/suggestions.

tools.name: uservoice_get_suggestion
tools.title: Get suggestion
tools.description: One suggestion (idea) by id, optionally with related records (forum, category, status, labels, users, status updates). GET /api/v2/admin/suggestions/{id}.

tools.name: uservoice_list_comments
tools.title: List comments
tools.description: List public comments, optionally only those on some suggestions or in some moderation states. GET /api/v2/admin/comments.

tools.name: uservoice_list_notes
tools.title: List internal notes
tools.description: List internal (admin-only) notes, optionally only those on one suggestion. GET /api/v2/admin/notes.

tools.name: uservoice_list_status_updates
tools.title: List status updates
tools.description: List the public status updates posted on suggestions (message, how many supporters were emailed, opens/clicks, reactions). GET /api/v2/admin/status_updates.

tools.name: uservoice_list_supporters
tools.title: List supporters (votes)
tools.description: List supporters (voters) of suggestions: who supports what, how (channel), importance and subscription. Filter by suggestion, user or forum. GET /api/v2/admin/supporters.

tools.name: uservoice_list_feedback_records
tools.title: List feedback records
tools.description: List captured feedback (from the admin console, widget, Zendesk, Salesforce, Slack, API ...), optionally only that linked to some suggestions or users. GET /api/v2/admin/feedback_records.

tools.name: uservoice_list_features
tools.title: List features
tools.description: List product features (the roadmap items suggestions are linked to) with suggestion counts and supporter revenue. Filter by text, linked suggestion or product area. GET /api/v2/admin/features.

tools.name: uservoice_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List or search end users and admins (name, email, satisfaction score, supported suggestions count). Filter by text, email address or supported suggestion. GET /api/v2/admin/users.

tools.name: uservoice_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: One user by id. GET /api/v2/admin/users/{id}.

tools.name: uservoice_create_suggestion
tools.title: Create suggestion
tools.description: WRITE: create a new suggestion (idea) in a forum, optionally in a category and on behalf of a user (by email; the user is created if new). It appears on the portal. POST /api/v2/admin/suggestions.

tools.name: uservoice_add_comment
tools.title: Add public comment
tools.description: WRITE: post a PUBLIC comment on a suggestion, visible on the portal and emailed to its subscribers, optionally on behalf of a user (by email). For an admin-only remark use uservoice_add_note. POST /api/v2/admin/comments.

tools.name: uservoice_add_note
tools.title: Add internal note
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal note (admins only, never shown to end users) to a suggestion, optionally as a reply to another note. POST /api/v2/admin/notes.

tools.name: uservoice_post_status_update
tools.title: Post status update
tools.description: WRITE: post a public status update on a suggestion, optionally changing its public status (see uservoice_list_statuses). Supporters are emailed ONLY when notify_supporters is true. POST /api/v2/admin/status_updates.

tools.name: uservoice_add_feedback
tools.title: Capture feedback
tools.description: WRITE: capture a piece of customer feedback (for example from a call or ticket), optionally from a user (by email) and linked to a suggestion, which adds that user's support. POST /api/v2/admin/feedback_records.

tools.name: uservoice_attach_label
tools.title: Attach label
tools.description: WRITE: attach a label to a suggestion (attaching it again changes nothing). POST /api/v2/admin/labels/attach.

tools.name: uservoice_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on UserVoice (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription

Requires confirm: true. Run uservoice_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: In UserVoice go to **Admin → Settings → Integrations → UserVoice API keys → Add API key**, leave the callback URL empty and check **Trusted** (the Admin API needs it; a trusted key can do what an admin can). The subdomain is the **acme** in acme.uservoice.com. Your credentials are used only to call the UserVoice API on your behalf; they are never shown to anyone.

examples: Which feature ideas have the most votes?
Show suggestions marked as planned and how many people support each.
What new comments came in on customer ideas recently?
Add an internal note to the dark mode suggestion: reviewed with the team.

servers.name: Breathe HR
servers.description: Read Breathe HR employees, absences, sickness and leave; create and review leave requests.

tools.name: breathehr_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The Breathe HR account (company) this API key belongs to: id, name, domain and enabled modules. GET /account.

tools.name: breathehr_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List the company's departments (id, name). Use the ids to filter absences, leave, sickness and pay. GET /departments.

tools.name: breathehr_list_divisions
tools.title: List divisions
tools.description: List the company's divisions (id, name). All of them are returned in one reply. GET /divisions.

tools.name: breathehr_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the company's work locations (id, name). All of them are returned in one reply. GET /locations.

tools.name: breathehr_list_working_patterns
tools.title: List working patterns
tools.description: List the working patterns (hours per weekday, total weekly hours, default flag). All of them are returned in one reply. GET /working_patterns.

tools.name: breathehr_list_holiday_allowances
tools.title: List holiday allowances
tools.description: List the holiday allowance schemes (id, default flag, year_1 to year_10 = the allowance for each year of service, created_at, updated_at). All of them are returned in one reply. GET /holiday_allowances.

tools.name: breathehr_list_other_leave_reasons
tools.title: List other leave reasons
tools.description: List the reasons for non-holiday leave (e.g. compassionate, jury service). Use the ids to filter absences. All of them are returned in one reply. GET /other_leave_reasons.

tools.name: breathehr_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List employees with job title, department, division, location, line manager, holiday approver, working pattern, join/leaving dates and status. Bank details and National Insurance numbers are never returned. GET /employees.

tools.name: breathehr_get_employee
tools.title: Get employee
tools.description: One employee's record by id (personal and job details, contacts, manager, working pattern). Bank details and NI number are never returned. GET /employees/{id}.

tools.name: breathehr_get_holiday_years
tools.title: Get holiday years (allowance balance)
tools.description: An employee's holiday years: start/end, allowance, days or hours taken, booked and remaining. Pass for_date to get only the year that contains that date. GET /employees/{id}/employee_holiday_years.

tools.name: breathehr_list_absences
tools.title: List absences
tools.description: List approved absences (holiday and other leave) with employee, dates, half days, days deducted and cancelled flag. Filter by employee, department, type, other-leave reason and dates. GET /absences.

tools.name: breathehr_list_leave_requests
tools.title: List leave requests
tools.description: List leave requests (pending, approved, rejected and cancelling requests) with employee, dates, half days, type, status and notes. Filter by employee, department and start-date range. GET /leave_requests.

tools.name: breathehr_get_leave_request
tools.title: Get leave request
tools.description: One leave request by id, with its status. GET /leave_requests/{id}.

tools.name: breathehr_list_sicknesses
tools.title: List sickness records
tools.description: List sickness absence records (health data): employee, sickness type, dates, half days, days deducted, status (open, returned, closed…) and reason. Filter by employee, department and start-date range. GET /sicknesses.

tools.name: breathehr_list_salaries
tools.title: List salaries
tools.description: List salary records (amount, basis, payment schedule, start date) for the whole company, one employee or one department. GET /salaries, /employees/{id}/salaries or /departments/{id}/salaries.

tools.name: breathehr_list_bonuses
tools.title: List bonuses
tools.description: List bonus records (amount, date, description) for the whole company, one employee or one department. GET /bonuses, /employees/{id}/bonuses or /departments/{id}/bonuses.

tools.name: breathehr_list_benefits
tools.title: List benefits
tools.description: List employee benefits (type, value, start/end) for the whole company, one employee or one department. GET /benefits, /employees/{id}/benefits or /departments/{id}/benefits.

tools.name: breathehr_list_employee_jobs
tools.title: List employee jobs
tools.description: List job history records (job title, start/end dates, department, location) for all employees or one employee. GET /employee_jobs.

tools.name: breathehr_list_training_courses
tools.title: List training courses
tools.description: List employee training records (course name, type, status, dates, cost) for all employees or one employee. GET /employee_training_courses.

tools.name: breathehr_list_expense_claims
tools.title: List expense claims
tools.description: List expense claims (employee, total, state, approver) filtered by employee and state. GET /employee_expense_claims.

tools.name: breathehr_list_expenses
tools.title: List expenses
tools.description: List individual expense items (date, description, type, amount, VAT, project). By default only unclaimed items; set include_claimed to see all. GET /employee_expenses.

tools.name: breathehr_list_change_requests
tools.title: List change requests
tools.description: List employee self-service change requests (field, requested value, approval state) for all employees or one employee. Requested values of bank and NI fields are redacted. GET /change_requests or /employees/{id}/change_requests.

tools.name: breathehr_create_leave_request
tools.title: Create leave request
tools.description: WRITE: request leave for an employee (holiday by default, or other leave). It is created as a request, then follows the account's approval rules; the employee's approver is notified. Each call creates a new request. POST /employees/{id}/leave_requests.

tools.name: breathehr_approve_leave_request
tools.title: Approve leave request
tools.description: WRITE: approve a pending leave request; it becomes an absence and is deducted from the allowance. Recorded as done by the "API Employee". POST /leave_requests/{id}/approve.

tools.name: breathehr_reject_leave_request
tools.title: Reject leave request
tools.description: WRITE: reject a pending leave request with a reason the employee will see. Recorded as done by the "API Employee". POST /leave_requests/{id}/reject.

tools.name: breathehr_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: breathehr_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Breathe HR tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: breathehr_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Breathe HR (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: breathehr_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Breathe HR Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run breathehr_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

login.hint: In Breathe, an account administrator enables the API and copies the key from **Configure → Settings → API setup**. Production keys start with `prod`; a `sandbox-` key connects to the Breathe sandbox instead. Your key is used only to call the Breathe HR API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

examples: Who is off on holiday next week, and for how many days each?
How many holiday days has Jane Smith used and how many are left?
Show leave requests starting next week with their approval status.
How many sickness absences did we have last month?

servers.name: Rev.ai
servers.description: Transcribe audio with Rev.ai: submit jobs by URL, read transcripts, summaries and captions.

login.hint: Create one at **rev.ai → Access Token → Generate New Access Token** (an account can hold 2 tokens). Rev.ai shows a token only once, so copy it right away. Your token is used only to call the Rev.ai API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: revai_get_account
tools.title: Get account and balance
tools.description: The Rev.ai account behind the token: email, free, purchased, total and invoiced balance (USD) and whether HIPAA is on. GET /account.

tools.name: revai_list_jobs
tools.title: List transcription jobs
tools.description: List transcription jobs from the last 30 days, newest first: id, status (in_progress, transcribed, failed), name, duration, language, failure reason. Page with starting_after = the previous reply's next_starting_after. GET /jobs.

tools.name: revai_get_job
tools.title: Get job status
tools.description: One transcription job by id: status (in_progress, transcribed, failed), timestamps, duration, language, failure reason. Poll this until status is transcribed. GET /jobs/{id}.

tools.name: revai_submit_job
tools.title: Submit transcription job
tools.description: WRITE: start an asynchronous machine transcription job for an audio or video file at a public URL. It uses Rev.ai credit (free credit first). Returns the job with status in_progress; then poll revai_get_job and read the result with revai_get_transcript. Human transcription is not offered. POST /jobs.

tools.name: revai_delete_job
tools.title: Delete job
tools.description: WRITE: permanently delete a finished (transcribed or failed) job with its media and transcript. This cannot be undone. A job still in progress cannot be deleted. DELETE /jobs/{id}.

tools.name: revai_get_transcript
tools.title: Get transcript
tools.description: The transcript of a transcribed job. format=text (default) is plain text with speaker labels and timestamps; format=segments is a list of {speaker, start, end, text} per speaker turn (seconds). Long transcripts are paged: repeat with next_offset until it is null. GET /jobs/{id}/transcript.

tools.name: revai_get_summary
tools.title: Get transcript summary
tools.description: The summary of a transcribed job. It exists only if the job was submitted with summarization_type. Paged by character like revai_get_transcript. GET /jobs/{id}/transcript/summary.

tools.name: revai_get_captions
tools.title: Get captions
tools.description: Captions for a transcribed job as SRT (default) or WebVTT. Long files are paged by character: repeat with next_offset until it is null. For multichannel jobs pass speaker_channel. GET /jobs/{id}/captions.

tools.name: revai_usage_status

tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

Does not count against the meter.

tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Rev.ai (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: revai_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Rev.ai Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). servers.name: Enchant
servers.description: Work with Enchant help desk tickets: list, read, reply, add notes and labels, manage customers.

login.hint: The identifier is the first part of your help desk address: **acme** for acme.enchant.com. For the token, install the **API** app in your help desk **Settings → Apps** and copy its access token. The API is available on paid Enchant plans. The token is used only to call the API on your behalf and to derive a private account id.

tools.name: enchant_list_tickets
tools.title: List tickets
tools.description: List and filter tickets (newest first by default). Enchant REST: GET /tickets. Use user_ids ["null"] for unassigned tickets. Each result has a short summary; use enchant_get_ticket for messages.

tools.name: enchant_get_ticket
tools.title: Get ticket
tools.description: Get one ticket by id. Embed related data with `embed`: messages (the conversation: replies and notes), customer, user, inbox, labels. Each embedded type costs 1 extra rate-limit credit. Enchant REST: GET /tickets/{id}.

tools.name: enchant_list_users
tools.title: List users (agents)
tools.description: List the help desk users (agents): id, name, email. Use the ids to assign tickets and to author replies and notes. Enchant REST: GET /users.

tools.name: enchant_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers, or find one by contact: set contact_type and contact_value (for example email + an address). Enchant REST: GET /customers.

tools.name: enchant_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id, with the contacts (emails, phones, Twitter names). Enchant REST: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: enchant_get_attachment
tools.title: Get attachment
tools.description: Get the metadata of an attachment (name, size, MIME type) by id; attachment ids appear in ticket messages. Enchant REST: GET /attachments/{id}.

tools.name: enchant_create_ticket
tools.title: Create ticket
tools.description: WRITE: create an email ticket. Give customer_id, or a customer (matched by contact email, created if new). Optionally add the customer's first message with body (needs the customer's email). Enchant REST: POST /tickets.

tools.name: enchant_update_ticket
tools.title: Update ticket
tools.description: WRITE: change a ticket: state (open, hold, closed), assignee, inbox, subject, spam or trash (not both true). label_ids REPLACES all labels (empty array clears them); use enchant_add_ticket_labels to keep existing ones. Enchant REST: PATCH /tickets/{id}.

tools.name: enchant_add_ticket_labels
tools.title: Add labels to ticket
tools.description: WRITE: add one or more labels to a ticket without changing its other labels. Enchant REST: PUT /tickets/{id}/labels/{label_ids}.

tools.name: enchant_remove_ticket_labels
tools.title: Remove labels from ticket
tools.description: WRITE: remove one or more labels from a ticket; its other labels stay. Enchant REST: DELETE /tickets/{id}/labels/{label_ids}.

tools.name: enchant_reply_to_ticket
tools.title: Reply to customer
tools.description: WRITE: send an outbound reply on a ticket. This SENDS A REAL EMAIL to the customer address in `to`. Use enchant_add_note for an internal note. Enchant REST: POST /tickets/{id}/messages (type reply, direction out).

tools.name: enchant_add_note
tools.title: Add internal note
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal note to a ticket (not sent to the customer). Enchant REST: POST /tickets/{id}/messages (type note).

tools.name: enchant_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer with optional contacts (email, twitter, phone). Enchant REST: POST /customers.

tools.name: enchant_update_customer
tools.title: Update customer
tools.description: WRITE: update a customer's name or summary. If `contacts` is given, it REPLACES the contact list; use enchant_add_customer_contact to add one. Enchant REST: PATCH /customers/{id}.

tools.name: enchant_add_customer_contact
tools.title: Add customer contact
tools.description: WRITE: add one contact (email, twitter or phone) to a customer. Enchant REST: POST /customers/{id}/contacts.

tools.name: enchant_delete_customer_contact
tools.title: Delete customer contact
tools.description: WRITE, DELETES DATA: remove one contact from a customer. Enchant REST: DELETE /customers/{id}/contacts/{contact_id}.

tools.name: enchant_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: enchant_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Enchant tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: enchant_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Enchant (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: enchant_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Enchant Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run enchant_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

Show the conversation on the latest open ticket from jane@example.com.
Which agents are on my help desk team, and what are their email addresses?
