servers.name: Akute Health
servers.description: Read Akute Health patients, appointments, tasks, notes, medications, allergies and observations.

login.hint: In Akute go to **Settings → Developer** and create or copy an API key (the API is on paid plans; ask Akute support if the page is missing). Choose **Production** for your live practice or **Sandbox** for the Akute staging environment. Your key is used only to call the Akute API on your behalf and to derive a private account id; it is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: akutehealth_search_patients
tools.title: Search patients
tools.description: Search patients by name, email, phone (with phone_type), date of birth or external id, optionally narrowed by sex and status. At least one identifying filter is required (no bulk listing); pages are capped at 25 and paging stops at offset 500. Returns demographics, address, status, provider and membership billing state. Government and insurance identifiers are never returned. GET /patients.

tools.name: akutehealth_get_patient
tools.title: Get patient
tools.description: One patient by id: demographics, address, status, provider, custom properties and membership billing state. GET /patients/{id}.

tools.name: akutehealth_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: Appointments by patient and/or date range, practitioner and status. Give a patient_id, or both start_range and end_range (at most 31 days apart). At most 100 are returned; narrow the dates if truncated. Room links are not returned. GET /appointments.

tools.name: akutehealth_get_appointment
tools.title: Get appointment
tools.description: One appointment by id: times, status, patient, practitioner and appointment type. GET /appointments/{id}.

tools.name: akutehealth_list_appointment_types
tools.title: List appointment types
tools.description: The practice's appointment types (beta in Akute): name, duration, video flag, who can book, practitioners. GET /appointment_types.

tools.name: akutehealth_get_availability
tools.title: Get practitioner availability
tools.description: Open appointment slots of one practitioner between two date-times. GET /availability.

tools.name: akutehealth_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: Tasks filtered by patient, status, owner, priority, tag, due date or archive state; at least one filter except archived is required. Pages are capped at 25. GET /tasks.

tools.name: akutehealth_get_task
tools.title: Get task
tools.description: One task by id: title, description, due date, priority, status, tags, comments and activity. GET /tasks/{id}.

tools.name: akutehealth_list_notes
tools.title: List clinical notes
tools.description: Clinical notes (encounters) of ONE patient, newest first as Akute returns them: type, service date, status, authors and section text. A patient_id is required and pages are capped at 10. 'entered-in-error' notes appear only when asked for. GET /notes.

tools.name: akutehealth_get_note
tools.title: Get clinical note
tools.description: One clinical note by id with all its sections (subjective, objective, assessment, plan ...). GET /notes/{id}.

tools.name: akutehealth_list_medications
tools.title: List patient medications
tools.description: A patient's medications: name, strength, directions, quantity, refills, status, diagnoses and prescriber. Optional date window on the start date. At most 100 are returned. GET /medications.

tools.name: akutehealth_list_allergies
tools.title: List patient allergies
tools.description: A patient's allergies and intolerances: substance, reaction, type, clinical status, onset date. GET /allergies.

tools.name: akutehealth_list_observations
tools.title: List patient observations
tools.description: A patient's vital signs (default) or laboratory results: name, value, unit, date, LOINC code. At most 100 are returned. GET /observations.

tools.name: akutehealth_list_practitioners
tools.title: List practitioners
tools.description: The practice's users: id, name, NPI and roles (Practitioner, Prescriber, Staff, Admin ...). Date of birth, DEA number, email and licences are not returned. GET /users.

tools.name: akutehealth_get_practitioner
tools.title: Get practitioner
tools.description: One user by id: name, NPI and roles. GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: akutehealth_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Practice Better
servers.description: Read Practice Better clients, sessions, availability, services, packages, invoices and forms.

login.hint: Create them in Practice Better under the **API Access** settings. The **API Access (Beta)** add-on must be on your plan. Your client ID and secret are used only to sign in to the Practice Better API on your behalf; they are never shown to anyone. Practice Better holds health information: only connect it if you are allowed to use an AI assistant with your client data.

tools.name: practice_better_get_account
tools.title: Get my account
tools.description: The practitioner (API user) behind this connection: id, name, title, timezone, default currency, role flags and the practice (company) id and name. Settings, integrations and the bio are not returned. GET /consultant/profile.

tools.name: practice_better_list_practitioners
tools.title: List practitioners
tools.description: List the practitioners and admin users of the practice, with id, name, role flags and activation status. Use the ids to filter sessions and invoices. GET /company/administration/members.

tools.name: practice_better_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List client records, newest first: id, status, name, email, phone, timezone and activity dates. Date of birth, address, insurance and notes are not returned. A page holds at most 100 records. To look up one person by name or email use practice_better_find_clients. GET /consultant/records.

tools.name: practice_better_find_clients
tools.title: Find clients by name or email
tools.description: Search client records by name, preferred name or email (case-insensitive text match). Practice Better has no search endpoint, so this reads the 500 most recent records (5 pages of 100) and filters them; `complete` says whether every record was checked. Returns at most `max_results` matches with the same fields as practice_better_list_clients. GET /consultant/records.

tools.name: practice_better_get_client
tools.title: Get client
tools.description: One client record by id: status, name, preferred name, pronouns, email, phones, timezone, activity dates and tag ids. Date of birth, address, insurance, emergency contacts, notes and health history are not returned. GET /consultant/records/{recordId}.

tools.name: practice_better_list_sessions
tools.title: List sessions (appointments)
tools.description: List sessions (appointments), newest first: date, duration, service, practitioner, client (id and name), status and payment status. Booking notes and session notes are not returned. Filter by date range, practitioner, client record, service or group/1-1. GET /consultant/sessions.

tools.name: practice_better_get_session
tools.title: Get session
tools.description: One session (appointment) by id: date, duration, service, practitioner, client (id and name), location and status. Booking notes and session notes are not returned. For a group session pass record_id to see one client's view. GET /consultant/sessions/{sessionId}.

tools.name: practice_better_get_availability
tools.title: Get available time slots
tools.description: Open booking slots of one practitioner for one service, starting on the given day: start, end and duration of each slot. It follows the practitioner's booking settings. Needs a practitioner id and a service id. GET /consultant/availability/slots.

tools.name: practice_better_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List the services (appointment types) the practice offers: id, name, duration, group or 1-1, session types and SKU. GET /consultant/services.

tools.name: practice_better_list_packages
tools.title: List packages
tools.description: List the package definitions (bundles of sessions or programs) the practice sells: id, name and SKU. GET /consultant/packages.

tools.name: practice_better_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the tags the practice uses to organize clients: id and name. A client record carries tag ids. GET /tags.

tools.name: practice_better_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List client invoices, newest first: number, date, totals, amount due and paid, payment status, client (id and name) and practitioner. Payment history and line items are not in the list; use practice_better_get_invoice. GET /consultant/payments/invoices.

tools.name: practice_better_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: One invoice by id with its line items (date, quantity, amount, tax) and totals. Descriptions, payment history and billing contact are not returned. GET /consultant/payments/invoices/{invoiceId}.

tools.name: practice_better_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List the form templates of the practice (intake forms, questionnaires, consent forms): id and name only. GET /consultant/forms.

tools.name: practice_better_list_form_requests
tools.title: List form requests
tools.description: List forms sent to clients, newest first: which form, which client (id), practitioner, and whether it was started or completed, with dates. The answers are never returned. GET /consultant/formrequests.

tools.name: practice_better_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. servers.name: Docparser
servers.description: Run Docparser parsers: import documents by URL or upload, check status, read parsed results.

login.hint: Find it in Docparser under **Account → API Settings**. The key gives access to all parsers of the account; it is used only to call the Docparser API on your behalf and is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: docparser_ping
tools.title: Check API key
tools.description: Check that the connected Docparser API key works. Returns {msg: "pong"} when it does. GET /v1/ping.

tools.name: docparser_list_parsers
tools.title: List parsers
tools.description: List all Document Parsers on the account (id and label). Start here: the parser id is needed by every other tool. GET /v1/parsers.

tools.name: docparser_list_parser_models
tools.title: List parser model layouts
tools.description: List the model layouts of one parser (id and label). GET /v1/parser/models/{parser_id}.

tools.name: docparser_get_document_status
tools.title: Get document status
tools.description: Processing status of one document: importing/processing flags, page count, timestamps (uploaded, imported, processed), webhook dispatch and failed jobs. Poll this after a fetch/upload: the document is done when importing_in_progress and processing_in_progress are false, processed_at is set and failed_jobs is empty (a non-empty failed_jobs means it failed); then read the results. GET /v2/document/status/{parser_id}/{document_id}.

tools.name: docparser_get_document_results
tools.title: Get parsed data of one document
tools.description: The parsed data of one document (the fields and tables the parser extracted, plus file name, page count and upload/processing times). Docparser allows 60 of these calls per minute. GET /v1/results/{parser_id}/{document_id}.

tools.name: docparser_list_document_results
tools.title: List parsed data of many documents
tools.description: Parsed data of several documents of one parser: the last uploaded ones (default), or those uploaded/processed after a date. Returns up to 100 documents per call; page with offset (next_offset is null on the last page). Docparser allows 30 of these calls per minute. GET /v1/results/{parser_id}.

tools.name: docparser_fetch_document_from_url
tools.title: Import a document from a URL
tools.description: WRITE: ask Docparser to download a document from a publicly reachable URL and parse it with the given parser. Uses page credits of the account's plan (documents queue when credits run out). Docparser may buy extra credits by itself only if the account owner turned on automatic credit replenishment, or the account is on an annual plan that renews early when credits run out - check the Docparser billing settings first. This server never buys credits or changes the plan. Returns the new document_id: poll docparser_get_document_status, then read docparser_get_document_results. POST /v2/document/fetch/{parser_id}.

tools.name: docparser_upload_document
tools.title: Upload a document (base64)
tools.description: WRITE: upload one small file as base64 content to a parser and parse it. Uses page credits of the account's plan. Docparser may buy extra credits by itself only if the account owner turned on automatic credit replenishment, or the account is on an annual plan that renews early when credits run out - check the Docparser billing settings first. This server never buys credits or changes the plan. Files up to about 2.3 MB; use docparser_fetch_document_from_url for larger files. Returns the new document id and the remaining quota. POST /v1/document/upload/{parser_id}.

tools.name: docparser_reparse_documents
tools.title: Re-parse documents
tools.description: WRITE: run the parser again over already imported documents (for example after changing parsing rules). Replaces their parsed data. Re-parsing documents already in the account does not use additional credits. 1-50 document ids per call. POST /v1/document/reparse/{parser_id}.

tools.name: docparser_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: docparser_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Docparser tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: docparser_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Docparser (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: docparser_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Docparser Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run docparser_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Vyfakturuj
servers.description: Read and create Vyfakturuj invoices and contacts: search, number series, payment methods, tags.

login.hint: Create the key in Vyfakturuj under **Nastavení → Propojení s dalšími systémy → API a webhook** ([app.vyfakturuj.cz/nastaveni/propojeni/api](https://app.vyfakturuj.cz/nastaveni/propojeni/api/)). Use the API key, **not your account password**. The API is part of the Ideal and Profi plans, and every call counts against your plan's monthly API request limit. Your key is used only to call the Vyfakturuj API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: vyfakturuj_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: Search documents (faktury, zalohove faktury, proformy, objednavky ...); pass sort=date_created~desc for the newest first. Each row has id, number, type, dates, customer, VS, currency, total, flags and flags_decoded (paid, sent_to_customer, cancelled, ...) and the public/PDF URLs; use vyfakturuj_get_invoice for the whole document with items. Filter by free text q, customer id, document type, number, variable symbol (VS), currency or creation date range. Paged with rows_limit/rows_offset. GET /invoice/.

tools.name: vyfakturuj_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: One document with all fields: supplier and customer blocks, items (text, quantity, unit_price, vat_rate, totals), dates, VS, bank details, total, flags and flags_decoded, payment method, public page, PDF and online-payment URLs. GET /invoice/{id}/.

tools.name: vyfakturuj_create_invoice
tools.title: Create an invoice (issues a real numbered document)
tools.description: WRITE. Creates a document in Vyfakturuj. Vyfakturuj has NO draft state: the document is issued at once and takes the next number of its number series (delete or cancel it in Vyfakturuj if wrong). Does NOT send an e-mail to the customer, does NOT mark it paid and moves no money; automatic reminders and paid notices are switched off for it (disable_automated_mails). Name the customer with id_customer (an address-book contact, from vyfakturuj_list_contacts) or with the customer_* fields. Items need text and unit_price. Optional id_number_series / id_payment_method come from vyfakturuj_list_number_series / vyfakturuj_list_payment_methods; the account defaults apply otherwise. Prices are net unless calculate_vat is 2 (gross). POST /invoice/.

tools.name: vyfakturuj_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: Search the address book (adresar): id, name, company, ICO (IC), DIC, address, e-mail (mail_to), phone, default days_due. Filter by free text q, ICO, DIC, name, e-mail or phone. Paged with rows_limit/rows_offset. GET /contact/.

tools.name: vyfakturuj_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: One address-book contact with every field (billing and delivery address, ICO/DIC, e-mails, default texts and days_due). GET /contact/{id}/.

tools.name: vyfakturuj_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: WRITE. Adds a contact to the address book (it is not a customer message: nothing is sent). Give at least a name (the address-book label) or company or last name. Returns the new contact with its id. POST /contact/.

tools.name: vyfakturuj_get_template
tools.title: Get a recurring-invoice template
tools.description: One template / recurring invoice (sablona, pravidelna faktura) by id: its items, customer, schedule and settings. The API has no list endpoint for templates, so the id comes from the user (the number in the template's URL in Vyfakturuj). GET /template/{id}/.

tools.name: vyfakturuj_list_payment_methods
tools.title: List payment methods
tools.description: The payment methods of the account (id_payment_method, name, type: 1 bank transfer, 2 cash, 4 cash on delivery, 8 card, ...). Use the id in vyfakturuj_create_invoice. GET /settings/payment-method/.

tools.name: vyfakturuj_list_number_series
tools.title: List number series
tools.description: The numbering series (ciselne rady) of the account: id_number_series, the document type it is for, name and the number pattern. Use the id in vyfakturuj_create_invoice. GET /settings/number-series/.

tools.name: vyfakturuj_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: The tags (stitky) of the account: id_tag, name and colour. Invoices carry an id_tag. GET /settings/tags/.

tools.name: vyfakturuj_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: vyfakturuj_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Vyfakturuj tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: vyfakturuj_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Vyfakturuj (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: vyfakturuj_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Vyfakturuj Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run vyfakturuj_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Invoiced
servers.description: Read Invoiced customers, invoices, payments, subscriptions; create customers, draft invoices, notes.

login.hint: In Invoiced go to **Settings → Developers → API Keys** and create a key (one key per application is recommended). Choose **Production** for your live account or **Sandbox** for sandbox.invoiced.com. Your key is used only to call the Invoiced API on your behalf and to derive a private account id; it is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: invoiced_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (accounts receivable debtors): name, number, email, payment terms, currency, autopay and chasing settings, owner. Filter by open balance, saved payment method, update time or any exact-match column. GET /customers.

tools.name: invoiced_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer by id: contact details, address, terms, currency, autopay, chasing cadence, credit hold/limit, parent customer, metadata. GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: invoiced_get_customer_balance
tools.title: Get customer balance
tools.description: A customer's current balance: total outstanding, past due, and available credit, in the customer's currency (or `currency`). GET /customers/{id}/balance.

tools.name: invoiced_list_contacts
tools.title: List customer contacts
tools.description: List the contacts of one customer: name, title, email, phone, whether primary (copied on communications) and SMS-enabled. GET /customers/{id}/contacts.

tools.name: invoiced_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices with number, customer, status (draft, not_sent, sent, viewed, past_due, pending, paid, voided), dates, totals, balance and line items. Filter by customer, paid flag, invoice date range, update time or any exact-match column. GET /invoices.

tools.name: invoiced_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: One invoice by id: status, dates, payment terms, totals, balance, line items, discounts, taxes, ship-to, payment and PDF links. `expand` replaces ids with full objects (e.g. customer). GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: invoiced_get_invoice_payment_plan
tools.title: Get invoice payment plan
tools.description: The payment plan (installments with dates, amounts and balances, and approval status) attached to an invoice. Errors with 404 when the invoice has none. GET /invoices/{id}/payment_plan.

tools.name: invoiced_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List payments received: customer, date, amount, unapplied balance, method (check, wire, ACH, card, ...), reference, whether matched or voided. Read only. GET /payments.

tools.name: invoiced_get_payment
tools.title: Get payment
tools.description: One payment by id, including which invoices and credit notes it was applied to (`applied_to`). GET /payments/{id}?include=applied_to.

tools.name: invoiced_list_credit_notes
tools.title: List credit notes
tools.description: List credit notes: customer, status (draft, open, paid, closed, voided), totals, remaining balance, line items. GET /credit_notes.

tools.name: invoiced_get_credit_note
tools.title: Get credit note
tools.description: One credit note by id with line items, totals and balance. GET /credit_notes/{id}.

tools.name: invoiced_list_estimates
tools.title: List estimates
tools.description: List estimates (quotes): customer, status (draft, not_sent, sent, approved, invoiced, declined, voided), expiration date, deposit, totals, resulting invoice. GET /estimates.

tools.name: invoiced_get_estimate
tools.title: Get estimate
tools.description: One estimate by id with line items, totals, deposit and approval state. GET /estimates/{id}.

tools.name: invoiced_list_items
tools.title: List catalog items
tools.description: List the item catalog (products and services): id, name, currency, unit cost, type, taxable. Use item ids as `catalog_item` when creating a draft invoice. GET /items.

tools.name: invoiced_get_item
tools.title: Get catalog item
tools.description: One catalog item by its id (a string such as "delivery"). GET /items/{id}.

tools.name: invoiced_list_tax_rates
tools.title: List tax rates
tools.description: List tax rates: id, name, value, whether a percentage, whether inclusive, currency. GET /tax_rates.

tools.name: invoiced_list_plans
tools.title: List subscription plans
tools.description: List subscription plans: id, name, currency, amount, pricing mode, billing interval, tiers. GET /plans.

tools.name: invoiced_get_plan
tools.title: Get subscription plan
tools.description: One subscription plan by its id (a string). GET /plans/{id}.

tools.name: invoiced_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List recurring subscriptions: customer, plan, quantity, billing period, status (not_started, active, past_due, finished, canceled), recurring total and MRR, contract renewal. GET /subscriptions.

tools.name: invoiced_get_subscription
tools.title: Get subscription
tools.description: One subscription by id with plan, add-ons, billing period, contract terms, recurring total and MRR. GET /subscriptions/{id}.

tools.name: invoiced_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List collection notes, newest first, for one customer or one invoice (give exactly one), or all notes when neither is given. GET /customers/{id}/notes, /invoices/{id}/notes or /notes.

tools.name: invoiced_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List collection tasks (call, letter, email, review): name, action, customer, assignee, due date, whether complete. GET /tasks.

tools.name: invoiced_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: The activity feed, newest first: event type (such as invoice.paid, customer.created), time, the object it concerns and who did it. Optionally only the events of one object. GET /events.

tools.name: invoiced_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer in Invoiced. Nothing is sent to anyone and no money moves. Name is required; Invoiced generates the customer number unless given. POST /customers.

tools.name: invoiced_create_draft_invoice
tools.title: Create draft invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create a DRAFT invoice for a customer. It is always created as a draft: it is not issued, not emailed, not charged and cannot trigger AutoPay until a person finalizes it in Invoiced. At least one line item is required. POST /invoices with draft=true.

tools.name: invoiced_add_note
tools.title: Add note
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal note to a customer or an invoice (give exactly one). Notes are internal; nothing is sent. POST /notes.

tools.name: invoiced_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: WRITE: create a collection task for a customer (a reminder to call, write, email or review). Nothing is sent to the customer. POST /tasks.

servers.name: Billomat

login.hint: The Billomat id is the first part of your Billomat address (`https://**yourcompany**.billomat.net`). Create the key in Billomat → **Einstellungen → Mitarbeiter** → your user (enable API access, then generate the API key). The key acts with that user's rights; a dedicated user makes its activity easy to track. Your key is used only to call the Billomat API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: billomat_get_current_user

tools.description: Show the Billomat user the API key belongs to (name, email, role and rights). Use it to check which rights the key has.

tools.name: billomat_get_company

tools.name: billomat_list_clients

tools.description: List the clients (customers) of the account, filtered by name, number, email, contact person, country, note or tags. Paged.

tools.name: billomat_get_client

tools.description: Get one client with address, contact person, bank details, payment terms and revenue.

tools.name: billomat_list_articles
tools.title: List articles

tools.name: billomat_get_article
tools.title: Get an article

tools.name: billomat_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List the suppliers of the account, filtered by name, email, contact person, country, note or tags. Paged.

tools.name: billomat_get_supplier
tools.title: Get a supplier
tools.description: Get one supplier with address and bank details.

tools.name: billomat_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices (Rechnungen), filtered by client, status (DRAFT, OPEN, PAID, OVERDUE, CANCELED), number, date range, text or tags. Paged; each invoice carries totals and the open amount.

tools.name: billomat_invoice_totals
tools.title: Invoice totals by group

tools.name: billomat_get_invoice

tools.name: billomat_list_invoice_items

tools.name: billomat_list_invoice_payments

tools.name: billomat_list_recurring_invoices

tools.name: billomat_list_offers
tools.title: List offers
tools.description: List offers (Angebote), filtered by client, status (DRAFT, OPEN, WON, LOST, CANCELED, CLEARED), number, date range or text. Paged.

tools.name: billomat_get_offer

tools.description: Get one offer (status, totals, validity, client).

tools.name: billomat_list_confirmations
tools.title: List order confirmations
tools.description: List order confirmations (Auftragsbestaetigungen), filtered by client, status (DRAFT, COMPLETED, CANCELED, CLEARED), number, date range or text. Paged.

tools.name: billomat_get_confirmation
tools.title: Get an order confirmation
tools.description: Get one order confirmation.

tools.name: billomat_list_delivery_notes
tools.title: List delivery notes
tools.description: List delivery notes (Lieferscheine), filtered by client, status (DRAFT, CREATED), number, date range or text. Paged.

tools.name: billomat_get_delivery_note
tools.title: Get a delivery note
tools.description: Get one delivery note.

tools.name: billomat_list_credit_notes
tools.title: List credit notes

tools.name: billomat_get_credit_note

tools.name: billomat_list_reminders

servers.name: ChargeOver
servers.description: Read ChargeOver customers, invoices, transactions, subscriptions, reports; create customers, quotes.

login.hint: In ChargeOver open **Settings (gear) → Developer → REST API**, enable the API and copy the **username** and **password** shown there. They are API credentials, not your ChargeOver login. The subdomain is the part before **.chargeover.com** in your address. Your credentials are used only to call the ChargeOver API on your behalf; they are never shown to anyone.

tools.name: chargeover_list_customers
tools.title: List or search customers
tools.description: List customers (companies that are billed). Filterable fields: customer_id, parent_customer_id, bill_state, ship_state, bill_country, ship_country, external_key, token, company, superuser_id, superuser_email, customer_status_state (a = active, i = inactive), customer_status_str (active-current, active-overdue, inactive-manual, inactive-activity), custom_1..custom_50, write_datetime, mod_datetime. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /customer.

tools.name: chargeover_list_contacts
tools.title: List or search contacts
tools.description: List contacts (the people at customers; the API calls them users). Filterable fields: user_id, external_key, first_name, last_name, email, phone, user_type_id, username, customers.customer_id (contacts of one customer). Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /user.

tools.name: chargeover_list_invoices
tools.title: List or search invoices
tools.description: List invoices with status, totals, credits, payments and balance. Filterable fields: invoice_id, refnumber, customer_id, invoice_status_str (open-unpaid, open-overdue, open-collections, closed-void, closed-paid), invoice_status_state (o = open, c = closed), package_id, package_token, date, currency_id, total, balance, subtotal, token, bill_state, bill_country, line_items.item_id, write_datetime, mod_datetime. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /invoice.

tools.name: chargeover_list_transactions
tools.title: List or search transactions (read only)
tools.description: List transactions (payments, refunds and credits that already happened; this tool only reads them). Filterable fields: transaction_id, customer_id, gateway_id, currency_id, creditcard_id, ach_id, tokenized_id, token, external_key, gateway_status, gateway_transid, amount, fee, transaction_type, transaction_method, transaction_detail, transaction_datetime, transaction_status.state, transaction_status.str, applied_to.invoice_id, applied_to.package_id. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /transaction.

tools.name: chargeover_list_quotes
tools.title: List or search quotes
tools.description: List quotes (proposals for a customer or lead; the list has no line items, get one quote for those). Filterable fields: quote_id, customer_id, brand_id, currency_id, refnumber, token, external_key, date, bill_state, bill_country, quote_status_str (open-new, open-sent, closed-won, closed-lost), quote_status_state (o = open, c = closed). Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /quote.

tools.name: chargeover_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List or search subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions (the API calls them packages): recurring billing plans of customers. Filterable fields: package_id, customer_id, token, brand_id, paymethod, paycycle (mon, qtr, yrl...), nickname, package_status_state (a active, c cancelled, e expired, s suspended), package_status_str (active-trial, active-current, active-overdue, canceled-nonpayment, canceled-manual, expired-expired, expired-trial, suspended-suspended), external_key, write_datetime, mod_datetime, cancel_datetime, line_items.item_id, customer.superuser_email, customer.users.email. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /package.

tools.name: chargeover_list_items
tools.title: List or search items (products and discounts)
tools.description: List items: the products, services and discounts that go on invoices, quotes and subscriptions, with their pricing tiers. Filterable fields: item_id, name, external_key, accounting_sku, item_type (service or discount), custom_1, custom_2, custom_3. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /item.

tools.name: chargeover_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List notes attached to customers, subscriptions, invoices, contacts, quotes and items. Filterable fields: context_str (customer, billing_package, invoice, user, quote, item), context_id. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /note.

tools.name: chargeover_list_usage
tools.title: List usage (metered) data
tools.description: List usage (metered billing) data points recorded against subscription line items. Filterable fields: line_item_id, external_key, from (date), to (date). Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /usage.

tools.name: chargeover_list_coupons
tools.title: List coupons
tools.description: List coupons (code, description, type, enabled, linked discount item). Filterable fields: none documented; the list is small. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /coupon.

tools.name: chargeover_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer by customer_id: company, status, addresses, primary contact, terms, balance fields, custom fields. GET /customer/{customer_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact (user) by user_id: name, email, phone, username, the customers they belong to. GET /user/{user_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by invoice_id: status, line items, totals, balance, payments and credits applied, billing address. GET /invoice/{invoice_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_get_transaction
tools.title: Get a transaction (read only)
tools.description: Get one transaction (payment, refund or credit that already happened) by transaction_id: amount, method, status, the invoices it was applied to, related refunds. GET /transaction/{transaction_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_get_quote
tools.title: Get a quote
tools.description: Get one quote by quote_id: status, line items, totals, memo, links to the invoice or subscription it became. GET /quote/{quote_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_get_subscription
tools.title: Get a subscription
tools.description: Get one subscription (package) by package_id: status, payment cycle, pay method, next invoice date, line items. GET /package/{package_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_get_item
tools.title: Get an item
tools.description: Get one item (product, service or discount) by item_id: name, type, SKU, pricing tiers per currency. GET /item/{item_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_list_reports
tools.title: List reports
tools.description: List the account's saved reports (report_id and name). Run one with chargeover_run_report. GET /_report.

tools.name: chargeover_get_report
tools.title: Get a report's definition
tools.description: A report's name, its available_filters (field names and allowed operators), available_columns and default_columns. Read this before chargeover_run_report to know which filters and columns to use. GET /_report/{report_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_run_report
tools.title: Run a report
tools.description: Run a saved report and return its rows (read only; nothing is changed). Filters use the report's own field names from chargeover_get_report, for example [{field:'transaction_transaction_date',op:'GTE',value:'2026-01-01'}]. Operators vary by field (dates GTE/LTE/EQUALS, ids EQUALS, strings CONTAINS/DOES_NOT_CONTAIN). To page (offset > 0) an order is required. Max 1000 rows per page. POST /_report/{report_id}/_action/reportData.

tools.name: chargeover_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a new customer (no charge, no invoice, no email is sent by this call). Returns the new customer_id. Add a primary contact with the superuser_* fields. Use chargeover_list_customers first to avoid a duplicate (external_key is unique). POST /customer.

tools.name: chargeover_update_customer
tools.title: Update a customer
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing customer; send only the fields to change. Cannot touch payment methods, balances or status. Replaces the previous values of the fields you send. PUT /customer/{customer_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_create_contact
tools.title: Add a contact to a customer
tools.description: WRITE: add a contact (person) to an existing customer. No email is sent by this call. Returns the new user_id. POST /user.

tools.name: chargeover_create_note
tools.title: Add a note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a customer, subscription, invoice, contact, quote or item (shown in the ChargeOver UI to the team; never sent to the customer). Returns the note id. POST /note.

tools.name: chargeover_create_quote
tools.title: Create a quote
tools.description: WRITE: create a quote (a proposal) for an existing customer. Nothing is billed and no email is sent: the quote stays open until someone sends or accepts it in ChargeOver. Each line refers to an existing item (chargeover_list_items). paycycle: one = one-time invoice, mon = monthly, 2mn = every 2 months, qtr = quarterly, six = every 6 months, yrl = yearly, 2yr, 3yr, 1wk = weekly, 2wk. Returns the new quote_id. POST /quote.

tools.name: chargeover_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: chargeover_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the ChargeOver tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: chargeover_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on ChargeOver (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: chargeover_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's ChargeOver Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run chargeover_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

servers.name: TrackingMore
servers.description: Track parcels with TrackingMore: detect couriers, create and read trackings, delivery status.

login.hint: Find it in the TrackingMore dashboard under **Settings → API** (the Tracking API needs a Basic or Pro plan; a 14-day trial is available). The key lets this server register, update and delete trackings in your account; it is used only to call the TrackingMore API on your behalf and is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: trackingmore_list_couriers
tools.title: List supported couriers
tools.description: List the carriers TrackingMore supports with their courier_code, name, country, website, phone and the extra fields some of them need. The full list is long (1,000+), so filter with `search` (matches name or code) and/or `country`; replies hold at most `limit` couriers. GET /couriers/all.

tools.name: trackingmore_detect_courier
tools.title: Detect courier from a tracking number
tools.description: Find which couriers a tracking number most likely belongs to (returns matching courier codes and names). Use the code with trackingmore_create_tracking. Does not create anything. POST /couriers/detect.

tools.name: trackingmore_list_trackings
tools.title: List trackings
tools.description: List the shipments already registered in the TrackingMore account, newest first as the API returns them: id, tracking number, courier, delivery_status (pending, notfound, transit, pickup, delivered, undelivered, exception, expired, inforeceived), latest event and milestone dates. Checkpoint lists are left out (use trackingmore_get_tracking for one shipment's full history). Filters: tracking numbers, courier, delivery status, created/updated date range. GET /trackings/get.

tools.name: trackingmore_get_tracking
tools.title: Get a shipment's tracking
tools.description: The full tracking record of one shipment already registered in the account, including every checkpoint (origin_info / destination_info trackinfo with date, status, details and location). Look it up by tracking number; add courier_code if the number is used by several couriers. A number that was never registered is not found: register it with trackingmore_create_tracking first. GET /trackings/get?tracking_numbers=.

tools.name: trackingmore_create_tracking
tools.title: Register a shipment for tracking
tools.description: WRITE: register ONE shipment so TrackingMore starts tracking it. tools.name: trackingmore_update_tracking

tools.description: WRITE: change the descriptive fields of a registered tracking (order number, customer name/email, title, note, label, language, postal code, ship date ...). Only the fields you pass change; the tracking number and courier cannot be changed here. PUT /trackings/update/{id}.

tools.name: trackingmore_delete_tracking
tools.title: Delete a tracking
tools.description: WRITE (destructive): permanently remove one tracking from the TrackingMore account by id. Its checkpoint history is lost; registering the shipment again later uses another credit. Confirm with the user first. DELETE /trackings/delete/{id}.

servers.name: NodePing
servers.description: Read NodePing checks, uptime, results and events; mute checks, manage maintenance and schedules.

login.hint: Find it in NodePing → **Account Settings** (API token). API access needs a plan that includes it; SubAccounts have no token. Your token is used only to call the NodePing API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: nodeping_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The NodePing account the token belongs to (name, status, timezone, next billing date, default probe locations), or a SubAccount with customer_id. GET /accounts.

tools.name: nodeping_list_checks
tools.title: List checks
tools.description: List monitoring checks with label, type, target, interval, enabled state and pass/fail (state 1 = passing, 0 = failing; firstdown = when the current outage began). Filter client-side by status, type or label text. Compact by default; set detail=true for the full (scrubbed) check objects. GET /checks.

tools.name: nodeping_get_check
tools.title: Get check
tools.description: One check by id with its full (scrubbed) configuration. Optionally include its latest result and uptime. GET /checks/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_get_check_results
tools.title: Get check results
tools.description: Raw results of a check, newest first by default: pass/fail (su), run time (rt, ms), message (m), status text (sc), start (s) and the probe location (l). Use span (hours) or start/end (ms epoch, ISO 8601 or RFC 2822; GMT unless a zone is given) to bound it. GET /results/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_get_check_uptime
tools.title: Get check uptime
tools.description: Uptime percentage of a check per day or month (enabled and down milliseconds plus uptime %), with a total. GET /results/uptime/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_get_check_events
tools.title: Get check events
tools.description: Down and disabled events of a check (start, end, message, open) newest first: an incident history. limit=1 returns the most recent event. GET /results/events/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_get_current_events
tools.title: Get current events
tools.description: Everything that is down or disabled right now across the account (type, label, since when). The quickest 'what is broken' view. GET /results/current.

tools.name: nodeping_get_check_summary
tools.title: Get check hourly summary
tools.description: Hourly summary of a check's results: count, min, max and average run time per UTC hour. GET /results/summary/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_list_notifications
tools.title: List notifications sent
tools.description: The alert notifications NodePing sent (who, when, what), for one check or for the whole account, newest first. Contact addresses that are webhook URLs or keys are masked. GET /notifications[/{check_id}].

tools.name: nodeping_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: All notification contacts with their addresses (email, SMS, webhook, Slack, ...). Webhook/Slack/PagerDuty/Pushover addresses are masked. Address ids are what contact groups and checks reference. GET /contacts.

tools.name: nodeping_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: One contact by id with its addresses (secret-like addresses masked). GET /contacts?id={id}.

tools.name: nodeping_list_contact_groups
tools.title: List contact groups
tools.description: Contact groups (name and member address ids), keyed by group id. GET /contactgroups.

tools.name: nodeping_list_schedules
tools.title: List notification schedules
tools.description: Notification schedules (per-weekday time windows a contact is alerted in). GET /schedules.

tools.name: nodeping_get_schedule
tools.title: Get notification schedule
tools.description: One notification schedule by name (for example Days or All) with its seven weekday entries. GET /schedules/{name}.

tools.name: nodeping_list_notification_profiles
tools.title: List notification profiles
tools.description: Notification profiles: named sets of contacts/groups with delay and schedule, reusable across checks. GET /notificationprofiles.

tools.name: nodeping_list_maintenance
tools.title: List maintenance windows
tools.description: Scheduled and ad-hoc maintenance entries (checks they disable, cron, duration, next run, last runs). GET /maintenance.

tools.name: nodeping_get_maintenance
tools.title: Get maintenance window
tools.description: One maintenance entry by id. GET /maintenance/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_get_probe_info
tools.title: Get probe locations
tools.description: NodePing's probe servers (two-letter codes) or regions (nam, lam, eur, eao, wlw): the values a check's run locations use. GET /info/probe[/{code}] or /info/location[/{code}].

tools.name: nodeping_update_check
tools.title: Update check settings
tools.description: WRITE: change a check's label, description, tags, target, timeout (threshold seconds) or re-checks before alert (sens). Only the fields you pass change. It does not enable the check, create checks or touch billing. PUT /checks/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_mute_check
tools.title: Mute or unmute check
tools.description: WRITE: mute a check's notifications (the check keeps running and recording) until a time or indefinitely, or unmute it. mute_until is a future time in ms since the epoch; omit it with mute=true to mute until unmuted. PUT /checks/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_disable_check
tools.title: Disable check
tools.description: WRITE: stop a check from running (enabled=false); its history is kept. Re-enabling is done in the NodePing app (it changes the number of billed checks). PUT /checks/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_create_adhoc_maintenance
tools.title: Create ad-hoc maintenance
tools.description: WRITE: create a one-off maintenance window that disables the listed checks for duration_minutes and re-enables them afterwards (no alerts meanwhile). Created inactive unless start_now=true, which starts it immediately. POST /maintenance/ad-hoc.

tools.name: nodeping_delete_maintenance
tools.title: Delete maintenance entry
tools.description: WRITE (destructive): remove a maintenance entry. DELETE /maintenance/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_create_contact_group
tools.title: Create contact group
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact group from existing contact address ids. POST /contactgroups.

tools.name: nodeping_update_contact_group
tools.title: Update contact group
tools.description: WRITE: rename a contact group and/or replace its member list (send the FULL list; omitted members are removed). PUT /contactgroups/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_delete_contact_group
tools.title: Delete contact group
tools.description: WRITE (destructive): delete a contact group. Checks that notify the group lose that notification target. DELETE /contactgroups/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_put_schedule
tools.title: Create or update notification schedule
tools.description: WRITE: create or update a notification schedule. NodePing stores all seven weekdays at once, so for an existing schedule the weekdays you pass are merged into its current ones; a new schedule needs all seven. Per weekday: time1/time2 window (24h), exclude to invert it, disabled for no alerts, allday for always. GET then PUT /schedules/{name}.

tools.name: nodeping_delete_schedule
tools.title: Delete notification schedule
tools.description: WRITE (destructive): delete a notification schedule by name. DELETE /schedules/{name}.

tools.name: nodeping_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: nodeping_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the NodePing tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: nodeping_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on NodePing (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: nodeping_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's NodePing Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run nodeping_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

examples: Is anything down or disabled across my monitors right now?
What was my website check's uptime for the last month?
Which alert notifications were sent in the last few days?
Mute alerts for my staging site check until tomorrow morning.

servers.name: MailBluster
servers.description: Manage MailBluster leads, custom fields, products and orders: look up, add and update records.

login.hint: In MailBluster open your brand, go to **Settings -> API keys** and click **Create new**. The key works for that one brand; API keys need a plan that includes API access. Your key is used only to call the MailBluster API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: mailbluster_list_fields
tools.title: List custom lead fields
tools.description: List the brand's custom lead fields: id, label and merge tag. Use the merge tags as keys of `fields` when creating or updating leads. GET /fields.

tools.name: mailbluster_create_field
tools.title: Create custom lead field
tools.description: WRITE: create a custom lead field. The merge tag is the key used in lead `fields` and in email templates. Creating a field changes the brand's data model but sends nothing. POST /fields.

tools.name: mailbluster_get_lead
tools.title: Get lead
tools.description: Get one lead by email address (the server computes the MD5 id MailBluster uses): name, custom fields, timezone, subscribed and opt-in status, tags, created/updated dates. MailBluster has no list-leads endpoint. GET /leads/{md5(email)}.

tools.name: mailbluster_create_lead
tools.title: Create lead
tools.description: WRITE: add a lead (contact) to the brand. `subscribed` defaults to FALSE: the lead is stored but is not subscribed to email. Only set subscribed=true when the person has given consent to receive email from this brand (the user is responsible for lawful consent); this server never subscribes anyone on its own. No email is sent by this tool (double opt-in is not offered). If the lead already exists the call fails unless overwrite_existing=true, which replaces the stored data (then `subscribed` must be given explicitly). POST /leads.

tools.name: mailbluster_update_lead
tools.title: Update lead
tools.description: WRITE: change an existing lead's name, custom fields, email, timezone, IP address, subscription flag or tags (send only what should change). `subscribed` is left alone unless you pass it; false unsubscribes the lead, true re-subscribes. Only set subscribed=true when the person has given consent to receive email from this brand (the user is responsible for lawful consent); this server never subscribes anyone on its own. PUT /leads/{md5(email)}.

tools.name: mailbluster_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List product records (id, name, dates) the brand has registered for e-commerce tracking. Paged: the reply's meta has total and nextPageNo (null on the last page). GET /products.

tools.name: mailbluster_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get one product record by the id you registered it under. GET /products/{product_id}.

tools.name: mailbluster_create_product
tools.title: Create product
tools.description: WRITE: register a product record (your own id plus a name) so orders can reference it. Sends nothing to anyone and charges nothing. POST /products.

tools.name: mailbluster_update_product
tools.title: Update product
tools.description: WRITE: rename a product record. PUT /products/{product_id}.

tools.name: mailbluster_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List order records (id, currency, total price, customer lead, campaign, line items). These are records kept in MailBluster for tracking; no payment is involved. Paged: see meta.nextPageNo. GET /orders.

tools.name: mailbluster_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: Get one order record by the id it was created with. GET /orders/{order_id}.

tools.name: mailbluster_create_order
tools.title: Create order record
tools.description: WRITE: record an order (a tracking record: it does not take payment, charge a card or send email). The customer's email becomes a lead if none exists, and the lead's tags are merged. `customer.subscribed` is REQUIRED because MailBluster would otherwise default it to true: pass false unless the customer has consented to email. For a customer who already exists, the value may replace their stored subscription state. Only set subscribed=true when the person has given consent to receive email from this brand (the user is responsible for lawful consent); this server never subscribes anyone on its own. POST /orders.

tools.name: mailbluster_update_order
tools.title: Update order record
tools.description: WRITE: change an order record's campaign, currency, total or items (send only what should change; `items`, when given, REPLACES all previous items). The customer cannot be changed here. No payment or email is involved. PUT /orders/{order_id}.

tools.name: mailbluster_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: mailbluster_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the MailBluster tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: mailbluster_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on MailBluster (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: mailbluster_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's MailBluster Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run mailbluster_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

examples: Look up the lead customer@example.com and show their contact details.
List the orders recorded for my shop with their totals.
Which products have I registered for my shop's sales tracking?
Add customer@example.com as a new lead with the first name Pat.

servers.name: Gift Up!
servers.description: Read Gift Up! gift cards, orders, items, promotions and transactions (read-only, codes masked).

login.hint: Create it in Gift Up → **Settings → Integrations → API keys**. A Gift Up key has broad privileges, but this server only reads: it never redeems, tops up, voids or issues gift cards. Your key is used only to call the Gift Up API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: giftup_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: The Gift Up account this API key belongs to: id, name, currency, whether onboarding is complete and whether the checkout is live. GET /company.

tools.name: giftup_list_gift_cards
tools.title: List gift cards
tools.description: List gift cards with balance, status flags (canBeRedeemed, hasExpired, notYetValid, isVoided), title, recipient, expiry and the order they came from. Codes are MASKED (at least 6 characters stay hidden); to see one card in full (code and ledger) use giftup_get_gift_card with its code. Filter by state, creation/update time, order, SKU, recipient/purchaser email or payment transaction id. GET /gift-cards.

tools.name: giftup_get_gift_card
tools.title: Get gift card
tools.description: One gift card by its code: balance (remainingValue / remainingUnits), status flags, expiry, recipient, order, fulfilment and the full ledger of events (created, redeemed, topped up, voided). Returns the code in full because you asked for this card by code; do not repeat it elsewhere. Read-only: it never redeems or changes the card. GET /gift-cards/{code}.

tools.name: giftup_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders (the purchases that created gift cards), newest first: order number, purchaser, revenue, tip, fees, discount, applied promotions, source, notes, metadata and payment provider. Filter by creation time, purchaser email or source. GET /orders.

tools.name: giftup_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by id: totals, purchaser, promotions, custom fields, sales taxes, notes, metadata and payment provider. GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: giftup_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: List the gift card products on sale (items): name, price, value, price type, availability window, group, stock level, per-order limit, SKU and terms. Pre-generated codes are reduced to a count and masked tails. Optionally only one group. GET /items.

tools.name: giftup_get_item
tools.title: Get item
tools.description: One item (gift card product) by id. Pre-generated codes are reduced to a count and masked tails. GET /items/{id}.

tools.name: giftup_list_item_groups
tools.title: List item groups
tools.description: List item groups (the sections that organize items in the checkout): id, name, description, sort order, auto-expand. GET /groups.

tools.name: giftup_get_item_group
tools.title: Get item group
tools.description: One item group by id. GET /groups/{id}.

tools.name: giftup_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the locations (stores) of the account; their ids filter and label report transactions. GET /locations.

tools.name: giftup_list_promotions
tools.title: List promotions
tools.description: List promotions (checkout discounts and bonus credit): name, published/stopped dates, benefits (percentage and fixed discounts, extra credit), usage counts and revenue, limitations and triggers (items, groups, spend and quantity thresholds, promo code). Read-only. GET /promotions.

tools.name: giftup_list_transactions
tools.title: List report transactions
tools.description: The immutable financial transaction log: OrderPlaced (income, fees, tip), GiftCardCreated, CreditAdded, Redeemed, Expired, Unexpired, Voided, Reactivated, with who, where, reason, Gift Up fee and the value change. Gift card codes are MASKED (at least 6 characters stay hidden). Filter by time range, event type, user email, location id or one gift card code. GET /reports/transactions.

tools.name: giftup_get_transaction
tools.title: Get report transaction
tools.description: One report transaction by id. The gift card code inside is MASKED (at least 6 characters stay hidden). GET /reports/transactions/{id}.

tools.name: giftup_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: giftup_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Gift Up! tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: giftup_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Gift Up! (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: giftup_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Gift Up! Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run giftup_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

examples: How many gift cards did we sell this month and for how much?
Show the latest gift card orders, newest first.
Which gift cards still have a balance left?
Which promotions do we currently have running at checkout?

servers.name: FireText
servers.description: Read FireText credit, messages and reports; send an SMS to up to 10 numbers; manage opt-outs.

login.hint: Log in to FireText and open **Settings > API** to view or generate a key ([API docs](https://www.firetext.co.uk/docs)). Your key is used only to call the FireText API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone. You can revoke it by generating a new one.

tools.name: firetext_get_credit
tools.title: Get SMS credit
tools.description: Number of SMS credits (messages) remaining on the FireText account or a sub-account. FireText: /credit.

tools.name: firetext_list_received_messages
tools.title: List received messages
tools.description: Inbound SMS received on the account's FireText numbers/keywords (messageID, sentTo, keyword, receivedFrom, receivedOn, message). Dates YYYY-MM-DD; from="last" returns only what is new since the last call. FireText: /receivedmessages.

tools.name: firetext_list_sent_messages
tools.title: List sent messages
tools.description: Messages (campaigns) sent from the account: messageID, sentOn, sentTo (group), recipientCount, message. The messageID is what the delivery and click reports need. Dates YYYY-MM-DD. FireText: /sentmessages.

tools.name: firetext_get_sent_summary
tools.title: Get sent summary
tools.description: Totals for a date range: number of campaigns, recipients and credits used. FireText: /sentreport.

tools.name: firetext_list_scheduled_messages
tools.title: List scheduled messages
tools.description: Messages queued for later sending (messageID, queuedOn, scheduledFor, recipientCount, sourceAddress, sendTo, message). FireText: /scheduledmessages.

tools.name: firetext_get_delivery_report
tools.title: Get delivery report
tools.description: Per-recipient delivery status of one sent message (mobile, names, messageSent, messageUpdate, status: Delivered / Declined / Buffered / Pending with Network / Rejected / Unconfirmed). Give the FireText message id OR the custom reference used when sending. FireText: /deliveryreport.

tools.name: firetext_get_click_report
tools.title: Get click report
tools.description: Link clicks for one sent message (mobile, names, clicked, userAgent). Only for messages that used FireText's Trackable SMS feature (otherwise the vendor answers URL error). FireText: /clickreport.

tools.name: firetext_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Stored details of one contact by mobile number (firstname, lastname, mobile, customField1-3). FireText: /contactinfo.

tools.name: firetext_list_unsubscribed
tools.title: List unsubscribed contacts
tools.description: Contacts that opted out (names, mobile, custom fields, addedOn, unsubscribedOn, reason). Optional date range and group API id. FireText: /unsubscribed.

tools.name: firetext_list_keywords
tools.title: List keywords
tools.description: SMS keywords on the account (keywordID, number, keyword, reference). FireText: /keywords.

tools.name: firetext_send_sms
tools.title: Send SMS
tools.description: WRITE, SPENDS MONEY: sends a REAL SMS to real phones and uses the account's SMS credits (one credit per 160 GSM characters per recipient; long and unicode messages cost more). Cannot be undone. At most 10 recipients per call; no groups, templates, scheduling or repeats. Only call after the user confirmed the exact text, sender and numbers. FireText: /sendsms.

tools.name: firetext_subscribe_contact
tools.title: Add or update contact
tools.description: WRITE: adds a contact (by mobile number) to the FireText account, optionally into a group, or with update=true refreshes the names/custom fields of an existing contact. Does not send any SMS. A contact that opted out cannot be re-added this way (they must rejoin by SMS). FireText: /subscribe.

tools.name: firetext_unsubscribe_contact
tools.title: Unsubscribe contact
tools.description: WRITE: opts a contact out of the FireText account (all groups by default), so it no longer receives group messages. The contact can only rejoin by SMS. Does not send any SMS. FireText: /unsubscribe.

tools.name: firetext_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the FireText tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: firetext_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on FireText (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: firetext_cancel_subscription

tools.description: Cancel the caller's FireText Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies).
