servers.name: Számlázz.hu
servers.description: Read Számlázz.hu invoices, PDFs, receipts, taxpayers; issue, reverse and pay invoices and receipts.

login.hint: Create the key in Számlázz.hu as the account owner or an administrator: **Vezérlőpult** (dashboard) → scroll down to **Számla Agent kulcsok** → click the key icon. The key has full rights on that account, never expires, and can be deleted there at any time. Számla Agent is a paid add-on of Számlázz.hu (billed monthly by the number of documents issued through the API); to try the tools without real documents, switch the account to test mode first. Your key is used only to call the Számlázz.hu API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: szamlazz_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Read the data of one issued invoice (seller, buyer, lines, totals, VAT breakdown, payments) by invoice number, order number or your external id (give exactly one; for an order number with several invoices the last one is returned). Only invoices issued in this Számlázz.hu account. Also use it to check whether an invoice exists before issuing again. Számla Agent action-szamla_agent_xml.

tools.name: szamlazz_get_invoice_pdf
tools.title: Get the PDF of an invoice
tools.description: Download the PDF of one issued document (invoice, pro forma, ...) by invoice number, order number or your external id (give exactly one). Returns the totals and the PDF as an embedded resource. Számla Agent action-szamla_agent_pdf.

tools.name: szamlazz_check_taxpayer
tools.title: Check a Hungarian taxpayer
tools.description: Look up a Hungarian taxpayer in the NAV register by the first 8 digits of the tax number (the törzsszám): whether the number is valid, the taxpayer's name, VAT status and addresses. Számla Agent action-szamla_agent_taxpayer (data from the NAV Online Invoice platform).

tools.name: szamlazz_get_receipt
tools.title: Get a receipt
tools.description: Read one issued receipt (nyugta) by receipt number: lines, payments, totals, whether it was reversed. Optionally the PDF. Számla Agent action-szamla_agent_nyugta_get.

tools.name: szamlazz_create_invoice
tools.title: Issue an invoice (fiscal, cannot be undone)
tools.description: ISSUES a real invoice in Számlázz.hu. A final invoice is reported to NAV (Online Számla) and can only be cancelled by a reversal (szamlazz_reverse_invoice), never deleted. kind: invoice (default), proforma (díjbekérő; not fiscal, can be deleted with szamlazz_delete_proforma), prepayment (előlegszámla). The tool computes net, VAT and gross of every line from net_unit_price and vat_rate. preview true builds the PDF only and creates NO document (check the reply: a returned invoice_number means a document WAS created). This call is NEVER retried: if the result is unclear, look the invoice up (szamlazz_get_invoice by order_number or external_id) before issuing again; always send external_id or order_number so that you can. Setting send_email_to_buyer e-mails the PDF to the buyer. Számla Agent action-xmlagentxmlfile.

tools.name: szamlazz_reverse_invoice
tools.title: Reverse (storno) an invoice (fiscal, cannot be undone)
tools.description: ISSUES a reversal (storno) invoice that cancels one issued invoice. Fiscal: it is reported to NAV and cannot be undone; the original stays in the books. A reversal needs the invoice number of a real invoice. NEVER retried: if the result is unclear, check with szamlazz_get_invoice before trying again. Számla Agent action-szamla_agent_st.

tools.name: szamlazz_delete_proforma
tools.title: Delete a pro forma invoice
tools.description: DELETES one pro forma invoice (díjbekérő) by its number or by its order number (give exactly one). Only pro forma invoices can be deleted; a real invoice is never touched (use szamlazz_reverse_invoice). Cannot be undone. Számla Agent action-szamla_agent_dijbekero_torlese.

tools.name: szamlazz_register_payment
tools.title: Register payments on an invoice
tools.description: Records 1-5 payments (kifizetés) on one of your own issued invoices or pro forma invoices, which updates its paid amount and outstanding balance. By default the payments are ADDED to the existing ones; replace_existing true REPLACES all earlier payment entries of the invoice. Not fiscal. Számla Agent action-szamla_agent_kifiz.

tools.name: szamlazz_create_receipt
tools.title: Issue a receipt (fiscal, cannot be undone)
tools.description: ISSUES a real HUF receipt (nyugta). Receipts are fiscal (NAV reporting) and can only be cancelled by szamlazz_reverse_receipt, never deleted. Give each line's whole-forint gross_total and vat_rate: the tool derives net, VAT and unit price (net + VAT equals gross exactly, as the vendor demands). The receipt prefix must be a receipt-only prefix (capital letters and digits, e.g. NYGTA), not an invoice prefix. call_id is required: the vendor refuses a second receipt with the same call_id (error 338), which protects against a duplicate. NEVER retried automatically: if the result is unclear, ask the user, then repeat the call with the SAME call_id (error 338 means the receipt already exists; find it in Számlázz.hu). Számla Agent action-szamla_agent_nyugta_create.

tools.name: szamlazz_reverse_receipt
tools.title: Reverse (storno) a receipt (fiscal, cannot be undone)
tools.description: ISSUES a reversal (storno) receipt that cancels one issued receipt. Fiscal and irreversible; a receipt can be reversed once, and a reversal receipt cannot be reversed. NEVER retried: if the result is unclear, check with szamlazz_get_receipt before trying again. Számla Agent action-szamla_agent_nyugta_storno.

tools.name: szamlazz_send_receipt
tools.title: E-mail a receipt
tools.description: E-MAILS an already issued receipt (PDF) to a customer. Without the e-mail fields, the vendor re-sends the receipt with the settings of the earlier e-mail. The e-mail cannot be recalled. Számla Agent action-szamla_agent_nyugta_send.

tools.name: szamlazz_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: szamlazz_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Számlázz.hu tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: szamlazz_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Számlázz.hu (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: szamlazz_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Számlázz.hu Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run szamlazz_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

examples: Show me the details of invoice number E-2026-15, including the VAT breakdown.
Download the PDF of invoice number E-2026-15.
Check whether the Hungarian company with tax number 12345678 is a registered taxpayer.
Look up receipt number NYGTA-2026-8 and tell me if it was reversed.

servers.name: Abstract API
servers.description: Validate emails, phones, IBAN, VAT; look up IPs and companies; rates, holidays, time via Abstract.

login.hint: Every Abstract API has its **own key** (an Email Reputation key does not work for IP Intelligence). Open the API in your Abstract dashboard (app.abstractapi.com) and copy its key. **Credits:** connecting makes one test request per key, and every tool call spends one credit of that API's plan (free plans have a monthly quota and 1 request per second). A tool for an API whose key you left empty answers with a clear message; connect again to add it. Your keys are used only to call Abstract on your behalf; they are never shown to anyone.

tools.name: abstractapi_validate_email
tools.title: Validate email
tools.description: Check one email address: deliverability (format, MX, SMTP), quality score, free/disposable/role/catch-all flags, sender details and known data breaches. Email Reputation API. Spends 1 credit of your Email Reputation plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the Email Reputation API key.

tools.name: abstractapi_lookup_phone
tools.title: Look up phone number
tools.description: Validate and enrich one phone number: format, carrier, line type (mobile, landline, VoIP), location, line status, risk and known breaches. Phone Intelligence API. Spends 1 credit of your Phone Intelligence plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the Phone Intelligence API key.

tools.name: abstractapi_lookup_ip
tools.title: Look up IP address
tools.description: Geolocation and security intelligence for one IPv4 or IPv6 address: VPN/proxy/Tor/hosting/abuse flags, ASN, company, location, timezone, flag and currency. IP Intelligence API. An explicit ip_address is required (without one Abstract would look up the caller's own address, which here is this server's). Spends 1 credit of your IP Intelligence plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the IP Intelligence API key.

tools.name: abstractapi_enrich_company
tools.title: Enrich company
tools.description: Firmographic data for a company web domain: name, description, logo, address, industry (SIC/NAICS), employee and revenue ranges, contacts, social profiles, technologies. Company Enrichment API. Spends 1 credit of your Company Enrichment plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the Company Enrichment API key.

tools.name: abstractapi_validate_iban
tools.title: Validate IBAN
tools.description: Check the structure and check digits of one International Bank Account Number. It does not prove that the account exists. IBAN Validation API. Spends 1 credit of your IBAN Validation plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the IBAN Validation API key.

tools.name: abstractapi_validate_vat
tools.title: Validate VAT number
tools.description: Check whether a VAT number is valid and, if it is, return the registered company name and address. VAT Validation API. Spends 1 credit of your VAT Validation plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the VAT Validation API key.

tools.name: abstractapi_calculate_vat
tools.title: Calculate VAT
tools.description: Work out the VAT-compliant price for an amount in a country: the amounts without and with VAT, the VAT amount and the rate. Set is_vat_incl to true for the reverse calculation (the amount already contains VAT). VAT Validation API. Spends 1 credit of your VAT Validation plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the VAT Validation API key.

tools.name: abstractapi_list_vat_rates
tools.title: List VAT rates
tools.description: The latest VAT rates of one country: the standard rate and each reduced-rate category with its description. VAT Validation API. Abstract answers this endpoint without checking the key and may not count it as a credit; this tool still needs the VAT API key.

tools.name: abstractapi_get_exchange_rates
tools.title: Get exchange rates
tools.description: Latest foreign-exchange and cryptocurrency rates for a base currency against one or more targets (all supported currencies if none is given). Exchange Rates API. Spends 1 credit of your Exchange Rates plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the Exchange Rates API key.

tools.name: abstractapi_convert_currency
tools.title: Convert currency
tools.description: Convert an amount from a base currency to one target currency, at the latest rate or at the rate of a past date. Exchange Rates API. Spends 1 credit of your Exchange Rates plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the Exchange Rates API key.

tools.name: abstractapi_get_historical_rates
tools.title: Get historical exchange rates
tools.description: Exchange rates of a base currency on a past date. Abstract lists this endpoint as closed beta: a key may be refused (HTTP 401/403) until Abstract enables it. Exchange Rates API. Spends 1 credit of your Exchange Rates plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the Exchange Rates API key.

tools.name: abstractapi_get_holidays
tools.title: Get public holidays
tools.description: Public, local and religious holidays of a country for a date, a month or a year. Free Abstract plans require year, month and day together; paid plans default missing values to today. Public Holidays API. Spends 1 credit of your Public Holidays plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the Public Holidays API key.

tools.name: abstractapi_get_current_time
tools.title: Get current time
tools.description: The current local date, time and timezone (name, abbreviation, GMT offset, daylight saving) of a place, coordinates or IP address. Timezone API. Spends 1 credit of your Timezone plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the Timezone API key.

tools.name: abstractapi_convert_time
tools.title: Convert time between locations
tools.description: Convert a date and time from one location to another (places, coordinates or IP addresses). Without base_datetime the current time is converted. Timezone API. Spends 1 credit of your Timezone plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the Timezone API key.

tools.name: abstractapi_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: abstractapi_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Abstract API tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: abstractapi_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Abstract API (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: abstractapi_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Abstract API Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run abstractapi_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

What is the VAT rate in Germany, including reduced rates?
Convert 2,500 euros to US dollars at today's rate.
Is December 25 a public holiday in Spain this year, and what is it called?

servers.name: Oblio
servers.description: Read Oblio clients, products and documents; create proformas, issue, collect and cancel invoices.

login.hint: Your e-mail is the one you log in to Oblio with. The API secret is the token under **Setari > Date Cont** in [Oblio.eu](https://www.oblio.eu); it changes whenever the Oblio password is reset. The secret is only used to call the Oblio API on your behalf and is never shown to anyone. Issuing, cancelling and sending invoices are fiscal actions: they always need your confirmation.

tools.name: oblio_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: The companies (CIF, name, your access level) linked to the connected Oblio account. Good first call: every other tool needs a CIF from here. GET /api/nomenclature/companies.

tools.name: oblio_list_vat_rates
tools.title: List VAT rates
tools.description: VAT rates (name, percent, default) of a company; use the name and percent on document lines. GET /api/nomenclature/vat_rates.

tools.name: oblio_list_series
tools.title: List document series
tools.description: Document series of a company (type Factura/Proforma/Aviz, name, start, next number, default). Use the name as series_name. GET /api/nomenclature/series.

tools.name: oblio_list_languages
tools.title: List document languages
tools.description: Foreign languages a company can issue documents in (code, name). GET /api/nomenclature/languages.

tools.name: oblio_list_management
tools.title: List stock managements
tools.description: Stock managements (gestiuni) of a company with their work point and type; works only when stock is enabled. GET /api/nomenclature/management.

tools.name: oblio_list_clients
tools.title: List or search clients
tools.description: Clients of a company, optionally filtered by name or client CIF. Up to 250 per page: pass next_offset as offset for the next page. GET /api/nomenclature/clients.

tools.name: oblio_list_products
tools.title: List or search products
tools.description: Products and services of a company with unit, price, VAT and (with stock) quantities. Up to 250 per page: pass next_offset as offset. GET /api/nomenclature/products.

tools.name: oblio_get_document
tools.title: Get a document
tools.description: One invoice, proforma or notice by series and number: type, series, number, link to the PDF and (invoices) the collections. GET /api/docs/<type>.

tools.name: oblio_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: Invoices of a company with filters (series, number, dates, client, draft/canceled/collected), newest first by default. Optional products, collections and e-Factura (SPV) status per invoice. Pass next_offset as offset for the next page. GET /api/docs/invoice/list.

tools.name: oblio_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: The webhook subscriptions of the account (id, CIF, topic, endpoint). GET /api/webhooks.

tools.name: oblio_create_proforma
tools.title: Create a proforma
tools.description: Create a PROFORMA (not a fiscal invoice; the preferred first step). It takes the next number of the series immediately, there is no draft state, and Oblio sends no e-mail. Check client, lines, VAT (oblio_list_vat_rates) and series (oblio_list_series) first. Returns the series, number and a PDF link. Not retried: if the reply is an error, look in Oblio before repeating. POST /api/docs/proforma.

tools.name: oblio_issue_invoice
tools.title: Issue an invoice (fiscal, irreversible)
tools.description: ISSUE a real INVOICE. This is a legal fiscal document: it takes the next number in the series at once, there is no draft state, it cannot be edited, and it can only be cancelled afterwards (it may also be sent to ANAF e-Factura / SPV, automatically if the account is set up so). Needs confirm: true, an idempotency_key, and the user's explicit approval of the exact client, lines, totals and series. Optionally base it on a proforma or notice (reference_document), record the payment at once (collect) or set the delivery date. Not retried: if the reply is an error, look in Oblio before repeating. Oblio never e-mails the client from this tool. POST /api/docs/invoice.

tools.name: oblio_collect_invoice
tools.title: Record an invoice payment (collect)
tools.description: Record that an issued invoice was paid (receipt, bank order, card...). Changes the invoice's paid status and is not reversible from the API. Needs confirm: true and the user's approval of the amount. Not retried. PUT /api/docs/invoice/collect.

tools.name: oblio_cancel_document
tools.title: Cancel a document (fiscal)
tools.description: CANCEL an invoice, proforma or notice. A cancelled invoice stays in the series but is void; if it was already sent to e-Factura / SPV, check the SPV side as well. Needs confirm: true and the user's approval. Not retried. PUT /api/docs/<type>/cancel.

tools.name: oblio_restore_document
tools.title: Restore a cancelled document (fiscal)
tools.description: Restore a previously CANCELLED invoice, proforma or notice. Needs confirm: true and the user's approval. Not retried. PUT /api/docs/<type>/restore.

tools.name: oblio_send_einvoice_to_spv
tools.title: Send an invoice to e-Factura (SPV)
tools.description: SEND an issued invoice to ANAF e-Factura (SPV). Irreversible: a document accepted by ANAF cannot be withdrawn from this API. Needs confirm: true and the user's approval. Not retried: check the status with oblio_list_invoices (with_einvoice_status) before repeating. Returns text, sent and a code (-1 not sent, 2 errors, 0 processing, 1 sent). POST /api/docs/einvoice.

tools.name: oblio_create_webhook
tools.title: Create a webhook
tools.description: Subscribe an HTTPS endpoint to an Oblio event (stock changes, drafts/updates/cancellations of documents, collections). Oblio will POST account data to that URL, so only use an endpoint the user named and controls; it must answer 200 with the base64 of the X-Oblio-Request-Id header. Needs confirm: true. POST /api/webhooks.

tools.name: oblio_delete_webhook
tools.title: Delete a webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook subscription by id (from oblio_list_webhooks). Needs confirm: true. DELETE /api/webhooks/{id}.

tools.name: oblio_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: oblio_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Oblio tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: oblio_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Oblio (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: oblio_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Oblio Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run oblio_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

servers.name: SmartAccounts
servers.description: Read SmartAccounts clients, vendors, invoices, payments, ledger, accounts; create and book records.

login.hint: Generate both keys in SmartAccounts under **Settings → Connected services → API**. The API user group has access to every function by default: narrow it under **Settings → User groups** to what you need. Your keys are used only to sign and send SmartAccounts API requests on your behalf; they are never shown to anyone.

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_clients
tools.title: List or search clients
tools.description: Customers of the company (purchasesales/clients:get): id, name, regCode, vatNumber, bank account, due days, discount, VAT code. Filter by name or registry code, by id, or by modification time. Paged (100 per page). The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_get_client_balance
tools.title: Get a client's outstanding balance
tools.description: The outstanding balance of one client (purchasesales/clients:getbalance), optionally on a past date and with the open documents. The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_vendors
tools.title: List or search vendors
tools.description: Suppliers of the company (purchasesales/vendors:get): id, name, regCode, vatNumber, bank account, VAT code. Filter by name or registry code, by id, or by modification time. Paged (100 per page). The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_get_vendor_balance
tools.title: Get a vendor's outstanding balance
tools.description: The outstanding balance owed to one vendor (purchasesales/vendors:getbalance), optionally on a past date and with the open documents. The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_articles
tools.title: List or search articles
tools.description: Products, services and warehouse items (purchasesales/articles:get): code, description, type, unit, VAT code, sales and purchase prices, accounts. Search by code or name, or by modification time. Paged (100 per page). The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_sales_invoices
tools.title: List sales invoices
tools.description: Sales (client) invoices (purchasesales/clientinvoices:get): number, client, dates, amounts, VAT, outstanding amount, optionally the rows. Filter by date, client, number or payment status (unpaid, overdue). Paged (100 per page). The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_purchase_invoices
tools.title: List purchase invoices
tools.description: Purchase (vendor) invoices (purchasesales/vendorinvoices:get): number, vendor, dates, amounts, VAT, outstanding amount, optionally the rows. Filter by date, vendor, number or payment status (unpaid, overdue). Paged (100 per page). The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: Bank and cash payments from clients and to vendors (purchasesales/payments:get): date, partner, account, currency, amount, optionally the rows (which invoices were paid). Paged (100 per page). The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_ledger_entries
tools.title: List general ledger entries
tools.description: General ledger entries of every type (general/entries:get): manual entries, invoices, payments, VAT returns, depreciation. Filter by date, type, text or payment status. Paged (100 per page). The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_accounts
tools.title: List the chart of accounts
tools.description: The chart of accounts: code, type (ASSET, LIABILITY, INCOME, EXPENSE), Estonian and English description. Use the codes in ledger entries. (settings/accounts:get). Not paged. The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_vat_rates
tools.title: List VAT rates
tools.description: VAT codes: vatPc code, percentage, descriptions, whether active for sales or purchases, accounts. Use vatPc in client and invoice rows. (settings/vatpcs:get). Not paged. The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_bank_accounts
tools.title: List bank accounts
tools.description: The company's bank accounts: name (used as accountName in payments), ledger account, currency, IBAN, SWIFT. (settings/bankaccounts:get). Not paged. The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_cash_accounts
tools.title: List cash accounts
tools.description: The company's cash registers: name (used as accountName in payments), ledger account, currency. (settings/cashaccounts:get). Not paged. The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_payment_methods
tools.title: List payment methods
tools.description: Payment methods: name, ledger account, whether cash. (settings/paymentmethods:get). Not paged. The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: Add a new client (purchasesales/clients:add). Search first with smartaccounts_list_clients so a client is not created twice. Returns clientId and the generated referenceNumber. This creates a real accounting record in the company's books. This server cannot edit or delete it; correct it in SmartAccounts. It never retries: if a reply is unclear, look in SmartAccounts before calling again. The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_create_sales_invoice
tools.title: Create a sales invoice
tools.description: Post a new sales (client) invoice (purchasesales/clientinvoices:add). The invoice number is generated by SmartAccounts, totals and VAT are calculated from the rows, and the invoice is booked to the ledger at once (it is not a draft). The client must exist (smartaccounts_list_clients); each row's code must be an article code (smartaccounts_list_articles) and vat_pc a VAT code (smartaccounts_list_vat_rates). Fails if the period is locked. Returns invoiceId, number and the totals. This creates a real accounting record in the company's books. This server cannot edit or delete it; correct it in SmartAccounts. It never retries: if a reply is unclear, look in SmartAccounts before calling again. The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_create_payment
tools.title: Create a payment
tools.description: Record a bank or cash payment against one or more invoices (purchasesales/payments:add): a client paying a sales invoice, or a payment to a vendor for a purchase invoice. Use smartaccounts_list_bank_accounts or _list_cash_accounts for account_name, and the invoice ids from the invoice lists. The currency must match the account's currency. Returns paymentId, number and amount. This creates a real accounting record in the company's books. This server cannot edit or delete it; correct it in SmartAccounts. It never retries: if a reply is unclear, look in SmartAccounts before calling again. The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_create_ledger_entry
tools.title: Create a manual ledger entry
tools.description: Post a manual general ledger entry (journal entry, general/entries:add) in EUR. Debits must equal credits. Account codes come from smartaccounts_list_accounts. Fails if the period is locked. Returns id, number and amount. This creates a real accounting record in the company's books. This server cannot edit or delete it; correct it in SmartAccounts. It never retries: if a reply is unclear, look in SmartAccounts before calling again. The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)

servers.name: Propstack
servers.description: Read Propstack contacts, properties, projects, deals, tasks, events; create and update CRM records.

login.hint: An admin creates it in Propstack under **Verwaltung → API-Schlüssel** (crm.propstack.de/app/admin/api_keys) and sets its permissions there; give it only the access you need. The key is used only to call the Propstack API on your behalf and is never shown to anyone. Contact data is personal data: connect only if your AI client and its provider are covered by your data-protection agreements.

tools.name: propstack_list_contacts
tools.title: List or search contacts
tools.description: List or search CRM contacts (Kontakte). Returns business fields only (name, company, email, phone numbers, status, source, tags, owner, dates), never birth data, identity or tax numbers, income or portal tokens. Search by free text (name, email, address, phone), exact email, exact phone number, or filter by status, source, tag, owner and dates. Archived contacts are excluded unless archived is set. GET /contacts.

tools.name: propstack_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: One contact by id with address, salutation, language, notes, GDPR status, owner, status, source, tags, sub-contacts and owned properties. Birth data, identity and tax numbers, income and the portal token are never returned. GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: propstack_list_properties
tools.title: List or search properties
tools.description: List or search properties (Objekte / units): address, type, marketing type (buy/rent), rooms, areas, prices, status. Images and owners are not returned. Filter by free text, status, tag, project, marketing type, object type, price and area ranges. GET /units.

tools.name: propstack_get_property
tools.title: Get property
tools.description: One property (Objekt) by id: address, type, rooms, areas, prices, status and the description, location and furnishing texts (clipped). No images or owner. GET /units/{id}.

tools.name: propstack_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects (Projekte: a project groups several property units): title, project id, status, address, owner. Not paged; at most 200 are returned. GET /projects.

tools.name: propstack_list_deals
tools.title: List deals
tools.description: List deals (a deal links a contact to a property and sits in a pipeline stage). Filter by pipeline, stage, category (qualified/unqualified/lost), contact, property, project or owner. Use propstack_list_deal_pipelines for stage ids. GET /client_properties.

tools.name: propstack_list_deal_pipelines
tools.title: List deal pipelines
tools.description: List the deal pipelines with their stages (id, name, position, win chance). Use the stage ids to filter deals or to move a deal. GET /deal_pipelines.

tools.name: propstack_list_activities
tools.title: List activities
tools.description: List the activity timeline (notes, tasks, appointments, e-mails, SMS, letters, rejections, inquiries) with title, linked contacts and properties, state and dates. Message and note bodies are not returned. Filter by type, contact, property, project, owner, category or date. GET /activities.

tools.name: propstack_get_task
tools.title: Get task
tools.description: One task by id (a note, to-do or appointment): title, body text (clipped), type, linked contacts, properties and projects (id and name only), due date or start/end. GET /tasks/{id}.

tools.name: propstack_list_events
tools.title: List calendar events
tools.description: List calendar appointments (Termine, e.g. viewings) in a time window, with title, place, start/end, state and the linked contact, property and project (id and name only). Paged: follow next_page. GET /events.

tools.name: propstack_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users (staff, Nutzer) of the Propstack account: id, name, work email, position, phone, team. Use the ids as owner/broker filters. GET /brokers.

tools.name: propstack_get_reference_data
tools.title: Get reference data
tools.description: Look up the ids used by other tools: property_statuses, activity_types (note/task/appointment types, needed as note_type_id), contact_sources, reservation_reasons (rejection reasons), contact_tags or property_tags. GET /property_statuses, /activity_types, /contact_sources, /reservation_reasons or /groups.

tools.name: propstack_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a CRM contact. Propstack matches on the email address: if a contact with the same email already exists it is UPDATED with the given fields instead of creating a duplicate. Consent flags (newsletter, contact permission, GDPR status) cannot be set here. Returns the contact id. POST /contacts.

tools.name: propstack_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: WRITE: change the given fields of an existing contact; fields not given stay as they are. Returns the updated contact (business fields). PUT /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: propstack_create_task
tools.title: Create note, to-do or appointment
tools.description: WRITE: create a note, a to-do (with due date) or an appointment (with start and end) in Propstack, linked to contacts, properties or projects. note_type_id is the activity type id (see propstack_get_reference_data activity_types). No e-mail or SMS is sent to the contact; the only mail is the reminder to the assignee when remind_at is set. Returns the new task id. POST /tasks.

tools.name: propstack_update_task
tools.title: Update task
tools.description: WRITE: change the given fields of an existing note, to-do or appointment (for example mark a to-do done, move its due date, or reschedule). Fields not given stay as they are. PUT /tasks/{id}.

tools.name: propstack_create_deal
tools.title: Create deal
tools.description: WRITE: create a deal linking a contact to a property in a pipeline stage (see propstack_list_deal_pipelines for stage ids). Returns the new deal. POST /client_properties.

tools.name: propstack_update_deal
tools.title: Update deal
tools.description: WRITE: change the given fields of a deal, typically move it to another pipeline stage or update its note or price. Fields not given stay as they are. PUT /client_properties/{id}.

tools.name: propstack_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: propstack_request_feature

tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Propstack tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Propstack (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: propstack_cancel_subscription

tools.description: Cancel the caller's Propstack Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). servers.name: Trumpia
servers.description: Read Trumpia lists, subscribers, keywords and reports; add contacts and send SMS or email campaigns.

login.hint: Both are in Trumpia under **Settings → Account Settings** (username) and **Settings → Account Settings → API Settings** (API key). The API must be enabled for your plan. Your key is used only to call the Trumpia API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: trumpia_get_credit_balance
tools.title: Get credit balance
tools.description: The account's remaining domestic and international text credits. GET /balance/credit.

tools.name: trumpia_get_request_report
tools.title: Get request status report
tools.description: The outcome of an earlier write request (list/contact/message changes are processed asynchronously). Pass the request_id that the write tool returned; the reply holds the result (for example the new list_id) or says it is still processing or failed. GET /report/{request_id}.

tools.name: trumpia_list_lists
tools.title: List distribution lists
tools.description: All distribution lists (id and name). Lists group subscriptions for targeted messages. GET /list.

tools.name: trumpia_get_list
tools.title: Get distribution list
tools.description: One distribution list: display name, description, message frequency and subscription / mobile / email counts. GET /list/{list_id}.

tools.name: trumpia_create_list
tools.title: Create distribution list
tools.description: WRITE: create a distribution list. Trumpia requires disclosing how often subscribers get messages and what for. Returns request_id and list_id. The list name must not contain spaces or special characters. PUT /list.

tools.name: trumpia_update_list
tools.title: Update distribution list
tools.description: WRITE: change a distribution list's name, display name, frequency or description. Only the fields you pass change. POST /list/{list_id}.

tools.name: trumpia_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscription ids
tools.description: Subscription (contact) ids, newest first. Returns ids only; use trumpia_get_subscription for the details. Pages of 100-10000 ids; next_page is set when a full page came back. GET /subscription.

tools.name: trumpia_get_subscription
tools.title: Get subscription
tools.description: One subscription (contact): name, email, mobile and landline (with verified flags), list ids, created date and custom data. Contains personal data. GET /subscription/{subscription_id}.

tools.name: trumpia_search_subscriptions
tools.title: Search subscriptions
tools.description: Find subscription ids by email, mobile number, landline, country code, created date, first name or last name; optionally within one list. search_data 'all' returns every subscription that has data of that type. Returns ids; use trumpia_get_subscription for details. GET /subscription/search.

tools.name: trumpia_add_subscriptions
tools.title: Add subscriptions
tools.description: WRITE: add contacts to one or more distribution lists (comma-separated list names that already exist). Each contact needs a mobile number, an email or a landline. Only add people who gave express consent to receive messages (TCPA, CAN-SPAM, CTIA rules apply); Trumpia may require a submitted API contract. Returns a request_id; check trumpia_get_request_report. PUT /subscription.

tools.name: trumpia_update_subscription
tools.title: Update subscription
tools.description: WRITE: change a contact's name, email, mobile, landline, custom data or list membership. Only the fields you pass change. Returns a request_id. POST /subscription/{subscription_id}.

tools.name: trumpia_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom data fields
tools.description: All custom data fields (id and name) that can be stored on subscriptions and used as mail-merge values. GET /customdata.

tools.name: trumpia_get_custom_field
tools.title: Get custom data field
tools.description: One custom data field: type, options (allowed values, max length), whether required, and its mail-merge text. GET /customdata/{customdata_id}.

tools.name: trumpia_list_keywords
tools.title: List keywords
tools.description: All mobile keywords with id, keyword and the short or long code. GET /keyword.

tools.name: trumpia_get_keyword
tools.title: Get keyword
tools.description: One mobile keyword in detail: auto-response message, code, alternative messages. GET /keyword/{keyword_id}.

tools.name: trumpia_list_org_names
tools.title: List organization names
tools.description: Registered organization names as { org_names: [ { org_name_id, name, default } ] } (Trumpia returns a bare array; it is wrapped). The id can be set as org_name_id on messages. GET /orgname.

tools.name: trumpia_list_email_senders
tools.title: List email sender addresses
tools.description: Registered email sender addresses (the From / Reply-To addresses allowed for email messages) as { senders: [ { sender_id, address, default } ] } (Trumpia returns a bare array; it is wrapped). GET /email/sender.

tools.name: trumpia_get_message
tools.title: Get message statistics
tools.description: Delivery statistics of a message sent with trumpia_send_message: status (sent / scheduled / canceled), totals, sent and failed counts per channel and credits used. GET /message/{message_id}.

tools.name: trumpia_list_scheduled_messages
tools.title: List scheduled messages
tools.description: Messages that are scheduled and not yet sent (id, description, scheduled time, recipient counts). Use offset and limit to page; total_count says how many exist. GET /message/scheduled.

tools.name: trumpia_send_message
tools.title: Send message
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS REAL MESSAGES that spend credits and cannot be recalled once sent: send an SMS and/or an email to distribution lists or specific subscriptions, now or scheduled (a scheduled one can be cancelled with trumpia_cancel_scheduled_message). Subscribers must have opted in (TCPA, CAN-SPAM, CTIA). Confirm the recipients and text with the user first. Mail merge tokens: [$FirstName], [$LastName], [$FullName], [$CustomData-NAME]. Returns request_id and message_id. PUT /message.

tools.name: trumpia_send_sms
tools.title: Send direct SMS
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS A REAL TEXT that spends a credit and cannot be recalled: one SMS to one mobile number without adding the contact first. The recipient must have consented; Trumpia may require API Certification for contacts that have not opted in. Confirm number and text with the user first. Returns request_id and sms_id. PUT /sms.

tools.name: trumpia_cancel_scheduled_message
tools.title: Cancel scheduled message
tools.description: WRITE: cancel a message that is scheduled and has not been sent yet (see trumpia_list_scheduled_messages). Does nothing for a message already sent. DELETE /message/scheduled/{message_id}.

tools.name: trumpia_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Trumpia tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: trumpia_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Trumpia (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: trumpia_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Trumpia Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run trumpia_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Order Desk
servers.description: Search Order Desk orders and inventory; read order items and shipments; create or update orders.

login.hint: Find both in Order Desk under **Store Settings → API** (create the key there if the tab shows none). The key gives full read and write access to that store, so keep it private. A wrong Store ID is blocked by Order Desk, so copy it carefully. Your credentials are used only to call the Order Desk API on your behalf; they are never shown to anyone.

tools.name: orderdesk_get_store
tools.title: Get store settings and folders
tools.description: The store's name, id, FOLDERS (id -> name; orders live in exactly one folder, and folder ids are needed to filter and move orders) and key settings (timezone, locale, stock behavior, shipping methods). The API key and mail credentials are never returned. GET /store.

tools.name: orderdesk_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: Search orders, newest first, with items, addresses, totals, payment and shipments. Filters combine with AND. Prefer a date range: Order Desk asks clients to avoid open-ended queries. Page with limit and offset (next_offset). GET /orders.

tools.name: orderdesk_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by Order Desk's internal id: addresses, items, totals, payment, notes, discounts, checkout data and shipments. To find an order by your own id, use orderdesk_list_orders with source_id. GET /orders/{order_id}.

tools.name: orderdesk_list_order_items
tools.title: List order items
tools.description: The line items of one order (name, SKU, price, quantity, weight, delivery type, variations). GET /orders/{order_id}/order-items.

tools.name: orderdesk_list_order_shipments
tools.title: List order shipments
tools.description: The shipments recorded against an order: carrier, tracking number and URL, method, weight, cost, dates. GET /orders/{order_id}/shipments.

tools.name: orderdesk_create_order
tools.title: Create order
tools.description: WRITE: add a new order to the store. Needs at least one item, and a name or company in the shipping or customer address (if only one address is given the other is copied from it). Omit folder_id to land in the first folder. Order Desk rejects an order it recognizes as a duplicate and names the existing order id. POST /orders.

tools.name: orderdesk_update_order
tools.title: Update order
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing order. Order Desk's PUT replaces the whole record, so this reads the order, applies only the fields you pass (shipping/customer address fields and checkout_data/order_metadata keys are merged into what is there, other values replaced) and sends the complete record back, items included. The order keeps its folder; use orderdesk_move_orders to move it. PUT /orders/{order_id}.

tools.name: orderdesk_add_order_item
tools.title: Add order item
tools.description: WRITE: add one line item to an existing order; Order Desk recalculates the totals. POST /orders/{order_id}/order-items.

tools.name: orderdesk_add_order_note
tools.title: Add order history note
tools.description: WRITE: append an entry to an order's history. History is append-only (entries cannot be edited or removed) and an order holds at most 250 entries, so do not use it for routine polling. POST /orders/{order_id}/order-history.

tools.name: orderdesk_add_shipment
tools.title: Add shipment
tools.description: WRITE: record a shipment (carrier and tracking number) against an order. One shipment per parcel; several shipments represent a partial fulfillment. Use "n/a" when there is no tracking number. If tracking_url is omitted Order Desk derives it. POST /orders/{order_id}/shipments.

tools.name: orderdesk_move_orders
tools.title: Move orders to a folder
tools.description: WRITE: move one or more orders to another folder. Moving runs the rules attached to the destination folder (which can send e-mail, call fulfillment services, etc.) and writes a history entry. Pass exactly one of destination_folder_id or destination_folder_name (see orderdesk_get_store). Returns each order's previous folder. POST /move-orders.

tools.name: orderdesk_list_inventory_items
tools.title: List inventory items
tools.description: Search the store's inventory (SKU, name, price, cost, weight, stock, location). Order Desk returns every match with no paging, so narrow with search/code/name; limit and offset slice the result here. GET /inventory-items.

tools.name: orderdesk_get_inventory_item
tools.title: Get inventory item
tools.description: One inventory item by Order Desk's internal id. GET /inventory-items/{inventory_item_id}.

tools.name: orderdesk_create_inventory_item
tools.title: Create inventory item
tools.description: WRITE: add an inventory item. The code (SKU) must match the code your orders arrive with. POST /inventory-items.

tools.name: orderdesk_update_inventory_item
tools.title: Update inventory item
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an inventory item, for example its stock count. Order Desk's PUT replaces the whole record, so this reads the item, applies only the fields you pass (metadata and variation keys are merged) and sends the complete record back. PUT /inventory-items/{inventory_item_id}.

tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Order Desk tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Order Desk (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: orderdesk_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Order Desk Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). servers.name: SimplyRETS
servers.description: Search SimplyRETS MLS listings and open houses; read listing and market analytics.

login.hint: Find both on your app at **simplyrets.com/account** (Apps). To try it without an account, use the public demo pair **simplyrets** / **simplyrets** (trial data only; everyone who uses the demo pair shares one usage count, so do not subscribe on it: use your own app's key for that). Your credentials are used only to call the SimplyRETS API on your behalf; the secret is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: simplyrets_get_account_info
tools.title: Get account info
tools.description: What these API credentials can reach: the MLS vendor ids (needed as `vendor` on multi-MLS apps), the time of each vendor's last sync, usernames and the available endpoints (/properties, /openhouses, /agents, /offices, /properties/analytics). OPTIONS /.

tools.name: simplyrets_get_feed_metadata
tools.title: Get feed metadata
tools.description: Values present in an MLS feed, to build valid searches: statuses, property types, cities, counties, neighborhoods, areas and features, plus the last sync time. OPTIONS /properties.

tools.name: simplyrets_search_listings
tools.title: Search listings
tools.description: Search MLS listings (SimplyRETS /properties): by keyword, status, type, price, beds, baths, area, year, city, zip, neighborhood, agent, broker, features or a map polygon. Returns address, price, status, photos, agent, office, property details and remarks, without empty fields. Pass count=true to get the total. Page with next.offset or next.lastId. GET /properties.

tools.name: simplyrets_get_listing
tools.title: Get listing
tools.description: One listing by its SimplyRETS id (`mlsId`, the number in search results; NOT the public MLS number `listingId`). Full detail: address, geo, price, photos, agent, office, property, school, tax, remarks. GET /properties/{mlsId}.

tools.name: simplyrets_list_open_houses
tools.title: List open houses
tools.description: Upcoming open houses with the listing they belong to: filter by property type, listing id, city, broker, agent, price, size, beds, baths and start date. Page with next.offset or next.lastId. GET /openhouses.

tools.name: simplyrets_get_open_house
tools.title: Get open house
tools.description: One open house by its key (the `openHouseKey` of a list result). GET /openhouses/{openHouseKey}.

tools.name: simplyrets_list_agents
tools.title: List agents
tools.description: The agent roster of the MLS feed: id, name, address, contact and office. Needs the Agents API add-on on your SimplyRETS app (the demo credentials return an empty list). GET /agents.

tools.name: simplyrets_list_offices
tools.title: List offices
tools.description: The brokerage office roster of the MLS feed, newest modification first. Needs the Offices API add-on on your SimplyRETS app (the demo credentials cannot use it). Pass count=true for the total. GET /offices.

tools.name: simplyrets_get_market_analytics
tools.title: Get market analytics
tools.description: Statistics for the listings a search matches (same filters as simplyrets_search_listings): total count, average price, bedrooms, full baths, living area, lot size and year built, and the number of listings per area. Use it for market summaries of a city, zip or price band. GET /properties/analytics.

tools.name: simplyrets_get_listing_analytics
tools.title: Get listing analytics
tools.description: Analytics for one listing, such as its price per square foot. GET /properties/{mlsId}/analytics.

tools.name: simplyrets_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: simplyrets_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the SimplyRETS tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: simplyrets_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on SimplyRETS (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: simplyrets_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's SimplyRETS Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run simplyrets_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

Which open houses are scheduled this weekend?
Give me market statistics for listings in zip code 77096.
Show the full details of the listing with SimplyRETS id 1005192.

servers.name: Hello Club
servers.description: Read Hello Club members, events, bookings and transactions; add members and charges.
examples: Which members have an unpaid balance, and how much do they owe in total?
Whose membership ends in the next week?
Show next week's classes that still have spaces left.
Who checked in to the club today?

login.hint: Create it in Hello Club under **Integrations → API keys** (the card at the bottom of the page; API access needs the Business plan). A key has full access to your club's data, so use a key made just for this connection and switch it off in Hello Club to revoke it. Your key is used only to call the Hello Club API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: hello_club_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List or search the club's members (people and staff) with contact details, roles, memberships (subscriptions), account credit and amount owing. Filter by free text, gender, role, staff, money owing, account credit, current subscription state, ending subscriptions or a membership type. GET /member.

tools.name: hello_club_get_member
tools.title: Get member
tools.description: One member by id: profile, contact details, roles, subscriptions, account credit, amount owing, custom fields. Password hashes and payment-provider data are not returned. GET /member/{id}.

tools.name: hello_club_list_membership_types
tools.title: List membership types
tools.description: The membership types (plans) the club sells: name, fee, term, age limits, renewal rules and access. GET /membership.

tools.name: hello_club_get_membership_type
tools.title: Get membership type
tools.description: One membership type by id. GET /membership/{id}.

tools.name: hello_club_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List or search events and classes (sessions, courses, tournaments) with dates, activity, area, organiser, capacity and attendance rules. Filter by date range, recurring, hidden, public, has attendees, has spaces left, rule type, activity, area or organiser. GET /event.

tools.name: hello_club_get_event
tools.title: Get event
tools.description: One event by id: dates, recurrence, activity, area, organiser, capacity, attendance rules, questions. GET /event/{id}.

tools.name: hello_club_list_event_attendees
tools.title: List event attendees
tools.description: List who is signed up to events: member or guest, event, sign-up date, paid state, whether they attended. Filter by event, member or guest. GET /eventAttendee.

tools.name: hello_club_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List resource bookings (courts, rooms, lanes): owner, activity, area, start/end, paid state, recurrence. Filter by date range, member, activity, mode, area, recurring, paid or removed. GET /booking.

tools.name: hello_club_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: List the club's financial transactions (invoices, charges, credits): member, type, amount, tax, due and payment dates, paid state. Filter by member, type, paid, credit or a date range on date / dueDate / paymentDate. GET /transaction.

tools.name: hello_club_get_transaction
tools.title: Get transaction
tools.description: One transaction by id: member, type, amount, tax, details, dates, paid state. GET /transaction/{id}.

tools.name: hello_club_list_check_ins
tools.title: List check-ins
tools.description: List check-in logs (members arriving at the club): who, when, how (type). Filter by member or type, or only unknown people. GET /checkInLog.

tools.name: hello_club_list_access_logs
tools.title: List door access logs
tools.description: List door / access-control logs in a date range: member, door, event, whether it was an override or an unknown person. GET /accessLog.

tools.name: hello_club_create_member
tools.title: Create member
tools.description: WRITE: create a new member in the club (first and last name required; email, mobile, phone and gender optional). Creates a real member record in the club's database; it does not assign a membership or send an invoice. Not idempotent: calling twice creates two members, so search with hello_club_list_members first. POST /member.

tools.name: hello_club_create_transaction
tools.title: Create transaction
tools.description: WRITE: create a financial transaction for a member (a charge, or a credit when is_credit is true), e.g. an invoice line or a manual adjustment. This changes the member's amount owing / account credit in the club's books and, with notify_by_email, emails the member. Not idempotent: calling twice creates two transactions. Confirm member, amount and type with the user first. POST /transaction.

servers.name: Zenbooker
servers.description: Read Zenbooker jobs, customers, invoices and timeslots; add customers and job notes.
examples: What jobs are scheduled for tomorrow and who is assigned to each?
Find the customer with phone 555-0134 and show their past jobs.
Which invoices are still unpaid this month?
What time slots are open in my Downtown territory next week for a 2-hour cleaning?

login.hint: Create it in Zenbooker → **Settings → Developers → API** → **Create API Key**. A Zenbooker key has full access to the account. Your key is used only to call the Zenbooker API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: zenbooker_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List jobs (booked appointments), by start time by default, with filters: customer id, assigned team member id, territory id, recurring booking id, status, canceled flag, creation time and scheduled start window. Returns { results, count, has_more, next_cursor }; pass next_cursor as cursor for the next page. GET /v1/jobs.

tools.name: zenbooker_get_job
tools.title: Get job
tools.description: One job by id: appointment time, status, customer, service address, services and fields, assigned providers, notes and invoice summary. GET /v1/jobs/{id}.

tools.name: zenbooker_add_job_note
tools.title: Add a note to a job
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal note (text) to a job. Notes are appended, never replaced, and cannot be deleted through this server, so check the job first. POST /v1/jobs/{id}/notes.

tools.name: zenbooker_list_recurring_bookings
tools.title: List recurring bookings
tools.description: List recurring bookings (repeating job series), by status (active or canceled), customer id, assigned team member id, territory id or creation time. Max 40 per page. Returns { results, count, has_more, next_cursor }. GET /v1/recurring.

tools.name: zenbooker_get_recurring_booking
tools.title: Get recurring booking
tools.description: One recurring booking by id: first job date, job count, time slot, status, territory, service, pricing and its job ids. GET /v1/recurring/{id}.

tools.name: zenbooker_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List or search customers by name, email or phone, by creation time, or by default address near a place (location + radius in miles). Returns { results, count, has_more, next_cursor }. GET /v1/customers.

tools.name: zenbooker_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer by id: contact details, notes, addresses, job and recurring booking ids and linked Stripe customer. GET /v1/customers/{id}.

tools.name: zenbooker_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a new customer record in Zenbooker (name required; phone and email optional). It does not look for an existing customer, so search with zenbooker_list_customers first to avoid duplicates. POST /v1/customers.

tools.name: zenbooker_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices, optionally by status (draft, unpaid, partial_paid, paid, void), customer id, territory id or creation time. Each invoice has line items, totals, amount paid and due and its transactions. Returns { results, count, has_more, next_cursor }. GET /v1/invoices.

tools.name: zenbooker_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: One invoice by id: recipient, line items, discounts, tax, totals, amount paid and due, status and transactions. GET /v1/invoices/{id}.

tools.name: zenbooker_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: List payment transactions, optionally by type (stripe_payment, external_transaction), payment method, status (succeeded, failed, voided), customer id, territory id, creation time or payment date. Returns { results, count, has_more, next_cursor }. GET /v1/transactions.

tools.name: zenbooker_get_transaction
tools.title: Get transaction
tools.description: One payment transaction by id: status, type, method, amount, invoice and customer ids, Stripe references. GET /v1/transactions/{id}.

tools.name: zenbooker_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List the services a business offers, with pricing method, base price and duration, option sections and recurring frequencies. GET /v1/services.

tools.name: zenbooker_get_service
tools.title: Get service
tools.description: One service by id: pricing, duration, option sections and their options. GET /v1/services/{id}.

tools.name: zenbooker_list_territories
tools.title: List service territories
tools.description: List the service territories (areas a business serves) with timezone, service area, providers and operating hours. Use the ids to filter jobs and invoices or to look up time slots. GET /v1/territories.

tools.name: zenbooker_get_territory
tools.title: Get service territory
tools.description: One service territory by id. GET /v1/territories/{id}.

tools.name: zenbooker_list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List team members (staff and service providers) with role, status, assigned territories, skill tags and work hours. Use the ids to filter jobs by assigned provider. GET /v1/team_members.

tools.name: zenbooker_get_team_member
tools.title: Get team member
tools.description: One team member by id: contact details, role, status, territories, skill tags and work hours. GET /v1/team_members/{id}.

tools.name: zenbooker_list_service_requests
tools.title: List service requests
tools.description: List incoming service requests (booking requests and quote requests) with status, customer, territory, duration, requested dates, services and pricing. Returns { results, count, has_more, next_cursor }. GET /v1/service_requests.

tools.name: zenbooker_check_service_area
tools.title: Check service area
tools.description: Check whether a location is inside the business's service area: returns in_service_area, the matching territory and other territories that serve it (or the closest territory when it is outside every area). Give a postal code, an address, or lat + lng. GET /v1/scheduling/service_area_check.

tools.name: zenbooker_get_timeslots
tools.title: Get available time slots
tools.description: Available booking time slots for a service territory, grouped by day (days[].timeslots[] with start, end and id). Needs the territory id (zenbooker_list_territories or zenbooker_check_service_area) and the service duration in minutes. GET /v1/scheduling/timeslots.

tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Zenbooker tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Does not count against the meter.
