tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Zenbooker (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: zenbooker_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Zenbooker Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run zenbooker_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Linnworks
servers.description: Read Linnworks inventory, stock and orders; set stock levels and add order notes.
examples: Which open orders came in today and which are still waiting to be despatched?
What is the stock level of SKU ABC-123 in each warehouse?
Find the order with eBay reference 12-34567-89012 and show its tracking number.
Add an internal note to order 150234: customer asked for a gift receipt.

login.hint: Create the application yourself, for free, in the **Linnworks Developer Portal** (developer.linnworks.com, sign in with your Linnworks account-holder email): **Create application → System Integration**. The Application Id and Secret are on its General page. Open the Installation URL shown there while logged in to your Linnworks account and install it: the page then shows the token. Give the application only the permissions you want an AI assistant to have. These values are used only to call the Linnworks API on your behalf and are never shown to anyone.

tools.name: linnworks_list_stock_locations
tools.title: List stock locations
tools.description: List the stock locations (warehouses, fulfilment centres) of the Linnworks account: id, name, address, whether it is a fulfilment centre. Use the ids as location_id in other tools. GET /api/Inventory/GetStockLocations.

tools.name: linnworks_search_inventory
tools.title: Search inventory
tools.description: Search the product catalogue by SKU, title or barcode and return the items with their stock levels per location (and optionally pricing, suppliers, images, extended properties). An empty keyword lists items. POST /api/Stock/GetStockItemsFull.

tools.name: linnworks_get_inventory_item
tools.title: Get inventory item
tools.description: One product by its stock item id: SKU (ItemNumber), title, barcode, quantities (in stock, in orders, due, available), prices, tax rate, category, dimensions and weight. GET /api/Inventory/GetInventoryItemById.

tools.name: linnworks_get_stock_levels
tools.title: Get stock levels
tools.description: The stock level of one product at every location: in stock, in open orders, due on purchase orders, available, minimum level, unit cost and when it last changed. GET /api/Stock/GetStockLevel.

tools.name: linnworks_get_stock_history
tools.title: Get stock change history
tools.description: The stock-level change history of one product (date, new level, change quantity, value, note), newest data first as Linnworks returns it; optionally for a single location, otherwise combined. GET /api/Stock/GetItemChangesHistory.

tools.name: linnworks_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List the product categories (id and name). GET /api/Inventory/GetCategories.

tools.name: linnworks_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List the suppliers: id, name, contact, address, email, web page and currency. GET /api/Inventory/GetSuppliers.

tools.name: linnworks_list_open_orders
tools.title: List open orders
tools.description: Page through the open (not yet processed) orders of a fulfilment location, with general info (status, reference, source, received date), shipping, customer, totals and items. Narrow with text filters (reference, customer, SKU ...) and a received-date range. POST /api/Orders/GetOpenOrders.

tools.name: linnworks_get_open_orders_details
tools.title: Get open order details
tools.description: Full details of open orders by their ids (up to 50): general info, shipping, customer, totals, items, folders, notes, identifiers, extended properties and bin racks. Pass include to load only some of the optional parts. Only works for open orders. POST /api/OpenOrders/GetOpenOrdersDetails.

tools.name: linnworks_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order, open or processed, by its order id (a GUID): general info, shipping, customer, totals, items, notes. GET /api/Orders/GetOrderById.

tools.name: linnworks_find_order_by_number
tools.title: Find order by order number
tools.description: Find one order, open or processed, by its Linnworks order number (the integer shown in the order book). Returns an empty order when none matches. GET /api/Orders/GetOrderDetailsByNumOrderId.

tools.name: linnworks_find_orders_by_reference
tools.title: Find orders by channel reference
tools.description: Find orders by their channel reference number (for example an Amazon or eBay order number) or secondary reference. Returns at most 50 orders. GET /api/Orders/GetOrderDetailsByReferenceId.

tools.name: linnworks_search_processed_orders
tools.title: Search processed orders
tools.description: Search processed (despatched) orders. Search by order number, tracking number, channel reference, customer name, email, postcode, address, SKU, source or sub-source, optionally within a date range (at most 3 months; a non-exact search covers only the last 3 months). POST /api/ProcessedOrders/SearchProcessedOrdersPaged.

tools.name: linnworks_get_order_notes
tools.title: Get order notes
tools.description: The notes on an order (text, internal or external, who wrote them and when). GET /api/Orders/GetOrderNotes.

tools.name: linnworks_list_postal_services
tools.title: List postal services
tools.description: List the postal (shipping) services with their courier vendor, tracking and weight requirements and linked channels. GET /api/PostalServices/GetPostalServices.

tools.name: linnworks_set_stock_level
tools.title: Set stock level
tools.description: WRITE: set the stock level of one product (by SKU) at one location to an absolute quantity. This overwrites the current level and flows to the sales channels the item is listed on. Check the current level with linnworks_get_stock_levels first. POST /api/Stock/SetStockLevel.

tools.name: linnworks_add_order_note
tools.title: Add order note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to an order (open or processed). Internal notes are visible only inside Linnworks; external notes may be passed to the sales channel. Adds a new note each call (not idempotent). POST /api/Orders/AddOrdersNote.

tools.description: Cancel the caller's Linnworks Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). servers.name: Employment Hero Payroll
servers.description: Read Employment Hero Payroll pay runs, payslips, timesheets and leave; approve or decline leave.
examples: Show my latest pay run and its total gross and net wages.
Which leave requests are still pending approval?
What is Jane Smith's annual leave balance?
List this week's timesheets for the Sydney location.

login.hint: In Employment Hero Payroll click **your name (top right) → My Account → Generate API Key** and copy the key. The key acts with your user's permissions; generating a new key invalidates the old one. Choose the region your payroll runs in (Australia, New Zealand, Singapore and Malaysia share one API host; the United Kingdom has its own). Your key is used only to call the Employment Hero Payroll API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: keypay_get_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: The Employment Hero Payroll user this API key belongs to: id, email, display name and time zone. GET /user.

tools.name: keypay_list_businesses
tools.title: List businesses
tools.description: List the payroll businesses this user can access: id, name, region, legal name, contact details, pay cycle, number of employees. Start here: most other tools need a business id. GET /business (OData).

tools.name: keypay_get_business
tools.title: Get business
tools.description: One business by id: name, legal name, contact, address, ABN/company details, leave year, standard hours, pay cycle. GET /business/{businessId}.

tools.name: keypay_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List the business's employees with basic details: id, name, preferred name, gender, date of birth, contact details, address, start and end date, external id. Tax file, bank and super details are not part of this list. Filter with OData, e.g. "Surname eq 'Smith'". GET /business/{businessId}/employee/details (OData).

tools.name: keypay_get_employee
tools.title: Get employee
tools.description: One employee's full record: name, contact, employment type, status, start/end date, pay schedule, primary location and pay category, rate and rate unit, hours per week, award, leave template, work types, tags. Tax file / national insurance / IRD / NRIC numbers, bank accounts and super member numbers are removed. GET /business/{businessId}/employee/unstructured/{employeeId}.

tools.name: keypay_get_leave_balances
tools.title: Get employee leave balances
tools.description: An employee's leave balances per leave category (accrued amount and unit), optionally as at a date. GET /business/{businessId}/employee/{employeeId}/leavebalances.

tools.name: keypay_list_pay_runs
tools.title: List pay runs
tools.description: List the business's pay runs: id, pay schedule, pay period start/end, date paid, finalised flag, payslips published, notation. Newest first with orderby "PayPeriodEnding desc". GET /business/{businessId}/payrun (OData).

tools.name: keypay_get_pay_run
tools.title: Get pay run
tools.description: One pay run by id: pay schedule, period, date paid, whether it is finalised, notation. GET /business/{businessId}/payrun/{payRunId}.

tools.name: keypay_list_pay_run_summaries
tools.title: List pay run summaries
tools.description: Pay runs with their totals: total hours, gross wages and net wages, plus the usual pay run fields. GET /business/{businessId}/payrun/summary (OData).

tools.name: keypay_get_pay_run_summary
tools.title: Get pay run summary
tools.description: One pay run with its total hours, gross wages and net wages. GET /business/{businessId}/payrun/{payRunId}/summary.

tools.name: keypay_get_pay_run_totals
tools.title: Get pay run totals per employee
tools.description: Per-employee totals of a pay run (gross, net, tax withheld, super and the like; the fields depend on the region). Bank payment details are removed. GET /business/{businessId}/payrun/{payRunId}/totals.

tools.name: keypay_get_pay_run_payslips
tools.title: Get pay slip data of a pay run
tools.description: Pay slip data for every employee in a pay run, keyed by employee: earnings lines, deductions, tax, super, leave taken and accrued, gross/net and year-to-date totals. Large for big pay runs. Bank account numbers and tax/identity numbers are removed. GET /business/{businessId}/payrun/{payRunId}/payslips.

tools.name: keypay_list_pay_run_warnings
tools.title: List pay run warnings
tools.description: Warnings on a pay run (for example an employee paid below their award rate or with a negative net pay): type, employee and message. GET /business/{businessId}/payrun/{payRunId}/warnings.

tools.name: keypay_list_timesheets
tools.title: List timesheets
tools.description: List the business's timesheet lines: employee, start/end time, units, work type, location, status, comments, breaks. Filter by employee or date with OData, e.g. "EmployeeId eq 123 and StartTime gt datetime'2026-04-01T00:00:00'". GET /business/{businessId}/timesheet (OData: $filter, $orderby, $top, $skip).

tools.name: keypay_get_timesheet
tools.title: Get timesheet line
tools.description: One timesheet line by id. GET /business/{businessId}/timesheet/{timesheetLineId}.

tools.name: keypay_list_leave_requests
tools.title: List leave requests
tools.description: List the business's leave requests: employee, leave category, from/to date, total hours, status (Approved, Pending, Rejected, Cancelled), notes. Filter by status, dates, category, location or employee. GET /business/{businessId}/leaverequest.

tools.name: keypay_get_leave_request
tools.title: Get leave request
tools.description: One leave request: employee, category, dates, hours, status, notes. GET /business/{businessId}/employee/{employeeId}/leaverequest/{leaveRequestId}.

tools.name: keypay_list_leave_categories
tools.title: List leave categories
tools.description: Leave categories of the business (annual, personal/sick, long service...): id, name, unit type, accrual rule. GET /business/{businessId}/leavecategory (OData).

tools.name: keypay_list_pay_schedules
tools.title: List pay schedules
tools.description: Pay schedules of the business: id, name, frequency, last date paid, last pay run. Bank and tax account details are removed. GET /business/{businessId}/payschedule (OData).

tools.name: keypay_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: Locations of the business (sites, departments): id, name, parent, fully qualified name, state. GET /business/{businessId}/location (OData).

tools.name: keypay_list_pay_categories
tools.title: List pay categories
tools.description: Pay categories (earnings types) of the business: id, name, rate unit, loadings, super rate, whether leave accrues. GET /business/{businessId}/paycategory (OData).

tools.name: keypay_list_work_types
tools.title: List work types
tools.description: Work types of the business: id, name, pay category, leave category, short code. GET /business/{businessId}/worktype (OData).

tools.name: keypay_report_gross_to_net
tools.title: Gross to net report
tools.description: Gross-to-net report per employee: earnings by pay category, tax, deductions, super, net pay. Choose a date range (from_date + to_date) or one finalised pay run (pay_run_id). The report has no paging: at most 200 rows are returned (narrow with employee_id or location_id). GET /business/{businessId}/report/grosstonet.

tools.name: keypay_report_leave_balances
tools.title: Leave balances report
tools.description: Leave balances of all employees as at a date, per leave category. The report has no paging: at most 200 rows are returned (narrow with location_id or leave_category_id). For one employee use keypay_get_leave_balances. GET /business/{businessId}/report/leavebalances.

tools.name: keypay_approve_leave_request
tools.title: Approve leave request
tools.description: WRITE: approves a pending leave request (the employee is notified and the leave is applied to their pay). Check the request first with keypay_get_leave_request. Cannot be undone through this server. POST /business/{businessId}/employee/{employeeId}/leaverequest/{leaveRequestId}/approve.

tools.name: keypay_decline_leave_request
tools.title: Decline leave request
tools.description: WRITE: declines a leave request, with an optional reason the employee sees. Check the request first with keypay_get_leave_request. POST /business/{businessId}/employee/{employeeId}/leaverequest/{leaveRequestId}/decline.

tools.name: keypay_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: keypay_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Employment Hero Payroll (KeyPay) tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: keypay_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Employment Hero Payroll (KeyPay) (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: keypay_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Employment Hero Payroll (KeyPay) Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run keypay_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Cratejoy
servers.description: Read Cratejoy subscriptions, customers, orders and shipments; skip or cancel subscriptions.
examples: How many active subscriptions do I have, and which ones are past due?
Show last week's orders and their payment status.
Which shipments are still unshipped?
Skip the next renewal of subscription 12345678.

login.hint: A store admin creates them in the Cratejoy Seller Portal under **Settings → API → Generate a new Key**; the secret is shown only once, so copy both values. They are used only to call the Cratejoy API on your behalf and are never shown to anyone. You can revoke the key in Cratejoy at any time.

tools.name: cratejoy_get_store_metadata
tools.title: Get store metadata
tools.description: The store-level metadata record (id, store_id, created_at, updated_at, data: free-form JSON attached to the store). GET /v1/metadata/.

tools.name: cratejoy_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (id, name, email, country, location, num_orders, num_subscriptions, subscription_status, total_revenue). Filter by email or name, or with `filters` (e.g. { 'addresses.city': 'Austin' }). Relationships: addresses, logs, carts, notes, orders, shipments, subscriptions. GET /v1/customers/.

tools.name: cratejoy_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer by id, optionally with relationships (addresses, subscriptions, orders, shipments, notes...). GET /v1/customers/{customer_id}/.

tools.name: cratejoy_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions (id, status, autorenew, billing_name, start_date, end_date, skipped_date, is_test, product_billing_id). Filter by status and end-date range, or with `filters` (e.g. { 'customer.email__like': '%@example.com' }). Relationships: customer, billing, term, product, address, orders, shipments, logs. GET /v1/subscriptions/.

tools.name: cratejoy_get_subscription
tools.title: Get subscription
tools.description: One subscription by id, optionally with relationships (customer, billing, term, product, address, orders, shipments, logs). GET /v1/subscriptions/{sub_id}/.

tools.name: cratejoy_list_subscription_coupons
tools.title: List subscription coupons
tools.description: Coupons applied to a subscription's next renewal (coupon_id, code_used, enabled, num_renewals). GET /v1/subscriptions/{sub_id}/coupons/.

tools.name: cratejoy_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders (id, customer_id, placed_at, status, financial_status, fulfillment_status, is_renewal, is_gift, sub_total, total, total_shipping, total_tax). Amounts are in cents. Filter by payment status and placed-at range, or with `filters`. Relationships: customer, products, coupons, bill_address, ship_address, fulfillments, transactions, subscriptions. GET /v1/orders/.

tools.name: cratejoy_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by id, optionally with relationships (customer, products, coupons, addresses, fulfillments, transactions). GET /v1/orders/{order_id}/.

tools.name: cratejoy_list_shipments
tools.title: List shipments
tools.description: List shipments (id, customer_id, status, created_at, target_at, shipped_at, tracking_number, is_gift). Filter by status and creation range, or with `filters`. Relationships: customer, fulfillments, labels, ship_address, subscriptions. GET /v1/shipments/.

tools.name: cratejoy_get_shipment
tools.title: Get shipment
tools.description: One shipment by id, optionally with relationships (customer, fulfillments, labels, ship_address, subscriptions). GET /v1/shipments/{ship_id}/.

tools.name: cratejoy_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products (id, name, sku, slug, description, visible, listed, giftable, ship_option, ship_weight, has_subscribers). Filter by type or with `filters` (e.g. { 'visible': true }). Relationships: billing, instances, variants, subscription_types. GET /v1/products/.

tools.name: cratejoy_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One product by id, optionally with relationships. GET /v1/products/{prod_id}/.

tools.name: cratejoy_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: List payment transactions (id, created_at, result: authorized/captured/failed/refunded, total in cents, is_test, order). Filter by result and creation range, or with `filters`. GET /v1/transactions/.

tools.name: cratejoy_get_transaction
tools.title: Get transaction
tools.description: One payment transaction by id. GET /v1/transactions/{trans_id}/.

tools.name: cratejoy_skip_subscription_renewal
tools.title: Skip or unskip next renewal
tools.description: WRITE: skip a subscriber's next renewal (action 'skip') or undo the skip (action 'unskip'). Requires confirm=true. Repeating the same action changes nothing more. This changes a merchant customer's subscription in Cratejoy; it is not this server's own billing. PUT /v1/subscriptions/{sub_id}/skip/.

tools.name: cratejoy_cancel_customer_subscription
tools.title: Cancel a customer's subscription
tools.description: WRITE: cancel a subscriber's subscription in Cratejoy (the customer stops receiving boxes and renewals). This cancels the merchant's customer subscription, NOT this server's Pro plan (use the *_cancel_subscription tool for that). Requires confirm=true. A cancelled subscription can be restored with cratejoy_reactivate_subscription. PUT /v1/subscriptions/{sub_id}/cancel/.

tools.name: cratejoy_reactivate_subscription
tools.title: Reactivate a customer's subscription
tools.description: WRITE: reactivate a cancelled subscription so it renews and charges the customer again. Requires confirm=true. Reactivating an active subscription changes nothing more. PUT /v1/subscriptions/{sub_id}/reactivate/.

tools.name: cratejoy_retry_subscription_renewal
tools.title: Retry a failed renewal
tools.description: WRITE: retry the renewal of a PAST-DUE subscription whose renewal failed within the last 30 days. This charges the customer's saved payment method. Requires confirm=true. PUT /v1/subscriptions/{sub_id}/renew/.

tools.name: cratejoy_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: cratejoy_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Cratejoy tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: cratejoy_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Cratejoy (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: cratejoy_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Cratejoy Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run cratejoy_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

servers.name: IDX Broker
servers.description: Read IDX Broker leads, agents, listings and MLS data; create and update leads and notes.
examples: Which new leads signed up in the last 24 hours?
Show me everything lead 4512 viewed and searched for.
Add a note to lead 4512: asked for a showing on Saturday.
List my featured listings with their prices.

login.hint: Find it in IDX Broker under **Home → Access Control** (create a key if there is none). The key is 22 characters. Your account allows 300 (Lite) or 500 (Platinum) API accesses per key per hour, and every tool call uses at least one; a dedicated key keeps your other integrations from competing. Your key is used only to call the IDX Broker API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: idx_get_account_info
tools.title: Get account info
tools.description: The IDX Broker client account this access key belongs to: company and contact details and account settings (access keys and passwords are never returned). The reply also shows how many of the key's hourly API accesses are used. GET /clients/accountinfo.

tools.name: idx_get_account_type
tools.title: Get account type
tools.description: The IDX Broker plan of the account (Lite or Platinum). It sets the hourly API limit: 300 accesses per key on Lite, 500 on Platinum. GET /clients/accounttype.

tools.name: idx_list_agents
tools.title: List agents
tools.description: Agents on a multi-user IDX Broker account (id, name, office, contact details, category, language, login dates). Filter by one field or by a time window. GET /clients/agents.

tools.name: idx_list_offices
tools.title: List offices
tools.description: Offices on a multi-user IDX Broker account. Filter by one field or by a time window. GET /clients/offices.

tools.name: idx_list_leads
tools.title: List leads
tools.description: List the account's leads (website registrants) with contact details, status, agent owner, and last viewed listings and searches. A reply holds up to 500 leads; pass offset to page on and look for pagination information in the reply. Filter by a time window on signup, edit, login or activity date. Uses one of the key's hourly API accesses. GET /leads/lead.

tools.name: idx_get_lead
tools.title: Get lead
tools.description: One lead by id with its details, last 5 viewed listings and searches, and the total number of listings viewed. GET /leads/lead/{leadID}.

tools.name: idx_list_lead_notes
tools.title: List lead notes
tools.description: Notes on a lead, or one note when note_id is given. GET /leads/note/{leadID}[/{noteID}].

tools.name: idx_list_lead_searches
tools.title: List lead saved searches
tools.description: Saved property searches of a lead (or one search when search_id is given), with the results URL of each. GET /leads/search/{leadID}[/{searchID}].

tools.name: idx_list_lead_saved_properties
tools.title: List lead saved properties
tools.description: Properties a lead saved (or one when property_id is given). GET /leads/property/{leadID}[/{propertyID}].

tools.name: idx_get_lead_traffic
tools.title: Get lead traffic
tools.description: Website traffic history of one lead: date, page, referrer and IP of each visit (at most 5,000 rows per request; use interval/offset/limit to narrow it). GET /leads/leadtraffic/{leadID}.

tools.name: idx_list_featured_listings
tools.title: List featured listings
tools.description: The account's featured (active) listings with address, price, status, photos and agent. Only the account's own listings are returned, never general MLS data. GET /clients/featured.

tools.name: idx_list_sold_pending_listings
tools.title: List sold and pending listings
tools.description: The account's sold and pending listings, that is those removed from the MLS feed. GET /clients/soldpending.

tools.name: idx_list_off_market_listings
tools.title: List off-market listings
tools.description: The account's off-market listings. GET /clients/offmarket.

tools.name: idx_list_supplemental_listings
tools.title: List supplemental listings
tools.description: The account's supplemental (non-MLS) listings with a basic set of fields. GET /clients/supplemental.

tools.name: idx_list_saved_links
tools.title: List saved links
tools.description: Saved links (pre-built property search pages) of the account with id, name and URL. GET /clients/savedlinks.

tools.name: idx_get_saved_link_count
tools.title: Count properties of a saved link
tools.description: The total number of properties a saved link currently matches. GET /clients/savedlinks/{savedLinkID}/count.

tools.name: idx_list_widgets
tools.title: List widgets
tools.description: The JavaScript widgets on the account with id, name, URL and options. GET /clients/widgets.

tools.name: idx_get_widget
tools.title: Get widget
tools.description: One JavaScript widget with its settings. GET /clients/widgets/{id}.

tools.name: idx_list_system_links
tools.title: List system links
tools.description: The system pages of the account's site (search, featured, contact...) with name, id and URL, which can be linked to directly. GET /clients/systemlinks.

tools.name: idx_list_approved_mls
tools.title: List approved MLSs
tools.description: The MLSs approved for display on the account, with their IDX ids (such as a001) and names. Use the id in the other MLS tools. GET /mls/approvedmls.

tools.name: idx_get_mls_age
tools.title: Get MLS data age
tools.description: When an MLS feed was last downloaded and processed and when its images were last gathered (UTC). GET /mls/age/{idxID}.

tools.name: idx_list_mls_property_types
tools.title: List MLS property types
tools.description: Property types of an MLS with the IDX type id, the MLS name, the parent type and subtypes. GET /mls/propertytypes/{idxID}.

tools.name: idx_list_mls_search_fields
tools.title: List MLS search fields
tools.description: The fields of an MLS that can be searched under MLS rules: field name, display name and the property types they belong to. GET /mls/searchfields/{idxID}.

tools.name: idx_list_mls_locations
tools.title: List MLS cities, counties or postal codes
tools.description: Cities, counties or postal codes present in an MLS's data, with ids and a count of occurrences. Filter fields: cities = cityID, cityName, stateAbrv, mlsPtID; counties = countyID, countyName, stateAbrv, mlsPtID; postalcodes = id, stateAbrv, mlsPtID. GET /mls/{cities|counties|postalcodes}/{idxID}.

tools.name: idx_create_lead
tools.title: Create lead
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new lead in the IDX Broker account (and may trigger the account's own lead notifications). Needs a correctly formatted email with a valid MX record; IDX rejects bad addresses with a server error. Extra fields go in `fields` by their IDX name, as seen on a lead returned by idx_get_lead. Returns the new lead id. PUT /leads/lead.

tools.name: idx_add_lead_note
tools.title: Add lead note
tools.description: WRITE: adds a note to a lead (visible to the account's agents). Returns the new note id. PUT /leads/note/{leadID}.

tools.name: idx_update_lead
tools.title: Update lead
tools.description: WRITE: changes fields of an existing lead; the given values replace the stored ones. Only pass what must change. Field names are the IDX lead field names as seen on a lead returned by idx_get_lead (for example firstName, lastName, email, phone, status). POST /leads/lead/{leadID}.

tools.name: idx_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: idx_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the IDX Broker tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: idx_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on IDX Broker (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: idx_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's IDX Broker Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run idx_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Gooten
servers.description: Browse the Gooten catalog, stock, shipping and price quotes; search orders and cancel items.
examples: Which Gooten products are in the Drinkware category and what do they cost to ship to Canada?
Show my Gooten orders from last week that have not shipped yet.
What is the tracking number for Gooten order 13-f91acc87-bd23-40d?
Is the Bella 3001 tee out of stock for shipping to New York?

login.hint: Find both in the Gooten Admin under **Settings → API** (the billing key is behind the Show button). The billing key can place and bill orders for your account, so treat it like a password. Your keys are used only to call the Gooten API on your behalf; they are never shown to anyone.

tools.name: gooten_list_products
tools.title: List catalog products
tools.description: Browse the Gooten print-on-demand product catalog (public data): product id, name, categories, cheapest price and shipping, stock and deprecation flags. Filter by name text or category; use product_id with gooten_list_product_variants. Prices are in USD for the cheapest variant.

tools.name: gooten_list_product_variants
tools.title: List product variants (SKUs)
tools.description: The orderable variants (SKUs) of a catalog product for a destination country, with option values (size, color, ...) and Gooten's price for your account. SKUs differ by region (inch vs cm sizes). GET /productvariants.

tools.name: gooten_get_product_templates
tools.title: Get product templates
tools.description: Print templates for a SKU: how many images are needed, required pixel sizes/DPI, print spaces and layer coordinates, and preview assets. GET /producttemplates.

tools.name: gooten_check_stock
tools.title: Check stock for SKUs
tools.description: Which of the given SKUs are out of stock for a destination (country, state, postal code). Returns only the out-of-stock SKUs; an empty list means all are available. Unknown SKUs are an error. POST /variantstatus (a read: nothing is changed).

tools.name: gooten_get_shipping_estimate
tools.title: Get shipping estimate for a product
tools.description: Shipping price range and delivery time for a product to a country: whether expedited is possible and estimated shipping days, plus min/max price and producing country when Gooten returns them. GET /shippriceestimate.

tools.name: gooten_get_shipping_options
tools.title: Get shipping options for a cart
tools.description: Available shipping methods (Standard, Expedited, Overnight) with price and delivery days for a cart of SKUs to a destination. POST /shippingprices (a quote: nothing is ordered).

tools.name: gooten_get_price_estimate
tools.title: Get price estimate for an order
tools.description: Estimate the cost of an order before placing it: per-item partner price, customer price and tax, plus shipping total, for SKUs shipped to an address. POST /price (a quote: nothing is ordered or charged).

tools.name: gooten_validate_address
tools.title: Validate a shipping address
tools.description: Check a shipping address: validity, a score and Gooten's suggested corrected address. GET /addressvalidation.

tools.name: gooten_list_currencies
tools.title: List supported currencies
tools.description: Currencies Gooten can quote prices in (name, code, display format). GET /currencies.

tools.name: gooten_list_shipping_countries
tools.title: List shipping countries
tools.description: Countries Gooten ships to (code, name, whether supported, measurement system, default currency). By default only supported countries. GET /countries.

tools.name: gooten_list_print_ready_products
tools.title: List print-ready products
tools.description: Your print-ready products (PRPs: SKUs with artwork already attached) with their variant counts. Paging starts at 1. GET /prpproducts.

tools.name: gooten_list_print_ready_variants
tools.title: List print-ready variants
tools.description: Orderable SKUs of your print-ready products, optionally for one PRP product name (from gooten_list_print_ready_products). GET /prpvariants.

tools.name: gooten_search_orders
tools.title: Search orders
tools.description: Search your Gooten orders by free text (name, address, phone...), last name, email, postal code, creation date range or your own user id. Returns order id, items with status and tracking, totals and addresses. Needs the Partner Billing Key. GET /ordersearch.

tools.name: gooten_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by its Safe Order ID: items with status, tracking numbers and carriers, images, options, totals, shipping and billing addresses, discount and metadata. GET /orders.

tools.name: gooten_get_order_billing
tools.title: Get order billing
tools.description: Billing breakdown of an order: product cost per item, shipping, surcharge, tax, fees, discount and total. Takes the numeric Gooten order id (GootenId from gooten_get_order), not the Safe Order ID. Needs the Partner Billing Key. GET /orderbilling.

tools.name: gooten_set_order_status
tools.title: Set order status
tools.description: WRITE: change an order's status. Allowed targets: Cancelled (cancels the whole order), Hold (pause before production) and New (re-submit an order that was fixed, e.g. after an image or address issue; it then goes on to production and billing). Only orders in AccountingIssue, AddressIssue, HoldByCIImageIssue, ImageIssue, NeedsManualApproval, New, ReadyForAccounting, ReadyForImageDl or Pending can change; a held order cannot be released through the API (Gooten support must release it); otherwise Gooten refuses. POST /orderstatus.

tools.name: gooten_cancel_order_items
tools.title: Cancel order items
tools.description: WRITE: cancel specific items of an order (cannot be undone). Only items of orders in a pre-production status can be cancelled. Pass the numeric Gooten order id and the order item ids (OrderItemId from gooten_get_order). PUT /orderCancel.

tools.name: gooten_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: gooten_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Gooten tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: gooten_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Gooten (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: gooten_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Gooten Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run gooten_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Service Fusion

tools.name: servicefusion_get_me
tools.title: Get current user

tools.name: servicefusion_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (newest id order unless sorted). Filter by name, contact, address, city, postal code, phone, email, tags or last-serviced date. Add expand=contacts,locations,custom_fields to include them. GET /customers.

tools.name: servicefusion_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer by id, optionally with contacts, phones, emails, locations and custom fields. GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: servicefusion_list_customer_equipment
tools.title: List customer equipment
tools.description: List the equipment on file for a customer (type, make, model, serial number, warranty and install dates). GET /customers/{id}/equipment.

tools.name: servicefusion_get_customer_equipment
tools.title: Get customer equipment
tools.description: One piece of equipment of a customer. GET /customers/{customer_id}/equipment/{equipment_id}.

tools.name: servicefusion_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List jobs (work orders). Filter by status, number, PO or invoice number, customer, contact, address, phone, email, category, source and start/end/updated/closed dates. Add expand (techs_assigned, services, products, payments, invoices, visits, notes, ...) for detail. GET /jobs.

tools.name: servicefusion_get_job
tools.title: Get job
tools.description: One job by id, optionally with technicians, line items, labor, expenses, payments, invoices, notes, visits and more. GET /jobs/{id}.

tools.name: servicefusion_list_estimates
tools.title: List estimates
tools.description: List estimates (quotes). Filter by status, number, PO number, customer, contact, address, phone, email, category, source and start/end/requested dates. GET /estimates.

tools.name: servicefusion_get_estimate
tools.title: Get estimate
tools.description: One estimate by id, optionally with line items, technicians, notes, tags and more. GET /estimates/{id}.

tools.name: servicefusion_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices with number, total, paid flag, dates and the customer. The API has no invoice filters: sort and page instead (for example sort=-date). GET /invoices.

tools.name: servicefusion_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: One invoice by id. GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: servicefusion_list_calendar_tasks
tools.title: List calendar tasks
tools.description: List calendar tasks (appointments and to-dos on the schedule) for one day (start_date or end_date alone), a date range (both) and/or given users. A task is returned when it overlaps the range. GET /calendar-tasks.

tools.name: servicefusion_get_calendar_task
tools.title: Get calendar task
tools.description: One calendar task by id. GET /calendar-tasks/{id}.

tools.name: servicefusion_get_availability
tools.title: Get technician availability
tools.description: Open time slots for technicians and/or crews over up to 8 days (end_date at most 7 days after start_date). Filter by technician, crew, department, experience level and slot length. GET /availability.

tools.name: servicefusion_list_techs
tools.title: List technicians
tools.description: List technicians and sales reps (name, contact details, department, title, color, field-worker and sales-rep flags). GET /techs.

tools.name: servicefusion_get_tech
tools.title: Get technician
tools.description: One technician by id. GET /techs/{id}.

tools.name: servicefusion_list_tech_departments
tools.title: List technician departments
tools.description: The technician department names configured in the account (useful for availability filters). GET /techs/departments.

tools.name: servicefusion_list_crews
tools.title: List crews
tools.description: List crews (named groups of technicians), optionally with their members. GET /crews.

tools.name: servicefusion_get_crew
tools.title: Get crew
tools.description: One crew by id, optionally with its technicians. GET /crews/{id}.

tools.name: servicefusion_list_job_categories
tools.title: List job categories
tools.description: The job category names to use when creating or filtering jobs. GET /job-categories.

tools.name: servicefusion_list_job_statuses
tools.title: List job statuses
tools.description: The job status names (code, name, custom flag, category) to use when creating or filtering jobs. GET /job-statuses.

tools.name: servicefusion_list_payment_types
tools.title: List payment types
tools.description: The payment types configured in the account. GET /payment-types.

tools.name: servicefusion_list_sources
tools.title: List lead sources
tools.description: The lead/referral sources (short and long names) to use when creating or filtering jobs and estimates. GET /sources.

tools.name: servicefusion_create_estimate
tools.title: Create estimate

servers.name: Brightpearl
servers.description: Search Brightpearl orders, products, stock, contacts and payments; add notes, update order status.
examples: Which sales orders were placed yesterday and are still waiting to be shipped?
How much stock of SKU ABC-123 do we have in each warehouse?
Show the full details and notes of order 100182.
Find the customer with the email anna@example.com and list their latest orders.

fields.label: Data centre (first part of your Brightpearl address)

login.hint: In Brightpearl open **App Store → Private Apps → Add Private App** (an account administrator with the settings permission). Choose a **staff app** (the token acts as one staff member and respects that member's permissions) or a system app (account token). Copy the app's **reference** and **token**. The account code and data centre are in your Brightpearl address: euw1.brightpearlapp.com/**mycompany**.login is data centre euw1, account mycompany. Your credentials are used only to call the Brightpearl API on your behalf; they are never shown to anyone.

tools.name: brightpearl_get_account_configuration
tools.title: Get account configuration
tools.description: The Brightpearl account's configuration as key/value pairs: base currency, tax scheme, time zone, default and new-order status ids, nominal codes, weight unit, whether multiple warehouses are enabled. GET /integration-service/account-configuration.

tools.name: brightpearl_search_orders
tools.title: Search orders
tools.description: Search sales orders, sales credits, purchase orders and purchase credits. Every filter is optional and they combine (AND); each result row has orderId, orderTypeId, contactId, orderStatusId, orderStockStatusId, createdOn, updatedOn, customerRef, externalRef, warehouseId and more. Use brightpearl_get_orders for the full order. Order type ids: brightpearl_list_order_types; status ids: brightpearl_list_order_statuses. GET /order-service/order-search.

tools.name: brightpearl_get_orders
tools.title: Get orders
tools.description: Full details of one or more orders by id: type, status, payment/stock/shipping status, dates, currency, totals, assignment, customer/supplier, billing and delivery parties, and the order rows (product, quantity, price, tax). Up to 50 ids. GET /order-service/order/{ids}.

tools.name: brightpearl_get_order_notes
tools.title: Get order notes
tools.description: All notes on one order (text, author contact id, date, whether it is public on the customer portal, the order status at the time). GET /order-service/order/{id}/note.

tools.name: brightpearl_list_order_statuses
tools.title: List order statuses
tools.description: The account's order statuses (id, name, order type code SO/PO/SC/PC, sort order, disabled, visible to the customer, state such as draft). Use the ids to filter orders or to change an order's status. GET /order-service/order-status.

tools.name: brightpearl_list_order_types
tools.title: List order types
tools.description: The four order types with their ids and codes (1 SO sales order, 2 PO purchase order, 3 SC sales credit, 4 PC purchase credit), for the order search. GET /order-service/order-type.

tools.name: brightpearl_add_order_note
tools.title: Add order note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to an existing order. The note is private (staff only) unless is_public is true, which makes it visible on the customer portal. Returns the new note id. Notes cannot be removed with this server. POST /order-service/order/{id}/note.

tools.name: brightpearl_update_order_status
tools.title: Update order status
tools.description: WRITE: move an existing order to another status (ids from brightpearl_list_order_statuses; the new status must exist, be visible and belong to this order's type). Brightpearl adds an order note on success, and status changes can trigger the account's alerts and automations. Moving a sales order to the account's 'cancelled' status removes its reservations and coupons and is refused while goods-out notes or payments exist. PUT /order-service/order/{id}/status.

tools.name: brightpearl_search_products
tools.title: Search products
tools.description: Search the product catalogue. Every filter is optional and they combine (AND); each result row has productId, productName, SKU, barcode, EAN, UPC, ISBN, MPN, stockTracked, createdOn, updatedOn, brightpearlCategoryCode, productGroupId, brandId, productTypeId, productStatus, primarySupplierId. Use brightpearl_get_products for full details. GET /product-service/product-search.

tools.name: brightpearl_get_products
tools.title: Get products
tools.description: Full details of one or more products by id: identity (SKU, barcodes), brand, type, stock-tracking, weight and dimensions, tax code, sales-channel names/descriptions/categories, bundle composition, variations, per-warehouse reorder levels, supplier and status. Up to 50 ids. GET /product-service/product/{ids}.

tools.name: brightpearl_get_product_prices
tools.title: Get product prices
tools.description: Prices of products per price list: for each product and price list the currency, SKU and the quantity-break price map (e.g. {"1":"12","100":"11"}). Up to 50 product ids; optionally only some price lists (ids from brightpearl_list_price_lists). GET /product-service/product-price/{product ids}/price-list/{price list ids}.

tools.name: brightpearl_get_product_availability
tools.title: Get product stock availability
tools.description: Stock availability of stock-tracked products: for each product the totals across all warehouses (inStock, onHand, allocated, inTransit) and the same per warehouse; optionally per location, with on-order quantities. Up to 50 product ids. GET /warehouse-service/product-availability/{ids}.

tools.name: brightpearl_list_price_lists
tools.title: List price lists
tools.description: The price lists (id, name, code, currency, SELL or BUY, gross or net). Id 0 is the cost price list. GET /product-service/price-list.

tools.name: brightpearl_search_brands
tools.title: Search brands
tools.description: Search product brands by name; each row has brandId, brandName, createdOn, updatedOn. GET /product-service/brand-search.

tools.name: brightpearl_search_categories
tools.title: Search product categories
tools.description: Search Brightpearl product categories; each row has id, name, parentId, active, createdOn, updatedOn. GET /product-service/brightpearl-category-search.

tools.name: brightpearl_list_warehouses
tools.title: List warehouses
tools.description: The warehouses (id, name, type, address id, click-and-collect settings, weekly operating hours). Use the ids for stock and order filters. GET /warehouse-service/warehouse.

tools.name: brightpearl_list_shipping_methods
tools.title: List shipping methods
tools.description: The shipping methods (id, name, code, carrier, price breaks, countries). GET /warehouse-service/shipping-method.

tools.name: brightpearl_search_goods_out_notes
tools.title: Search goods-out notes (shipments)
tools.description: Search goods-out notes, the pick/pack/ship records of sales orders; each row has goodsOutNoteId, printed, picked, packed, shipped, shippedOn, orderId, shippingMethodId, warehouseId, createdOn, releaseDate, transfer. GET /warehouse-service/goods-note/goods-out-search.

tools.name: brightpearl_search_goods_in_notes
tools.title: Search goods-in notes (stock received)
tools.description: Search goods-in records (stock received against purchase orders, by batch and location); each row has purchaseOrderId, batchId, productId, locationId, price, currCode, receivedQuantity, onHand, createdDate, receivedDate, warehouseId. GET /warehouse-service/goods-in-search.

tools.name: brightpearl_search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: Search contacts (customers, suppliers and staff). Every filter is optional and they combine (AND); each result row has contactId, primaryEmail, firstName, lastName, companyName, isSupplier, isStaff, isCustomer, createdOn, updatedOn, lastOrderedOn and more. Use brightpearl_get_contacts for the full record. GET /contact-service/contact-search.

tools.name: brightpearl_get_contacts
tools.title: Get contacts
tools.description: Full records of one or more contacts by id: name, emails, phones, status, supplier/staff flags, financial details (price list, tax code, credit limit and terms), assignment, organisation, tags, dates; optionally custom fields and the full postal addresses. Up to 50 ids. GET /contact-service/contact/{ids}.

tools.name: brightpearl_add_contact_note
tools.title: Add contact note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a contact's timeline (for example a record of correspondence). The note is private (staff only) unless is_public is true, which makes it visible on the customer portal. Returns the new note id. Notes cannot be removed with this server. POST /contact-service/contact/{id}/note.

tools.name: brightpearl_search_customer_payments
tools.title: Search customer payments
tools.description: Search payments received against sales orders; each row has paymentId, transactionRef, paymentMethodCode, paymentType, orderId, currencyCode, amountAuthorized, amountPaid, paymentDate, createdOn, journalId. GET /accounting-service/customer-payment-search.

tools.name: brightpearl_list_payment_methods
tools.title: List payment methods
tools.description: The payment methods (name, code, active, bank accounts with currency and nominal code). GET /accounting-service/payment-method.

tools.name: brightpearl_list_tax_codes

servers.name: CharlieHR
servers.description: Read CharlieHR team members, leave, allowances, offices, teams and salaries; add team member notes.
examples: Who is off on leave next week?
How much holiday allowance does each team member have left this year?
Show me the team members in the London office and who their managers are.
Add the employee number ABC123 as a note on Jane Doe's profile.

login.hint: In Charlie open **Company → Integrations → API keys** (a Super Admin or Admin) and generate a key pair; the secret is shown only once. The keys act for your whole company. Your keys are used only to call the CharlieHR API on your behalf; they are never shown to anyone.

tools.name: charliehr_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: The Charlie company the API keys belong to: id, name, subdomain and logo. GET /company.

tools.name: charliehr_list_offices
tools.title: List offices
tools.description: List the company's offices: id, name, whether it is the head office, address, timezone, phone and email. GET /offices.

tools.name: charliehr_get_office
tools.title: Get office
tools.description: One office by id. GET /offices/{id}.

tools.name: charliehr_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List the company's teams with the ids of their team members. GET /teams.

tools.name: charliehr_get_team
tools.title: Get team
tools.description: One team by id, with the ids of its team members. GET /teams/{id}.

tools.name: charliehr_list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List the company's team members (employees): name, work and personal email, phone, address, office, manager, teams, job title, start date, employment status and leaving date. Sensitive fields included: date_of_birth, gender, married, personal email, phone and home address. National Insurance numbers, payroll id, starter declaration and student-loan flags are never returned. GET /team_members.

tools.name: charliehr_get_team_member
tools.title: Get team member
tools.description: One team member by id with the full profile (contact details, address, office, manager, teams, dates, employment status, job title, notes). Sensitive fields included: date_of_birth, gender, married, personal email, phone, home address and notes. National Insurance numbers (also inside notes), payroll id, starter declaration and student-loan flags are never returned. GET /team_members/{id}.

tools.name: charliehr_get_team_member_working_location
tools.title: Get a team member's working location
tools.description: Where one team member works on a date (custom overrides win over the default assignment). Defaults to today. GET /team_members/{id}/working_location.

tools.name: charliehr_get_team_member_working_weeks
tools.title: Get a team member's working weeks
tools.description: The working-week segments of one team member (which days are full_day/morning/afternoon, weekly hours, from/to dates), company defaults and custom overrides. Not paginated. GET /team_members/{id}/working_weeks.

tools.name: charliehr_list_working_locations
tools.title: List working locations
tools.description: List the active working locations (the catalog). With a date, instead returns where each active team member works on that date. GET /working_locations.

tools.name: charliehr_list_leave_requests
tools.title: List leave requests
tools.description: List leave requests of the whole company (id, team member, approver, status, request type, start/end date, amount and units, duration, details). Optionally only those in a date window. GET /leave_requests.

tools.name: charliehr_get_leave_request
tools.title: Get leave request
tools.description: One leave request by id. GET /leave_requests/{id}.

tools.name: charliehr_list_team_member_leave_requests
tools.title: List a team member's leave requests
tools.description: The leave requests of one team member, optionally only those in a date window. GET /team_members/{id}/leave_requests.

tools.name: charliehr_list_leave_allowances
tools.title: List leave allowances
tools.description: The current holiday allowance of every team member: allowance, used and remaining, in days and hours, with the leave period. GET /leave_allowances.

tools.name: charliehr_get_team_member_leave_allowance
tools.title: Get a team member's leave allowance
tools.description: The current holiday allowance of one team member (allowance, used, remaining, in days and hours, with the period). GET /team_members/{id}/leave_allowance.

tools.name: charliehr_list_allowance_adjustments
tools.title: List a team member's allowance adjustments
tools.description: All holiday allowance adjustments of one team member across every leave period (description, days/hours, carryover flag, creator, period). GET /team_members/{id}/allowance_adjustments.

tools.name: charliehr_list_non_holiday_leave_allowances
tools.title: List a team member's non-holiday leave allowances
tools.description: Days taken and limit for each non-holiday leave type (sick, compassionate...) of one team member. GET /team_members/{id}/non_holiday_leave_allowances.

tools.name: charliehr_list_leave_types
tools.title: List leave types
tools.description: The enabled leave types (Holiday, Sick...): id, name, deductible, default, auto-approved, sensitive. GET /leave_types.

tools.name: charliehr_get_leave_type
tools.title: Get leave type
tools.description: One leave type by id. GET /leave_types/{id}.

tools.name: charliehr_list_company_holidays
tools.title: List company holidays
tools.description: The company's holidays (bank holidays and closures): name, start/end date, duration, deductible. Optionally only those in a date window. GET /company_holidays.

tools.name: charliehr_list_restricted_dates
tools.title: List restricted dates
tools.description: The dates on which leave is restricted (e.g. a year-end freeze): name, start/end date, duration. Optionally only those in a date window. GET /restricted_dates.

tools.name: charliehr_list_salaries
tools.title: List salaries
tools.description: SENSITIVE: the salary records of all team members (job title, pay rate, pay period, frequency, currency, effective date, employment type). Needs API keys with access to salary data. GET /salaries.

tools.name: charliehr_list_team_member_salaries
tools.title: List a team member's salaries
tools.description: SENSITIVE: the salary history of one team member (job title, pay rate, currency, effective date). GET /team_members/{id}/salaries.

tools.name: charliehr_list_team_member_note_types
tools.title: List team member note types
tools.description: The custom note types (fields such as Employee No. or Laptop Serial Number) with who may see them. GET /team_member_note_types.

tools.name: charliehr_get_team_member_note_type
tools.title: Get team member note type

tools.name: teamleader_list_companies
tools.title: List companies

tools.name: teamleader_list_deals
tools.title: List deals
tools.description: List or search deals (sales opportunities). Filter by customer, phase, pipeline, status, responsible user, expected closing date or last update. Teamleader: deals.list.

tools.name: teamleader_get_deal

tools.name: teamleader_list_deal_phases

tools.name: teamleader_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List the notes on one contact, company, deal, invoice, quotation, project and more, with their text and date. Teamleader: notes.list.

tools.name: teamleader_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a new contact (person) in Teamleader. Only last_name is required. Returns the new contact's id. Teamleader: contacts.add.

tools.name: teamleader_create_company
tools.title: Create a company
tools.description: WRITE: create a new company in Teamleader. Only name is required. Returns the new company's id. Teamleader: companies.add.

tools.name: teamleader_create_deal
tools.title: Create a deal
tools.description: WRITE: create a new deal for an existing contact or company. Requires the customer and a title; optionally a phase (see teamleader_list_deal_phases), value, probability and expected closing date. Returns the new deal's id. Teamleader: deals.create.

tools.name: teamleader_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: WRITE: create a task (to-do). Requires a title, a due date and a work type id (see teamleader_list_work_types). Optionally assign it to a user or team and link a customer, deal, project or ticket. Returns the new task's id. Teamleader: tasks.create.

tools.name: teamleader_add_note
tools.title: Add a note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a contact, company, deal, invoice, quotation, project and more, e.g. a call summary. Optionally notify colleagues. Returns the new note's id. Teamleader: notes.create.

tools.name: teamleader_create_event
tools.title: Create a calendar event
tools.description: WRITE: put a meeting or call on the Teamleader calendar. Requires a title, an activity type id (see teamleader_list_activity_types), a start and an end. Attendees are firm users only; link the customer or deal with links. Returns the new event's id. Teamleader: events.create.

tools.name: teamleader_complete_task
tools.title: Complete a task
tools.description: WRITE: mark a task (to-do) as complete. It can be reopened in Teamleader. Teamleader: tasks.complete.

tools.name: teamleader_add_time_tracking
tools.title: Add tracked time
tools.description: WRITE: record time spent, e.g. 90 minutes of development for a company. Give started_at plus duration_minutes or ended_at; optionally a work type, a description, the subject (customer, ticket, task, ...) and whether it is invoiceable. Teamleader splits an entry that passes midnight. Returns the new entry's id. Teamleader: timeTracking.add.

tools.name: teamleader_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: teamleader_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Teamleader Focus tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: teamleader_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Teamleader Focus (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: teamleader_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Teamleader Focus Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run teamleader_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.
