servers.name: Appointo
servers.description: Read Appointo bookings, availability and subscriptions; create, reschedule and cancel bookings.

login.hint: Find it in the Appointo app under **Plans & Settings → API access** (API access is available on paid Appointo plans). Your token is used only to call the Appointo API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: appointo_list_products
tools.title: List bookable products
tools.description: List the Shopify products that are set up as bookable in Appointo: name, appointment type, whether the widget is shown, and each product's appointments (the bookable variants/services with price, currency and id). Use an appointment id for availability and bookings. GET /products.

tools.name: appointo_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments (bookable services)
tools.description: List appointments, i.e. the bookable services/variants, with name, price, currency and configuration. Filter by product or fetch one by id. These are the services customers book, not the bookings themselves (use appointo_list_bookings for those). GET /appointments.

tools.name: appointo_get_availability
tools.title: Get appointment availability
tools.description: The free time slots of one appointment (bookable service) from start_date, optionally to end_date. Use it before creating or rescheduling a booking. GET /appointments/{appointment_id}/calendar_availability.

tools.name: appointo_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings with time, product, duration, quantity, price and the customers (name, email, phone, address). Filter upcoming/past or search; pass booking_id for one booking. The customers' cancel/reschedule link ids are never returned. GET /bookings.

tools.name: appointo_list_cancelled_bookings
tools.title: List cancelled bookings
tools.description: List cancelled bookings, same shape as appointo_list_bookings. GET /bookings/cancelled_bookings.

tools.name: appointo_list_subscription_contracts
tools.title: List subscription contracts
tools.description: List the recurring booking subscription contracts (customers who subscribed to repeat appointments). Search by product, variant, order number or customer name. The API documents no paging for this list. GET /appointment_subscriptions.

tools.name: appointo_create_booking
tools.title: Create booking
tools.description: WRITE: create a booking for a customer on an appointment (bookable service) at a time slot. This is a real booking: Appointo may email the customer a confirmation and reserve the slot; the booking can later be cancelled with appointo_cancel_booking. Check appointo_get_availability first. tools.name: appointo_reschedule_booking

tools.name: appointo_cancel_booking
tools.title: Cancel booking
tools.description: WRITE: cancel a booking, or only some of its customers. The slot is freed and Appointo may notify the customers; whether a Shopify order is refunded is not controlled by this call. Cannot be undone through this server (create a new booking instead). The docs cap this at 100 requests per day. PUT /bookings/cancel.

tools.name: appointo_update_booking_buffers
tools.title: Update booking buffer times
tools.description: WRITE: set the start and/or end buffer time (minutes blocked before/after) of one booking. At least one value is required. The docs cap this at 100 requests per day. PUT /bookings/{booking_id}.

tools.name: appointo_usage_status

Does not count against the meter.

tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Appointo (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: appointo_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Appointo Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run appointo_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Cyberimpact
servers.description: Read Cyberimpact members, groups and mailing results; add members, send opt-ins, create mailings.

login.hint: In Cyberimpact open **Developers → API tokens** and create a token (a long text with two dots in it). It acts with your account's rights and can be revoked there at any time. Your token is used only to call the Cyberimpact API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone. This is a token for integrations, not your Cyberimpact password.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Check the connection and show which Cyberimpact account the API token belongs to (username, email, account name). GET /ping.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List subscribed contacts (members) with name, email, language, consent type, mailing counts and custom fields. status: active (in at least one group, default), orphans (in no group) or all. Filter by the date a member joined or was last updated. Bounced and unsubscribed members have their own tools. GET /members.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_member
tools.title: Get member
tools.description: One member by email address or id: all attributes, consent type, mailings received/opened/clicked and custom fields (keyed by custom field id; see cyberimpact_list_custom_fields). GET /members/{key}.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_member_groups
tools.title: Get member's groups
tools.description: The groups a member belongs to (id, title, public/private, dynamic). GET /members/{key}/groups.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_member_mailings
tools.title: Get member's mailings
tools.description: The mailings a member received (use it to see what a contact was sent and when). GET /members/{key}/mailings.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_member_consent
tools.title: Get member consent
tools.description: A member's consent record: consent type, relation type, consent date, expiration and proof (for CASL compliance checks). GET /members/{key}/consent.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_bounced_members
tools.title: List bounced members
tools.description: Members whose last mailing hard-bounced (invalid addresses to clean up), with the bounce date. GET /members/bounced.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_unsubscribed_members
tools.title: List unsubscribed members
tools.description: Members who unsubscribed, with the unsubscribe date. These contacts must not be mailed again. GET /members/unsubscribed.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: The account's custom member fields (id, name, type text/date/integer/decimal). Member customFields are keyed by these ids. GET /customfields.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List the account's groups (mailing lists) with member and mailing counts, public/private and dynamic flags. Use the ids to target mailings and opt-ins. GET /groups.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_group
tools.title: Get group
tools.description: One group by id with its member count, mailing count and flags. GET /groups/{id}.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_group_members
tools.title: List group members
tools.description: The members of one group, with the same member filters as cyberimpact_list_members. GET /groups/{id}/members.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_mailings
tools.title: List mailings
tools.description: List mailings by state: sent (default, archived ones excluded), scheduled (queued to go out) or archived. Each has id, subject, language, send/schedule date, recipient count and sender. Optionally only mailings sent to one group. GET /mailings/{sent|scheduled|archived}.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_mailing
tools.title: Get mailing
tools.description: One mailing by id with its results: sent/delivered/stopped counts, views, clicks, delivery/click/view rates, per-link clicks, recipient groups, sender and body (HTML/text, cut at 20 000 characters). GET /mailings/{id}.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_mailing_recipients
tools.title: List mailing recipients
tools.description: Who received a mailing and what happened: kind = all, delivered, stopped, hard_bounced, soft_bounced, unsubscribed, opened or clicked. Optionally only recipients from one group. GET /mailings/{id}/recipients[/{kind}].

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List the account's email templates (id, title, created/updated). GET /templates.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_template
tools.title: Get template
tools.description: One template by id with its HTML and text body (cut at 20 000 characters). GET /templates/{id}.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_batch
tools.title: Get batch
tools.description: Status of a bulk batch job (NEW, PROCESSING or COMPLETED) and its result. Set show_error_details to list the per-member errors. GET /batches/{id}.

tools.name: cyberimpact_add_member
tools.title: Add member
tools.description: WRITE: add a contact as a subscribed member WITHOUT a confirmation email (implied consent) and put it in the given groups; the contact can then be mailed. Only use it for people who really gave their consent (CASL); to ask the person to confirm first use cyberimpact_send_optin. A member that already exists is rejected by the API. Throttled by Cyberimpact; for many contacts use the app's import. POST /members.

tools.name: cyberimpact_update_member
tools.title: Update member
tools.description: WRITE: change only the given attributes of a member (other attributes stay as they are). The old values of the changed fields are overwritten and not recoverable through the API. Set new_email to change the address. PATCH /members/{key}.

tools.name: cyberimpact_add_member_to_groups
tools.title: Add member to groups
tools.description: WRITE: add an existing member to more groups (existing group memberships are kept). Being in a group makes the member a recipient of mailings sent to it. Returns the member's groups after the update. POST /members/{key}/groups.

tools.name: cyberimpact_send_optin
tools.title: Send opt-in email
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS AN EMAIL to the given address: an opt-in confirmation request. The person is added to the groups only after they confirm (the member is created if it does not exist). Use this instead of cyberimpact_add_member when you do not have the person's consent yet. Only call it after the user has approved sending to this address, and set confirm_send to true. Throttled by Cyberimpact. POST /members/optins.

tools.name: cyberimpact_create_group
tools.title: Create group
tools.description: WRITE: create a new, empty group (mailing list). A public group can be offered on subscription forms; a private one is internal. Groups cannot be deleted through this server. POST /groups.

tools.name: cyberimpact_create_template
tools.title: Create template
tools.description: WRITE: create a new email template from HTML and/or text. It is only saved in the account; nothing is sent. POST /templates.

tools.name: cyberimpact_create_mailing
tools.title: Schedule mailing
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS EMAIL TO CUSTOMERS: create a mailing scheduled to be sent at send_at to every member of the chosen groups. It goes out for real unless it is cancelled in the Cyberimpact app before send_at. Only call it after the user has approved the subject, body, sender and groups, and set confirm_send to true. mail_from must be a validated sender address of the account. A mailing cannot be deleted through this server. POST /mailings.

tools.name: loox_list_product_reviews

tools.name: loox_get_product_review

tools.description: One product review by id, any moderation status (published, unpublished or pending), with full reviewer details. Merchant data: includes the reviewer's name, email, Shopify customer id and order id. GET /api/v1/store/{id}/product-reviews/{reviewId}.

tools.name: loox_list_store_reviews

tools.name: loox_get_store_review
tools.title: Get store review
tools.description: One store-level review by id, any moderation status, with full reviewer details. Merchant data: includes the reviewer's name, email, Shopify customer id and order id. GET /api/v1/store/{id}/store-reviews/{reviewId}.

tools.name: loox_get_product_reviews_summary

tools.description: Overall rating of the store's published product reviews: total count, average stars and how many reviews per star (1-5). Public Storefront API, published reviews only. GET /storefront/v1/store/{id}/product-reviews/bottomline.

tools.name: loox_get_product_rating

servers.name: Method CRM
servers.description: Query Method CRM customers, leads, activities and invoices; create and update records.

login.hint: Only a Method **Admin** can create one: sign in to Method, click the blue circle icon (top right) → **Integrations** → **API** → **New**, name it and copy the key at once (it is shown only once). The key acts with that user's permissions and cannot be read-only, so a dedicated user makes its activity easy to track. It is used only to call the Method API on your behalf and is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: method_get_account
tools.title: Get API key owner
tools.description: Who the API key acts as: the Method user behind it (id and name; use the id as an assignee). Also a cheap check that the key works. GET /api/v1/me.

tools.name: method_list_tables
tools.title: List tables
tools.description: List every table on this Method account (standard QuickBooks/Xero/Method tables and custom ones) with its source and whether it can be created, updated or deleted. Tables differ per account: call this before querying a table you are unsure of. GET /api/v1/tables.

tools.name: method_get_table_fields
tools.title: Get table fields
tools.description: The exact field names of a table with type, whether required, creatable and mutable, and for dropdowns the table they reference. Use it to pick `select` fields and to name fields in create/update calls (names are case-sensitive and wrong ones are silently ignored). GET /api/v1/tables/{table}/fields.

tools.name: method_query_records
tools.title: Query records
tools.description: Query any table (Customer, Contacts, Activity, Invoice, Estimate, Item, Users, custom tables ...). Always pass `select`. `filter` uses OData-style syntax: strings in single quotes, dates as '2026-05-26T00:00:00Z' with Z or an offset, operators eq ne lt gt le ge and or not, functions contains(Name,'x') startswith() endswith(); e.g. "BalanceRemaining gt 0 and DueDate lt '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'". `apply` runs server-side aggregation instead of listing rows, e.g. "aggregate(BalanceRemaining with sum as Outstanding)" or "groupby((Customer), aggregate(Amount with sum as Total))". Default order is RecordID ascending (stable paging); page with next_skip. GET /api/v1/tables/{table}.

tools.name: method_count_records
tools.title: Count records
tools.description: How many records a table has, optionally matching a filter (same filter syntax as method_query_records). Cheap: call it before paging through a big table. GET /api/v1/tables/{table}/count.

tools.name: method_get_record
tools.title: Get record
tools.description: One record by RecordID from any table. Pass `select` to limit the columns; `expand` names a related CHILD table whose rows are embedded (e.g. InvoiceLine on Invoice; at most 50 rows); a parent such as a contact's Entity is not expanded: read it with its own RecordID (Entity_RecordID). GET /api/v1/tables/{table}/{recordId}.

tools.name: method_search_customers
tools.title: Search customers and leads
tools.description: Find customers and leads (the Customer table: Customers & Leads in Method) by text in the name or email, by lead/customer type, or list them all. Returns RecordID, name, email, phone, lead flag and status; override `select` for other fields (see method_get_table_fields with table Customer). Page with next_skip. GET /api/v1/tables/Customer.

tools.name: method_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people), optionally those of one customer/lead entity (entity_id = the Customer's RecordID) or matching text in name/email/phone. Returns RecordID, name, email, phone, the entity link and active flag. Use a Contact's RecordID (not the Customer's) when linking activities. GET /api/v1/tables/Contacts.

tools.name: method_list_activities
tools.title: List activities
tools.description: List activities (calls, emails, to-dos, notes), newest first. Filter by the entity they belong to, the assigned user or a due-date window. The note text is in Comments. Override `select` for other fields (method_get_table_fields with table Activity). GET /api/v1/tables/Activity.

tools.name: method_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices, newest first, optionally only unpaid ones (BalanceRemaining > 0), one customer's (customer_id = Customer RecordID) or created since a time. Returns reference number, customer, dates, amount and balance; override `select` for other fields. For totals use method_query_records with `apply`. GET /api/v1/tables/Invoice.

tools.name: method_list_files
tools.title: List files on a record
tools.description: List the files attached to a record (name, size, who added it, id). Use the id with method_get_file_url. GET /api/v1/files.

tools.name: method_get_file_url
tools.title: Get file download link
tools.description: A temporary download link (valid 20 minutes) for an attached file, by the file id from method_list_files. The link works without the API key: share it only with someone allowed to see the file. GET /api/v1/files/{id}/url.

tools.name: method_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer or lead
tools.description: WRITE: creates a record in Method's Customer table. is_lead true = a Customer Lead (does not sync to the accounting system); is_lead false = a full customer, which Method syncs to QuickBooks/Xero (it appears there too). Method also creates the primary Contact; its RecordID is returned as contact_id when it could be found (use it, not the customer id, to link activities). Name is required (for a person with no company use "First Last"). `extra_fields` sets other fields by their exact names (see method_get_table_fields, table Customer). Not idempotent: calling twice creates two records, so search first (method_search_customers). POST /api/v1/tables/Customer.

tools.name: method_create_activity
tools.title: Log an activity
tools.description: WRITE: logs an activity (call, email, to-do, note) on a customer/lead. entity_id is the Customer RecordID; contact_id is the Contact RecordID (not the Customer's; method_list_contacts finds it). The text goes in Comments. Prefer activity_type_id (read it from an existing activity of that type) over the caption activity_type: a caption that matches zero or several options is silently dropped. Method requires an assignee on standard accounts. The reply re-reads the activity so you can check the links were stored (field names are account-specific; method_get_table_fields with table Activity shows them). It does not email anyone. Not idempotent. POST /api/v1/tables/Activity.

tools.name: method_create_record
tools.title: Create a record
tools.description: WRITE: creates a record in any table that allows it (method_list_tables shows canCreate), e.g. Estimate, Invoice, Item, Vendor. For customers/leads and activities use the dedicated tools. Field names are case-sensitive and a wrong one is silently ignored: read them with method_get_table_fields first, and send dropdown links as their `_RecordID` integer. Creating accounting records (Invoice, Estimate, Customer ...) makes Method sync them to QuickBooks/Xero. Child lines (InvoiceLine ...) are not supported here. Not idempotent. Returns the new RecordID. POST /api/v1/tables/{table}.

tools.name: method_update_record
tools.title: Update a record
tools.description: WRITE: changes fields on one record (PATCH: only the fields you pass change). Field names are case-sensitive and Method silently ignores wrong or read-only names, so the reply re-reads the record and shows the stored values of the fields you sent: check them. Linked fields are changed through their `_RecordID` integer field. Updating accounting records (Customer, Invoice ...) makes Method sync the change to QuickBooks/Xero; setting IsLeadStatusOnly to false converts a lead into a synced customer. There is no delete tool. PATCH /api/v1/tables/{table}/{recordId}.

tools.name: method_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: method_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Method CRM tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: method_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Method CRM (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: method_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Method CRM Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run method_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

Show every unpaid invoice older than 30 days with the customer's email.
Log a call note on Acme Landscaping: asked for a quote on spring cleanup.
Create a lead for Jane Smith, jane@example.com, assigned to me.

servers.name: noCRM.io
servers.description: Read noCRM.io leads, pipeline steps, comments and client folders; create, update and assign leads.

login.hint: In noCRM.io open the **Admin** section, **Integrations → API**, and generate a key (admins only). The account name is the first part of your address: `acme` for `https://acme.nocrm.io`. tools.name: nocrm_list_leads
tools.title: List leads
tools.description: List or search sales leads (noCRM.io's opportunities), newest first by default, with title, pipeline step, status, amount, probability, tags, owner, next reminder and the contact details in the description. Filter by status, step (names or ids, not mixed), owner, tags, email, starred or a date range. Unassigned leads are excluded unless include_unassigned is true. GET /leads.

tools.name: nocrm_list_unassigned_leads
tools.title: List unassigned leads
tools.description: Leads that have no owner yet (for example web-form or API leads waiting to be handed to a salesperson). GET /leads/unassigned.

tools.name: nocrm_get_lead
tools.title: Get lead
tools.description: One lead by id: title, step, status, amount, probability, tags, owner, client folder, team, reminder, and the full description with the contact's details. GET /leads/{id}.

tools.name: nocrm_list_lead_comments
tools.title: List lead comments
tools.description: The comments (notes, logged calls/meetings/emails) on a lead, newest first by default. GET /leads/{id}/comments.

tools.name: nocrm_list_lead_history
tools.title: List lead history
tools.description: The timeline of a lead: creation, assignments, step and status changes, amount changes, comments and emails sent, with who did it and when. Filter by date range, action type or user. GET /leads/{id}/action_histories.

tools.name: nocrm_get_lead_duplicates
tools.title: Find duplicate leads
tools.description: Leads that noCRM.io detects as possible duplicates of this lead (same email or key field). GET /leads/{id}/duplicates.

tools.name: nocrm_list_lead_attachments
tools.title: List lead attachments
tools.description: File attachments on a lead (names, ids, sizes, links). GET /leads/{id}/attachments.

tools.name: nocrm_list_follow_ups
tools.title: List post-sales follow-ups
tools.description: Post-sales processes (task checklists created from a template) of one lead OR of one user. Needs lead_id or user_id. Post-sales is a higher-edition feature (HTTP 403 otherwise). GET /follow_ups.

tools.name: nocrm_list_pipelines
tools.title: List pipelines
tools.description: The sales pipelines of the account (one unless the multiple-pipelines feature is on). GET /pipelines.

tools.name: nocrm_list_steps
tools.title: List pipeline steps
tools.description: The steps (stages) of the sales pipeline in order, with ids, positions and their pipeline. Use the ids or names when filtering leads or moving a lead. GET /steps.

tools.name: nocrm_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: The users (salespeople) of the account with name, email, phone, role (admin or not) and whether they are active or deactivated. Deleted users are included, flagged is_disabled. GET /users.

tools.name: nocrm_get_user

tools.name: nocrm_list_teams
tools.title: List teams

tools.name: nocrm_list_client_folders
tools.title: List client folders
tools.description: Client folders (accounts that group several leads), ordered by name by default. GET /clients.

tools.name: nocrm_get_client_folder
tools.title: Get client folder
tools.description: One client folder by id, with its contact fields and owner. GET /clients/{id}.

tools.name: nocrm_list_activities
tools.title: List activity types
tools.description: The activity types (call, email, meeting and their outcomes) that can be set on a comment or reminder. GET /activities.

tools.name: nocrm_list_predefined_tags
tools.title: List predefined tags
tools.description: The account's predefined tags (admin keys only; an HTTP 401 unauthorized_non_admin means the key lacks rights). GET /predefined_tags.

tools.name: nocrm_list_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: The custom fields defined for leads or client folders. GET /fields.

tools.name: nocrm_create_lead

The description holds the contact's details, one 'Label: value' per line (for example 'Firstname: Ada', 'Email: ada@example.com', 'Phone: ...'); noCRM.io reads those lines. Without user_id the lead is created unassigned; a pipeline step can only be set when the lead is assigned. Not idempotent: calling twice creates two leads. POST /leads.

tools.name: nocrm_update_lead
tools.title: Update lead
tools.description: WRITE: change a lead: title, status (won, lost, cancelled, todo or standby), pipeline step, amount, probability, star, estimated closing date, tags (replaces the lead's tag list), or append text to the description (existing description text is never replaced). Moving to standby needs remind_date. Only the fields you pass change. PUT /leads/{id}.

tools.name: nocrm_assign_lead
tools.title: Assign lead
tools.description: WRITE: assign a lead to a user (id or email), replacing its current owner. The owner may get a notification from noCRM.io. POST /leads/{id}/assign.

tools.name: nocrm_add_lead_comment
tools.title: Add lead comment
tools.description: WRITE: add a comment (an internal note) to a lead, optionally typed as an activity such as a call or meeting. It is visible to the lead's team in noCRM.io and sends nothing to the customer. Not idempotent. POST /leads/{id}/comments.

tools.name: nocrm_create_client_folder
tools.title: Create client folder
tools.description: WRITE: create a client folder (an account that groups leads). Not idempotent. POST /clients.

tools.name: nocrm_add_lead_to_client_folder
tools.title: Add lead to client folder
tools.description: WRITE: file a lead under a client folder. POST /leads/{id}/add_to_client.

servers.name: PHP Point of Sale
servers.description: Read PHP Point of Sale items, sales, customers and 138 reports; manage customers, items, expenses.

fields.label: PHP Point of Sale API key

login.hint: The store name is the part before **.phppointofsale.com** in your store address. Create the key in the POS under **Store Config → API Settings → Add API Key**: choose **Read** for questions only, **Read/Write** to let the AI create or change customers, items and expenses. An employee scope limits the key to what that employee may do. Copy the key when it is shown (it appears only once). Your key is used only to call your store's API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: phppos_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the store's locations (shops/warehouses) with name, address, phone, email, time zone and default tax rates, plus each location's registers (id and name). Use the location ids to filter sales, expenses, customers and reports. Payment-processor credentials and device settings are never returned. GET /locations.

tools.name: phppos_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: List or search inventory items with name, item number, category, supplier, prices and reorder level. Search by text, or by one field (name, item_number, product_id, supplier, tag_name...). GET /items.

tools.name: phppos_get_item
tools.title: Get item
tools.description: One inventory item by id: prices, tax settings, category, supplier, tags, attributes, variations, tier pricing and per-location settings. GET /items/{id}.

tools.name: phppos_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List item categories with their ids. Use the ids to filter items or to file a new item. GET /categories.

tools.name: phppos_list_item_kits
tools.title: List item kits
tools.description: List item kits (bundles of items sold together) with their prices. GET /item_kits.

tools.name: phppos_list_sales
tools.title: List sales
tools.description: List or search completed sales, by date range, customer (id or email) or location. verbosity: minimal (headline fields), medium (adds customer, totals, profit, location - the default here) or full (every line item, payment and tax). Suspended sales (layaways, estimates) are fetched with suspended_type. GET /sales.

tools.name: phppos_get_sale
tools.title: Get sale
tools.description: One sale by id with line items, payments, taxes, customer and employee (verbosity full by default). GET /sales/{id}.

tools.name: phppos_list_receivings
tools.title: List receivings
tools.description: List receivings (stock received from suppliers, purchase orders, transfers) with supplier, totals and items, by date range. GET /receivings.

tools.name: phppos_get_receiving
tools.title: Get receiving
tools.description: One receiving by id: supplier, items, quantities, costs and payments. GET /receivings/{id}.

tools.name: phppos_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List or search customers with contact details, tier, store-account balance, credit limit and loyalty points. Search by text or by one field (email, phone_number, first_name, last_name, account_number). GET /customers.

tools.name: phppos_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer by person id: contact details, tier, tax settings, balance, credit limit, points, notes and custom fields. GET /customers/{person_id}.

tools.name: phppos_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List or search suppliers with contact details, company, account number and balance. GET /suppliers.

tools.name: phppos_get_supplier
tools.title: Get supplier
tools.description: One supplier by person id. GET /suppliers/{person_id}.

tools.name: phppos_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List employees with name, contact details, username, hire date, manager, commission and pay rate settings and assigned locations. Passwords and the permission maps are never returned. GET /employees.

tools.name: phppos_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List customer invoices (money customers owe) or supplier invoices (money the store owes) with date, due date, status and amount. GET /invoices/customer or /invoices/supplier.

tools.name: phppos_list_expenses
tools.title: List expenses
tools.description: List recorded expenses with type, description, date, amount, tax, payment type, category and location. GET /expenses.

tools.name: phppos_list_gift_cards
tools.title: List gift cards
tools.description: List gift cards with number, description, remaining value, customer and whether inactive. GET /giftcards.

tools.name: phppos_get_gift_card
tools.title: Get gift card
tools.description: One gift card by its card number (or id): remaining value, customer and status. GET /giftcards/{giftcard_number}.

tools.name: phppos_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List appointments (bookings) with customer, employee, service, start and end time, optionally within a time window. GET /appointments.

tools.name: phppos_list_reports
tools.title: List reports
tools.description: The catalog of the store's reports (138 of them: sales summaries, top sellers, inventory low/aging/summary, profit and loss, taxes, payments, employee, customer, supplier and store-account reports) with the inputs each accepts. Without `search` only the report keys are returned; with `search` (for example 'inventory' or 'profit') the matching reports are returned with their inputs. GET /reports.

tools.name: phppos_run_report
tools.title: Run report
tools.description: Run one of the store's reports and return it (title, summary, detail rows); `paging.next_offset` is set when more detail rows remain. Report keys and their inputs come from phppos_list_reports (for example summary_sales, top_sellers, inventory_low, summary_profit_and_loss, summary_taxes, closeout). Typical inputs go in `params`: start_date, end_date, sale_type, location_ids (array), category_id, supplier_id, customer_id, employee_id. A scoped key needs the Reports module plus that report's view permission. GET /reports/{report_key}.

tools.name: phppos_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer in the store. Store-account balance, credit limit and loyalty points cannot be set here. Needs a Read/Write API key. Retrying creates a duplicate (check phppos_list_customers first). The store's 'new customer' webhook, if configured, fires. POST /customers.

tools.name: phppos_update_customer

tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing customer; only the fields you pass are sent. Overwrites the current values. Needs a Read/Write API key. The store's 'edit customer' webhook, if configured, fires. POST /customers/{person_id}.

tools.name: phppos_create_item

tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing item (for example its price, category or active state); only the fields you pass are sent. Overwrites the current values, and a price change applies to the next sale. Needs a Read/Write API key. The store's 'edit item' webhook, if configured, fires. POST /items/{item_id}.

servers.name: Tamigo
servers.description: Read Tamigo departments, employees, shifts, absences and opening hours; register attendance.

login.hint: A Tamigo administrator creates the key in Tamigo under **Configuration → Web Services (API)**: enter a name, then choose **Create Key**. The key is tied to your company; the web-services API may need to be enabled in your Tamigo package. Your key is used only to call the Tamigo API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: tamigo_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List all departments (shops, restaurants, units) of the company: DepartmentId (a GUID, used by other tools), DepartmentKey (the POS key set in Tamigo), Name, IsDefault and ParentDepartmentId. GET /departments/application/.

tools.name: tamigo_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List all employees of the company (basic): EmployeeId, Name, Email, IsPlanner, PosKey (the employee key used by the attendance tool) and DepartmentRoles. For contract, wage and absence-balance details use tamigo_list_employee_details. GET /employees/.

tools.name: tamigo_list_employee_details
tools.title: List employee details
tools.description: Detailed employee records, 500 per page in alphabetical order: contact data, roles per department, home department, contract hours, wage type and history, absence balances, competencies, custom columns, notes and availability. Bank details and ID numbers are never returned. Large pages are returned in slices: pass the reply's next_page and next_offset to continue. GET /employees/getemployeedetails/.

tools.name: tamigo_list_shifts
tools.title: List shifts (original, planned, worked)
tools.description: Per employee and day, the original rota, the planned (current) rota and the worked (timesheet) hours for a date range, with department, employee POS key, email and wage number. Use it for payroll checks, hours worked vs planned and who worked when. Shift values are hours. GET /shifts/all/{start}/{end}/.

tools.name: tamigo_list_absences
tools.title: List absences
tools.description: All absences (holiday, sickness, leave) that overlap a date range: employee, department, absence type, start and end, and whether it is approved or rejected. GET /LeaveRequests/All/.

tools.name: tamigo_get_opening_hours
tools.title: Get opening hours
tools.description: Normal and special opening hours per department for a date range. GET /OpeningHours/{start}/{end}/.

tools.name: tamigo_register_attendance
tools.title: Register check-ins / check-outs
tools.description: WRITE: register check-in and check-out times in the Tamigo timesheet, for one or many employees (the same call a POS system makes). Each entry names a department key and an employee key (the POS keys set in Tamigo under Configuration -> Departments / POS Keys; they are shown by tamigo_list_departments and tamigo_list_employees) and EITHER a check_in_time OR a check_out_time, in chronological order per employee. A break is registered by giving the same activity_name (for example Lunch, SmallBreak) on its check-in and its check-out. Tamigo may round the times by the company's rules, and the reply echoes the times actually registered. This changes worked hours and wages: it is not undone by repeating it, so confirm the entries first.

tools.name: tamigo_upload_daily_revenue
tools.title: Upload daily revenue
tools.description: WRITE: import daily revenue per department into Tamigo (the same call a cash-register system makes), used for revenue-based planning and KPIs. Each row is a department key (the POS key set in Tamigo), a date and a revenue amount (a plain number with a dot as decimal separator). A date that already has revenue for that department may be overwritten by Tamigo, so confirm the rows first. POST /Revenues/.

tools.name: tamigo_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: tamigo_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Tamigo tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: tamigo_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Tamigo (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: tamigo_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Tamigo Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run tamigo_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

examples: Which departments do we have in Tamigo, and what are their keys?
Show planned vs worked hours per employee for last week.
Who is absent next week and is it approved?
List all employees with their roles and contract hours.

servers.name: Precoro
servers.description: Read Precoro purchase orders, invoices, suppliers and budgets; approve, reject and submit documents.

login.hint: In Precoro open **Configuration → Integrations → API Key** and press Generate API Key (it is shown only once). The key belongs to one user and one company, and the connection sees only what that user may see; a dedicated user with the roles you want to share makes its activity easy to track. Choose the region of your Precoro address: app.precoro.com is International, app.precoro.us is United States. Your key is used only to call the Precoro API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: precoro_list_purchase_orders
tools.title: List purchase orders
tools.description: List purchase orders (POs) with number (idn), supplier, location, totals, currency, required date, approval status, receiving status (0 not received, 1 partly, 2 received) and payment status (0 needs invoice, 1 not paid, 2 partly paid, 3 paid). Line items come only from precoro_get_purchase_order. Filter by status, last-modified time, approval date range, or 'waiting for my approval'. Page with next_page. GET /purchaseorders.

tools.name: precoro_get_purchase_order
tools.title: Get a purchase order
tools.description: One purchase order by IDN with all items, taxes, custom fields, approval steps, receiving and payment status. GET /purchaseorders/{idn}.

tools.name: precoro_list_purchase_requisitions
tools.title: List purchase requisitions
tools.description: List purchase requisitions (purchase requests): requester, location, totals, required date, approval status. Line items come only from precoro_get_purchase_requisition. Filter by status, last-modified time, approval date range, or 'waiting for my approval'. GET /purchaserequisitions.

tools.name: precoro_get_purchase_requisition
tools.title: Get a purchase requisition
tools.description: One purchase requisition by IDN with items, custom fields and approval steps. GET /purchaserequisitions/{idn}.

tools.name: precoro_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices and credit notes
tools.description: List supplier invoices and credit notes: supplier, totals, currency, issue and due dates, paid sum, approval/payment status. Filter by status, kind, last-modified time, approval date range, or 'waiting for my approval'. GET /invoices.

tools.name: precoro_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: One supplier invoice or credit note by IDN with items, taxes, matching to purchase orders and receipts, and payments. GET /invoices/{idn}.

tools.name: precoro_list_expenses
tools.title: List expenses
tools.description: List expense documents (purchases without a purchase order): supplier, totals, currency, status and payment status. Filter by status, last-modified time, approval date range, or 'waiting for my approval'. GET /expenses.

tools.name: precoro_get_expense
tools.title: Get an expense
tools.description: One expense document by IDN with items, custom fields and approval steps. GET /expenses/{idn}.

tools.name: precoro_list_receipts
tools.title: List receipts
tools.description: List goods receipts (what was delivered against purchase orders): purchase order, status and dates. Line items and received quantities come only from precoro_get_receipt. Filter by status, last-modified time, approval date range, or 'waiting for my approval'. GET /receipts.

tools.name: precoro_get_receipt
tools.title: Get a receipt
tools.description: One goods receipt by IDN with items and approval steps. GET /receipts/{idn}.

tools.name: precoro_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List payments recorded against invoices and expenses: pay date, sum paid, status (0 paid, 8 canceled), kind (0 payment, 1 credit, 2 supplier credit balance, 3-6 prepayments/credits) and the invoice or expense paid. GET /payments.

tools.name: precoro_list_budgets
tools.title: List budgets
tools.description: List budgets with name, period, total sum, how much is used in purchase requisitions, purchase orders, invoices and expenses, and whether the limit is enforced. GET /budgets.

tools.name: precoro_list_contracts
tools.title: List supplier contracts
tools.description: List supplier contracts with number, supplier, begin and end dates and whether they auto-prolong. GET /contracts.

tools.name: precoro_list_ap_inbox
tools.title: List AP inbox documents
tools.description: List documents in the accounts-payable inbox (uploaded or emailed supplier invoices read by OCR): file name, supplier, gross total, currency, status, upload and processed dates. GET /ap/documents.

tools.name: precoro_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers: name, unique code, currencies, payment conditions, minimum order sum, contact and address fields, accounting ids, status. Bank details are never returned. Filter by last-modified time. GET /suppliers.

tools.name: precoro_get_supplier
tools.title: Get a supplier
tools.description: One supplier by id with contacts, conditions, custom field defaults and credit balance. Bank details are never returned. GET /suppliers/{id}.

tools.name: precoro_list_items
tools.title: List catalog items
tools.description: List catalog items (products and services): name, SKU, unit, price, currency, supplier, group and custom fields. Filter by last-modified time. GET /items.

tools.name: precoro_get_item
tools.title: Get a catalog item
tools.description: One catalog item by id. GET /items/{id}.

tools.name: precoro_list_reference_data
tools.title: List reference data
tools.description: List a configuration table: users (name, email, roles), locations, legal_entities, taxes, payment_terms, units, warehouses, product_groups, document_custom_fields (departments, projects, classes, GL accounts), item_custom_fields or supplier_custom_fields. Use it to find the ids that purchase requisitions and suppliers need (location, legal entity, custom field). Bank details are never returned. GET /users, /locations, /legalentities, /taxes, /paymentterms, /units, /warehouses, /groups, /documentcustomfields, /itemcustomfields, /suppliercustomfields.

tools.name: precoro_approve_document
tools.title: Approve a document
tools.description: WRITE: approve a document as the Precoro user the API key belongs to (that user must be a current approver of it). Approving can release spending: an approved purchase order may be sent to the supplier and an approved invoice can go to payment. Find candidates with the list tools and waiting_for_my_approval. Cannot be undone through this server. POST /{document}/{idn}/approve.

tools.name: precoro_reject_document
tools.title: Reject a document
tools.description: WRITE: reject (deny) a document that is waiting for the key user's approval. A comment is required; the creator is notified and sees it. POST /{document}/{idn}/reject.

tools.name: precoro_submit_document
tools.title: Submit a draft for approval
tools.description: WRITE: confirm a draft (open) document so it enters the approval flow (or is approved at once if no approval is needed). Approvers are notified. POST /{document}/{idn}/confirm.

tools.name: precoro_create_purchase_requisition
tools.title: Create a purchase requisition (draft)
tools.description: WRITE: create a purchase requisition in draft (open) status for the key user; it is not submitted for approval until precoro_submit_document is called. Needs a location id, a currency, a delivery date and at least one item (a catalog item_id, or a name with quantity and price). Find ids with precoro_list_reference_data (locations, legal_entities, document_custom_fields) and precoro_list_items. All required document custom fields (for example department or project) must be passed in custom_fields. Returns the new idn and id. POST /purchaserequisitions.

tools.name: precoro_create_supplier
tools.title: Create a supplier
tools.description: WRITE: create a supplier. The name must be unique in the company (a duplicate name, unique code or registration number is rejected). The supplier is available to all legal entities. Depending on the company's settings it may need approval before it can be used on orders. Returns the new supplier. POST /suppliers.

tools.name: precoro_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Precoro tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: precoro_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Precoro (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: precoro_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Precoro Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run precoro_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

examples: Which purchase orders are waiting for my approval, and what do they total?
List the unpaid supplier invoices from the last 30 days.
How much of each budget have we spent so far this quarter?
Create a draft purchase requisition for 20 office chairs at 150 USD for the Head Office.

servers.name: AgencyBloc
servers.description: Read and update AgencyBloc individuals, groups, policies and agents; log activities and notes.

login.hint: AgencyBloc support issues the SID and key (phone 866-338-7075, or ask in the help center); the API is a paid add-on of your AMS+ account. The key has full access to the account, so treat it like a password. Your credentials are used only to call the AgencyBloc API on your behalf; they are never shown to anyone. SSNs and other national ids are removed from everything this server returns.

tools.name: agencybloc_search_individuals
tools.title: Search individuals
tools.description: Search individuals (clients and contacts) in AgencyBloc. All filters are optional and combine; with none you get the first records. Returns id, name, email, birth date, phones and last-updated time (national ids such as SSN are never returned). Use updated_since to find recently changed people. POST individuals/search.

tools.name: agencybloc_get_individual
tools.title: Get individual
tools.description: One individual by id, with addresses, policies and custom fields (and activities when include_activities is true). National ids are removed. POST individuals/detail.

tools.name: agencybloc_search_groups
tools.title: Search groups
tools.description: Search groups (employer / business accounts) in AgencyBloc by name, type or phone. Returns id, name, type and phone. POST groups/search.

tools.name: agencybloc_get_group
tools.title: Get group
tools.description: One group by id, with addresses, policies and custom fields (and activities when include_activities is true). POST groups/detail.

tools.name: agencybloc_search_policies
tools.title: Search policies
tools.description: Search policies by number, coverage type, carrier, holder, servicing agent, application date or last update. Returns id, holder, policy number, carrier, status, coverage type, effective and renewal dates. Use submitted_after/updated_since for recent business. POST policies/search.

tools.name: agencybloc_get_policy
tools.title: Get policy
tools.description: One policy by id: holder, agent, carrier, status, dates, premium, coverages and custom fields. POST policies/detail.

tools.name: agencybloc_search_agents
tools.title: Search agents
tools.description: Search agents (producers) by name, email or phone. Returns id, name, email and phones. POST agents/search.

tools.name: agencybloc_get_agent
tools.title: Get agent
tools.description: One agent by id, with agencies, addresses and custom fields (and activities when include_activities is true). POST agents/detail.

tools.name: agencybloc_search_carriers
tools.title: Search carriers
tools.description: Search insurance carriers by name or phone. Returns id, name, abbreviation and phones. POST carriers/search.

tools.name: agencybloc_list_activities
tools.title: List activities of a record
tools.description: All activities (tasks, calls, renewals) logged on one group, individual, agent, carrier or lead: date, subject, notes, status, type, method, priority and follow-up. There is no paging. POST activities/list.

tools.name: agencybloc_get_activities
tools.title: Get activities by id
tools.description: Activities by id (1-50 ids), e.g. the ids shown on a policy or individual. POST activity/list.

tools.name: agencybloc_list_notes
tools.title: List notes of a record
tools.description: Notes (subject, body, author, dates, pinned flag, attachment names) on one agent, group, individual or policy, newest change first. There is no paging. POST notes/list.

tools.name: agencybloc_search_leads_by_phone
tools.title: Search sales records (leads) by phone
tools.description: Find Sales Enablement records (leads) by phone number; the search is by phone only. Only accounts with the Sales Enablement module have them. POST salesEnablement/leads/searchphone.

tools.name: agencybloc_get_lead
tools.title: Get sales record (lead)
tools.description: One Sales Enablement record (lead) by record id. POST salesEnablement/Leads/detail.

tools.name: agencybloc_create_individual
tools.title: Create individual
tools.description: WRITE: create a new individual (client or contact) in AgencyBloc. Needs first and last name; everything else is optional. It does not check for duplicates: search first. Returns the new individualID. POST individuals/create.

tools.name: agencybloc_update_individual
tools.title: Update individual
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing individual; fields you leave out are not sent. Tags are replaced (empty string clears them). Addresses are not changed here. Returns the individualID. POST individuals/update.

tools.name: agencybloc_create_group
tools.title: Create group
tools.description: WRITE: create a new group (employer / business account) in AgencyBloc. It does not check for duplicates: search first. Returns the new groupID. POST groups/create.

tools.name: agencybloc_update_group
tools.title: Update group
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing group (including its name); fields you leave out are not sent. Returns the groupID. POST groups/update.

tools.name: agencybloc_create_policy
tools.title: Create policy
tools.description: WRITE: create a policy on an existing group or individual. Needs the holder (entity_id + entity_type), coverage type, status and the carrier's full name; unknown coverage types / statuses are created in the account. Returns the new policyID. POST policies/create.

tools.name: agencybloc_update_policy
tools.title: Update policy
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing policy (status, carrier, dates, premium ...); fields you leave out are not sent. Returns the policyID. POST policies/update.

tools.name: agencybloc_create_activity
tools.title: Create activity
tools.description: WRITE: log an activity (call, task, renewal reminder) on a group, individual, agent, carrier or lead. Status, type, method and priority are the text values of the account's dropdowns (My Agency Settings > Data Administration); unknown values are created. When the status is not Complete the activity is a follow-up: give follow_up_user_id and follow_up_date (and start/end times), and AgencyBloc assigns it to that user. Nothing is sent to the customer. Activities cannot be edited or deleted through the API. Returns the new activityID. POST activities/create.

tools.name: agencybloc_create_note
tools.title: Add note
tools.description: WRITE: add one note (subject + body) to an agent, group, individual or policy. AgencyBloc never allows notes to be edited or deleted through the API (audit rule), so the note is permanent. Pinning a note unpins the previously pinned one. Returns the new note id. POST notes/create.

Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on AgencyBloc (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's AgencyBloc Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Which policies were submitted in the last 14 days and what are their carriers?
