servers.name: Hiveage
servers.description: Manage Hiveage clients, invoices, estimates and payments; send invoices and record payments.

login.hint: Your subdomain is the part before **.hiveage.com** in your account address. Find the API key in Hiveage **Launchpad > Your Global Profile**; it acts with your own permissions. Your key is used only to call the Hiveage API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: hiveage_list_connections
tools.title: List connections
tools.description: List connections: the companies, clients and vendors in the account's network, sorted by name. Each has a hash_key (used by other tools) and a numeric id (used as connection_id when creating invoices). Hiveage: GET /network.

tools.name: hiveage_get_connection
tools.title: Get connection
tools.description: Get one connection (client, vendor or company) by hash_key. Hiveage: GET /network/{hash_key}.

tools.name: hiveage_list_connection_invoices
tools.title: List a connection's invoices
tools.description: List the invoices of one connection (client), by date. Hiveage: GET /network/{hash_key}/invoices.

tools.name: hiveage_list_connection_estimates
tools.title: List a connection's estimates
tools.description: List the estimates of one connection (client). Hiveage: GET /network/{hash_key}/estimates.

tools.name: hiveage_list_connection_recurring_invoices
tools.title: List a connection's recurring invoices
tools.description: List the recurring invoice profiles of one connection (client). Hiveage: GET /network/{hash_key}/recurring_invoices.

tools.name: hiveage_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List the contacts (people with an email address for sending statements) of a connection. Hiveage: GET /network/{hash_key}/contacts.

tools.name: hiveage_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get one contact of a connection by its numeric id. Hiveage: GET /network/{hash_key}/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: hiveage_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices (state draft, viewed, sent, paid or partial) with totals, sorted by date. Hiveage: GET /invs.

tools.name: hiveage_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by hash_key, with its line items, taxes, discounts and shipping. Hiveage: GET /invs/{hash_key}.

tools.name: hiveage_list_estimates
tools.title: List estimates
tools.description: List estimates (quotes), sorted by date. Hiveage: GET /estm.

tools.name: hiveage_get_estimate
tools.title: Get estimate
tools.description: Get one estimate by hash_key, with its line items. Hiveage: GET /estm/{hash_key}.

tools.name: hiveage_list_recurring_invoices
tools.title: List recurring invoices
tools.description: List recurring invoice profiles (interval, next billing date, occurrences). Hiveage: GET /rinv.

tools.name: hiveage_get_recurring_invoice
tools.title: Get recurring invoice
tools.description: Get one recurring invoice profile by hash_key. Hiveage: GET /rinv/{hash_key}.

tools.name: hiveage_list_recurring_invoice_invoices
tools.title: List invoices generated by a recurring invoice
tools.description: List the invoices a recurring invoice profile has generated. Hiveage: GET /rinv/{hash_key}/invoices.

tools.name: hiveage_list_payments
tools.title: List invoice payments
tools.description: List the payments entered on an invoice. Hiveage: GET /invs/{hash_key}/payments.

tools.name: hiveage_get_payment
tools.title: Get payment
tools.description: Get one payment of an invoice by its numeric id. Hiveage: GET /invs/{hash_key}/payments/{id}.

tools.name: hiveage_list_categories
tools.title: List saved items, expense, task or trip categories
tools.description: List the saved line-item templates: kind items (saved items with price and unit), expenses, tasks (with rate) or trips (with rate). Hiveage: GET /categories/{kind}.

tools.name: hiveage_create_connection
tools.title: Create connection
tools.description: WRITE: create a new connection (client, vendor or company) in the account. For an organization give `name`; for an individual give first_name and last_name. Hiveage: POST /network.

tools.name: hiveage_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: add a contact (name and email, used when sending statements) to a connection. Hiveage: POST /network/{hash_key}/contacts.

tools.name: hiveage_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of a contact (only the fields you pass are sent). Hiveage: PUT /network/{hash_key}/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: hiveage_create_invoice
tools.title: Create invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create an invoice (starts as a draft; nothing is emailed) for a connection. statement_no must be unique. connection_id is the numeric `id` from hiveage_list_connections. Hiveage: POST /invs.

tools.name: hiveage_create_estimate
tools.title: Create estimate
tools.description: WRITE: create an estimate (quote; starts as a draft, nothing is emailed) for a connection. statement_no must be unique. Hiveage: POST /estm.

tools.name: hiveage_record_payment
tools.title: Record invoice payment
tools.description: WRITE: enter a payment received on an invoice (changes its paid and due totals). Offline payments (cash, check, bank_transfer) are saved as unrealized until marked realized. Hiveage: POST /invs/{hash_key}/payments.

tools.name: hiveage_mark_payment_realized
tools.title: Mark payment realized
tools.description: WRITE: mark an offline (unrealized) payment as realized, so it counts as received. Hiveage: POST /invs/{hash_key}/payments/{id}/mark_as_realized.

tools.name: hiveage_create_saved_item
tools.title: Create saved item
tools.description: WRITE: save a reusable line item (name, price, unit) for statements. Hiveage: POST /categories/items.

tools.name: hiveage_send_invoice
tools.title: Send invoice by email
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS EMAIL: email an invoice to the client (the default invoice template to the connection's contacts, or a custom recipient/subject/message). Cannot be undone. Hiveage: POST /invs/{hash_key}/deliver.

tools.name: hiveage_send_invoice_reminder
tools.title: Send invoice reminder by email
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS EMAIL: email a payment reminder for an invoice (default reminder template, or custom). Cannot be undone. Hiveage: POST /invs/{hash_key}/reminder.

tools.name: hiveage_send_estimate
tools.title: Send estimate by email
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS EMAIL: email an estimate to the client (default template, or custom). Cannot be undone. Hiveage: POST /estm/{hash_key}/deliver.

tools.name: hiveage_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: hiveage_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Hiveage tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: hiveage_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Hiveage (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: hiveage_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Hiveage Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run hiveage_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

examples: Which invoices are overdue or still unpaid, and what is the total outstanding?
Show all invoices and estimates for the client Acme Inc.
Record a $500 bank transfer payment on invoice IN-014.
Create a draft invoice for Acme Inc for 10 hours of consulting at $120.

servers.name: iContact
servers.description: Read iContact contacts, lists, campaigns and message stats; add contacts and manage subscriptions.

login.hint: iContact API access needs an application id: register one in iContact's developer portal (help.icontact.com, search for "API Developer Portal") and set an API password for it. The API password is the one you choose for the application id, not your iContact login password. The username is the one you log in to iContact with. If your account has several client folders and you want one other than the first, enter its id. Your credentials are used only to call the iContact API on your behalf; they are never shown to anyone.

tools.name: icontact_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The iContact account behind the credentials (company name, address, plan fields) and its client folders, with the folder this server uses. GET /a/ and GET /a/{accountId}/c/.

tools.name: icontact_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (email, name, address, phone, status, create date). Filter by status, exact email, first/last name or a list the contact belongs to. GET /contacts.

tools.name: icontact_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: One contact by id. GET /contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: icontact_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: add one contact to the account (it is not added to any list; use icontact_set_subscription for that). Not idempotent: an email that already exists is reported by iContact as a warning. POST /contacts.

tools.name: icontact_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of one contact; only the fields you pass are sent. Setting status to donotcontact or deleted stops mail to that contact. POST /contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: icontact_list_lists
tools.title: List mailing lists
tools.description: List the account's mailing lists (name, description, welcome-message settings). GET /lists.

tools.name: icontact_get_list
tools.title: Get mailing list
tools.description: One mailing list by id. GET /lists/{listId}.

tools.name: icontact_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List list memberships (subscriptionId, contactId, listId, status). Filter by list, contact or status. GET /subscriptions.

tools.name: icontact_set_subscription
tools.title: Subscribe or unsubscribe contact
tools.description: WRITE: put a contact on a list (status normal, or pending to start double opt-in) or unsubscribe it (status unsubscribed). Only for contacts who agreed to receive mail. POST /subscriptions.

tools.name: icontact_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns (the sender identity and settings that messages belong to). GET /campaigns.

tools.name: icontact_get_campaign
tools.title: Get campaign
tools.description: One campaign by id. GET /campaigns/{campaignId}.

tools.name: icontact_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List messages (subject, type, campaign, create date, HTML and text bodies). Filter by type or campaign. GET /messages.

tools.name: icontact_get_message
tools.title: Get message
tools.description: One message by id, with subject and HTML/text bodies. GET /messages/{messageId}.

tools.name: icontact_get_message_statistics
tools.title: Get message statistics
tools.description: Delivery statistics of a message (released, bounces, opens, clicks, unsubscribes, complaints, forwards). GET /messages/{messageId}/statistics.

tools.name: icontact_list_message_activity
tools.title: List message activity
tools.description: Who opened, clicked, bounced from or unsubscribed after a message: one page of events for one message. GET /messages/{messageId}/opens | clicks | bounces | unsubscribes.

tools.name: icontact_list_sends
tools.title: List sends
tools.description: List sends (a message sent to lists/segments: send id, message id, included/excluded lists, scheduled time, status). GET /sends.

tools.name: icontact_get_send
tools.title: Get send
tools.description: One send by id. GET /sends/{sendId}.

tools.name: icontact_list_segments
tools.title: List segments
tools.description: List saved segments (rule-based groups of contacts). GET /segments.

tools.name: icontact_get_segment
tools.title: Get segment
tools.description: One segment by id. GET /segments/{segmentId}.

tools.name: icontact_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: List the account's custom contact fields (name, type). GET /customfields.

tools.name: icontact_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: icontact_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the iContact tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: icontact_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on iContact (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: icontact_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's iContact Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run icontact_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

examples: How many contacts are on my newsletter list and how many unsubscribed?
Show the open and click statistics of my latest message.
Add jane@example.com to the Customers list.
Which contacts bounced from my last send?

servers.name: Freshsales
servers.description: Manage Freshsales contacts, accounts, deals, tasks and appointments; add notes.

login.hint: Both are under your profile picture -> **Profile Settings -> API Settings**: the API key, and the **bundle alias** below it (for example acme.myfreshworks.com; accounts on freshworks.com or freshsales.io enter that host). The key acts with that user's permissions. Freshsales allows 1,000 API requests per hour per account, shared with your other integrations. Your key is used only to call the Freshsales API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: freshsales_list_contact_views
tools.title: List contact views
tools.description: List the saved contact views (filters) of the account, e.g. 'My Contacts', 'New Contacts', 'All Contacts'. A view id is needed by freshsales_list_contacts; ids differ per account. GET /contacts/filters.

tools.name: freshsales_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List the contacts in a view (get view_id from freshsales_list_contact_views), 25 per page with name, email, phone numbers, job title, lead score, open deals amount and last contacted. Pages: use next_page. GET /contacts/view/{view_id}.

tools.name: freshsales_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: One contact by id with all its fields, optionally with related records embedded via include (notes, tasks, appointments, deals, sales_accounts, owner, sales_activities...). GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: freshsales_search
tools.title: Search records
tools.description: Search by name/email text across one record type: contact, sales_account (company), deal or user. Returns id, type, name and email for the matches (up to per_page, default 10). Use the id with the get tools. GET /search.

tools.name: freshsales_lookup
tools.title: Look up by exact field
tools.description: Exact-match lookup of contacts, companies or deals by one field, e.g. a contact by email address. field is 'email' (contacts), 'name', or a custom field name (cf_...). Returns the full records. GET /lookup.

tools.name: freshsales_list_account_views
tools.title: List account views
tools.description: List the saved account (company) views of the account, e.g. 'My Accounts'. A view id is needed by freshsales_list_accounts. GET /sales_accounts/filters.

tools.name: freshsales_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts
tools.description: List the accounts (companies) in a view (view_id from freshsales_list_account_views), 25 per page, with name, location, open deals amount and last contacted. GET /sales_accounts/view/{view_id}.

tools.name: freshsales_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: One account (company) by id with its fields, optionally with related records embedded (contacts, deals, tasks, appointments, owner...). GET /sales_accounts/{id}.

tools.name: freshsales_list_deal_views
tools.title: List deal views
tools.description: List the saved deal views of the account, e.g. 'Open Deals'. A view id is needed by freshsales_list_deals. GET /deals/filters.

tools.name: freshsales_list_deals
tools.title: List deals
tools.description: List the deals in a view (view_id from freshsales_list_deal_views), 25 per page, with name, amount, expected close, probability and age. GET /deals/view/{view_id}.

tools.name: freshsales_get_deal
tools.title: Get deal
tools.description: One deal by id with amount, expected close, probability and ids of its stage, pipeline and owner, optionally with related records embedded (contacts, sales_account, deal_stage, owner, notes via sales_activities...). GET /deals/{id}.

tools.name: freshsales_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks by status filter: open, due_today, due_tomorrow, overdue or completed (one filter per call). Returns title, due date, owner and status. GET /tasks.

tools.name: freshsales_get_task
tools.title: Get task
tools.description: One task by id. GET /tasks/{id}.

tools.name: freshsales_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List appointments that are open (upcoming) or complete (one filter per call), with title, time, location and creator. GET /appointments.

tools.name: freshsales_get_appointment
tools.title: Get appointment
tools.description: One appointment by id with its attendees. GET /appointments/{id}.

tools.name: freshsales_list_sales_activities
tools.title: List sales activities
tools.description: List logged sales activities (calls, meetings, emails...) of the account. GET /sales_activities.

tools.name: freshsales_list_owners
tools.title: List owners (users)
tools.description: List the users of the account (id and name). Use the id as owner_id when creating or updating records. GET /selector/owners.

tools.name: freshsales_list_deal_pipelines
tools.title: List deal pipelines
tools.description: List the deal pipelines (id, name). GET /selector/deal_pipelines.

tools.name: freshsales_list_deal_stages
tools.title: List deal stages
tools.description: List deal stages (id, name, deal_pipeline_id): those of the default pipeline, or of the pipeline given by pipeline_id. Use the id as deal_stage_id. GET /selector/deal_stages or /selector/deal_pipelines/{id}/deal_stages.

tools.name: freshsales_list_options
tools.title: List option values
tools.description: List the configured choices (id and name) for a field: lead_sources, contact_statuses, lifecycle_stages, deal_types, deal_reasons, deal_products, deal_payment_statuses, territories, currencies, industry_types, business_types, campaigns, sales_activity_types, sales_activity_outcomes. Use the ids in the *_id fields of the write tools. GET /selector/{kind}.

tools.name: freshsales_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact. Freshsales requires an email or a mobile number. It may create a duplicate of an existing contact: search first (freshsales_lookup by email). POST /contacts.

tools.name: freshsales_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing contact; only the fields you pass are changed (passing sales_accounts replaces the associated companies). PUT /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: freshsales_create_account
tools.title: Create account
tools.description: WRITE: create an account (company). name is required. It may duplicate an existing company: search first (freshsales_search). POST /sales_accounts.

tools.name: freshsales_update_account
tools.title: Update account
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing account (company); only the fields you pass are changed. PUT /sales_accounts/{id}.

tools.name: freshsales_create_deal
tools.title: Create deal
tools.description: WRITE: create a deal. name, amount and sales_account_id are required; contact_ids attach existing contacts. Stage and pipeline default to the first of the default pipeline. POST /deals.

tools.name: freshsales_update_deal
tools.title: Update deal
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing deal, e.g. move it to another stage (deal_stage_id), change amount or expected close; only the fields you pass are changed. PUT /deals/{id}.

tools.name: freshsales_create_note
tools.title: Add note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a contact, account or deal. Visible to your team on the record. POST /notes.

tools.name: freshsales_update_note
tools.title: Update note
tools.description: WRITE: replace the text of an existing note. PUT /notes/{id}.

tools.name: freshsales_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: WRITE: create a task (to-do) attached to a contact, account or deal. title, due_date, owner_id and the target are required. POST /tasks.

tools.name: freshsales_update_task
tools.title: Update task
tools.description: WRITE: change a task: title, details, due date, owner, or mark it completed (status 1) or open (status 0). PUT /tasks/{id}.

tools.name: freshsales_create_appointment
tools.title: Create appointment
tools.description: WRITE: create an appointment (meeting) with a start and end, optionally attached to a contact, account or deal and with attendees. Attendees may be notified by Freshsales. POST /appointments.

tools.name: freshsales_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: freshsales_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Freshsales tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: freshsales_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Freshsales (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: freshsales_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Freshsales Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run freshsales_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

examples: Which deals are in my open-deals view, and which close this month?
Find the contact with the email jane@example.com and show her notes and open tasks.
Add a note to the Acme account: renewal call went well, send the quote Friday.
Create a task for tomorrow 9am to follow up with the contact Tom Reed.

servers.name: Hiboutik
servers.description: Read Hiboutik products, stock, customers, sales and turnover; edit customers and sale comments.

login.hint: The account name is the first part of your back-office address (youraccount.hiboutik.com). The API key is in Hiboutik under **Settings > API**, for the user whose email you enter; it acts with that user's rights. Your key is used only to call the Hiboutik API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone. The shop's Hiboutik API allowance (10,000 calls a month) is shared with your other apps.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_stores
tools.title: List stores
tools.description: List the shops (stores) of the account: id, name, warehouse id, currency, time zone, address. Use store ids for sales, payment types and reports. GET /stores.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_warehouses
tools.title: List warehouses
tools.description: List warehouses (stock locations) with id and name. Use the ids for stock levels. GET /warehouses.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_users
tools.title: List users (vendors)
tools.description: List the Hiboutik users (staff, sales vendors): id, name, email, access level. The id is the vendor_id of a sale. Passwords and keys are never returned. GET /users.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_taxes
tools.title: List taxes
tools.description: List the tax (VAT) rates with id, name, value and default flag. GET /taxes.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_payment_types
tools.title: List payment types
tools.description: List the payment types enabled in a store (cash, card, cheque...) with currency and flags. GET /payment_types/{store_id}/.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List product categories (newest id first) with parent id and flags. GET /categories.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_brands
tools.title: List brands
tools.description: List product brands (newest id first). GET /brands.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List the suppliers with id, name and contact details. GET /suppliers/.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_size_types
tools.title: List variant types
tools.description: List the variant (size) types, such as clothing sizes or colours. Use an id with hiboutik_list_sizes. GET /size_types.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_sizes
tools.title: List variants of a type
tools.description: List the variants (sizes) of one variant type: size_id and name. The size_id identifies a variant of a product in stock and sales. GET /sizes/{size_type_id}.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products (default newest id first) with model, barcode, price, supply price, brand, category, supplier and stock management flag. 250 per page. GET /products/.

tools.name: hiboutik_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One product with its full details. GET /products/{product_id}.

tools.name: hiboutik_search_products_by_name
tools.title: Search products by name
tools.description: Find products whose model (name) matches the text. GET /products/search/name/{q}.

tools.name: hiboutik_find_product_by_barcode
tools.title: Find product by barcode
tools.description: Find the product (and variant) with this barcode. GET /products/search/barcode/{barcode}/.

tools.name: hiboutik_search_products
tools.title: Search products by filters
tools.description: Search products by model, category, brand, supplier, archived state, supplier or external reference. GET /products/search/.

tools.name: hiboutik_stock_all_warehouses
tools.title: Stock in all warehouses
tools.description: Available stock per product and variant across warehouses, optionally filtered by category, brand, supplier or archived state. GET /stock_available/all_wh.

tools.name: hiboutik_stock_by_warehouse
tools.title: Stock in one warehouse
tools.description: Available stock per product and variant in one warehouse, optionally filtered. GET /stock_available/warehouse_id/{warehouse_id}.

tools.name: hiboutik_stock_by_product
tools.title: Stock of one product
tools.description: Available stock of one product per variant and warehouse, with the inventory alert level. GET /stock_available/product_id/{product_id}.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_stock_orders
tools.title: List stock orders (inventory inputs)
tools.description: List the stock orders / goods receipts. GET /inventory_inputs/.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (newest id first) with name, email, phone, country, loyalty points and store credit. Personal data of the shop's customers. GET /customers/.

tools.name: hiboutik_search_customers
tools.title: Search customers
tools.description: Search customers by last name, first name, email, phone, VAT number, country, customer code or external reference (each text value needs at least 3 characters). Dates: yyyy-mm-dd, or prefix with > < >= <= to compare. GET /customers/search/.

tools.name: hiboutik_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer with full details. GET /customer/{customers_id}.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_customer_sales
tools.title: List sales of a customer
tools.description: List the sales made to one customer (newest first). GET /customer/{customers_id}/sales/.

tools.name: hiboutik_get_sale
tools.title: Get sale
tools.description: One sale with its header, totals, payment and line items. GET /sales/{sale_id}.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_open_sales
tools.title: List open sales
tools.description: List the sales not yet closed in a store (newest first). GET /open_sales/{store_id}.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_closed_sales
tools.title: List closed sales
tools.description: List the closed (completed) sales of a store for one day, or for a whole month when day is omitted. GET /closed_sales/{store_id}/{year}/{month}[/{day}].

tools.name: hiboutik_report_turnover
tools.title: Turnover report
tools.description: Sales total (turnover) of a store for one day, or per day for a whole month when day is omitted. GET /reports/turnover/{store_id}/{year}/{month}[/{day}].

tools.name: hiboutik_report_products_sold
tools.title: Products sold report
tools.description: Products sold in a store during one month: quantities and revenue per product. GET /reports/products/{store_id}/{year}/{month}.

tools.name: hiboutik_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer in Hiboutik. Needs at least a last name, first name, company or email. Returns the new customer id. POST /customers/.

tools.name: hiboutik_update_customer
tools.title: Update a customer attribute
tools.description: WRITE: change ONE attribute of a customer (it overwrites the current value). Attributes: gender (0 unknown, 1 male, 2 female), last_name, first_name, email, company, phone, vat, country, date_of_birth, customers_code, comments, validity, customers_ref_ext, customers_misc. PUT /customer/{customers_id}/.

tools.name: hiboutik_set_sale_comment
tools.title: Set sale comment
tools.description: WRITE: add or replace the comment of a sale (it overwrites any existing comment). POST /sales/comments/.

tools.name: hiboutik_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: hiboutik_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Hiboutik tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: hiboutik_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Hiboutik (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: hiboutik_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Hiboutik Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run hiboutik_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

examples: What was the turnover of my shop yesterday, and how many sales were closed?
Which products are low on stock in my main warehouse?
Find the customer with email marie@example.com and list her latest sales.
Which products sold best in my store last month?

servers.name: Feefo
servers.description: Read Feefo service, product and NPS reviews and ratings; reply to reviews.

login.hint: In Feefo Hub open **Settings -> Connectivity -> App Keys**, create an App Key (limit its services if you like) and copy the Client ID and Secret from its Details. The merchant identifier is under **Settings -> Business details**. Your credentials are used only to call the Feefo API on your behalf; they are never shown to anyone.

tools.name: feefo_list_reviews
tools.title: List Feefo reviews
tools.description: List reviews of your Feefo account, newest updates first. mode: all (service + product, default), service (seller/service reviews), product (product reviews; give product_sku or parent_product_sku) or nps (Net Promoter Score responses). Returns summary.meta (count, pages) and reviews[] with ratings, comment text, customer display name and review threads. Page with page/page_size.

tools.name: feefo_get_review
tools.title: Get a Feefo review
tools.description: Get one review by its id (the `id` of a service or product element from feefo_list_reviews), optionally with its full thread of replies.

tools.name: feefo_get_review_summary
tools.title: Get Feefo rating summary
tools.description: Aggregate ratings for your Feefo account: average rating and star distribution (1 to 5 stars) for service and product reviews, merchant details, review counts. mode: all (default), service, product (needs product_sku or parent_product_sku) or nps (promoters/passives/detractors). Use since_period=all for lifetime figures (Feefo default: the last year).

tools.name: feefo_get_product_ratings
tools.title: Get Feefo product ratings
tools.description: Average star rating per product SKU (products[] with rating, sku and optionally review_count). Filter by product_sku (comma-separated, leading/trailing * wildcards allowed) or parent_product_sku.

tools.name: feefo_reply_to_review
tools.title: Reply to a Feefo review
tools.description: WRITE: publish a public reply to a review on your Feefo account, optionally emailing the customer (notify_customer). Visible to the public on your Feefo page and not undoable through this server. `review_id` is the `id` of the service or product element returned by feefo_list_reviews (not the outer review url id). Confirm the wording with the user first.

tools.name: feefo_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: feefo_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Feefo tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: feefo_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Feefo (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: feefo_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Feefo Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run feefo_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

examples: Show my latest 1 and 2 star Feefo reviews from the last month.
What is my average Feefo service rating and star breakdown this year?
Which products have the best average rating? Show the top 10 by rating.
Reply to the review from yesterday about late delivery with a short apology.

servers.name: inv.bg
servers.description: Read inv.bg invoices, clients, items, payments and banking; create clients, items, invoices.

login.hint: Create it in inv.bg under **Settings → About the Company → API access** (a long-term token). Do not use your inv.bg password. The token is used only to call the inv.bg API on your behalf and is never shown to anyone; you can delete it in the same place at any time.

tools.name: invbg_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The company (id, name, subdomain) and the user the API token belongs to. GET /account.

tools.name: invbg_get_firm
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: The issuing company's details: name, Bulstat, VAT registration and VAT number, address, MOL, contact email, custom properties. GET /firm.

tools.name: invbg_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List documents (tax invoices, proformas, debit and credit notes) with filters: type, number, issue-date range, amount ranges, payment status, client, draft/annulled, sent status, currency. Each row has number, client, totals, balance_paid, balance_due and dates. GET /invoices.

tools.name: invbg_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: One document by id: number, type, issuer and recipient, line items, VAT, totals, balance_paid and balance_due, dates, bank accounts, sent/confirmation status. Optionally with its comments. GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: invbg_list_invoice_types
tools.title: List document types
tools.description: All document types of this company (tax invoice, proforma, debit/credit note and any custom types) with their codes. GET /invoices/types.

tools.name: invbg_get_next_invoice_number
tools.title: Get next invoice number
tools.description: The next free document number of the default number set for a document type. Read-only: it does not reserve the number. GET /invoices/free-number.

tools.name: invbg_list_number_sets
tools.title: List number sets
tools.description: The company's invoice number sets (separate numbering series) with ids; pass an id as number_set to invbg_create_invoice. GET /invoices/number-sets.

tools.name: invbg_list_payment_methods
tools.title: List payment methods
tools.description: The payment method codes a document accepts (cash, bank, card, ...) with their names. GET /invoices/payment-methods.

tools.name: invbg_list_vat_exemption_reasons
tools.title: List VAT exemption reasons
tools.description: The legal reasons for issuing a document without VAT (use one as vat_exemption_reason in invbg_create_invoice). GET /invoices/without-vat-reasons.

tools.name: invbg_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List or search clients (customers): name, Bulstat, VAT number, address, MOL, whether it is a person. GET /clients.

tools.name: invbg_get_client
tools.title: Get client
tools.description: One client by id with all stored details (names in both languages, Bulstat, VAT, address, MOL, code, custom properties). GET /clients/{id}.

tools.name: invbg_list_client_contacts
tools.title: List client contacts
tools.description: Contact people of a client (or of all clients) with their names and roles. GET /client-contacts.

tools.name: invbg_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: The product/service catalogue: name, price, currency, unit, tags. GET /items.

tools.name: invbg_get_item
tools.title: Get item
tools.description: One catalogue item by id. GET /items/{id}.

tools.name: invbg_list_item_units
tools.title: List units of measure
tools.description: Units of measure accepted as quantity_unit on items and invoice lines. GET /items/units.

tools.name: invbg_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: Recorded payments (income and expense) with amount, method, date, counterparty, how much is allocated to invoices (amount_used) and what is left (amount_left). GET /payments.

tools.name: invbg_get_payment
tools.title: Get payment
tools.description: One payment by id with its allocations to invoices (invoice_payments). GET /payments/{id}.

tools.name: invbg_list_bank_accounts
tools.title: List bank accounts
tools.description: The company's bank accounts (alias, bank, IBAN, BIC, currency). GET /bank/accounts.

tools.name: invbg_list_bank_transactions
tools.title: List bank transactions
tools.description: Imported bank transactions with amount, date, counterparty, and whether they are linked to a document. Useful for reconciliation (linked=false = unmatched). GET /bank/transactions.

tools.name: invbg_list_cashboxes
tools.title: List cashboxes
tools.description: The company's cash registers (cashboxes) with names and balances. GET /cashboxes.

tools.name: invbg_get_exchange_rate
tools.title: Get exchange rate
tools.description: The exchange rate of a currency to BGN on a date (default: today), as inv.bg uses it for documents. GET /currency/rates/{currency}.

tools.name: invbg_create_client
tools.title: Create client
tools.description: WRITE: add a company client (name, Bulstat, VAT, address, MOL). Check invbg_list_clients first to avoid a duplicate. For an individual (EGN) issue the document with invbg_create_invoice and is_to_person instead. POST /clients.

tools.name: invbg_update_client
tools.title: Update client
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing client (only the fields you pass are changed). PATCH /clients/{id}.

tools.name: invbg_create_item
tools.title: Create item
tools.description: WRITE: add a product or service to the catalogue (name, price, unit). POST /items.

tools.name: invbg_create_invoice
tools.title: Create invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create a document (tax invoice by default; proforma, debit/credit note via type). It is saved as a DRAFT unless draft is false: an issued document takes the next legal number and cannot be undone through this tool. Address it to an existing client_id, or give to_name + to_address (+ to_mol and to_bulstat for a company, to_egn for a person) and inv.bg matches or creates the client from those details (an existing client matched by Bulstat or VAT number is UPDATED with the address, MOL and other details you pass). VAT: set vat_percent on the document, or on every item. POST /invoices.

tools.name: invbg_send_invoice_email
tools.title: Email invoice
tools.description: WRITE: email a document to a recipient (as a download link or an attached file). The email goes out immediately and cannot be recalled. POST /invoices/{id}/emails.

tools.name: invbg_record_invoice_payment
tools.title: Record invoice payment
tools.description: WRITE: record a payment received for a document and allocate it, which updates the document's balance_paid/balance_due and payment status. Two calls: POST /payments, then POST /payments/{id}/invoices. If the allocation fails the payment stays recorded: the error names its id (see invbg_get_payment).

tools.name: invbg_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: invbg_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the inv.bg tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: invbg_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on inv.bg (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: invbg_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's inv.bg Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run invbg_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

examples: Which invoices are still unpaid, oldest first?
Show everything I invoiced to client Acme OOD this year.
Create a draft invoice for 3 hours of consulting at 80 BGN plus 20% VAT for client 1042.
Which bank transactions are not yet linked to an invoice?

servers.name: KashFlow
servers.description: Read KashFlow invoices, customers, suppliers, banking and reports; add customers, notes.

login.hint: KashFlow's API is available on the Business package. In KashFlow open **Apps → API Settings**, tick **Enable API**, untick **Restrict Access** (this server has no fixed IP address) and, if you like, choose **Separate API password** and use that password here instead of your main one ([KashFlow explains it](https://www.kashflow.com/support/kb/enabling-the-api/)). Your login is used only to call the KashFlow API on your behalf and is never shown to anyone. KashFlow locks an account after repeated wrong passwords, so check them before you try again.

tools.name: kashflow_get_company_details
tools.title: Get company details
tools.description: The KashFlow company: name, address, contact, VAT registration, currency, payment terms and business type. SOAP GetCompanyDetails.

tools.name: kashflow_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: All customers (name, code, contact, email, phone, address, VAT number, payment terms, notes), paged here: the reply says total and next_offset. SOAP GetCustomers.

tools.name: kashflow_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer by code
tools.description: One customer by its KashFlow customer code (the short code shown in the customer list, e.g. ACME01). SOAP GetCustomer.

tools.name: kashflow_get_customer_by_id
tools.title: Get customer by id
tools.description: One customer by its numeric CustomerID (as returned in other replies). SOAP GetCustomerByID.

tools.name: kashflow_find_customer_by_email
tools.title: Find customer by email
tools.description: The customer whose e-mail address matches. SOAP GetCustomerByEmail.

tools.name: kashflow_get_customer_balance
tools.title: Get customer balance
tools.description: What one customer owes: the total invoiced value and the outstanding balance. SOAP GetCustomerBalance.

tools.name: kashflow_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a new customer. The code must be unique (KashFlow refuses a code that exists) and nothing existing is changed. Returns the new CustomerID. SOAP InsertCustomer.

tools.name: kashflow_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: All suppliers (name, code, contact, email, phone, address, VAT number, payment terms), paged here: the reply says total and next_offset. SOAP GetSuppliers.

tools.name: kashflow_get_supplier
tools.title: Get supplier by code
tools.description: One supplier by its KashFlow supplier code. SOAP GetSupplier.

tools.name: kashflow_create_supplier
tools.title: Create supplier
tools.description: WRITE: create a new supplier. The code must be unique (KashFlow refuses a code that exists) and nothing existing is changed. Returns the new SupplierID. SOAP InsertSupplier.

tools.name: kashflow_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice by number
tools.description: One sales invoice by its invoice number: customer, dates, lines (description, quantity, rate, VAT), net, VAT, amount paid and a link. SOAP GetInvoice.

tools.name: kashflow_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices by date range
tools.description: Sales invoices dated within a range (inclusive; a bare end date means the end of that day), paged here. Dates are yyyy-mm-dd. SOAP GetInvoicesByDateRange.

tools.name: kashflow_list_customer_invoices
tools.title: List a customer's invoices
tools.description: All sales invoices of one customer, by numeric CustomerID (see kashflow_get_customer for the id), paged here. SOAP GetInvoicesForCustomer.

tools.name: kashflow_list_unpaid_invoices
tools.title: List unpaid invoices
tools.description: All sales invoices not yet paid in full, paged here. SOAP GetInvoices_Unpaid.

tools.name: kashflow_list_overdue_invoices
tools.title: List overdue invoices
tools.description: All sales invoices past their due date and not paid in full, paged here. SOAP GetInvoices_Overdue.

tools.name: kashflow_list_recent_invoices
tools.title: List recent invoices
tools.description: The most recently created sales invoices. SOAP GetInvoices_Recent.

tools.name: kashflow_list_invoice_payments
tools.title: List payments of an invoice
tools.description: The payments recorded against one sales invoice (date, amount, method, bank account, note), by invoice number. SOAP GetInvoicePayment.

tools.name: kashflow_list_payments_by_date
tools.title: List invoice payments by date range
tools.description: Customer payments received within a date range (date, amount, invoice, method, bank account). KashFlow returns them a page at a time: set page_number 1, 2, ... until a page comes back empty. Dates are yyyy-mm-dd. SOAP GetInvoicePaymentsByDateRange.

tools.name: kashflow_get_invoice_notes
tools.title: Get invoice notes
tools.description: The notes attached to one sales invoice, by its InvoiceDBID (the numeric id in invoice replies, not the invoice number). SOAP GetInvoiceNotes.

tools.name: kashflow_add_invoice_note
tools.title: Add invoice note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a sales invoice, by its InvoiceDBID (the numeric id in invoice replies). Existing notes and the invoice are not changed. SOAP InsertInvoiceNote.

tools.name: kashflow_list_quotes
tools.title: List quotes
tools.description: All sales quotes (same shape as invoices), paged here. SOAP GetQuotes.

tools.name: kashflow_get_receipt
tools.title: Get purchase by number
tools.description: One purchase (supplier invoice / receipt) by its receipt number: supplier, dates, lines, net, VAT, amount paid. SOAP GetReceipt.

tools.name: kashflow_list_recent_receipts
tools.title: List recent purchases
tools.description: The most recently created purchases (supplier invoices / receipts). SOAP GetReceipts_Recent.

tools.name: kashflow_list_supplier_receipts
tools.title: List a supplier's purchases
tools.description: All purchases (supplier invoices / receipts) of one supplier, by numeric SupplierID (see kashflow_get_supplier), paged here. SOAP GetReceiptsForSupplier.

tools.name: kashflow_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: The product catalogue (name, code, description, price, stock level), paged here. SOAP GetProducts.

tools.name: kashflow_list_bank_accounts
tools.title: List bank accounts
tools.description: The bank accounts (AccountID, name, nominal code). SOAP GetBankAccounts.

tools.name: kashflow_list_bank_transactions
tools.title: List bank transactions
tools.description: The transactions of one bank account (date, money in/out, VAT, type, comment, customer/supplier), by AccountID from kashflow_list_bank_accounts, paged here. SOAP GetBankTransactions.

tools.name: kashflow_get_bank_balance
tools.title: Get bank balance
tools.description: The balance of one bank account on a date (default today). SOAP GetBankBalance.

tools.name: kashflow_list_nominal_codes
tools.title: List nominal codes
tools.description: The chart of accounts: nominal codes with their names. SOAP GetNominalCodes.

tools.name: kashflow_list_vat_rates
tools.title: List VAT rates
tools.description: The VAT rates set up in the account. SOAP GetVATRates.

tools.name: kashflow_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: The projects defined in the account (id, name). SOAP GetProjects.

tools.name: kashflow_get_profit_and_loss
tools.title: Get profit and loss
tools.description: The profit and loss report for a date range: turnover, cost of sales, gross profit, expenses and net profit, with the lines of each section. SOAP GetProfitAndLoss.

tools.name: kashflow_get_balance_sheet
tools.title: Get balance sheet
tools.description: The balance sheet at a date (default today): fixed assets, current assets, current liabilities, capital and reserves with the lines of each. SOAP GetBalanceSheet.

tools.name: kashflow_get_trial_balance
tools.title: Get trial balance
tools.description: The trial balance for a date range: every nominal code with debit, credit and balance. SOAP GetTrialBalance.

tools.name: kashflow_get_aged_debtors
tools.title: Get aged debtors
tools.description: Who owes you money at a date (default today), aged into current, three periods and older, per customer. SOAP GetAgedDebtors.

tools.name: kashflow_get_aged_creditors
tools.title: Get aged creditors
tools.description: Who you owe money to at a date (default today), aged into current, three periods and older, per supplier. SOAP GetAgedCreditors.

tools.name: kashflow_get_vat_report
tools.title: Get VAT report
tools.description: The VAT return figures (boxes 1 to 9) for a period, and whether it was submitted to HMRC. SOAP GetVATReport.

tools.name: kashflow_get_kpis
tools.title: Get KPIs
tools.description: Key figures for a date range (income, expenses, profit and similar, as name/value pairs). SOAP GetKPIs.

tools.name: kashflow_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: kashflow_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the KashFlow tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: kashflow_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on KashFlow (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: kashflow_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's KashFlow Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run kashflow_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Papierkram
servers.description: Read Papierkram invoices, vouchers, contacts, projects, time; create contacts, time, draft invoices.

login.hint: The account is the first part of your Papierkram address (`https://**yourcompany**.papierkram.de`). Create the token in Papierkram under **Einstellungen → API** (the API is a beta feature of the plans M and L). Every API call uses up credits of your monthly quota. Your token is used only to call the Papierkram API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: papierkram_get_info

tools.description: Read the API version and the account's custom invoice templates (ids usable as custom_template_id when creating an invoice).

tools.name: papierkram_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List contacts (companies: customers and suppliers) with address, VAT id and contact data. Paged.

tools.name: papierkram_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: Get one contact (company) by id, with its people.

tools.name: papierkram_list_persons
tools.title: List persons of a company
tools.description: List the contact persons of one company. Paged.

tools.name: papierkram_get_person
tools.title: Get person
tools.description: Get one contact person of a company.

tools.name: papierkram_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List outgoing invoices (Ausgangsrechnungen) with state (draft, ...), dates, totals and outstanding_amount. Filter by company, project or document date range. Paged.

tools.name: papierkram_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: Get one outgoing invoice with its line items, billing address and payment term.

tools.name: papierkram_list_estimates
tools.title: List estimates
tools.description: List estimates (Angebote) with state, dates and totals. Filter by company, project or document date range. Paged.

tools.name: papierkram_get_estimate
tools.title: Get estimate
tools.description: Get one estimate with its line items.

tools.name: papierkram_list_vouchers
tools.title: List expense vouchers
tools.description: List expense vouchers (Belege / incoming invoices and receipts) with creditor, state, dates and amounts. Filter by creditor (supplier company), project or document date range. Paged.

tools.name: papierkram_get_voucher
tools.title: Get expense voucher
tools.description: Get one expense voucher with its line items.

tools.name: papierkram_list_payment_terms
tools.title: List payment terms
tools.description: List the payment term templates (ids needed as payment_term_id when creating an invoice).

tools.name: papierkram_list_propositions
tools.title: List products and services
tools.description: List the stored products and services (Leistungen/Artikel) with article number, price and unit (the VAT rate is only in papierkram_get_proposition). Paged.

tools.name: papierkram_get_proposition
tools.title: Get product or service
tools.description: Get one stored product or service, including its vat_rate (name such as 19% and rate such as 0.19).

tools.name: papierkram_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects with dates, budget and state. Filter by company. Paged.

tools.name: papierkram_get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: Get one project by id.

tools.name: papierkram_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List time-tracking tasks. Filter by project or product/service. Paged.

tools.name: papierkram_get_task
tools.title: Get task
tools.description: Get one task by id.

tools.name: papierkram_list_time_entries
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List tracked time entries. Filter by project, task, invoice, user, billing state or start time range (RFC 3339 date-time). Paged.

tools.name: papierkram_get_time_entry
tools.title: Get time entry
tools.description: Get one time entry by id.

tools.name: papierkram_list_bank_connections
tools.title: List bank connections
tools.description: List the bank accounts connected to Papierkram (name, IBAN, balance data as Papierkram reports it). Paged.

tools.name: papierkram_list_bank_transactions
tools.title: List bank transactions
tools.description: List bank transactions (value, currency, usage text, booking date, counterparty). Filter by bank connection. Paged.

tools.name: papierkram_get_bank_transaction
tools.title: Get bank transaction
tools.description: Get one bank transaction by id.

tools.name: papierkram_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users of the account (ids needed as user_id for time entries and tasks).

tools.name: papierkram_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Get one user by id.

tools.title: Update company
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing contact (only the fields you pass are changed). Read it first with papierkram_get_company.

servers.name: PaySpace
servers.description: Read PaySpace employees, organization, payroll runs, payslips and leave records. Read-only.

login.hint: A company administrator creates them in PaySpace under **Config > Basic Settings > General Company > Integrations > API Credentials** (the secret is shown only once, copy it when you save). The values are used only to get short-lived access tokens and read from the PaySpace API on your behalf; they are never shown to anyone. Employee, payslip and leave records are personal data.

tools.name: payspace_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List the companies (id, code, name, group) the API credentials can access. Company ids go into the company_id argument of the other tools. From the token reply of POST /connect/token.

tools.name: payspace_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List active employees of a company with their biographical details (name, employee number, contact, dates). Personal data. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/Employee. Use payspace_list_all_employees to include terminated employees.

tools.name: payspace_list_all_employees
tools.title: List all employees (incl. terminated)
tools.description: List all employees of a company including terminated ones. Personal data. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/Employee/all.

tools.name: payspace_get_employee
tools.title: Get an employee
tools.description: Get one employee's biographical record by EmployeeId (the numeric id from payspace_list_employees). Personal data. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/Employee({id}).

tools.name: payspace_list_employee_positions
tools.title: List employee positions
tools.description: List employee position records (job, organization unit, grade, manager, effective dates). GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/EmployeePosition.

tools.name: payspace_list_employment_statuses
tools.title: List employment statuses
tools.description: List employee employment status records (hire, termination, reason, dates). GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/EmployeeEmploymentStatus.

tools.name: payspace_list_suspensions
tools.title: List employee suspensions
tools.description: List employee suspension records. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/EmployeeSuspension.

tools.name: payspace_list_organization_units
tools.title: List organization units
tools.description: List the organization hierarchy units (departments, divisions, cost centres) of a company. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/OrganizationUnit.

tools.name: payspace_list_organization_positions
tools.title: List organization positions
tools.description: List the organization positions (position details) defined for a company. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/OrganizationPositionDetail.

tools.name: payspace_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List the jobs defined in job management for a company. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/JobManagement.

tools.name: payspace_list_regions
tools.title: List regions
tools.description: List the company's regions. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/CompanyRegion.

tools.name: payspace_list_payroll_frequencies
tools.title: List payroll frequencies
tools.description: List the payroll frequencies of a company (the CompanyFrequency lookup). A value goes into the frequency argument of payspace_list_payroll_components, payspace_list_payroll_runs and payspace_list_recurring_components. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/Lookup/CompanyFrequency.

tools.name: payspace_list_payroll_runs
tools.title: List payroll runs
tools.description: List the payroll runs (periods) of a company for one frequency (the CompanyRun lookup). A value goes into the period argument of payspace_list_payroll_components and payspace_list_recurring_components. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/Lookup/CompanyRun?frequency=.

tools.name: payspace_list_payroll_components
tools.title: List payroll components
tools.description: List the company's payroll components (earnings, deductions, contributions) with their codes, for one payroll frequency and run. Get frequency from payspace_list_payroll_frequencies and period from payspace_list_payroll_runs. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/ComponentCompany?frequency=&period=.

tools.name: payspace_list_recurring_components
tools.title: List an employee's recurring components or loans
tools.description: List the recurring payroll components (EmployeeComponent) or loans (EmployeeLoan) of ONE employee for a payroll frequency and run. Personal data (pay). Get frequency from payspace_list_payroll_frequencies and period from payspace_list_payroll_runs. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/{entity}?frequency=&period=&$filter=EmployeeNumber eq '...'.

tools.name: payspace_list_payslips
tools.title: List payslips for a month
tools.description: List employee payslips (totals per employee) for a calendar year and month. Personal data (pay). GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/EmployeePayslip/{year}/{month}.

tools.name: payspace_list_payslip_lines

tools.description: List the payslip lines (one per component per employee: code, description, amount) for a calendar year and month. Personal data (pay). GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/EmployeePayslipLine/{year}/{month}.

tools.name: payspace_list_leave_applications
tools.title: List leave applications
tools.description: List employee leave applications (type, dates, days, status). Give year and month together to restrict to a period. Personal data (absence). GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/EmployeeLeaveApplication[/{year}/{month}].

tools.name: payspace_list_leave_adjustments
tools.title: List leave adjustments
tools.description: List employee leave adjustments (manual changes to leave balances). Personal data. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/EmployeeLeaveAdjustment.

tools.name: payspace_list_leave_entitlements
tools.title: List leave entitlements
tools.description: List employee leave setup entitlements (leave type, days per cycle). GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/EmployeeLeaveSetupEntitlement.

tools.name: payspace_list_records
tools.title: List records of another entity
tools.description: List records of another read-only entity set: CompanyEmploymentCategory, CompanyEmploymentSubCategory, CompanyLeaveReason, CompanyPositionFamily, CompanyPositionFunctionArea, CompanyTrainingCourse, CompanyQualification, CostingProjectActivity, OrganizationGrade, EmployeeAsset, EmployeeClaim, EmployeeDependant, EmployeeIncident, EmployeePayRate, EmployeeProject, EmployeeQualification, EmployeeSkill, EmployeeOutOfOffice. tools.name: sapo_list_order_transactions

How many email and SMS credits do I have left?
Add jane@example.com to my newsletter list with her first name.

tools.name: sarbacane_get_credits
tools.title: Get remaining credits

tools.name: sarbacane_list_users
tools.title: List account users
tools.description: Users and pending invitations of the Sarbacane account (name, email, role, team). GET /v1/users.

tools.name: sarbacane_list_lists
tools.title: List contact lists

tools.name: sarbacane_list_list_fields
