servers.name: Halaxy
servers.description: Read Halaxy patients, appointments, slots and invoices; create patients, appointments and notes.

login.hint: Buy the API add-on under **Add-ons** (only the account owner can), then open **Developer** in Halaxy, create an API key and copy the Client ID and Client Secret ([Halaxy docs](https://developers.halaxy.com/docs/authentication)). Choose **UK and EU** if your practice is in the UK or EU, otherwise Australia and rest of world. Your credentials are used only to call the Halaxy API on your behalf; they are never shown to anyone.

tools.name: halaxy_list_patients
tools.title: List or search patients
tools.description: List or search patient records (demographics and contact details; HEALTH DATA). Filters combine with AND. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /main/Patient.

tools.name: halaxy_list_practitioners
tools.title: List practitioners
tools.description: List or search practitioners and administrators of the practice group (ids look like PR-12345). Filters combine with AND. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /main/Practitioner.

tools.name: halaxy_list_practitioner_roles
tools.title: List practitioner roles (clinic locations)
tools.description: List or search practitioner roles: a practitioner's association with one clinic location (the id used when booking and for clinical notes). Filters combine with AND. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /main/PractitionerRole.

tools.name: halaxy_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations and clinics
tools.description: List or search the practice group, its clinic locations, funders and external practices (practice group ids look like PG-12345). Filters combine with AND. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /main/Organization.

tools.name: halaxy_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List or search appointments (HEALTH DATA: names the patient). Filters combine with AND. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /main/Appointment.

tools.name: halaxy_list_schedules
tools.title: List practitioner schedules
tools.description: List or search schedules: containers of bookable time slots per practitioner. Filters combine with AND. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /main/Schedule.

tools.name: halaxy_list_slots
tools.title: List time slots
tools.description: List or search time slots of practitioner schedules (free or busy). Filters combine with AND. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /main/Slot.

tools.name: halaxy_list_healthcare_services
tools.title: List appointment types
tools.description: List or search appointment types used by the practice group, clinics and practitioners. Filters combine with AND. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /main/HealthcareService.

tools.name: halaxy_list_fees
tools.title: List fees
tools.description: List or search fees (ChargeItemDefinition): the services and products a practice charges for. Filters combine with AND. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /main/ChargeItemDefinition.

tools.name: halaxy_list_coverage
tools.title: List patient coverage (claim details)
tools.description: List or search patients' health fund membership and claim details (HEALTH DATA). Filters combine with AND. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /main/Coverage.

tools.name: halaxy_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List or search invoices of the practice group. Filters combine with AND. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /main/Invoice.

tools.name: halaxy_list_invoice_lines
tools.title: List invoice lines
tools.description: List or search invoice lines: single fees on invoices. Filters combine with AND. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /main/InvoiceLine.

tools.name: halaxy_list_payment_transactions
tools.title: List payment transactions
tools.description: List or search payment transactions recorded on invoices. Filters combine with AND. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /main/PaymentTransaction.

tools.name: halaxy_list_referrals
tools.title: List referrals
tools.description: List or search referrals from one healthcare provider to another (HEALTH DATA). Filters combine with AND. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /main/Referral.

tools.name: halaxy_list_referral_definitions
tools.title: List referral templates
tools.description: List or search referral templates with preset properties. Filters combine with AND. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /main/ReferralDefinition.

tools.name: halaxy_get_patient
tools.title: Get a patient
tools.description: Fetch a patient record (HEALTH DATA) by id. GET /main/Patient/{id}.

tools.name: halaxy_get_practitioner
tools.title: Get a practitioner
tools.description: Fetch a practitioner or administrator by id. GET /main/Practitioner/{id}.

tools.name: halaxy_get_practitioner_role
tools.title: Get a practitioner role
tools.description: Fetch a practitioner role at a clinic location by id. GET /main/PractitionerRole/{id}.

tools.name: halaxy_get_organization
tools.title: Get an organization
tools.description: Fetch a practice group, clinic, funder or external practice by id. GET /main/Organization/{id}.

tools.name: halaxy_get_appointment
tools.title: Get an appointment
tools.description: Fetch an appointment with its participants and statuses (HEALTH DATA) by id. GET /main/Appointment/{id}.

tools.name: halaxy_get_schedule
tools.title: Get a schedule
tools.description: Fetch a practitioner schedule by id. GET /main/Schedule/{id}.

tools.name: halaxy_get_slot
tools.title: Get a time slot
tools.description: Fetch a time slot by id. GET /main/Slot/{id}.

tools.name: halaxy_get_healthcare_service
tools.title: Get an appointment type
tools.description: Fetch an appointment type by id. GET /main/HealthcareService/{id}.

tools.name: halaxy_get_fee
tools.title: Get a fee
tools.description: Fetch a fee (ChargeItemDefinition) by id. GET /main/ChargeItemDefinition/{id}.

tools.name: halaxy_get_coverage
tools.title: Get patient coverage
tools.description: Fetch a patient's coverage (claim details) record by id. GET /main/Coverage/{id}.

tools.name: halaxy_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Fetch an invoice by id. GET /main/Invoice/{id}.

tools.name: halaxy_get_invoice_line
tools.title: Get an invoice line
tools.description: Fetch an invoice line by id. GET /main/InvoiceLine/{id}.

tools.name: halaxy_get_payment_transaction
tools.title: Get a payment transaction
tools.description: Fetch a payment transaction by id. GET /main/PaymentTransaction/{id}.

tools.name: halaxy_get_referral
tools.title: Get a referral
tools.description: Fetch a referral (HEALTH DATA) by id. GET /main/Referral/{id}.

tools.name: halaxy_get_referral_definition
tools.title: Get a referral template
tools.description: Fetch a referral template by id. GET /main/ReferralDefinition/{id}.

tools.name: halaxy_find_available_appointments
tools.title: Find available appointment times
tools.description: Find free appointment times between start and end for a given duration, respecting each practitioner's online booking preferences (buffer time, lead time, advance booking limit). Narrow it with practitioner, practitioner_role or organization. GET /main/Appointment/$find.

tools.name: halaxy_create_patient
tools.title: Create a patient
tools.description: Writes to the live Halaxy account. Creates a new patient record (always a new one: search with halaxy_list_patients first to avoid a duplicate). Pass managing_organization (the practice group id, e.g. PG-12345, from halaxy_list_organizations) if Halaxy asks for it. POST /main/Patient.

tools.name: halaxy_create_appointment
tools.title: Book an appointment
tools.description: Writes to the live Halaxy account. Books an appointment for a patient with a practitioner at a clinic (the practitioner role). Halaxy also creates the invoice, clinical note and reminder. Use halaxy_find_available_appointments for free times. By default a double booking is refused (HTTP 409, nothing created). POST /main/Appointment/$book.

tools.name: halaxy_update_appointment_status
tools.title: Update an appointment status
tools.description: Writes to the live Halaxy account. Sets the patient's status on an appointment (shown in the Halaxy calendar), for example arrived, attended, confirmed or cancelled. "cancelled (no charge)" also sets the invoice to $0. For a group appointment pass patient_id to say whose status changes. PATCH /main/Appointment/{id}.

tools.name: halaxy_create_clinical_note
tools.title: Create a draft clinical note
tools.description: Writes to the live Halaxy account. Adds a clinical note to a patient's record as a DRAFT (preliminary); the practitioner reviews and publishes it in Halaxy. The author is a PractitionerRole (practitioner at a clinic). Only HTML text is supported. POST /main/DocumentReference.

tools.name: halaxy_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: halaxy_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Halaxy tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: halaxy_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Halaxy (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: halaxy_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Halaxy Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run halaxy_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

examples: Which appointments does Dr Smith have tomorrow, and who are the patients?
Find free 30-minute appointment times next week at the main clinic.
List unpaid invoices from the last month with the amount owing.
Book Jane Citizen in for a 1 hour appointment on Friday at 3pm.

servers.name: Semble
servers.description: Read Semble patients, bookings, invoices and products; create patients and tasks, label patients.

tools.name: semble_get_practice
tools.title: Get the practice
tools.description: The practice the API token belongs to: name, timezone, locations, appointment types and medical specialties. A good first call to check the connection.

tools.name: semble_list_patients
tools.title: List or search patients
tools.description: Patients of the practice (personal and health data). `search` matches name, email, phone or date of birth. Returns id, name, date of birth, contact details and status, plus pageInfo.hasMore for the next page.

tools.name: semble_get_patient
tools.title: Get a patient
tools.description: One patient by id (personal data): demographics, phones, address, numbers, custom attributes, labels, comments and status. Appointments, invoices and tasks have their own tools.

tools.name: semble_list_patient_bookings
tools.title: List a patient's bookings
tools.description: The bookings (appointments) of one patient between two dates, with doctor, location, appointment type and status. Both dates are required (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: semble_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: Bookings (appointments) of the whole practice. With a date range, a booking is included if it starts or ends inside it. Returns patient, doctor, location, appointment type, status and journey (arrived, consultation, departed, dna).

tools.name: semble_get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: One booking by id, with patient, doctor, location, appointment type, status and journey.

tools.name: semble_list_users
tools.title: List users (staff)
tools.description: Staff users of the practice (clinicians and admin): name, email, role, qualifications and specialties. Use the ids for bookings and tasks.

tools.name: semble_get_user
tools.title: Get a user (staff)
tools.description: One staff user by id.

tools.name: semble_list_products
tools.title: List products and services
tools.description: The practice's price list: appointment types, services and stock items, with price, cost, duration and stock level. `search` matches the item code or name.

tools.name: semble_get_product
tools.title: Get a product or service
tools.description: One product, service or appointment type by id.

tools.name: semble_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: Invoices whose invoice date is inside a date range, with patient, totals and what is outstanding. Filter by status (active or cancelled) and paid_or_outstanding. Monetary amounts are in the practice currency.

tools.name: semble_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: One invoice by id, with its line items, totals and what is outstanding.

tools.name: semble_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: Contacts of the practice (referring doctors, insurers and other payors). `search` matches name, email, phone, specialty and numbers.

tools.name: semble_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: Practice tasks, filtered by patient, status, priority, type or assignee. Returns subject, due date, priority, assignee and patient.

tools.name: semble_list_labels
tools.title: List patient labels
tools.description: The labels that can be put on patients (id, title, colour). Use the id with semble_add_patient_label.

tools.name: semble_create_task
tools.title: Create a task (WRITE)
tools.description: Creates a task in Semble assigned to a staff user (get ids from semble_list_users), optionally about a patient, with a due date, priority and type. Creates a new record each time it is called.

tools.name: semble_update_task
tools.title: Update a task (WRITE)
tools.description: Changes a task: close or reopen it (status), reassign it, move the due date, or edit subject, priority and notes. Only the fields you pass are changed.

tools.name: semble_add_patient_label
tools.title: Add a label to a patient (WRITE)
tools.description: Puts an existing label on a patient (label ids from semble_list_labels). Adds only; nothing is removed.

tools.name: semble_create_patient
tools.title: Create a patient (WRITE)
tools.description: Creates a new patient record (personal data) from the details you give. It does not check for an existing patient: search with semble_list_patients first to avoid a duplicate.

tools.name: semble_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: semble_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Semble tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Semble (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: semble_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Semble Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). examples: Which appointments does my practice have booked tomorrow?
Find the patient Jane Doe and show her recent bookings.
List the outstanding invoices from the last month.
Create a recall task for Dr Patel about patient 1234, due next Friday.

login.hint: In Semble open **Settings** and generate an API token (see [Semble API authentication](https://docs.semble.io/docs/authentication/)). Give it only the permissions you want to share. Choose **Sandbox** only for a token created in the Semble sandbox. Your token is stored encrypted and used only to call the Semble API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

servers.name: Yuki
servers.description: Read Yuki administrations, open invoices, ledger balances, contacts and documents.

tools.name: yuki_list_domains
tools.title: List domains
tools.description: List the Yuki domains (customer environments) this access key can reach: id, name and URL. Accountant keys reach many domains. Accounting.Domains.

tools.name: yuki_list_administrations
tools.title: List administrations
tools.description: List the administrations (companies with their own books) this access key can reach: id, name, address, Chamber of Commerce and VAT numbers, start date. Use the ids in the other tools. Accounting.Administrations.

tools.name: yuki_list_outstanding_debtor_items
tools.title: List open sales invoices (debtors)
tools.description: Open items on the debtors list (unpaid sales invoices): date, description, contact, open and original amount, reference, due date. Optionally within a date range. Accounting.OutstandingDebtorItems / OutstandingDebtorItemsByDate.

tools.name: yuki_list_outstanding_creditor_items
tools.title: List open purchase invoices (creditors)
tools.description: Open items on the creditors list (unpaid purchase invoices): date, description, contact, open and original amount, reference, due date. Optionally within a date range. Accounting.OutstandingCreditorItems / OutstandingCreditorItemsByDate.

tools.name: yuki_get_gl_account_balance
tools.title: Get general ledger balances
tools.description: The balance of every general ledger account of an administration on a date (yyyy-mm-dd): account code, description, amount. Accounting.GLAccountBalance.

tools.name: yuki_list_gl_account_transactions
tools.title: List general ledger transactions
tools.description: The transactions booked on one general ledger account in a date range: date, description, amount, contact, project. Get account codes from yuki_get_gl_account_scheme. Accounting.GLAccountTransactions.

tools.name: yuki_get_net_revenue
tools.title: Get net revenue
tools.description: The net revenue (turnover) of an administration in a date range, by transaction date. Accounting.NetRevenue.

tools.name: yuki_get_gl_account_scheme
tools.title: Get chart of accounts
tools.description: The general ledger accounts (chart of accounts) of an administration: code, description, type. Use the codes in yuki_list_gl_account_transactions. AccountingInfo.GetGLAccountScheme.

tools.name: yuki_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: Projects of an administration (code, description, company, contact, period, budgets), optionally filtered. AccountingInfo.GetProjects.

tools.name: yuki_search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: Search the contacts (customers and suppliers) of a domain by name, city, postcode, tag, email, website, phone, code, Chamber of Commerce number, VAT number or bank account. Returns at most 100 contacts per page; ask for the next page_number until the reply is empty. Contact.SearchContacts.

tools.name: yuki_list_document_folders
tools.title: List archive folders
tools.description: The folders of the document archive (id, name). With an accountant key that reaches several domains, pass domain_id so the archive of that domain is read (default: the key's only domain). Archive.DocumentFolders.

tools.name: yuki_list_document_folder_tabs
tools.title: List archive folder tabs
tools.description: The tabs inside one archive folder (id, name). Archive.DocumentFolderTabs.

tools.name: yuki_list_documents
tools.title: List archive documents
tools.description: Documents in the archive (invoices, receipts, bank statements...) with id, subject, type, contact, dates, amount. Narrow by archive folder or by document type, and by creation date range. Page with number_of_records and start_record. Archive.Documents / DocumentsInFolder / DocumentsByType.

tools.name: yuki_search_documents
tools.title: Search archive documents
tools.description: Search archive documents by text in the creator, contact, subject, tag or type (or all). Optionally limit to a folder or tab and a date range. Archive.SearchDocuments.

tools.name: yuki_get_document
tools.title: Get document
tools.description: Details of one archive document by id (subject, type, contact, dates, amounts, folder). Archive.FindDocument.

tools.name: yuki_get_document_download_url
tools.title: Get document download link
tools.description: A presigned download URL for the file of one archive document (the link works for a short time; open it in a browser). Archive.DocumentDownloadUrl.

tools.name: yuki_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: yuki_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's Yuki Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). examples: Which sales invoices are still open, and which are past their due date?
Show the balance of every ledger account of my company on 31 December.
What was my net revenue in the third quarter?
Find the contact with VAT number NL123456789B01 and their open invoices.

login.hint: In Yuki open **Settings → Integrations → Web services** and choose **Add new API key** (needs the Management or Backoffice role; the key can be limited to one administration). Copy the key. It is used only to read your Yuki data on your behalf; revoke it in Yuki at any time.

servers.name: KiotViet
servers.description: Read KiotViet products, customers, invoices, orders and stock; create customers and orders.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products (code, barcode, name, category, base price, units, attributes). Optionally include stock per branch (include_inventory) and price-book prices. Filter by name, category, branch, active flag or last change. GET /products.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One product by id: code, barcode, name, category, base price, units, attributes, images, stock per branch and price books. GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_product_by_code
tools.title: Get product by code
tools.description: One product by its product code (SKU). GET /products/code/{code}.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List product categories (id, name, parent, whether it has children). Set hierarchical to get the category tree. GET /categories.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_category
tools.title: Get category
tools.description: One product category by id (name, parent, children). GET /categories/{id}.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (code, name, phone, email, address, debt, total invoiced, reward points, groups). Contains personal data of the shop's customers. Filter by code, name, phone, group or last change. GET /customers.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer by id: contact data, debt, total invoiced, reward points, groups. GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_customer_by_code
tools.title: Get customer by code
tools.description: One customer by customer code. GET /customers/code/{code}.

tools.name: kiotviet_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a new customer in the shop (name required; code is generated by KiotViet if omitted). Always check with the user first, and look the customer up by phone before creating a duplicate. POST /customers.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices (code, date, branch, customer, total, amount paid, status, lines). Filter by branch, customer, status, order, purchase-date range or last change. GET /invoices.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: One invoice by id with its lines, payments and delivery. GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_invoice_by_code
tools.title: Get invoice by code
tools.description: One invoice by invoice code (for example HD000123). GET /invoices/code/{code}.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_orders
tools.title: List sales orders
tools.description: List sales orders (code, date, branch, customer, total, status, lines, delivery). Filter by branch, customer, status, creation date (from) or last change (from/to). GET /orders.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_order
tools.title: Get sales order
tools.description: One sales order by id with its lines, payments and delivery. GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_order_by_code
tools.title: Get sales order by code
tools.description: One sales order by order code (for example DH000123). GET /orders/code/{code}.

tools.name: kiotviet_create_order
tools.title: Create sales order
tools.description: WRITE: create a sales order (an order, not an invoice: no invoice is made and no payment is recorded) with lines of existing products in a branch, for an existing customer or none. Always confirm the products, quantities and prices with the user first. POST /orders.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_branches
tools.title: List branches
tools.description: List the shop's branches (id, name, code, phone, address). Use the ids to filter other tools. GET /branches.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_stock
tools.title: List stock on hand
tools.description: Stock on hand and reserved quantity per product and branch. Filter by branch or last change. GET /productOnHands.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers (code, name, phone, email, address, debt, total invoiced). Filter by code, name, phone or last change. GET /suppliers.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_supplier
tools.title: Get supplier
tools.description: One supplier by id. GET /suppliers/{id}.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_purchase_orders
tools.title: List goods receipts
tools.description: List goods receipts from suppliers (nhap hang: code, date, branch, supplier, total, lines). Filter by branch, status or purchase-date range. GET /purchaseorders.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_purchase_order
tools.title: Get goods receipt
tools.description: One goods receipt (nhap hang) by id with its lines. GET /purchaseorders/{id}.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_supplier_orders
tools.title: List supplier orders
tools.description: List orders placed with suppliers (dat hang nhap: code, date, branch, supplier, status, lines, amount paid). Filter by branch, status, supplier or product text. GET /ordersuppliers.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_returns
tools.title: List returns
tools.description: List customer returns (code, date, branch, customer, invoice, return total, lines). GET /returns.

tools.name: kiotviet_get_return
tools.title: Get return
tools.description: One customer return by id with its lines. GET /returns/{id}.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_cashflow
tools.title: List cash flow
tools.description: List cash-book entries (receipts and payments: code, branch, method, partner, amount, date, status). Filter by branch, direction or date range. GET /cashflow.

tools.name: kiotviet_list_users

tools.name: newsman_list_segments
tools.title: List segments
tools.description: The segments of a list with segment_id, segment_name, subscriber count and status (0 idle, 1 import running, 2 counting, 3 searching). NewsMAN allows 20 calls a minute for this method. GET /v2/segment/all.

tools.name: newsman_count_segment_subscribers
tools.title: Count segment subscribers
tools.description: The number of active subscribers in a segment. GET /v2/segment/count.

tools.name: newsman_list_segment_subscribers
tools.title: List segment subscribers
tools.description: The subscribers of a segment (subscriber_id and email). Paged (page from 0, up to 1000 per page). GET /v2/segment/getSubscribers.

tools.name: newsman_list_newsletters
tools.title: List newsletters
tools.description: Newsletters (campaigns) of a list with newsletter_id, subject, status, dates, segments and headline stats. Filter by status (-1 cancelled, 0 new, 1 confirmed, 2 sending, 3 paused, 4 resumed, 5 sent; or a comma list such as 1,5; default all), by creation date range, or the last N days. Paged. GET /v2/newsletter/all.

tools.name: newsman_get_newsletter
tools.title: Get newsletter
tools.description: Properties of one newsletter: subject, sender, status, dates, segments, links to the online view. Long HTML is clipped. GET /v2/newsletter/getProps.

tools.name: newsman_get_newsletter_stats
tools.title: Get newsletter stats
tools.description: Delivery and engagement stats of one newsletter: sent, views, clicks, unsubscribes, bounces, spam reports and rates. GET /v2/newsletter/stats.

tools.name: newsman_get_newsletter_clicked_links
tools.title: Get newsletter clicked links
tools.description: The links clicked in one newsletter with the number of clicks and the last click time. GET /v2/newsletter/linksClicked.

tools.name: newsman_list_automations
tools.title: List automations
tools.description: Automation workflows of a list with workflow_id, name, type, status (0 inactive, 1 active), version and stats. Filter by name, status and last-updated range. GET /v2/automation/all.

tools.name: newsman_get_automation
tools.title: Get automation
tools.description: One automation workflow: name, type, status, version, recurrence, stats and preview links. GET /v2/automation/getWorkflow.

tools.name: newsman_get_automation_stats
tools.title: Get automation stats
tools.description: Daily stats of the automations of a list: sends, opens, clicks, purchases, bounces, unsubscribes. Optionally for given workflows and a period (last N days, or start_date/stop_date; at most 90 days). GET /v2/automation/stats.

tools.name: newsman_get_import_status
tools.title: Get import status
tools.description: Status of a background subscriber import by import_id: new, running, finished or error, with times and the last error. GET /v2/import/status.

tools.name: newsman_subscribe_email
tools.title: Subscribe an email
tools.description: WRITE: subscribe an email address to a list (or update it if it exists), with optional name and custom properties. A property key with the tag_ prefix sets a tag. Only use for people who gave consent. The subscriber is active at once, with no confirmation email. Returns the subscriber_id. POST /v2/subscriber/saveSubscribe.

tools.name: newsman_unsubscribe_email
tools.title: Unsubscribe an email
tools.description: WRITE: unsubscribe an email address from a list, so it no longer receives campaigns from that list. Returns the subscriber_id. POST /v2/subscriber/saveUnsubscribe.

tools.name: newsman_update_subscriber
tools.title: Update a subscriber
tools.description: WRITE: change the email, first name or last name of a subscriber. Give only the fields to change; the others are left as they are. POST /v2/subscriber/update.

tools.name: newsman_add_subscriber_tags
tools.title: Add tags to a subscriber
tools.description: WRITE: add tags to a subscriber (existing tags stay). POST /v2/subscriber/addTags.

tools.name: newsman_add_subscriber_to_segment
tools.title: Add a subscriber to a segment
tools.description: WRITE: add a subscriber to a (static) segment. POST /v2/subscriber/addToSegment.

tools.name: newsman_remove_subscriber_from_segment
tools.title: Remove a subscriber from a segment
tools.description: WRITE: remove a subscriber from a segment (the subscriber stays on the list). POST /v2/subscriber/removeFromSegment.

tools.name: newsman_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: newsman_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the NewsMAN tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: newsman_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on NewsMAN (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: newsman_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's NewsMAN Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run newsman_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

examples: How many active subscribers does each of my NewsMAN lists have?
Show the open and click stats of my last three newsletters.
Is jane@example.com subscribed, and what did she open recently?
Subscribe sam@example.com to my main list and tag them as vip.

login.hint: Find it in NewsMAN under **Account → API**, in the **Authorization token** field. It is your numeric user id and your API key joined by a dash (`<user_id>-<api_key>`). A limited-access key works too; tools it may not call will report that. Your token is used only to call the NewsMAN API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

servers.name: Sellasist
servers.description: Read Sellasist orders, products, stock, customers, invoices, returns; add order notes, set status.

tools.name: sellasist_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders, newest first, with status, buyer billing address, payment, total, source (Allegro, eBay, Amazon, shop...) and comment. Filter by status, email, name, external id, payment, source or date. Use sellasist_get_order for line items and shipments. GET /orders.

tools.name: sellasist_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by id: status, buyer and delivery address, payment, shipment method, line items (product ids, EAN, quantities, prices), notes, waybills with tracking numbers, payments and additional fields. GET /orders/{order_id}.

tools.name: sellasist_search_orders
tools.title: Search orders by creation date and status
tools.description: Find up to 100 orders created in a date range and/or in one status (id, date, status). Read-only: it uses POST only because the criteria go in the body. POST /orders_search.

tools.name: sellasist_list_order_statuses
tools.title: List order statuses
tools.description: The order statuses configured in the account. Use the ids to filter orders or to change a status. GET /statuses.

tools.name: sellasist_list_order_notes
tools.title: List order notes
tools.description: Notes written on one order (author id, date, text, visibility). GET /notes/{order_id}.

tools.name: sellasist_list_order_logs
tools.title: List order change log
tools.description: The audit log of order actions (create, edit, status change, delete, merge, invoice and receipt actions) with date and user id. Filter by order ids, action type or date. GET /orders_logs.

tools.name: sellasist_list_waybills
tools.title: List waybills (shipping labels)
tools.description: Waybills (shipping labels) with order id, tracking number, creation and delivery date. Filter by order or date. Label files are not returned inline. GET /ordersshipments.

tools.name: sellasist_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products with id, name, EAN, symbol, catalog number, location, price, promo price, stock quantity, reserved quantity and variants. Filter by category, manufacturer, EAN, symbol or catalog number. GET /products.

tools.name: sellasist_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One product by id: title, category, prices, VAT, stock, sold counts, EAN, symbol, location, weight, qualities, availability, manufacturer and more. GET /products/{product_id}.

tools.name: sellasist_get_stock
tools.title: Get stock levels
tools.description: Stock quantity of one product, found by id, EAN, symbol or catalog number (the first one given in that order counts); with none of them, a page of stock levels for all products. GET /products_stock.

tools.name: sellasist_list_bestsellers
tools.title: List bestselling products
tools.description: Products ranked by units sold in the last month (sold_last_month), with stock and price. GET /products_bestsellers.

tools.name: sellasist_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: Product categories. GET /categories.

tools.name: sellasist_get_category
tools.title: Get category
tools.description: One category: names per language, parent category and status. GET /categories/{category_id}.

tools.name: sellasist_list_warehouses
tools.title: List warehouses
tools.description: Warehouses (id, title). Needs the warehouse-management feature, otherwise Sellasist answers HTTP 406. GET /storages.

tools.name: sellasist_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: Registered customers (the account's buyers). GET /users.

tools.name: sellasist_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer: email, registration date, billing and delivery address. GET /users/{user_id}.

tools.name: sellasist_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: Invoices (id, number, date). Filter by order, document series or issue date. GET /invoices.

tools.name: sellasist_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: One invoice: number, dates, seller, buyer, currency, line items (net, gross, VAT), total and paid amount. GET /invoices/{invoice_id}.

tools.name: sellasist_list_returns
tools.title: List returns
tools.description: Return documents (RMZ): number, status, source, linked order, refund value and tracking number. Filter by date, order, status, source or return number. GET /returns.

tools.name: sellasist_get_return
tools.title: Get return
tools.description: One return document with status, refund and payment details, tracking, courier and the returned items. GET /returns/{id}.

tools.name: sellasist_list_payment_methods
tools.title: List payment methods
tools.description: Payment methods (id, title) for filtering orders. GET /payments.

tools.name: sellasist_list_shipment_methods
tools.title: List delivery methods
tools.description: Delivery methods (id, title) for filtering orders. GET /shipments.

tools.name: sellasist_list_order_sources
tools.title: List order sources
tools.description: Order sources available in the account (id, name, type: Allegro, shop, marketplace...). GET /sources.

tools.name: sellasist_list_integration_accounts
tools.title: List connected marketplace accounts
tools.description: Accounts connected in external services (id, login, type). Only these three fields are returned. GET /external_accounts.

tools.name: sellasist_list_alerts
tools.title: List system alerts
tools.description: Active alerts and system messages shown on the Sellasist dashboard (type, severity, title, message). GET /alerts.

tools.name: sellasist_add_order_note
tools.title: Add order note
tools.description: WRITE: add a new note to an order. Notes are visible to the account's staff; each call adds another note (nothing is overwritten). POST /notes.

tools.name: sellasist_update_order_status
tools.title: Change order status
tools.description: WRITE: change the status of one order (PUT /orders/{order_id} with only the status). Sellasist may run the status's automations (emails, stock moves). examples: Which orders from the last 7 days are still unpaid?
Show me order 12345 with its items and tracking number.
Which products have fewer than 5 units in stock?
Add a note to order 12345: customer asked to deliver after 5 pm.

servers.name: Vtiger
servers.description: Search, read, create and update Vtiger CRM leads, contacts, deals, cases and more; tag records.

tools.name: vtiger_get_me
tools.title: Get the connected user
tools.description: The Vtiger user the credentials belong to (id, user name, name, email). GET /me.

tools.name: vtiger_list_modules
tools.title: List modules
tools.description: The CRM modules this user can access (Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Potentials, Cases, ...) with label and whether each holds records. GET /listtypes.

tools.name: vtiger_describe_module
tools.title: Describe a module
tools.description: A module's fields (name, label, type, mandatory, editable, reference targets, picklist values) and whether it can be created, updated or deleted. Read this before creating or filtering. GET /describe?elementType=<module>.

tools.name: vtiger_list_records
tools.title: List or search records
tools.description: Records of one module, optionally filtered (all filters AND-ed), sorted and paged. Builds a SELECT for GET /query. The vendor returns at most 100 records per call; pass next_offset as offset for the next page. Name the fields you need: a full record has 100+ fields.

tools.name: vtiger_count_records
tools.title: Count records
tools.description: How many records of a module match the filters (same filters as vtiger_list_records). GET /query with count(*).

tools.name: vtiger_query
tools.title: Run a SELECT query
tools.description: Run your own read-only query: SELECT <fields|*|count(*)> FROM <Module> [WHERE ...] [ORDER BY ...] [LIMIT offset,count]. One module only, no joins, no grouping brackets; at most 100 records per call. Only SELECT is accepted. GET /query.

tools.name: vtiger_get_record
tools.title: Get a record
tools.description: One record with all its fields, by id (for example 4x2063). GET /retrieve?id=<id>.

tools.name: vtiger_lookup
tools.title: Find records by email or phone
tools.description: Find records in one or more modules by an exact email address or phone number. GET /lookup.

tools.name: vtiger_list_related_modules
tools.title: List related modules
tools.description: The modules a module can be related to (for example Accounts relate to Contacts, Potentials, Cases, Documents). GET /relatedtypes?elementType=<module>.

tools.name: vtiger_get_tags
tools.title: Get a record's tags
tools.description: The tags on one record. GET /tags_retrieve?id=<id>.

tools.name: vtiger_create_record
tools.title: Create a record
tools.description: WRITE: create one record in a module (a lead, contact, account, deal, case, ...). Send every mandatory field (vtiger_describe_module lists them; assigned_user_id is usually mandatory, use the id from vtiger_get_me). Returns the new record. POST /create. Not retried.

tools.name: vtiger_update_record
tools.title: Update fields of a record
tools.description: WRITE: change only the named fields of an existing record (the vendor's revise call; other fields stay as they are). Returns the updated record. POST /revise. Not retried.

tools.name: vtiger_add_tags
tools.title: Add tags to a record
tools.description: WRITE: add tags to one record (existing tags stay). POST /tags_add. Not retried.

tools.name: vtiger_usage_status

tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on Vtiger (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: vtiger_cancel_subscription

examples: Which leads are marked Hot and who owns them?
Find the contact with the email jane@example.com and show her open deals.
How many open cases do we have for Acme Corp?
Create a lead for John Smith at Globex and tag it webinar-2026.

login.hint: The address is the one in your browser when you use the CRM, for example **acme.od2.vtiger.com** (Vtiger Cloud). servers.name: Cogmento
servers.description: Read Cogmento CRM contacts, companies, deals, tasks and cases; create records and complete tasks.

tools.name: cogmento_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: The Cogmento user this API token belongs to: id, name, email, timezone and account id. GET /auth/user/.

tools.name: cogmento_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The Cogmento account: name, country, settings, billing plan, trial days left and number of users. GET /account/.

tools.name: cogmento_get_templates
tools.title: Get field templates
tools.description: The field definitions (names, labels, types, options) of the account's templates for each record type: contacts, companies, deals, cases, tasks. Use it to learn the custom field names for filters, creates and field updates. GET /templates/.

tools.name: cogmento_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List or search contacts (name, email and phone channels, company). Filter on any field, e.g. first_name contains 'Eric'. GET /contacts/.

tools.name: cogmento_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: One full contact record, including its related tasks, cases, calls, events and documents. GET /contacts/{id}/.

tools.name: cogmento_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact. Needs first and last name; email and phone are optional. POST /contacts/.

tools.name: cogmento_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List or search companies (name, website, contacts). GET /companies/.

tools.name: cogmento_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: One full company record with its contacts and related records. GET /companies/{id}/.

tools.name: cogmento_create_company
tools.title: Create company
tools.description: WRITE: create a company. POST /companies/.

tools.name: cogmento_list_deals
tools.title: List deals
tools.description: List or search deals (title, amount, close date, assigned users, products). GET /deals/.

tools.name: cogmento_get_deal
tools.title: Get deal
tools.description: One full deal record with its contacts, products and related records. GET /deals/{id}/.

tools.name: cogmento_create_deal
tools.title: Create deal
tools.description: WRITE: create a deal. POST /deals/.

tools.name: cogmento_get_deal_pipeline_summary
tools.title: Get deal pipeline summary
tools.description: Totals by pipeline stage: how many deals sit at each stage and what they are worth. Optional filters narrow the deals counted. GET /deals/summary/.

tools.name: cogmento_aggregate_deals
tools.title: Aggregate deal values
tools.description: Sums and counts deals grouped by a field (default grouping as Cogmento chooses; e.g. field=stage). GET /deals/aggregate/.

tools.name: cogmento_list_deal_stages
tools.title: List deal contact stages
tools.description: The account-wide stages a contact can be at within a deal (for example Champion or Decision maker). GET /deals/stages/.

tools.name: cogmento_set_deal_contact_stage
tools.title: Set a contact's stage in a deal
tools.description: WRITE: record where a contact sits in a deal (a stage from cogmento_list_deal_stages). The contact is attached to the deal if it is not already. POST /deals/{id}/contact/{id}/stage/.

tools.name: cogmento_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List or search tasks (title, due date, completion date, assigned users, linked deal/contact/case). Filter e.g. on due_date. GET /tasks/.

tools.name: cogmento_get_task
tools.title: Get task
tools.description: One task record. GET /tasks/{id}/.

tools.name: cogmento_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: WRITE: create a task. POST /tasks/.

tools.name: cogmento_complete_task
tools.title: Complete task
tools.description: WRITE: mark a task complete, stamping who completed it and when. A recurring task also gets its next occurrence. POST /tasks/{id}/complete/.

tools.name: cogmento_list_cases
tools.title: List cases
tools.description: List or search cases (support or project cases: title, close date, assigned users, deal, company). GET /cases/.

tools.name: cogmento_get_case
tools.title: Get case
tools.description: One case record. GET /cases/{id}/.

tools.name: cogmento_create_case
tools.title: Create case
tools.description: WRITE: create a case. POST /cases/.

tools.name: cogmento_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the product catalogue (name, prices) that deals and invoices draw on. GET /products/.

tools.name: cogmento_list_calls
tools.title: List calls
tools.description: The account's call records, most recent first: logged manual calls and calls placed through the browser dialer. GET /calls/.

tools.name: cogmento_update_record_field
tools.title: Update one field of a record
tools.description: WRITE: change a single field of a contact, company, deal, task or case, e.g. a deal's status or a contact's first_name. Custom field names come from cogmento_get_templates. System fields (id, acl, private, timestamps) are refused. PATCH /<type>/{id}/.

examples: Which deals are open in my Cogmento pipeline and what are they worth?
Find the contact Eric Smith and show their related tasks and cases.

tools.name: safetychain_search_records

Pages are not snapshotted: for a stable multi-page read use a closed date range (start and end in the past). Use safetychain_get_record_fields for the field values. tools.name: safetychain_get_record_fields

tools.name: safetychain_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature

Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. tools.name: safetychain_upgrade

Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). tools.name: safetychain_cancel_subscription

login.hint: Create a dedicated user for this connection in SafetyChain: **System Management → Roles** (a role with the Access to Integration API Scope permission), then add a user with that role and tick Disable Password Expiration Policy. The tenant is the part before .safetychain.com in your address (acme.safetychain.com → acme). That permission lets the user read all records and resources, so every record the integration user can see is visible to your AI assistant. The password is used only to sign in to the SafetyChain API on your behalf (SafetyChain issues 5-minute access tokens) and is never shown to anyone. servers.name: WuBook
servers.description: Read WuBook ZaK rooms, availability and reservations; manage inventory and guest check-in.

login.hint: In ZaK open **Settings → Configurations → ZaK API** and generate the key (it starts with `wb_`). The ZaK API needs the Essentials Module and must be switched on by WuBook staff first. If you set an IP allow-list on the key, leave it empty or calls from this server are refused. Your key is used only to call the WuBook API on your behalf; it is never shown to anyone.

tools.name: wubook_list_rooms
tools.title: List rooms
tools.description: List the physical rooms of the property (id, room type id, name, tags). POST /kp/property/fetch_rooms.

tools.name: wubook_list_room_types
tools.title: List room types
tools.description: List the room types (id, name, short name, default price, default occupancy). POST /kp/property/fetch_room_types.

tools.name: wubook_list_rates
tools.title: List rates
tools.description: List the rates of the property (id, name, board, currency, standard flag). Use a rate id for prices and restrictions. POST /kp/property/fetch_rates.

tools.name: wubook_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the products (a room type sold on a board basis: id, room type id, name, default price, occupancy). Product ids are the keys of prices and availability. POST /kp/property/fetch_products.

tools.name: wubook_list_meal_boards
tools.title: List meal boards
tools.description: List the meal rules and meal prices per board type (fb, hb, bb, ai) for adults, teens, children and babies. POST /kp/property/fetch_meals_board.

tools.name: wubook_list_extras
tools.title: List extras
tools.description: List the extras the property sells (id, name, price, VAT percentage, cost, tags). POST /kp/property/fetch_extras.

tools.name: wubook_get_inventory_symbols
tools.title: Get inventory symbols
tools.description: The meaning of the short keys in prices and restrictions (p price, a availability, m MinStay, M MaxStay, c closure, ...). POST /kp/inventory/fetch_symbols.

tools.name: wubook_get_room_availability
tools.title: Get room availability
tools.description: Availability for a stay: for each room type id, the number of rooms available and the ids of the available physical rooms. The availability count can be lower than the number of listed physical rooms when a reservation has no physical room assigned yet; use the availability count when assessing bookable capacity. POST /kp/inventory/fetch_rooms_availability.

tools.name: wubook_get_rate_values
tools.title: Get rate values
tools.description: Daily prices, availability and restrictions of one rate, starting at a date: for each product id a list with one object per day (p price, a availability, m/M min/max stay, c closed, ...; see wubook_get_inventory_symbols). POST /kp/inventory/fetch_rate_values.

tools.name: wubook_update_inventory
tools.title: Update prices, availability and restrictions
tools.description: WRITE: overwrite daily prices, availability and stay restrictions of one rate. `products` maps a product id to a list of day objects; the first object is the day `from`, the next the following day, and so on. Only the fields you send per day change. Changes can be pushed to connected channels (OTAs) and affect live bookings, so confirm the values with the user first. POST /kp/inventory/write.

tools.name: wubook_get_reservation
tools.title: Get reservation
tools.description: One reservation by id or by reservation code (XY-0001): status, booker customer id, origin channel, board, dates, price split (rooms, extras, meals), payment, taxes and rooms with occupancy and customer ids. POST /kp/reservations/fetch_one_reservation.

tools.name: wubook_list_reservations
tools.title: List reservations
tools.description: List reservations, optionally filtered by creation, arrival or departure date ranges (inclusive). Newest first is not guaranteed; page with offset. Returns the page plus next_offset (null when the last page was reached). POST /kp/reservations/fetch_reservations.

tools.name: wubook_list_todays_reservations
tools.title: List today's reservations
tools.description: Reservations of the property for today (arrivals, departures and stays in house). POST /kp/reservations/fetch_today_reservations.

tools.name: wubook_create_reservation
tools.title: Create reservation
tools.description: WRITE: create a reservation in ZaK for one guest. Give rooms (room type and optionally the physical room id, with price and currency) and/or products (product id with price and currency). Set assign_rooms to let ZaK pick the physical rooms. This books inventory and is NOT idempotent: calling it twice creates two reservations, so check wubook_get_room_availability first and do not retry on an error without looking the reservation up. POST /kp/reservations/new.

tools.name: wubook_check_in
tools.title: Check in
tools.description: WRITE: check in the guests of a reservation in ZaK. Applies to every guest of the reservation unless room_customer_ids is given. POST /kp/reservations/do_checkin.

tools.name: wubook_check_out
tools.title: Check out
tools.description: WRITE: check out the guests of a reservation in ZaK. Applies to every guest of the reservation unless room_customer_ids is given. POST /kp/reservations/do_checkout.

tools.name: wubook_undo_check_in
tools.title: Undo check-in
tools.description: WRITE: revert the check-in of a reservation in ZaK. POST /kp/reservations/undo_checkin.

tools.name: wubook_undo_check_out
tools.title: Undo check-out
tools.description: WRITE: revert the check-out of a reservation in ZaK. POST /kp/reservations/undo_checkout.

tools.name: wubook_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer (guest)
tools.description: One guest record by customer id (from a reservation's booker or room customers): name, country, address, contact, birth data, billing info. Personal data. Identity documents (type, number, expiry) are left out unless include_documents is true. POST /kp/customers/fetch_one.

tools.name: wubook_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: wubook_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the WuBook tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: wubook_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on WuBook (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: wubook_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's WuBook Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run wubook_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

examples: Which rooms are available from 12 to 15 November?
Show today's arrivals and departures.
What is the reservation XY-0123 and how much has been paid?
Close the Double room type for sale on 24 and 25 December.

servers.name: Saldeo
servers.description: Read SaldeoSMART companies, contractors, documents, invoices, bank statements and employees.

login.hint: Saldeo API access is for **office accounts** (all accounting-office packages, and company packages Specjalista / Ekspert). Sign in to SaldeoSMART, open **Konfiguracja → Konto → API** and generate or copy the token. The username is the login of that same user. The token only signs requests and is never shown to anyone; for a client, create a separate user for them in the office account ([Saldeo help](https://pomoc.saldeosmart.pl/hc/pl/articles/30603709166237)).

tools.name: saldeo_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List the companies (clients) the Saldeo user can see: COMPANY_PROGRAM_ID (needed by every other tool), COMPANY_ID, names, VAT number, address, bank accounts. Start here. Saldeo: GET /api/xml/3.0/company/list.

tools.name: saldeo_list_contractors
tools.title: List contractors
tools.description: List the contractors (suppliers and customers) of one company: names, VAT number (NIP), address, bank accounts, e-mails, payment days. Saldeo: GET /api/xml/3.0/contractor/list.

tools.name: saldeo_search_documents
tools.title: Search documents
tools.description: Find documents of one company by field (at least one of document_id, number, nip, guid; several are combined with AND). Returns the matching documents. Saldeo: POST /api/xml/3.1/document/search (policy BY_FIELDS).

tools.name: saldeo_list_document_ids
tools.title: List document ids
tools.description: List the ids of all documents of one company in one month folder, grouped by type (contracts, cost/sale/internal/material invoices, orders, writings, other). Feed the ids to saldeo_get_documents_by_ids. Saldeo: POST /api/xml/3.0/document/getidlist.

tools.name: saldeo_get_documents_by_ids
tools.title: Get documents by id
tools.description: Get full documents of one company by id, per type (use the groups from saldeo_list_document_ids; at most 200 ids per call). Saldeo: POST /api/xml/3.1/document/listbyid.

tools.name: saldeo_list_invoices

tools.description: List the sales invoices of one company that were marked for export in Saldeo (policy SALDEO): number, dates, contractor, line items, amounts. Saldeo: GET /api/xml/3.0/invoice/list.

tools.name: saldeo_list_invoice_ids

tools.description: List the ids of the invoices (invoices, corrective invoices, pre-invoices, corrective pre-invoices) of one company in one month folder. Feed them to saldeo_get_invoices_by_ids. Saldeo: POST /api/xml/3.0/invoice/getidlist.

tools.name: saldeo_get_invoices_by_ids
tools.title: Get invoices by id
tools.description: Get full invoices of one company by id (ids from saldeo_list_invoice_ids; at most 200 per call). Saldeo: POST /api/xml/3.0/invoice/listbyid.

tools.name: saldeo_list_bank_statements
tools.title: List bank statements
tools.description: List the bank statements of one company with their entries, contractors and links. Saldeo: GET /api/xml/3.0/bank_statement/list.

tools.name: saldeo_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List the employees of one company (personnel module): names, acronym and HR master data. Contains personal data. Saldeo: GET /api/xml/3.0/employee/list.

servers.name: Plutio
servers.description: Manage Plutio clients, projects, tasks, time entries and invoices.

login.hint: In Plutio open **Settings → API** and create an API client; copy its **Client ID** and **Client Secret**. The workspace is the first part of your Plutio address (`acme` for acme.plutio.com). The client acts with the access of the person who created it, and your secret is used only to call the Plutio API on your behalf.

tools.name: plutio_get_workspace
tools.title: Get workspace
tools.description: The Plutio workspace this API client is connected to: name, domain, currency, locale, timezone and settings. GET /businesses.

tools.name: plutio_list_people
tools.title: List people
tools.description: People: clients and your own team members (name, role, contactEmails, contactPhones, companies). Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /people.

tools.name: plutio_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: Companies (clients that group people): title, industry, people, contact details. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /companies.

tools.name: plutio_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: Projects: name, client, status, dates, budget, billing rate. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /projects.

tools.name: plutio_list_task_boards
tools.title: List task boards
tools.description: Task boards of projects. A project has one or more boards that hold tasks. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /task-boards.

tools.name: plutio_list_task_groups
tools.title: List task groups
tools.description: Task groups (columns/lists on a task board). Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /task-groups.

tools.name: plutio_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: Tasks: title, status (incomplete, completed, overdue), dueDate, assignedTo, projectId, taskBoardId. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /tasks.

tools.name: plutio_list_statuses
tools.title: List statuses
tools.description: Custom statuses (for projects and similar records): title, type, entityType. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /statuses.

tools.name: plutio_list_time_entries
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: Time entries: personId, projectId, taskId, startedAt, stoppedAt, time in seconds, billing amount and rate. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /time-tracks.

tools.name: plutio_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: Categories used to organize records such as time entries and transactions. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /categories.

tools.name: plutio_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: Calendar events: title, startDate, endDate, location, participants. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /events.

tools.name: plutio_list_schedulers
tools.title: List schedulers
tools.description: Scheduling pages (booking links) and their settings. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /scheduler.

tools.name: plutio_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: Invoices: name, client, status (draft, pending, paid and so on), amount, amountPaid, currency, dueDate, issueDate. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /invoices.

tools.name: plutio_list_invoice_subscriptions
tools.title: List recurring invoices
tools.description: Recurring invoice subscriptions: client, schedule, amount. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /invoice-subscriptions.

tools.name: plutio_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: Payments and expenses: amount, currency, client, invoiceId, status, type, issueDate. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /transactions.

tools.name: plutio_list_proposals
tools.title: List proposals
tools.description: Proposals: name, client, status, amount. The text is in blocks: see plutio_get_document_blocks. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /proposals.

tools.name: plutio_list_contracts
tools.title: List contracts
tools.description: Contracts: name, client, status, signatures. The text is in blocks: see plutio_get_document_blocks. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /contracts.

tools.name: plutio_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: Forms (intake forms, questionnaires): name and status. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /forms.

tools.name: plutio_list_form_responses
tools.title: List form responses
tools.description: Submitted responses to forms. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /form-responses.

tools.name: plutio_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: Notes: title, descriptionHTML, entityType and entityId of the record they belong to. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /notes.

tools.name: plutio_list_comments
tools.title: List comments
tools.description: Comments on tasks, files and conversations: bodyHTML, createdBy, entityType, entityId. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /comments.

tools.name: plutio_list_conversations
tools.title: List conversations
tools.description: Inbox conversations: subject, participants, last message. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /conversations.

tools.name: plutio_list_wiki_pages
tools.title: List wiki pages
tools.description: Pages of the Plutio wiki / knowledge base. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /wiki-entities.

tools.name: plutio_list_files
tools.title: List files
tools.description: File records (name, size, folder, sharing). File contents are not downloaded. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /files.

tools.name: plutio_list_folders
tools.title: List folders
tools.description: File folders. Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /file-folders.

tools.name: plutio_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: Custom field definitions (label, type, which records they apply to). Returns { count, next_skip, items }; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Pass id to read one record. Filter with exact-match fields or a MongoDB-style query. GET /custom-fields.

tools.name: plutio_get_document_blocks
tools.title: Get document blocks
tools.description: The content blocks of a contract, proposal or invoice: the written text (textHTML) and, for invoices, the line items. A document record only holds block ids. GET /blocks (entityType and entityId are both required).

tools.name: plutio_create_person
tools.title: Create person
tools.description: WRITE: add a person (a client by default) to the workspace. Returns the new record with its _id. POST /people.

tools.name: plutio_create_company
tools.title: Create company
tools.description: WRITE: add a company, optionally linking existing people to it. Returns the new record. POST /companies.

tools.name: plutio_create_project
tools.title: Create project
tools.description: WRITE: create a project. Plutio gives it a default status and a first task board (find it with plutio_list_task_boards). Returns the new record. POST /projects.

tools.name: plutio_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: WRITE: add a task to a project's task board. Get taskBoardId from plutio_list_task_boards (projectId filter). New tasks start as incomplete. Returns the new record. POST /tasks.

tools.name: plutio_update_task
tools.title: Update task
tools.description: WRITE: change a task's title, status (incomplete, completed, overdue), due date or description. Only the fields you pass change. Returns the updated record. PUT /tasks.

tools.name: plutio_log_time
tools.title: Log time
tools.description: WRITE: record a time entry against a task. projectId must be the task's own project (read the task first). time is the length in seconds (5400 = 1.5 hours). POST /time-tracks.

tools.name: plutio_create_comment
tools.title: Comment on a task
tools.description: WRITE: post a comment on a task, file or conversation. Visible to everyone who can see that record. Returns the new record. POST /comments.

tools.name: plutio_create_event
tools.title: Create event
tools.description: WRITE: add a calendar event. No invitations are sent. Returns the new record. POST /events.

tools.name: plutio_create_invoice
tools.title: Create draft invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create a DRAFT invoice for a person or company. The client cannot pay it and nothing is emailed. Add line items with plutio_add_invoice_items. Returns the new record. POST /invoices.

tools.name: plutio_add_invoice_items
tools.title: Add invoice line items
tools.description: WRITE: put line items on an invoice that has none yet (an invoice made with plutio_create_invoice). Refuses an invoice that already has an items block. Plutio works out line totals, subtotal and total. POST /blocks.

tools.name: workyard_get_organization
tools.title: Get Workyard organization
tools.description: The organization this connection uses (id, name, settings such as timezone) from GET /orgs/{org_id}.

tools.name: workyard_list_employees
tools.title: List Workyard employees
tools.description: List employees of the organization (employee_id, profile_id, name, title, role, status, contact data). Filter by status (active, removed, saas_disabled, expired; comma list), email, role name or free-text search. Paged: use next_page.

tools.name: workyard_list_projects

tools.name: workyard_get_project

tools.name: workyard_list_time_cards

tools.name: workyard_get_time_card

tools.name: workyard_list_time_card_activity_segments

tools.name: workyard_list_geofences

tools.name: workyard_list_active_geofences

servers.name: Hub Planner
servers.description: Read Hub Planner resources, projects, bookings and timesheets; create clients and time entries.

login.hint: An administrator can enable API access and generate a key under **Settings → API**. Use a **Read Only** key for queries, or a **Read & Write** key to create clients and time entries. Paste the key itself, without Bearer. Your key is used to call Hub Planner on your behalf.

tools.name: hubplanner_list_resources
tools.title: List resources
