servers.name: CourtReserve
servers.description: Read club members, court availability, reservations, events, attendance and revenue reports.

login.hint: In CourtReserve open **Settings → Additional Features → Integrations → API Access**, click **Create API Key** (choose Restricted Access and Read permission for only the roles you want to share), then **View** to see the Username and Password. API access needs the Advance, Momentum or Enterprise plan, and one key belongs to one location. Your credentials are used only to call the CourtReserve API on your behalf; they are never shown to anyone.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List the club's members (name, email, phone, membership type and status, start/end/next payment dates, family id). Filter by member id, family, exact email, phone or the created (at most 30 days) / created-or-updated (at most 31 days) time. Paged: pass next_page back as page. PIN codes and SSO links are not returned. Needs the Member role (Read). GET /api/v1/member/get.

tools.name: courtreserve_get_member_reservations
tools.title: Get a member's reservations
tools.description: A member's upcoming (or dated) court bookings and event registrations: type, start/end, courts, event name and players. For a family member the reply covers the whole family. Give the member id or your own external id. Needs the Member role (Read). GET /api/v1/member/reservations.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_families
tools.title: List families
tools.description: List family accounts (family id, name, number, members and membership). Needs the Family role (Read). GET /api/v1/family/get.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_membership_types
tools.title: List membership types
tools.description: The club's membership types (id, name, price, billing and status). Use the ids to filter the membership report. Needs the MembershipType role (Read). GET /api/v1/membershiptype/get.

tools.name: courtreserve_membership_report
tools.title: Membership report
tools.description: The Membership report: one row per member or family membership with status, billing cadence, start/end, next payment and cancellation history. Filter by type, assignment (family or individual) and the start, end, next-payment or cancellation dates. Paged. Needs the Membership Report role (Read). GET /api/v1/membershipreport/list.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_courts
tools.title: List courts
tools.description: The club's courts: id, label, court type and order. Use the ids in court utilization and court blocks. Needs the Reservation role (Read). GET /api/v1/reservation/courts.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_reservation_types
tools.title: List reservation types
tools.description: The club's reservation types (court booking, lesson, court block and so on) with ids. Needs the Reservation role (Read). GET /api/v1/reservation/reservationtypes.

tools.name: courtreserve_get_court_availability
tools.title: Get court availability
tools.description: Court availability: each court's operating hours and the time slots already booked, for one date or a date range of at most 31 days (time zone of the club in the reply). Needs the Reservation role (Read). GET /api/v1/reservation/availability.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_reservations
tools.title: List active reservations
tools.description: Active court reservations for a reservation period (the dates played) or a created/updated period, at most 31 days each: type, courts, start/end, players with contact details and what they owe/paid. Give at least one period. PIN codes are not returned. Needs the ReservationReport role (Read). GET /api/v1/reservationreport/listactive.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_cancelled_reservations
tools.title: List cancelled reservations
tools.description: Cancelled court reservations by the date they were cancelled or by the reservation period, at most 31 days each. Give at least one period. Needs the ReservationReport role (Read). GET /api/v1/reservationreport/listcancelled.

tools.name: courtreserve_whos_here
tools.title: Who is here
tools.description: Who is booked in a time window (for example today): member reservations and event registrations with the member, court and time, optionally including or only cancelled ones. The window can be at most 31 days. Needs the ReservationReport role (Read). GET /api/v1/reservationreport/whoisheretoday.

tools.name: courtreserve_court_utilization
tools.title: Court utilization
tools.description: Court utilization report (booked vs available time per time slot) for a period of at most 7 days, optionally for chosen courts, court types, event types, event tags or reservation types. Needs the ReservationReport role (Read). GET /api/v1/reservationreport/courtutilization.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_event_categories
tools.title: List event categories
tools.description: Event categories (clinics, round robins, tournaments, open play...) with ids. Needs the EventCalendar role (Read). GET /api/v1/eventcalendar/categories.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: Events on the club calendar between two dates: name, category, start/end, courts, instructors, capacity, registered and waitlist counts, price and rating limits. SSO links are not returned. Needs the EventCalendar role (Read). GET /api/v1/eventcalendar/eventlist.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_event_registrations
tools.title: List event registrations
tools.description: Active registrations for events, clinics and lessons with the member, event and what was paid. Give an event period or a registration period, at most 31 days each. Needs the EventRegistrationReport role (Read). GET /api/v1/eventregistrationreport/listactive.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_event_waitlist
tools.title: List event waitlist
tools.description: People on event waitlists. Give an event period or a registration period, at most 31 days each. Needs the EventRegistrationReport role (Read). GET /api/v1/eventregistrationreport/listwaitlist.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_cancelled_event_registrations
tools.title: List cancelled event registrations
tools.description: Cancelled event registrations by cancellation date or by event date, at most 31 days each. Give at least one period. Needs the EventRegistrationReport role (Read). GET /api/v1/eventregistrationreport/listcancelled.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_checkins
tools.title: List check-ins
tools.description: Check-in report: who checked in to court bookings and events, by check-in period or reservation period (at most 31 days each). Give at least one period. Role: the key's access to attendance data. GET /api/v1/attendancereport/checkin.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_transactions

tools.description: Transactions (fees, membership fees, payments, refunds...) by transaction date or reservation date: id, type, date, subtotal, tax, total, unpaid amount, payment type, category and the member's name, email and phone. Filter by type, paid/unpaid and payment type. Give at least one period. Needs the Transactions role (Read). GET /api/v1/transactions/list.

tools.name: courtreserve_sales_summary

tools.description: Detailed sales summary for a payment period of at most 31 days: paid fees plus refunds by category and payment type. Needs the Transactions role (Read). GET /api/v1/transactions/salessummarydetailed.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_promo_codes
tools.title: List promo codes
tools.description: The club's promo codes: code, name, type, value, dates, limits and what they apply to. Needs the PromoCodes role (Read). GET /api/v1/promocode/get.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_leagues
tools.title: List leagues
tools.description: The club's leagues, with their sessions (id and name) when include_sessions is true (default). Paged. Needs the League role (Read). GET /api/v1/league/get.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_league_sessions
tools.title: List league sessions
tools.description: League sessions, for one league or one session, optionally with their game days and registered players. Paged. Needs the League role (Read). GET /api/v1/league/sessions.

tools.name: courtreserve_cancel_subscription

Which memberships end in the next 30 days, and who has not booked a court in a month?

tools.name: emma_list_groups

tools.name: emma_get_mailing

tools.name: emma_list_mailing_members

tools.name: emma_get_response_summary
tools.title: Account response summary
tools.description: Month-by-month response statistics for the whole account: mailings, sent, delivered, bounced, opened, clicked, forwarded, opt-outs, sign-ups (test mailings excluded).

tools.name: emma_get_mailing_response

tools.name: emma_list_mailing_links

tools.name: emma_list_mailing_activity
tools.title: List mailing activity
tools.description: Who did what with one mailing: members it was sent to (sends), still in the queue (in_progress), delivered or bounced (deliveries), opened (opens), clicked (clicks), forwarded, opted out (optouts) or signed up (signups). Each row has the member's email and timestamp. Paged: use next_start.

tools.name: emma_list_searches
tools.title: List saved searches
tools.description: List the saved searches (dynamic segments) of the account, with their criteria.

tools.name: emma_get_search_members

servers.name: OKSign
servers.description: Read documents, signatures, contacts and credits; manage contacts and remove documents.

login.hint: Find it in your OKsign account under **REST API → API Console**: it is the value of the `x-oksign-authorization` header, three parts joined by semicolons, e.g. `100693;463204-5BC1F362-…;marketing` (add an organizational token there first if you have none). The credentials are used only to call the OKsign API on your behalf; they are never shown to anyone.

tools.name: oksign_get_credits
tools.title: Get credits and storage
tools.description: The account's remaining credits (quantity), when they expire (validuntil), the plan (subscription), whether it is paid, and storage used (account_size) versus the maximum (max_account_size) in bytes. GET /v1/credits/retrieve.

tools.name: oksign_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: The users of the OKsign account: name, email, mobile, role, status, language and the immutable signerid (use it to tell who signed). GET /v1/users/retrieve.

tools.name: oksign_list_email_templates
tools.title: List email templates
tools.description: The email templates defined in the account: id, name, subject, HTML body, reminder_days and repeat. GET /v1/email-templates/retrieve.

tools.name: oksign_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: The account's contact list: name, email, mobile, actingas (capacity) and group. GET /v1/contacts/retrieve.

tools.name: oksign_list_active_documents
tools.title: List active documents
tools.description: Documents in the account's Active Documents tab: docid, filename, creator, createdate, signatures required/valid, orgtoken, status (1 active, 10 briefcase, 11 document in a briefcase, 12 reusable, 14 template), viaapi and signed_docid when signed. OKsign allows this call only once every 3 minutes (429 otherwise). GET /v1/documents/active.

tools.name: oksign_list_signed_documents
tools.title: List signed documents
tools.description: Documents uploaded through the API that were signed between two moments: signed_docid, source_docid, filename, signerid, signing source, signature counts, completed fields, credits per signer and timestamp. Keep the window short; OKsign allows this call only once every 3 minutes (429 otherwise). GET /v1/documents/signed.

tools.name: oksign_list_notification_errors
tools.title: List email and SMS delivery errors
tools.description: Email and SMS delivery problems (hard_bounce, soft_bounce, blocked, spam, invalid_email, deferred) for signing invitations sent between two moments: recipient, source_docid, reason, orgtoken and timestamp. Only error events are reported. OKsign allows this call only once every 3 minutes (429 otherwise). GET /v1/webhooks/retrieve.

tools.name: oksign_document_exists
tools.title: Check a document exists
tools.description: Whether a (signed) document still exists on the platform; returns its filename and whether it is a template. GET /v1/document/exists.

tools.name: oksign_get_document_metadata
tools.title: Get signed document metadata
tools.description: Metadata of a signed document (pass the signed_docid): filename, size, signatures required/valid, who signed, and the values of all completed fields (can contain personal data). Metadata v2. GET /v2/metadata/retrieve.

tools.name: oksign_get_form_descriptor
tools.title: Get a document's form descriptor
tools.description: The form descriptor of an uploaded document: its signature and form fields (type, page, position, signer, required, signing options) and the signing URL of each signer. The URLs let their holders sign, so share them only with the signer. GET /v1/formdesc/retrieve.

tools.name: oksign_get_linked_document
tools.title: Find the source or signed copy of a document
tools.description: Given a source_docid, the signed_docid of its signed copy (absent if not signed yet) and the timestamp; given a signed_docid, the source_docid. An empty result means the document never existed here or was removed. GET /v1/linkedlist/retrieve.

tools.name: oksign_upsert_contacts
tools.title: Add or update contacts
tools.description: WRITE: add contacts to the account's contact list, or update them when a contact with the same email AND name exists (its other fields are replaced). Existing contacts are never cleared. Contacts OKsign rejects are skipped and reported. POST /v1/contacts/upload.

tools.name: oksign_remove_contacts
tools.title: Remove contacts
tools.description: WRITE: permanently remove contacts from the account's contact list. A contact is identified by its email AND name. Cannot be undone (re-add with oksign_upsert_contacts). POST /v1/contacts/remove.

tools.name: oksign_remove_document
tools.title: Remove a document
tools.description: WRITE: permanently remove a (signed) document from the OKsign platform. This deletes the file and its pending webhook events and cannot be undone. A signed document removed right after its callback may answer 'Too soon': retry later. DELETE /v1/document/remove.

servers.name: HireHop
servers.description: Read rental jobs, projects, late returns, contacts, inventory catalogs, depots and notes.

login.hint: In HireHop administrator mode go to **Settings → Users**, select a user, then **Menu → API Token**. HireHop recommends a dedicated API user: logging into that user interactively, changing its email or changing its password invalidates the token. Choose the HireHop host you use and keep the same host when reconnecting to retain your subscription. Your token is used only server-side to access your account. HireHop's limit is 60 API requests per minute and 3 per second; ask for one page at a time.

tools.name: hirehop_get_current_user
tools.title: Get connected user
tools.description: Show the connected HireHop user's ID, company ID, name, email and default depot. Uses the authenticated current-user endpoint; excludes account settings and credentials.

tools.name: hirehop_list_depots
tools.title: List depots
tools.description: List depot IDs, names and whether each is virtual. GET /php_functions/get_depots.php.

tools.name: hirehop_search_jobs
tools.title: Search jobs and projects
tools.description: Search rental jobs and open/closed projects with customer, company, venue or job-name filters. Can filter late returns, money owing or jobs needing an invoice. Returns one page and the vendor's totals; follow pages for a complete report. Dates use depot-local calendar dates.

tools.name: hirehop_get_job
tools.title: Get job
tools.description: Read one rental job's details using its numeric job ID from hirehop_search_jobs. GET /api/job_data.php; returns customer, dates, status and the details available to your user.

tools.name: hirehop_get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: Read a project's details, customer, managers, dates and status. Use its numeric project ID from hirehop_search_jobs. GET /php_functions/project_get_data.php.

tools.name: hirehop_list_project_jobs
tools.title: List project jobs
tools.description: List a single page of the jobs in a project, with vendor totals. Use subsequent pages for the full project. GET /php_functions/projects_jobs_list.php.

tools.name: hirehop_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: Read or search customer, delivery-address and supplier contacts. One page, with vendor paging totals. Hidden/deleted contacts are excluded. GET /modules/contacts/list.php.

tools.name: hirehop_list_products
tools.title: List rental or tracked sales products
tools.description: List rental products or tracked sales products and their categories, IDs, names, part numbers and status. This is a catalog, not a date-specific availability report. One page with vendor totals. GET /modules/stock/asset_assign_list.php.

tools.name: hirehop_list_notes
tools.title: Read record notes
tools.description: Read a page of notes belonging to a job, project, rental inventory product (stock) or asset. Sales inventory notes are not included. Notes can contain HTML. GET /php_functions/notes_list.php. This tool never creates or changes notes.

tools.name: hirehop_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: hirehop_request_feature
tools.title: Request a missing feature
tools.description: Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the HireHop tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: hirehop_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited*)
tools.description: Get Pro: unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month) on HireHop (the free tier caps monthly usage). Plans: "monthly" — $9/month; "yearly" — $90/year (2 months free). Cancel any time: Pro then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. *A fair use limit applies. For heavy use (near Pro's limit): "plus" or "plus_yearly" — Pro+, $39/month or $390/year, unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 100,000 a month); an existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place (needs confirm: true; the price difference for the rest of the period is charged at once). Otherwise returns a short link to open in your browser (it opens Stripe Checkout); after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.

tools.name: hirehop_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel the Pro subscription
tools.description: Cancel the caller's HireHop Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run hirehop_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.
